articleTitle: The Effect of Inflow Foreign Direct Investment on China's Trade Surplus
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The reason why the China's trade surplus is large-scaled and persistent is mainly FDI brought by the global industry transfer. In this paper we not only analyze the impact of FDI on the trade balance of host country from the qualitative perspective, but also adopting SURE to test the relationship between the inflow FDI and the trade surplus in China from the quantitative perspective.

articleTitle: Determination of the Concession Period in a Transportation Infrastructure BOT Scheme Based on CPM Simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The build-operate-transfer (BOT) approach is one of the privatization mechanisms for effectively promoting transportation infrastructure developments by using private funds to construct new infrastructure facilities. But in a BOT scheme, the concession period is important to the host government because it is relative to road toll pricing, construction cost and operation. In this paper, we will develop an optimal road toll pricing models under demand uncertainty for maximize the social welfare. Then, we will simulate the project completion time based on the Monte Carlo method and ensure the construction cost. According to the scope of the profit rate, which is designed for contractors by the host government, we can figure out the scope of the concession period on the basis of the tradeoff of profit and construction cost.

articleTitle: Word Co-Occurrence Network Analysis of Scientific Data Using NWB Tool
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Acquire the metadata of shared scientific data of Earth System Science on the Portal of Chinese Science and Technology Resource, extract field keyword for analysis, then use Network Workbench Tool (NWB Tool) for keyword co-occurrence network analysis. By conducting community detection and network visualization on 5 sub-fields of the acquired data, this paper presents the status and features in each selected sub-field of shared Earth System Science data resources under China Scientific Data Sharing Project (SDSP), this work shows that network analysis and visualization tools of NWB provide effective means for data resource measurement and analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Services Outsourcing Vendors' Capabilities Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper establishes index system of Chinese services outsourcing vendors' capabilities, uses analytic hierarchy process to determine the weight of each level index, establishes the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model of Chinese services outsourcing vendors' capabilities, finally the case study shows that it is reasonable and credible to evaluate Chinese services outsourcing vendors' capabilities with analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation.

articleTitle: A Study of the Information Integrated Approach on CAx and ERP for Aviation Manufacturing Enterprise Based upon PDM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Production data management became the bottleneck of contemporary corporation management, the hot problem on the software exploitation and the information technology (IT) application, and the key on the achievement of information integration for aeronautical manufacturing enterprise. In this paper, the actual needs situations of aviation manufacturing enterprise were analyzed in detail. The PDM architecture on the data-valut and document management, the product configuration management, the workflow and the human & organization management were studied. An analysis approach model on the implement of PDM system was realized and a PDM-based information integrated frameworks on the platform of CAx and ERP was accomplished. Finally, an illustrative example to validate the application and examined its effectiveness was proposed. It is not only fair and reasonable conclusions, but also the improvable agility on product data management which achieved the information exchanging and sharing of group activity in distributing environment, the dynamic adjustment and monitor in the design process.

articleTitle: A Study on Modeling and Measuring the Value Network of Mobile Services
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristics of the mobile service industry and focuses on the coopetition of many actors within the industry to explain the nature of the complex and dynamic mobile services. And the paper proposes a value network model to describe the corresponding relationship between service providers and service modules, which can help to understand the sources of value and competitive advantages. Finally, the paper shows how to measure the value created by the whole network and its actors in theory.

articleTitle: A Study on the Relationship between Tourism Market Demand and Undergraduate Education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, tourism undergraduate education appears atrophic phenomenon, which poses a great challenge to higher education of tourism. Many tourism departments of universities face enormous pressure to survive, and a small number of that is even revoked or suspended. Therefore, tourism development of creative tourism industries set new demands to higher education and provide an opportunity to undergraduate education for the development of tourism - Cultivating versatile, practical and creative talents in tourism.

articleTitle: The Research of the IPO Underpricing in China Growth Enterprise Market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper mainly discusses the IPO underpricing of common stock in China growth enterprise market.IPO underpricing refers to the phenomenon that the pricing of new shares is lower than secondary market. This study explains the diversity and complexity of factors which cause the phenomenon of the IPO underpricing .Studies show when pricing new share, we are prior to considering indicators of corporate earning targets and indicators of firm size, however, in the secondary market, they are indicators of profit targets.

articleTitle: Tourism Recovery Assessment of Sichuan after the Wenchuan Earthquake
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Wenchuan Earthquake of 8.0 on the Richter scale struck western Sichuan, China on May 12, 2008. The earthquake has negatively influenced the development of tourism industry in Sichuan. The recovery period of domestic tourism was ten months, while inbound tourism was still under recovery. The losses of inbound tourists and domestic tourists were 2.7millions (till May, 2010) and 24.6 million, respectively. The economic losses of foreign exchanges and domestic tourists' expenditures were $706.8 millions (till May, 2010) and 27.2 billion yuan RMB, respectively. Tourist attraction business, travel agencies and accommodations have not yet returned to pre-earthquake level. At present, tourism in Deyang, Mianyang, Guangyuan, Neijiang, Aba and Ganzi have not revived. Tourism of Chengdu and Leshan declined in 2008, but re-boomed in 2009. Other sub-regions in Sichuan gained benefits from the earthquake and witnessed the increment of tourists and revenue.

articleTitle: Criticality Analysis in Precedence Networks with Multiple Time-Constraints
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A method for floats computing and activity criticality analysis in precedence networks with multiple time-constraints is proposed in this paper. Different from the traditional CPM networks, the existence of time constraints makes some of activities on the critical path have floats. A procedure for computing temporal parameters in precedence networks with time-constraints is presented, including forward algorithm and backward algorithm. Then five types of floats are defined and analyzed. On the basis of these, activity criticality is analyzed. An example is presented to illustrate the procedure for floats computing and criticality analysis. The method proposed in this paper presents project managers a useful tool to identify activity criticality in precedence networks with time-constraints.

articleTitle: Research on Strategies of Promoting Social Responsibilities of Private Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Currently, private enterprise takes an important role in our national economy. However, under the driven force of "maximum profit", certain private enterprises throw away the social interests and neglect their social responsibility and thus a series of social problems come out with it. This paper mainly analyses several problems when the private enterprise takes the social responsibility. Based on the analysis, this paper is hoped to put forward certain strategies to promote the private enterprise to take more social responsibilities.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Correlation between Environmental Protection and Spillover Effects of Foreign Direct Investment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to analyze the correlation between environmental regulations and foreign direct investment (FDI) technology spillovers. Ordinary least squares regression is applied to empirically study the impacts of environmental regulation to spillover effects of FDI from 1991 to 2009 in China. The results show that foreign direct investment has a significant spillover effects to China's economic growth. Environmental regulation has positive effects on the improvement of FDI spillover effects. The management proficiency of environmental regulation in China needs updated, the technological advance and technology utilization in foreign-funded enterprises should be encouraged, and improve spillover effects of FDI to China's economic growth.

articleTitle: Construct the New Authority System with E-Government Monitoring System Suppressing Authority Corrupt
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The existence of the power loopholes in the supervision system leads to power the corruption that the perpetrator abuse power ridden. build new power operation system, so that the power of people working is programmed normalized, and in the process, the authority's work and efficiency are put into the e-government information monitoring system, forms the counter-corruption authority movement monitoring system of the information science and technology and the accountability mechanism. Eliminate the existence condition of the authority person's illegal recessive benefit ,which is a beneficial attempt to construct the counter-corruption scientific style system under the new situation .

articleTitle: Countermeasure Analysis on the Framework Construction of Regional Talent Market Integration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the perspective of the analysis of regional integration of talents, this paper expounds the significance of regional talents with market integration, explains the connotation and features, and tries to provide theoretical guidance in the process of constructing regional talent market integration framework and establishing a unified, open, competitive and orderly regional talent market based on regional economic theory, market economics theory and talent market theory.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Set Pair Analysis Model for Evaluation of Hospital Medical Service Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Considering the characteristics of multi-objective, multi-index and coexistence of certainty and uncertainties, set pair analysis theory was introduced into evaluation of hospital medical service efficiency. The concept of structural function, that is, identity-discrepancy-contrary connection degree was developed. Based on the set pair theory, the fuzzy set pair analysis evaluation model of hospital medical service efficiency was established. This model was applied to evaluate the service efficiency in hospital D1, D2, D3 and D4. Service efficiency of the four hospitals could be determined objectively and the order preference of service efficiency was gained. The case study shows that this method is scientific, simple, and practical for multi-objective decision-making questions of service efficiency evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on Accounting Information Distortion and Governance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This thesis is focused on player's actions and strategies under irrational institution and procedure which lead to the institutional and intended falsehood. So the behavioral falsehood and falsehood led by human being's limited rationality are excluded. Firstly, this thesis introduce the conception which related on the distortion of accounting information; secondly, we analyze the cause of accounting information distortion; thirdly, this thesis gives some suggestion which is about how to govern the accounting information distortion.

articleTitle: Chinese Political Skills: A Inductive Study in South China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Despite the growing number of studies on the topics of political skill in an organisational context, there is a paucity of research in the South Provinces of the People's Republic of China. This paper critically reviews the extant literature on political skill in human resource management and organisational behaviour and applies an inductive approach to explore the perception of them from both superior and subordinate perspectives. Data collected from 133 employees indicated the existence of seven clusters of behaviours that characterise political skill.

articleTitle: The Benefits and Limitations of Pairwise Understanding of IT Business Value
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Empirical studies examining the business value of information technology have predominantly used pairwise associations between IT and other organizational factors. This paper discusses the main benefits and limitations of this pairwise approach. Based on this understanding, future research in the research domain is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Appraisal System of Guizhou Sante Fan Jing Mountain Tourism Co., Ltd.
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies and re-designs the performance appraisal system, concerning managers, technicians and serving staff of Guizhou Sante Fan Jin Mountain Tourism Co., Ltd. The AHP method is used to determine the weight of each index and 360 degree is introduced to the design process of performance appraisal.

articleTitle: A Method of WEB Security Certification Based on Browser Middleware
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents a method of WEB security certification based on browser middleware. The method aims at that it is not very good in security and is not enough in flexibility to use the HTTP and HTTPS mode based on B/S model, and a method of WEB security certification based on browser JSE middleware is presented using the excellence of browser JSE. This method has good compatibility, extensively and friendly interface and can be used different platform, and it is better to improve the WEB securit y certification and application

articleTitle: Business Advertising Strategy in Co-Marketing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Co-marketing can make cooperative companies complement each other, enhance the competitiveness and achieve win-win. Based on the brief introduction about the benefits and preconditions of implementation of co-marketing, this essay put the emphases on the ways that how to realize the co-marketing successfully through advertising strategies like resource sharing, advantages complementing, brands affiliating and profits sharing.

articleTitle: Researches on Mode of Sharing Service Management of Multinational Corporation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The most outstanding phenomenon of economic globalization is the rapid development of multinational corporations. As a fruitful new management mode, Shared Service Management Mode has become the unanimous choice of multinational corporations in developed countries. By 2010, 80% of the global fortune 500 companies are using Shared Services. 90% of multinational corporations are implementing Shared Services. Its achievements are remarkable, return on investment is improved greatly, cost is reduced, the corporation's flexibility is enhanced and strain capability of business department is improved. Chinese companies' business operation internationalization has achieved rapid development after implementing the Reform and Opening-Up policy. But on the whole, compared with the developed countries, not only the total lags behind, but also the multinational ability in business and management is obviously deficient. To those which have become or plan to become multinationals in China, learning this Shared Service, an advanced management and organization mode, of multinational corporations in developed countries, will greatly help to improve the ability of controlling the global enterprises. The article introduces the classification, function, risk, applicability and operation management of Shared Service Center, discusses method and procedure of implementing Shared Service Center.

articleTitle: How SME Build up Core Competencies to Support Itself Grow Up: A Case Study to Tanzania Firm Kilombero Sugar Company Ltd (KSCL)
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Every company's business consists of a collection of activities undertaken in the course of designing , producing, marketing , delivering and supporting its products or service. Company resource strengths should generally form the cornerstones of strategy because they represent company's best chance for market and growth success. If a company doesn't have the resources and competitive capabilities around which to craft an attractive strategy, manager needs to take decisive remedial action either to upgrade the existing organizational resources and capabilities and add others as needed or to acquire them through partnership or strategic alliance with firms possessing the needed expertise. Basis was formed for assessing and analyzing the policy and programmed support for the development of the enterprise in Tanzania, with a particular focus on supporting growth. The overall findings and recommendations for further actions presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Evolution Mechanism on Integration of Crops Variety R&D and Commercialization: A Research Summary
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In 1990s, the vertical integration development of the international seed industry was accelerated. This paper puts forward a research agenda for evolution mechanism on integration of crops variety R&D and Commercialization from a new perspective on the basis of summary the research both aboard and at home.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Analysis of Papers in the Field of Information Science and Library Science of Mainland China Based on the SSCI Database from 2000 to 2010
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on bibliometric methods, the article makes an analysis on 455 papers published by the scholars of Mainland China (ML) in 66 foreign periodicals in the field of Information Science & Library Science (ISLS) included in Social Sciences Citation Index from 2000 to 2010. A series of quantitative analysis has been made from the aspects of publications, periodicals, affiliation to reflect the current research status and academic ability of Mainland China in the field of ISLS.

articleTitle: Study on Business Performance Correlation of Sporting Goods Manufacturing Enterprise Based on SEM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China is one of the greatest sporting goods consumption and manufacturing country in the world. The sporting goods manufacturing enterprises are palying importantant roles in meetting the growing demand for sports consumption. Restricted by many factors, the business performance (BP) of sports goods manufacturing enterprises are significant differences. This paper studies performance correlation of sporting goods manufacturing enterprise based on SEM. To begin with, it puts forward a conceptual model based on some assumptions. Next, it constructs some latent variables and their observation index system. Then, a case study is given. The results show that: Capital Operation (CO), Debt Level (DL) and Marketing Capability (MC) have significant covariation and that they all have significant positive influence to the business performance of sports goods manufacturing enterprises. The reslut provides a theoretical support to enhance the performance of sports goods manufacturing enterprise.

articleTitle: Research on Building West-Based Service Performance of E-Government - With the Grass-Root Governments of Xi'an Municipality as Case Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the process of institutional transforming pattern and affected by the system constraints and traditional concept, there still exists a big problem in providing the electronic service capacity and level by the local governments in west China. The construction of government portal website in particular is difficult to satisfy the growing demands of the masses of the people. Through the performance-based evaluation of the government websites by EXCEL, it is considered that only by accelerating the specifications and in-depth information open can the communication channel with the social public be established and improved so as to attract the public attention and to pay much more attention to the effects of interacting exchanges. Accordingly, it is only by strengthening website design and Improving the Institute of Politics and Law deep emotion and close relation of website with the people that can the public service demands by the average citizens are satisfied.

articleTitle: On Economic Lot Sizes with Quantity and Freight Discounts: The Mixed Discount Cases
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Previous studies have incorporated both quantity and freight discounts into various inventory models and developed algorithms to determine the optimal lot sizes for all the possible discount configurations. In this study, for the cases where quantity discounts are either of the all-units or the incremental type and freight discounts are of the opposite type, we first conduct numerical experiments to show that the existing algorithm may lead to a suboptimal solution, and then modify the key steps for the existing algorithm to obtain the global optimal solution.

articleTitle: On the Cooperation Mechanism between Government and Non-Profit Organizations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The cooperation between government and non-profit organizations is formed in the process of cognitive development and interaction. In reality, there are various relationships such as rivalry, competition, independence, dependence and cooperation. Though the cooperation of government and non-profit organizations in china is in the primary stage, the strategic and collaborative partnership will be formed if they can stick to interaction under the guidance of public interests. As for the government, it is necessary to change the positioning for the non-profit organizations, complete the legislation for the development of non-profit organizations, reform on the "government-run" organizations and promote the development of grassroots ones. While the non-profit organizations should strengthen their institutional improvement, seek for service places and define service objects, play the role of expressing interests to become one channel for the public to express their interests and reduce the response cost to the public services provided by the government, and take the responsibility of production and supply of some public goods such as policy making.

articleTitle: Human Capital Accumulation, Economic Growth and Social Harmony in Rural China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the relation among the accumulation of human capital, economic growth and social harmony in rural China based on a cointegration analysis and Granger causality test model. The analysis demonstrates equilibrium among them in the long periods. In the short periods economic growth and social harmony will change 0.48 and 2.38 separately if human capital accumulation in rural China changes every other unit, as the cause of the recent increase in inequality in China. In the long periods imbalance among the three variables will disappear by adjustment for 29 years by about 6.9% biennially. Our findings suggest that economic growth is developmental cause of human capital accumulation in rural areas both in the long term and in the short term. On the contrary, human capital accumulation in rural China just impulses economic growth in the long term since its lagged development makes itself not to release pulling role effectively. Study also shows human capital accumulation does not cause income gap between urban and rural areas. Reversely, the latter will affect the former in the long term, which maybe plays referenced roles for plans and policies. The results of VECM analysis suggest that the goal of quadrupling the farmers' per capita net income of the year 2008 by 2020 put forward by the CPC has its scientific reasons.

articleTitle: Customer Satisfaction Index Model Building and Empirical Research of Sports Fitness and Entertainment Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Adopting questionnaire, comparison, logic analysis and other methods, analyzed the customer satisfaction index model building of fitness and entertainment industry. This paper proposed the corporate image, the customer expectation, customer perceived quality were the effects of customer satisfaction logical reasons, due to customer satisfaction which invites the customer trust and loyalty, using the structural equation tested the relation of the paths. It is concluded that the relationship between foster loyal customers should be the purpose of current fitness and entertainment enterprise operation and management.

articleTitle: Retailer's Shelf-Space and Pricing Decisions under Revenue Sharing Contracts
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In some retail contexts, retailers can often stimulate product sales by offering a price discount or allocating more shelf or display space. The retailer's shelf-space and pricing decisions can affect not only the retailer's profitability but also the supplier's profitability. This paper investigates the impact of revenue sharing contracts on the retailer's shelf-space and pricing decisions. Consider a two-echelon supply chain with a supplier supplying a certain product to a retailer facing non-linear inventory holding costs and the customer demand that depends on both the price of the product and the shelf space allocated. We firstly provide the equilibrium of the optimal decisions of the retailer and the supplier when no revenue sharing contract is offered. Then we consider the case where the supplier replenishes the retailer's shelf under a revenue sharing contract. It is shown that a properly designed revenue sharing contract can increase the profit of the manufacture, comparing to the benchmark case. Finally we conclude that revenue sharing contracts still can not coordinate the supply chain.

articleTitle: The Empirical Research of Contrarian and Momentum Strategies in Chinese Stock Market (1993-2010)
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the EMH (Efficient Market Hypothesis), the price of stock should reflect available information correctly and quickly, investors can not obtain the abnormal return based on the past stock return. However, in the recent years, many practitioners and academics found there are some anomaly phenomenon existed in the stock market which caused strong debate with EMH (Efficient Market Hypothesis), such as continuation return and reversal return. Then, continuation return and reversal return can cause the momentum and contrarian investing strategies, respectively. If the momentum and contrarian trading strategies can generate abnormal return, it means the market is efficient. On the other hand, whether momentum and contrarian trading strategies can effect in some country's stock market, which is very important for individual and institutional investors. After China joined into WTO, which has played an important role in global stock market. Therefore, in this paper, following the method examined by Jegadeesh and Titman (2001), we studied the effects of momentum and contrarian trading strategies in the China's stock market over 17 - year from 1994 to 2010.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Enterprises' E-Commerce Operational Performance Factors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to reveal enterprises' e-commerce operational performance, the regression measurement model is used in this paper. By model deduction and model validation, the model can effectively reveal the corresponding factors which can affect enterprises' e-commerce operational performance. For illustration, 100 professional teachers with a certain academic e-commerce specialty from many universities in different countries were selected and 60 effective questionnaires were selected in the recovery of the 87 questionnaires returned. The empirical results show that such elements as logistics, social credit cultivation, social information level, business website improvement, e-commerce legislation construction and security model improvement and other elements have a direct action in promoting the improve the e-commerce operation performance. The professional cultivation and product standardization does not play a substantive function. The empirical research has revealed that enterprises should strengthen the construction of product standardization and improve the efficiency of training professionals in order to improve the e-commerce operational efficiency.

articleTitle: The Satisfaction Evaluation of New-Countryside's Green Community Based on SEM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the process of New-countryside construction, green community is a developing mode that can harmonize economic factory and ecological factory. New-countryside green community's design was influenced by many factories, such as humanistic image, ecological image, economic conditions, etc. Structural equation model (SEM) is known as covariance structure analysis or linear structure modeling. It can quantitative evaluate the complex relationship between multi-factor. SEM can fit the resident satisfaction and its influence factors into a system, and analyze the variable (people expect, residents perceived) and the relationship between resident satisfaction. Evaluating the resident satisfaction by SEM can provide the basis to design of new-countryside' green community.

articleTitle: The Establishment and Assessment of Medium-Sized and Small Enterprises Environmental Evaluation Index System - Based on the Empirical Analysis around the Cities of Jiangsu
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, the connotation and extension of business environment for SMEs at home and abroad remain greater differences. This article drew on the research framework of Global Entrepreneurship Monitor (GEM), combined with practical research, established entrepreneurial environment evaluation index system for SMEs, and conducted Positive Analysis through a combination of data around the city of Jiangsu Province, verified the evaluation index system was scientific and rationality to some extent and could be used as environment assessment model selection of small and medium business.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Chinese Government Cost of Administrative Expenses
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the reality of government administrative expenses, the article designed the theoretical models of government administrative expenses to predict the future cost of government--the basic criteria for administrative expenses, and came up with the corresponding proposes according to the basic analysis of Chinese government's expenses. The basic idea is based on the actual expenditure of the Chinese Government's administrative expenses from 1978 to 2006 to establish the corresponding theoretical model and test, then according to 30 years of practice, to predict the basic bottom line the future expense of the Chinese government.

articleTitle: The Empirical Research of Information Technology Construction and Core Competence
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to study information technology construction and core competence in China's coal industry, structural equation model (SEM) is used in this paper. By model theory, research assumptions, model construction, model validation and SEM can effectively reveal the microscopic mechanism of information technology construction and core competence. For illustration, 297 samples were selected from medium-sized independent accounting of state-owned coal mining enterprises, in which 253 valid data were obtained. The empirical results show that the observed ratio of sample size and the number of indicators was about 8:1, which can meet the basic requirements for verification of structural equation. Five Cronbach a coefficient of latent variable minimum value of were 0.867, which meant that survey results had higher reliability. After model updating, the covariance of organizational learning (ξ1) and information technology (ξ2) was 0.56, the minimum of 20 factor loading was 0.55, and the minimum of T value was 2.1.The empirical research results have revealed that there is a certain correlation between China's coal industries, organizational learning and information technology.

articleTitle: Network Competence: The Conception and the Functional Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Network competence means not only having qualifications but also using or having the potential to use the qualifications. The network competence is a three-dimensional construct that can be defined as network qualifications competence, network management competence and network development competence. By resource capture and transfer, relationship integration and innovation, there is the functional mechanism on network competence. Network competence can be also enhanced by favorable network positions, network learning capabilities and innovative network.

articleTitle: Study of Residential Real Estate Based on the Customer Satisfaction Index
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of real estate industry, customer satisfaction plays a very big role for enterprises. Residential real estate has entered a stage of rapid development in our country after this country completed the residence distribution system; simultaneously the market competition is also getting intense day by day. The organiza¬tion should have better understanding of the real needs of the customers and to locate the most popular residential projects in the perspective of the customers based on grey comprehensive evaluation. By analyzing the result, the enterprises will comprehensively consider the needs of the customers and pay more attention to what the customers valued most in the future development, so to improve the satisfactory products for customers.

articleTitle: Integration and Optimization Analysis of Ecological Industry Chain of Mining Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On one hand, the integration of ecological industry chain in mining area is affected by technology development level, market demand, industrial policy and the use of products, by-products and wastes. On the other hand, it is also limited by the optimal production scale, the inflows and outflows of the resources of industry units. Therefore, through the integration of optimal production scale of industry units, optimization analysis of the inflows and outflows of resources, and the establishment of environmental control indexes and comprehensive benefit control index and resource flowing control indexes, we can judge the feasibility and necessity of the integration of the ecological industry chain scientifically.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation of TPL Logistics Service Quality on the Basis of the Language OWA Operator and Customer Perception
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Logistics activities are generally characterized by its dynamic and complexity. The measure of its services quality is often difficult to be quantified and can only be evaluated through customer perception in vague language. Based on customers' satisfaction of Logistics service quality, this paper presents a evaluating method of comprehensive multi-attribute group-made decision based on language ordered weighted average (OWA) operator to achieve the effective evaluation of TPL logistics service quality. And through building evaluation index system from the three dimensions of logistics service performance, process, capacity, this paper makes a positive analysis to illustrate operation of the method.

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Disposal Mode of Metro Fire
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Accurate and timely emergency measures can effectively control the fire and reduce casualties. In this paper, the two similar metro arson cases with totally different casualties were compared, and their emergency measures were examined. The reasonable emergency disposal mode of metro fire is advanced.

articleTitle: Intra-Product International Specialization, Global Value Chain and China's Manufacturing Industries Upgrading
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the theory of global value chain and the process in which the value hierarchy of global value chain matches the global hierarchy of comparative advantages throughout the world is also the process of global vertical separation and spatial reconstruction of the value nodes in the network of intra-product international specialization. Currently, there exists the possibility for the developing countries located at the low-end position of the global value chain to upgrade, and the specialization at different nodes of value chain of the manufacturing industry has become the mainstream of modern international specialization in manufacturing industry. China's manufacturing sectors need to make full use of its own comparative advantages, including abundant labor resources, powerful manufacturing capacity and vast market, and to actively integrate into the system of global value chain dominated by transnational corporations. And only by mastering the core technology through innovation and by possessing independent intellectual property rights could China hold the strategic high ground in the new-type international specialization.

articleTitle: Research on Incentive Mechanism Based on Inter-Temporal Choice Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Traditional incentive theory is built on the assumption of rational agents. In this paper, inter-temporal choice theory is introduced to reflect time preference of agents while they make decisions. For agents with dynamic inconsistency, dynamic gaming models are established under performance incentive and stock option incentive mechanisms. The results are different comparing to those of traditional incentive theory and provide a more realistic approach to study employment contract.

articleTitle: The Effect Analysis of Adjustment and Monitoring Based on the AR(2) Process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The effect of adjustment and monitoring method was discussed for autocorrelation based on the process AR(2). In the method, the autocorrelation is removed by introducing the MMSE adjustment method. The model of the process mean drift is analysis in the adjustment. The influence of S/N, ARL and alarm probability is studied for process mean drift in the control chart. The phenomena are found that the drift can be detected in the start or it is difficult to be detected in other time. The phenomena depend on the autocorrelation and process mean drift mode. The drift mode of process mean is crucial for the phenomena.

articleTitle: An Exploration of New Educational Patterns for Patent Vocational Community in the New Information Age
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Intellectual property has been one of the most critical factors for a nation to boost its competitiveness. As the core of intellectual property, patent serves as the foundation for developing and operating intellectual property and building the innovation capacity of the country. Above all, the formation and development of educational pattern for patent vocational community is particularly critical. This paper focuses on the base of formation of patent vocation community, and the challenges faced by patent professionals, as well as their career options. And then it analyzes the shortcomings existed in China's current educational modes for Patent Professionals. At the end, it provides suggestions for developing new educational patterns for patent vocational community.

articleTitle: On Moral Hazard Management in Social Medical Insurance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Social medical insurance system is an important system to guarantee labors' basic medical needs. Due to the complicated relations involved, the problem of moral hazard in social medical insurance is quite outstanding, which would influence the normal operation of its system. This paper aims to list some forms of moral hazard in social medical insurance, analyses causes for moral hazard from various angles and puts forward such solutions as establishing credit system, perfecting social medical insurance system and reducing information asymmetry.

articleTitle: Countermeasures on PFI Financing Mode in Urban Infrastructures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the SWOT analytical tool, the paper has analyzed the strengths and weaknesses in PFI mode and the opportunities and threats in the implementation of PFI financing in our urban infrastructures. The author puts forward a variety of countermeasures to promote PFI mode in our country and the achievement of this paper can be used for reference on how to introduce PFI to the construction of urban infrastructure.

articleTitle: The Competency Level Measurement and Analysis of Marketing Personnel in Xi'an Equipment Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the competency test model of Marketing Personnel in Xi'an Equipment Manufacturing Industry, taking the automotive manufacturing industry, distribution and control equipment manufacturing industry, motor manufacturing industry in Xi'an as an example, we use questionnaires measuring competency levels of marketing personnel in Xi'an equipment manufacturing industry in this paper. The results showed that competency levels above the average level, different industries, work experience, education and age, marketing personnel competency level were significantly different.This paper studies Marketing Personnel Competency Test questionnaire , revealing the scale for quality level and its characteristics, build competency benchmark standards of Xi'an equipment manufacturing industry enterprise.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysing on Cooperative Innovation with Simple Imitating and Training
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The cooperative innovation is somewhat a prisoners' dilemma. If enterprises of an innovation game have the static dominant rationality, the game will get a result called "dominant equilibrium",no one wants to innovate. To walk out of the dilemma, players should change either environment or themselves. Game trainers can't use infinite repeated training to effect learners. Training should be limitted and training behaviour may change according to the game context .

articleTitle: Discussing on Pollution Sources, Status and Control Countermeasures of Uranium Mine in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Environmental issues result from uranium mining have been a great problem facing the mining industry in china. The need to control or prevent pollution led to carry out environmental research. This paper describes the pollution sources, their environmental impacts, options about pollution control, and the available control strategies.

articleTitle: The Empirical Studies of Innovative Technology Source, Learning Mode and Innovative Performance Relation on Technology-Based SMEs
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The essence of technology innovation is the updating of knowledge and the technology source of enterprises innovation are multi-channeled. Different learning and innovation mode are needed to digest, assimilate and re-innovate the techniques which come from different sources. Based on the definitions about learning and innovation mode of Denmark scholars such as Jensen,Lorenz and Lundvall, the author concluded the techniques source channel and learning mode of technology-based SMEs (small and medium enterprises) when they implemented the technology innovation fund project and he believed that the enterprises will get higher innovation performances when they adopted and digested the technology by using the suitable learning mode adapted to the technology source.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Shared Memory in the Account Management System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The account management system is the core part of telecom billing management system. This paper presents a account management approach based on shared memory technology, according to the status of telecom account system as well as the characteristics and requirements of the account management system.The method of processing account in the shared memory can achieve the accessing data and processing data separation. It is not only slow down the pressure of the database, but also accelerated the speed of the account.

articleTitle: Evolvement and Structure of Cluster: A Research Based on Tiexi Equipment Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To a certain extent the concentration effect was formed at the beginning of the founding of the century, which Generally Tiexi Equipment Manufacturing Industrial Cluster experienced three main development stages: Old industrial area in fluctuation, Reform period driven by system and technology innovation, and Cluster effect release period. In cluster large enterprises, supporting institutions, and public management, play important role. However, how to construct a mechanism that can support cluster continuous innovation is still a tough task.

articleTitle: Mode of the Multi-Objective Optimization of SITS Operation Network Plan Based on NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: SITS(shipping intelligent transportation system) operation is complex problem for decision making, which plays an important role in our country's society and economy as well as in our multi-modal transportation system. Based on the analysis of network planning optimization method for SITS operation, this paper establishes the quality - duration - the cost optimization model with the characteristics of network planning for SITS operation. Then it proposes the multi-objective optimization method based on NSGA-II. The method is GA that using non-dominated sort about crowding distance and elitism strategy. Through chromosome coding based on process, it optimizes the search space of solution. With the roulette wheel selection, arithmetic crossover and mutation operation, this paper gets the Pareto optimal solution collection that can allow decision-makers to choose. At last, an example confirms that the optimization method can solve the Pareto optimal solution collection from establishing the optimization model, using MATLAB7.0 simulation program.

articleTitle: Early Warning of the Financial Risk Based on Combination Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new model, called as PCA-LSSVM was investigated. The model is fit for company in the small sample space. It uses PCA to predigest the input vector and uses LSSVM to judge the statement of the company risk. With the model, one or more listed company could be selected in textile industry, and the defects in resolving early warning of the financial risk with traditional algorithm model could be omitted. The application case proved that the proposed method can improve the feasibility of the program in financial risk, and it is suitable for on-line financial risk control.

articleTitle: The Multipolynomial Approximations and Inverse and Boundary Value Problems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: All the published algorithms for a solution of the inverse problems of dynamics are grounded on a definition of a minimum of sum of squares of discrepancy - the minimum of the price function. Thenumerical method of the definition of the minimum demands to guess the first approximation. Thepaper suggests to use the new method of multipolynomial approximations (the MPA - algorithm) which do es not demand the definition of the minimum of the goal function. Vector estimations approximate an optimum vector estimations which are a optimal mean square as it are the vector of a conditional expectation. The algorithm approved at solutions of inverse problems i. the estimation of function the flexural rigidity of the beam for the steady-state Euler-Bernoulli beam equation, ii. the estimation of coefficients of equations of the attractor from electrical engineering blocks.

articleTitle: Systems and Policies for Undertaking the International Expansion of Producer Services
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The favorable policies and systems are the necessary development conditions of producer service industry in its international expansion tide. Policy and system arrangement includes two aspects: system and policy. The former includes relaxing services market access, promoting service systematic reform, intensifying to encourage foreign services into the local industry and introducing advanced technology, etc. The latter includes strengthening policies to support the development of service industry by providing funds, actively guiding credit capital and social capital investment into producer services, and accelerating the implementation of project impetusing, establishing a sound service coordination mechanism, optimizing the service environment, strengthening services market supervision, strengthen the training and introduction of talents, strengthening statistics and analysis work for the service development.

articleTitle: Talent Demand Forecast in the "Twelfth-Five" Period of TangShan City
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The next 10 years, Tangshan is in a critical period of promoting scientific development,realizing the wealthy and strong city, and building a moderately prosperous society. Today,some question exit in Tangshan's human resource,such as inadquation of talent quantity,acute shortage of high-level personnel.,irrational structure and distribution of talent, a lower of innovation capability of talentand ,imperfection of Human environmen.This paper using regression predicts the demand of talents of Tangshan City in the "12th Five-Year" period, in order to provide a theoretical basis for government's strategic decisions.

articleTitle: Study on Strategy of ERP Implementation in Small and Medium-Sized Manufacturing Enterprises in Northern Jiangsu Area, China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From research background and current situation at home and abroad,based on an investigation on status of ERP implementation in Small and Medium-sized Manufacturing Enterprises(SMMEs) in Northern Jiangsu Area,China,this paper analyzes successful experience on ERP implementation of SMMEs Who have Succeeded in ERP Implementation,main causes responsible for failure of ERP Implementation of SMMEs Who have Failed in ERP Implementation,and main problems of enterprises who have never started ERP implementation and main reasons for them not using ERP.After that,this paper provides strategies of ERP implementation in SMMEs from 3 aspects(such as project organization,Step-by-step implementation,and sustainable use) in Northern Jiangsu Area,China,in order to provide a useful reference for ERP providers and SMMEs in underdeveloped areas domestic on ERP implementation and application.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithms for Optimal Fuzzy-Connective-Based Aggregation Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Multilayer fuzzy connective-based hierarchical aggregation networks simulate the decision-making processes performed by humans, and the results can be interpreted as a set of rules. Identifying the relative importance of the inputs helps to identify redundancies that do not contribute to the decision-making process. However, a gradient-based learning approach tends to generate local solutions, and requires the aggregation function to be continuous and differentiable. This study proposes a GA-based learning approach to identify the connective parameters, exploiting the global exploration ability of GAs to improve the quality of solutions. This approach does not require gradient information, making it applicable to both differentiable and nondifferentiable aggregation functions. Statistical analysis of the experimental results confirms that the proposed approach outperforms the gradient-based learning approach, generating more accurate estimates for both generalized mean and gamma operators.

articleTitle: Research on the Key Factors of Tourism Sudden Accident Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Tourism sudden accident has serious consequences. Thus, academic circles and business community put the research interest on the tourism sudden accident. At present, a lot of research relative with tourism sudden accident are focused on emergency management. Based on the large different kinds of tourism sudden accidents, the four key factors of tourism sudden accident diffusion is concluded in this paper. These four key factors are tourism sudden accidents, diffusion channel, diffusion time and diffusion system.

articleTitle: Systematic Analysis on the Factors That Influenced the Service Quality of the Domestic Travel Agency
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service quality controlling is one of the most important questions in travel agency's running. The paper holds the points that the factors which influence the service quality of travel agency are pluralistic and multi-intensity. It divides all the factors into three categories: the controllable, the half-controllable and the uncontrollable factors. The controllable factors should be pay more attention in a travel agency's running.

articleTitle: The Application of Statistics and Analyzes in the Ultrasound Diagnosis Digital Management System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The ultrasonic diagnosis digital management system is a computer technology and the technology of ultrasound B-mode scan diagnosis machine, deploysthe digital management of image data and ultrasonic diagnosis medical history. This paper mainly discusses how to adopt the computer statistics analysis technique carries on the medical science Mathematical Statistics of automation to a great deal of patient's medical history, image data information and other medical science parameters that the system has been already collected and provides the data for the academic research of medical science professional personnel.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Service System in Open Innovation Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After discussing the literature of open innovation and the existing problems, the whole framework of knowledge service system in open innovation environment was proposed, and further, the system structure, related mechanism and Wiki-based collaborative ontology annotation (WCOA) technology of knowledge service system was analyzed. The intention was to provide a solution to enhance open innovation ability for enterprises.

articleTitle: Analyse on Export Competitiveness Influence Factors in the Background of Economic Crisis - A Case Study of Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, Zhejiang's exports continued to grow rapidly, becoming the main force of economic development in open economy. However, with the spreading of the U.S. "subprime crisis " and the global economic crisis, the global economy fall into recession which inevitably affected the export trade. This paper endeavors to propose some suggestions on enhancing export competitiveness of Zhejiang , based on the actual situation of Zhejiang's exports and the analysis of the factors of the export competitiveness during the economic crisis.

articleTitle: Research on Differences Evaluation of Economic Development Level between Cities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the deepening of reform and opening up, the economic development gap between several cities is widening, the imbalance in regional economic development is becoming increasingly prominent. This paper discussed the regional economic difference and regional model division by the qualitative analysis method with factor analysis and cluster analysis. Revealing the gap in unbalanced regional economic development, the paper puts forward the countermeasures and suggestions of regional economic development.

articleTitle: A Learning Theory of the Corporation Governance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, I find that in the corporation governance literatures the research of corporation governance learning is a gap and that the corporate governance is as a learning process. I present the assumption of governance man and a learning theory of the corporation governance. The corporation governance learning is a force not to be ignored, sometime it determine the corporation success or failure, especially for the corporate governance in developing countries or in the non-leader companies in the development countries.

articleTitle: Corporate Governance, Uncertainty and the Value of Cash Holdings - Based on Preliminary Evidence of Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper selects listed company data of A share from 1999 to 2008, explores the relationship among different levels of corporate governance, uncertainties of macro/ industry/ individual and the value of corporate cash holding. The results show that enterprises are facing higher degree of uncertainty, the higher the value of its cash holdings, this higher level of corporate governance reflects the more significant positive relationship.

articleTitle: Air Material Support Optimal Strategy Based on Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Air material is important for the aircraft and air force, and its supply and support situation will affect the fighting strength. In this paper, the air material support based on supply chain management is firstly established. Secondly, in order to make full use of the logistics information, an integrated information flow mode is proposed to coordinate command information on the supply chain. Finally, a direct distribution system is analyzed and set up for rapid support of air material.

articleTitle: On the Problems and Tactics of Technology Innovation of Small and Medium Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Small and medium enterprises play an important role in driving the persistent development of China's economy, and the development of small and medium enterprises relies on technology innovation. From the present whole situation, the level of technology innovation of China's small and medium enterprises is not still high, which has become the most outstanding factor restricting the development of China's small and medium enterprises. Based on the analysis on the present situation of technology innovation of small and medium enterprises, this paper makes an systematical analysis on the problems and the difficult positions during the technology innovation of small and medium enterprises. From the building of service system, macroscopic system, microcosmic innovation system and idea, and the evading of management risk in technology innovation, it puts forward some tactics to solve the problems of technology innovation of China's small and medium enterprises.

articleTitle: Analysis on Problems of Service FDI in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using the data of foreign direct investment (FDI) in China from 1979 to 2009 and the quantitative analysis method, this paper analyzes the situation and existing problems of service FDI in China. The results show that service FDI in China has been developed rapidly since 1992, the growth rate of service FDI is higher than that of total FDI in recent years, and the proportion of service FDI to total FDI has gradually increased. However, the absolute scale of service FDI is still small, the proportion of service FDI to total FDI is still too low when compared with developed countries', and the share of the contribution to the increase of total FDI is very unstable. Meanwhile, the industrial structure of service FDI is not reasonable and excessively concentrates on the social service sectors such as real estate, leasing and business services, and wholesale and retail.

articleTitle: The Job Burnout in College Teachers and the Management Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From the angle of Management Psychology, The survey discusses the correlations between job burnout in college teachers and their physical exercise by means of "Maslach Burnout Inventory-General Survey" (MBI-GS) and "Physical Activity Rating Scale" (PARS), in which 515 college teachers are involved. The findings indicate the status of job burnout in college teachers is not severe according to theoretical value, but as for the dimension of "emotion exhaustion", the subjects get a higher score with the implicit feature. Physical exercise intensity, duration, frequency and exercise quantity are significantly negatively related to job burnout, and exercise quantity and intensity can come into the regression equation of the total score of job burnout; generally speaking, college teachers' physical exercise status is grim. Based on the result, some management strategies are proposed.

articleTitle: Construction of Low-Carbon Lifestyle Based on the Internet
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article analyzes low-carbon lifestyle and characteristics of five dimensions of Internet-based lifestyle on the basis of division of lifestyle into attitude, behavior, time, space, and matter. Internet-based lifestyle is a low-carbon lifestyle. But it can hardly sustain because of the unhealthy and incomplete configurations. An example from online network, the article initials a new era of constructing an Internet-based, healthy, sustainable lifestyle.

articleTitle: Interorganizational Cost Management in Supply Chain Based on Open Book Accounting
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Supply chain developments demand the introduction of new management accounting techniques alongside traditional reporting systems. Interorganizational cost management(ICOM) can be defined as buyers' and suppliers' coordinated efforts to reduce costs. Open book accounting(OBA) is a strategy that leads towards co-operation between firms situated in a supply chain. To date, it has been analyzed by a small number of studies that addressed current practice and implementation cost management in supply chain. From this view, the paper analyse ICOM circumstance, techniques, and construct a application framework of cost management in supply chain based on open book Accounting.

articleTitle: Influence of Environmental Regulations on FDI in Jiangsu
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, multiple linear regression model is established to analyze the influence of environment regulation on FDI in Jiangsu. Results show that the regression coefficient sign of environmental regulation stringency (InXREGU), the main explanatory variable is negatively correlated, the same as expected. But the coefficient (-0.35) is small , indicating that environmental regulations has a negative impact on FDI but the impact is not significant.

articleTitle: Being Human-Oriented, Constructing Harmonious Urban Traffic
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Constructing harmonious traffic is the momentous content of building socialistic harmonious society.Traffic problems in Chinese cities are mainly embodied in the contradictions between the increasing traffic requirements of people and the traffic supply can not meeting the requirements. Therefore harmonious urban traffic should be constructed on human-oriented, solving the contradictions between the traffic requirements and the traffic supply of people. Only when people in traffic syetem have harmonious traffic consciousness and go to action can harmonious traffic truly put into effect.

articleTitle: Research on Relations between Fair Value and Stock Value
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The enterprise market value includes the fair value of net assets, the fair value of residual income, and the impact of Non-Economic Factors on share prices. In addition to the fair value of net assets, the measurement of enterprise excess profitability (Self-created Goodwill) could revise the differences between the fair value of financial statements' items and the stock value, and help the fair value to regain the value relevance. The Non-Economic Factors should be considered not only during the value relevance test, but also when to explain the results.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis of Knowledge Conversion Based on Reciprocal Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to reveal knowledge conversion effect under reciprocal enterprise environment, structural equation modeling (SEM) is used in this paper. By model deduction and model validation, SEM can effectively reveal the incentive function of mutual motivation to mutual behavior as well as the incentive function of reciprocal preferences to knowledge conversion. For illustration, 300 questionnaires were distributed among senior management in enterprises. 276 questionnaires returned, and survey data had the higher reliability. The empirical results show that three paths (ξ1 → η 1, ξ 1 → η 4, ξ 2 → η 3) were the lack of significant coefficients. The model was well fitted without the need for model updating. The empirical research has revealed that the reciprocal corporate culture will strengthen and improve mutual knowledge conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on Impact from Land Use/Cover Change on Eco-Economic Harmony
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The harmonious development of ecological economy is the core matter of society sustainable development and the ultimate way of human development. Land use patterns as the most significant ties of interaction between human and nature reflect the situation of eco-environmental protection and economic development. In view of this, the paper attempted to make a study on the situation of eco-environmental protection and economic development by eco-economic harmony in Tongshan, Jiangsu Province. Firstly, the ecological service value from 1998 to 2007 in Tongshan County are calculated by using Costanza formula and land use/land cover changes data, and the dynamic changes of eco-economic harmony from 1998 to 2007 in Tongshan were got by combining the GDP and land use /cover changes. Then the paper analyzed the eco-economic harmony of Tongshan County and its different townships from 1998 to 2007, and explained changes based on actual situation of Tongshan County. Finally, it was found that the eco-economic harmony from 1998 to 2007 "first ascended and then descended" in a U-shape. According to the eco-economic harmony in 1998, 2002 and 2007, the eco-economic harmony of northeast of Tongshan County that is rich in natural resources is inferior to flat-bottomed land in the northwest, southeast.

articleTitle: Empirical Study of Firm's Competition Awareness and Innovation Performance in the Alliances
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There is co-petition in the technology alliances. The correlation between competition awareness and innovation performance in the process of knowledge transfer within the alliance is studied in the paper. The empirical study collects data from 131 firms located in Liaoning Province area in China, and the hypothesis of the correlation are tested with Structural Equation Modeling. The result shows that the competition awareness of the firm positively and significantly correlates with its innovation performance.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Hotel Employee Satisfaction Based on Factor Analysis - A Case Study of Changjiang Hotel
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Hotel employee satisfaction has been the focus of hotel management,20 variable factors which affect employee satisfaction are achieved by analyzing employee satisfaction of Changjiang hotel. These variable factors are analysed by SPSS, Five factors are extracted by factor analysis, including work environment, incentives, work intensity, career planning, job stress,reliability analysed followed. Then the evaluation model of employee satisfaction of Changjiang hotel is constructed on the basis of empirical analysis. Finally, the suggestions how to improve employee satisfaction are proposed at the base of empirical research so as to strengthen the management, and promote the quality of hotel service. These are several measures for hotel to improve the employee satisfaction so as to provide high quality services for guests.

articleTitle: The Three-Stage Game between Contractor, Supervisor and Owner
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using game theory, the paper discusses the collusion between the contractor and supervisor as well as the action of owner. According to the judgment of the probability which the supervisor accepts the contract's bribe, the owner gives his strategy. So supervisor judges the owner's conduct to decide how to do. And then contractor makes the decision whether bribe or not. Therefore, all the strategies of players are discussed.

articleTitle: Construct a Comprehensive Development Platform on the Role of Graduate Studies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Innovative grass-roots organizations working to advance and promote the comprehensive development of students, more and more universities have begun into the community; build relationships with a number of units established. However, some co-construction and in the actual operations of easy to build in practice, exist cooperation insufficiently effect not prominent issues. Shanghai university postgraduates at school of electrical and mechanical engineering and automation according to former President Qian Weichang training " comprehensive development of the people " philosophy of education, science and engineering postgraduate education concepts, combining the actual situation, with several units established a long-term relationship, and the co-construction and form a new kind of co-constructing and platform. Practice shows that this platform widely range of social growth of postgraduate education, which greatly enhances the party organization's cohesive force and the combat efficiency, make science and engineering postgraduate can give full play to their strengths and characteristics of all development of their playing an important role.

articleTitle: On Realization of Self-Adaptive Personalized Knowledge Service Based on Context Aware
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In Web2.0, users become the adaptive agents of knowledge architecture. As a result, knowledge architectu­re and services get restored to their original state of human-oriented and furthermore, personal knowledge architecture becomes a process of self-organization. This provides a favorable condition under which we can expect to develop a self-adaptive personalized knowledge service system based on context-aware. However, the implementa­tion of such a system will not be possible without utilizing the standard semantics descriptions and inferences from ontology when processing knowledge items and context information.

articleTitle: Use Postponement Strategy to Control Ordering Modification Risk for Collaborative Production Scheduling in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper selects the ordering modification risk as a study point, which has a significant impact on the overall efficiency of the supply chain. First, it pointed out the causes of ordering modification risk, analyzed the role of postponement strategy in supply chain management, then proposed risk control measures by using postponement strategy, and the process of risk management. Finally, by the application of postponement strategy in a clothing enterprise, we can see that postponement strategy can effectively control ordering modification risk for collaborative production scheduling in supply chain.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Service Quality of Restaurant Enterprise Based on SERVQUAL
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Evaluation method of service quality of restaurant is studied in this paper. Based on SERVQUAL, Evaluation system for restaurant is established. And empirical study is done for a restaurant in Mianyang,china. Service quality of the restaurant is evaluated by the restaurant's service quality evaluation method based on SERVQUAL. Then according to current service quality level of the restaurant, quality improvement method is discussed.

articleTitle: Study on the Risk Prevention of the Overseas Mergers and Acquisitions of Zhejiang Scientific and Technological Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the circumstance of global financial crises, the overseas mergers and acquisitions conducted by Zhejiang scientific and technological enterprises helps them attract advanced patent technology by lawful methods, increase the technological element and competitive advantages of the products, strengthen the enterprise core competitiveness and occupy foreign market. It also helps the transfer of economic growth mode, promote the industrial structure adjustment and optimize the industrial upgrade. However, while overseas mergers and acquisitions provide Zhejiang scientific technological enterprises with a shortcut to obtain advanced technology, they might also cause enterprises to be trapped in the technological trap and cannot escape. Therefore, Zhejiang scientific and technological enterprises should highly emphasize the risk control in overseas mergers and acquisitions, and adopt measures to ensure the effectiveness of the overseas mergers and acquisitions.

articleTitle: Review on the Technical Efficiency of High-Tech Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
