abstract: The high-tech industry has evolved to reflect the importance of scientific level of a country and lead the development of new industries and economic growth, technical efficiency relates to an industry or business viability and development opportunities, is an important way able to effectively improve the area or industrial economy. By researching and studying the literature of the efficiency and technical efficiency of high-tech industry at home and abroad, this paper reviewed the current situation of the technical efficiency of high-tech industry, and then it put forward the characteristic and shortage of existing research. Finally, the future research on the technical efficiency of high-tech industry was discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Generalized Real Domain Probability Rough DEA Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the generalized rough DEA model, this article researches the probability rough operator and probability rough set, and generalizes the latter into the real domain. This article also makes the contrast of the number axes simulation between generalized real domain rough variables and generalized probability real domain rough variables. Finally, it establishes generalized real domain probability rough DEA model. This model can solve the problem of relative efficiency evaluation of decision-making unit (DMU) when its input and output variables are probability rough variables. This research is a deepening one of rough DEA model.

articleTitle: Research on the Coupling Interaction Innovation of Knowledge of the University-Industry Collaboration Institutions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes that the essence of coupling interaction innovation of knowledge of university-industry collaboration institutions is the coupling, sharing, creating and transferring of knowledge. It then further explores the process of the coupling interaction innovation of knowledge in the modes of commissioned research, technical cooperation and joint institute and finally provides with three basic approaches to follow in order to enhance the effect of coupling interaction innovation of knowledge of university-industry collaboration institutions.

articleTitle: Strategic Research of Employee Sports Development in the Northeast
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the survey of 6800 employees from 25 enterprises in the Northeast Old Industrial Base, we summarize various statistics about employee sports activities and propose important Strategic steps for further development. Questionnaires, interviews and other research methods were used in this survey.

articleTitle: The Study of the Companies Distorted Marketing Behavior and Management Paths in the Paradigm Shift
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Firstly, author sortes and refines literature about the distorted marketing behavior of companies mainly from rent-seeking ,market stakeholders and the documents conclusion of the distorted marketing behavior. Secondly analyzing the distorted marketing behavior in companies during the transition period.Then analyzing the consequence of companiess' distorting marketing.Finally constructing the management paths for the distorted marketing behaviors.

articleTitle: The Strategic Conception of Constructing a Modern Network & Garden City in Jiaxing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Jiaxing is a city between Shanghai and Hangzhou. How do we locate the development of this city in a new period? This article innovatively proposed the strategic conception of constructing a modern network & garden city in Jiaxing. Garden city and network city are two concepts which are separated in time by one hundred years. But the two theories have harmonious coexistence, which is the theoretical basis of this article. The target model for constructing modern network & garden city in Jiaxing are "Three Combinations". The overall structure of the important nodes for network and garden city in Jiaxing is"1640". The diversified links are veins of network and garden city.

articleTitle: An Introduction of Teaching Model for Entrepreneurship Education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Entrepreneurship has become an important economic and social phenomenon. The teaching of entrepreneurship involves both arts and sciences. Entrepreneurship education suggests the need for a shift from teaching to learning in an environment as close to real life as possible. Concrete experience gained through the active participation of students should be part of the curriculum. This paper tries to propose a teaching model that fits for entrepreneurship education.

articleTitle: Theory Support of Establishing Emergency Rescue Force System in Public Crisis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Establishing Emergency Rescue Force System of Public Crisis is an important portion of emergency management. Through explaining the ideological problems of establishing emergency rescue force system in public crisis, the paper reviews the supporting theories of establishing emergency rescue force system. It provides the necessary theoretical basis and practical orientation for research and implementation of emergency rescue force system.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Management Personnel Working Pressure Relief Strategy Based on EAP System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Management Personnel is distinguish from the general employee, is not only the executor of the management function such as planning, organizing, coordinating and control, but also the direct decision maker to reasonably distribute and coordinate the resources within the organization. Their special status and the constantly changing circumstances may easily lead the management personnel to the situation of overpressure. EAP is one of the successful theories to deal with the working pressure of management personnel. This paper based on the system of EAP, combined with the character of the management personnel pressure, proposes the relief strategy of management personnel.

articleTitle: Why Talent Agglomerates in Industrial Cluster?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial cluster expands organization's boundaries, builda three-levels labor market, and forms a greater "labor pool" to attract and gather more talent. This paper reveals that it is a dynamic process the talent agglomeration in cluster, namely the "initial fission - attraction - co-evolution - embedded - self-reinforce" formation mechanism, constructs a funnel model of the talent agglomeration, and analyzes its self-reinforce effect.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Development of Rural Microcredit from the Rural Credit Cooperatives - Taking Hubei Province Yi Chang City Rural Credit Cooperative as Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Our country is a agriculture Great Power, the agriculture is entire national economy basis, development of agriculture is related to the national economy stability. The increase to the agriculture and countryside investment may promote our country agriculture and rural economy continually and Improve the peasants' income level. This article has mainly analyzed the situation, the main problems as well as the countermeasure of the rural microcredit from the rural credit cooperatives of Yichang City. The rural credit cooperatives of Yi Chang City have carried out small peasant household credit business energetically, have got substantial progress and the huge stimulation to the local rural economy, oneself have also obtained certain income. But also have some problems such as the slow institutional reform, the inferior profit making and so on. The article puts forward the corresponding proposals specifically for all above problems.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on IPO Underpricing of GEM Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper using a sample of 50 companies listed on GEM during October 2009 to January 2010 in China, Studying the share which is initial public offerings. Using statistic analysis applications of SPSS17.0 make regression with built model. It finds that IPO underpricing ratio quite different, and has a high average. Additional, making classification with endogenous variables and exogenous variables, and then choose appropriate independent variable. It verify the assumption that impact of each independent variable on IPO underpricing. Find that exogenous variables have bigger affect on IPO underpricing than endogenous variables. Lottery rate, company age, issue PE, ROE, issue price were negative relation with IPO underpricing. And the interval of offering day to listing day, first turnover, asset-liability ratio and logarithm of issue size were positive relation with IPO underpricing. From t-statistic can know that issue price-earnings ratio prob was most remarkable.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Rural Circulation Industry Promoting Effect on Rural Economy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the data of 1991-2007, this article estimates the rural circulation industry promoting effect to rural economy by using state space model. Then, by means of quantitative analysis, this study demonstrates that there is the long-term cointegration relationship between rural circulation industry promoting effect and rural per capita net income, the level of urbanization and rural per capita consumption. It is found that rural per capita net income and the level of urbanization have a positive role in improvement of rural circulation industry promoting effect, and the later is especially important. But the influence of rural per capita consumption on rural circulation promoting effect is negative. Regarding this, the article puts forward several corresponding proposals.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Application Software Project Implementation Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of the features of enterprise application software (EAS), this paper researches on its project implementation model combining software development process and software project management. With existing software development theories and tools, we analyze the implementation of EAS project from three dimensions (Process, Management and Technique) and put forward the 3-dimension model and each dimension's core concepts and constitution. This model establishes system model and knowledge structure for implementing EAS and can be used to guide project management. At last, the paper indicates that the model is effective and reasonable.

articleTitle: User Behavior Study in the Virtual Community
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of the virtual community has changed the way of human life and activities. This article focuses on the user behavior study in the virtual world. In this paper, the questionnaire investigation is used to analyze the characteristics of user behaviors in the virtual communities. Some problems, such as trust issue, self-disclosure, trust crisis, and relationship adjustment are discussed.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of Athlete Transfer in Professional Sport: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Athlete-club conflict risk factors in professional sports are identified through literature review and Delphi method, allowing for the probability of risks. Through sensitivity analysis, the degree of impact of transfer risks, from high to low, are risk of benefit interests, risk of transfer institution, risk of misbehavior, risk of transfer fees, risk of property, risk of labor contract, risk between labor and capital, risk of training, and risk of goal.

articleTitle: Inductivity Extracurricular Sport Competition Model on Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The definition of the inductivity institution for extracurricular sport competition in colleges and universities is given from the perspective of new institutional economics. The relationship between incentive investment and utility is analyzed on the basis of the incentive theory, and a model of incentive utility of extracurricular sport competition in colleges and universities is constructed. With the validation of the model by incentive score as a numerical example, the conclusion is that inductivity institution for extracurricular sport competition in colleges and universities can improve students' enthusiasm of participating in it.

articleTitle: Research on the Psychological Contract Development of Chinese Employee
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research divided the career of Chinese Employee into four stages under the two dimensions of age and psychological career status. Adopting the three-dimension structure of psychological contract, research on both organization responsibilities and employee responsibilities of the Chinese employees are conducted in three dimensions: interpersonal responsibilities, development responsibilities and criterion responsibilities. Development rules of the three items of both organization responsibilities and employee responsibilities are found and then differentiated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Chinese Consumer Ethical Beliefs: A Scale Development and Comparison
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the Muncy-Vitell Consumer Ethics Scale (CES), this study develops a Chinese version of CES. Three dimensions are added, they are (1) consumer hegemony, (2) uncivil or discourteous acts in public and (3) drawing upon public funds or resources for personal consumption. The study also compares the present scale with the previous ones. Results show that 'passively benefiting acts' were considered as more ethical than those obtained from previous studies. In addition, in Chinese consumers mind, 'uncivil or discourteous acts in public' is as unethical as 'actively benefiting from illegal activities'. The reasons for these interesting findings are discussed.

articleTitle: Government and Producer's Game Analysis and System Design Based on EPR
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By the game for the government and the producers, the paper revealed the producer's reaction under the different EPR system designs, pointed out that the producer's attitude bearing the EPR responsibility determines the recycling effect for its end-of-life product, the producer's attitude depends on the EPR system designed by the government, deduced out the incentive mechanism of the EPR system, then, presented the view that the stimulating EPR systems should include the incentive systems and the restricting systems, and gave out series of inspirational systems for EPR, with a view to the adoption of effective EPR system, impel the producers to change their extensive production mode, to undertake the extended responsibility actively, then, to achieve the ultimate goal of resource-saving and environment-optimizing for the whole society.

articleTitle: Marketing Ethics Construction of Pharmaceutical Companies in the Prospective of Customer Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer life cycle of pharmaceutical companies comprises four stages, namely, the value exploration, the value growth, the value preservation and the value termination. For each stages, the value orientation, marketing strategies and tools of pharmaceutical companies are different, therefore, the focus of their marketing ethics at different stages are different. The ethics construction in pharmaceutical companies should take stage-specific features of the customer life cycle into consideration, and target to enhance the customer value-driven pharmaceutical company ethics, social responsibility effectively, which not only promotes the medical enterprise marketing, but also extend customer life cycle in a greater degree. By this way, the pharmaceutical companies can realize the healthy, harmonious and sustainable development.

articleTitle: Commercial Presence vs. Presence of Natural Persons of Trade in Service: Evidence of Complementarity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Because of the interactions between four modes of supply of trade in service, it increases the complications when constructing policy of trade in service. In this paper, we put forward 4 assumptions that the positive effects of Presence of Natural Persons (mode 4) have on Commercial Presence (mode 3). In addition, with US export data and gravity model, we try to quantify the above effects by using the regression of econometrics. We conclude that 1% increasing of trade value of Presence of Natural Persons will increase 0.533% of trade value of Commercial Presence.

articleTitle: System Planning & Studying on Greenland Based on Low-Carbon Concept
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Setting green land of Sixin ecological town of Wuhan in China as studying object, this article analyzed and studied the carbon sequestration functions of the green land by using qualitative and quantitative research methods, and finally put forward corresponding countermeasures and suggestions.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Job Resources and Organizational Justice on College Counselors' Working State
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research through survey on 102 college counselors at Hangzhou Xiasha Higher Education District shows that counselor's job autonomy has significantly positive correlation to their job involvement, job satisfaction, career commitment and other factors. On social support, supervisor support has a higher degree of correlation to counselor's job satisfaction and career commitment, while coworker support has a higher degree of correlation to counselor's job involvement. Increased job autonomy and supervisor support plays a more noticeable role in enhancing male counselor's job involvement. The various dimensions of organizational justice have significantly positive effect on counselor's job involvement, job satisfaction and career commitment. Based on survey analysis, this research recommends measures to improve the working state of counselors.

articleTitle: Construction of the Evaluation Index System of Incubator Service
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the research of related literatures about incubator service capability, this paper divides incubation service capability into three types of indicator: operation service capability, development service capability and network service capability. It constructs the evaluation index system and provides a method for comprehensive assessment of incubator service capability.

articleTitle: The Empirical Research of the Relationship between Board Governance and Corporate Competitiveness of the Listed Companies of Iron and Steel Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Board governance is the core of corporate governance and has an important influence on.the enhancement of corporate competitiveness.This paper takes the listed companies of iron and steel industry in China as the research samples and makes the empircal research on the relationship between board governance and corporate competitiveness.The results show that: appropriate size of the board and the set of board committees have a positive role in promoting the competitiveness of enterprises;excessive number of board meetings is not beneficial to enhancing the competitiveness of enterprises;the proportion of independent directors,board leadership structure and directors' salary don't affect the competitiveness of enterprises obviously. Finally,on the basis of empirical research findings,this paper gives some recommendations on developing and improving the board governance and corporate competitiveness of listed companies of iron and steel industry in China.

articleTitle: The Evaluation on Financial Risks of Listed Companies - Based on the Empirical Evidence from Chinese Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper adopted Altman's Z model to analyze Chinese listed companies' financial data which has been selected from the A stock market in China. The paper found that the Z score is unstable but the whole trend is better compared to the former years. Finally, the author has found some microcosmic problems.

articleTitle: Design of Distortion Parameters Test System for Aircraft Power System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The AC and DC voltage distortion of the aircraft power supply system will cause serious pollution, and seriously affect the aircraft safety performance. According to the requirement of the voltage distortion parameters test of the aircraft power system, the distortion test based on LabVIEW CVI is designed in this paper. The hardware and software of the test system is designed according to the requirements of GJG181 and GJB181A. The test system hardware adopts portable equipments and high-speed data acquisition and processing. The test system software adopts the modular design idea and program by using the software LabVIEW CVI. The hardware filtering and digital filtering are used in this system. The application shows that the distortion test system have reached the design requirements, and have the characters such as stable and reliable operation, convenient operation, simple maintenance and so on, and satisfied the needs of the distortion test for AC and DC aircraft power system.

articleTitle: Reputation Model in Newsvendor-Type Supply Chain with Long Term Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With a view to the sustainable development of both supply chain and its members, in this paper, the factor of time is introduced into the principal-agent problem about gaming on moral hazard in newsvendor-type supply chain. Firstly, we define the specific connotation of the reputation of the manufacturer (the principal), and based on which we build the stackelberg game model between the two decision makers in single moral hazard framework on the background of single-period newsvendor problem. We analyze the influence of moral hazard from the manufacturer on the order strategy of the retailer, and testify that the retailer's prior judgment on the manufacturer's reputation has a positive influence to its order quantity. Thereafter, we extend the game on single period moral hazard to long term cooperation: based on the feature of newsvendor-type supply chain coordination in multi-period game, which refers to "long-term existing multi-period cooperation relationship, constant varying single period game contain", considering the possibility of the retailer's misjudging the manufacturer's behavior when it makes judgment only according to the actual demand, we build the Manufacturer's Reputation Model. This model reveals that the retailer's evaluation on the manufacturer's reputation and the latter's moral change in the same direction.

articleTitle: Social Effects of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The application of information technology has brought both positive and negative effects; this paper analyzes the social effects of information technology and gives approach to solve the negative effects.

articleTitle: Using the Theory of Inventive Problem-Solving (TRIZ) to Implement Safety Improvements in Foundry Engineering Pouring Procedures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Foundry engineering can not only produce precise one-piece and complex parts, but can also conserve materials, which is why the industrial market is happy to adopt it. The most dangerous step in the foundry process is the pouring process. This article focuses on this pouring process, which may cause serious safety hazards, and employs Substance-Field Analysis and Contradiction Analysis from the Theory of Inventive Problem-Solving (TRIZ) to seek solutions and improved methods for lowering hazard potential, ensuring factory safety, raising productivity, and promoting workers' welfare.

articleTitle: Corporate Ownership Arrangement of Technical Capital of Small and Medium-Sized Hi-Tech Entrepreneurial Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Small and medium-sized hi-tech entrepreneurial enterprises are special contracts of technical capital and nontechnical capital, therefore, the ownership arrangements of both sharing residual claims and controlling rights should be established. This article starts the discussion of property right characteristics, such as control of technical capital or assets, personal dependence, integration, etc, and then explores corporate ownership arrangement under the sharing condition of small and medium-sized enterprises of hi-tech entrepreneurial.

articleTitle: Chinese Servant Leadership: A Qualitative Investigation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims to examine whether the Western concept of servant leadership could be applied to the non-Western context of the People's Republic of China (PRC). Employing a qualitative, open-ended survey approach, we found that when asked to characterise Chinese servant leadership, the study respondents consider six types of servant leadership similar to the West but also three types of Chinese extended servant leadership, highlighting research gaps for future studies within the context of comparison between the PRC and the West.

articleTitle: The Relationship Research between Innovation Network and Innovation Resource in Culture Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Innovation is the important source of competitive advantage for culture industry. And service innovation is becoming one of key competitions in a country or region. In this paper, the relationship between innovation network and innovation resource of culture industry is analyzed by using literature research method and qualitative research method. On the basis of this, and empirically tests the model with data from a survey of culture industry in 7 different regions in China. Results show that there is positive interdependence between the both. And the result puts forward the quantitative basis for innovation network development and innovation resource acquisition of culture industry.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Sustainable Competitiveness of Heilongjiang Manufacturing SMEs Based on PCA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the analysis of influence factors of sustainable competitiveness in the regional manufacturing SMEs, the article establishes the evaluation index system of sustainable competitiveness of regional manufacturing SMEs. Empirical research on sustainable competitiveness of manufacturing SMEs of 30 provinces has been done by collecting statistical data of 30 provinces and using principal component analysis (PCA). Empirically evaluating sustainable competitiveness of manufacturing SMEs in Heilongjiang has been made by comparing the other provinces Area. And corresponding suggestion of advancing sustainable competitiveness of Heilongjiang manufacturing SMEs has been proposed on the basis of the empirical research's results.

articleTitle: The Quantification of Individual Tacit Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the purpose of doing quantification of individual tacit knowledge, this paper discusses different classifications of the recessive knowledge from all aspects and does further research of the secondary index subordinating to every index in order to design a psychological scale including questions corresponding to different indexes, with which the individual tacit knowledge was successfully quantified.

articleTitle: The Strategy Analysis of Lowering Supply Chain Cost
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This steady analyzed the cost composing of supply chain first, then put forward some strategies of lowering the supply chain cost, such as excellent design for turning a product, the implementation faces to the production organization of supply chain plan management and carries out strategic supply chain purchase strategy, excellent turn a supply chain to go together with to send system, carry out new supply chain inventory management strategy etc..It is believed that the business enterprise can examine the cost management of oneself.

articleTitle: Management Strength Measure of Rural Credit Cooperatives in Hebei Area Which Is in the Economic Circle Ringing Capital
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of Economic is inseparable from the support of financial. Rural credit cooperatives are the mainstay of supporting the development of county economy, so measuring the development level of rural credit cooperatives has the extremely vital significance. This paper has selected 17 indexes by using factor analysis to measure the management strength of rural credit cooperatives,then concludes the total ranking,and advances some suggestions.

articleTitle: E-Government and Government's Public Services
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-Government is a new form of government organization and administrative mechanism of public affairs, where the government's public sectors realize digitalized and information-based government affairs by means of network communication and other electronic technology, administrate public affairs, and provide public services through network. It is citizen-oriented and regards the improvement of government's public services as the core value. The process of promoting the e-Governance is a process of organic combination of application of computer network technology and new government's administration philosophy, normal forms of services and value goals for adjustment and improvement of the government's administrative organization. As e-commerce has created new commercial environment for most sectors including many traditional sectors, it is expected that the internet technology will bring deep changes for the provision of public services by the government. Though internet technology performs taxation, law enforcement and even defense and other functions for the government and plays a certain role in political process and connection between the citizens and their representatives, how the internet technology can be widely applied to provide public services remains an issue to be developed and perfected. This is not simply an issue of technology application.

articleTitle: Research on Network Marketing of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years ,Chinese small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) have developed rapidly, and SMEs have played a more and more important role in the development of the national economy and social progress. But nowadays, most SMEs are still adopting the traditional marketing methods, which have the weakness of laggard marketing concept, simple means and low efficiency. Although some SMEs have realized and tried to use network marketing or cyber-marketing as a new marketing tool , but a few of them have achieved very satisfying effects. Network marketing is to extend the traditional marketing to a wilder application area-cyberspace. Network marketing is to develop and innovate on the basis of traditional marketing theory. Based on the basic theory of network marketing and the characteristics of SMEs, this paper analyzed the opportunities and challenges brought by the Internet era. After formulating problems that SMEs encountered, we tried to bring forward our analysis and solutions.

articleTitle: The Application of Cognitive Neuroscience Methods in IS Research: A Retrospect of NeuroIS Research Using the fMRI Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Cognitive neuroscience methods have been used increasingly in IS research, this new field termed NeuroIS hold great potential for IS research. This paper first introduced the overall background of NeuroIS research, and then reported some recent research progress in NeuroIS. And in the third part of this paper, the advantage, potential of neuroIS research and the possible implications were discussed. The last part further discussed possible limitations and future research directions of NeuroIS study.

articleTitle: Bilingual Economics Education for Business Schools in Running Chinese-Foreign Cooperation Programme: A Perspective of Cross Culture Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Bilingual education comes to be a significant strategy developing interdisciplinary talents and international human recourses in Chinese colleges and universities. The research takes the case study of bilingual education for Economics teaching strategy in the context of Chinese-foreign cooperation programme. A perspective of cross culture adjustment is studied for both the reaction of students and teachers from hectic, shock, stress relief and assimilation in the practical bilingual Economics education.

articleTitle: On the Improvement of Chinese "One-Stop" Service of E-Government
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-Government has a very close relationship with service administration. In order to offer an all-round, custom-made and high efficient service by achieving this creative interactive pattern, it is necessary to transform the administration concept and service faculty of the government and reconstruct the government organizational structure and work assembly line. Service procedures must be set up. Targets of service enterprises, institutions, and citizens are consumers of public products that are supposed to be the object of government service. Government agencies should strengthen horizontal connections so as to offer a swift and efficient service called "integrated service".

articleTitle: Survey and Analysis on Design Management Facing Small and Medium Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper firstly designed a questionnaire on basis of industrial design and design management for the product development in small and medium enterprises in China. The survey was done through field interview and internet. According to statistics result and the field interviewing record, the problems of design management existed were analyzed, mainly focusing on incorrect or shallow understanding of Industrial Design, incomplete design process, lack of communication and cooperation system, short of evaluation system. The analysis results will give a good reference to the managers to improve the design management and also are helpful for the product development and design.

articleTitle: Study on the Logistic Decision-Making of Third-Party Logistics and Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of market economy and the continuous influx of foreign enterprises, Chinese enterprises are facing increasingly complex and versatile market environment. Under pressure of market competition, companies begin turning to logistics and hope that through efficient logistics management to improve efficiency throughout the supply chain. Against this background, the third-party logistics is emerged as a result. The article will analysis the self-selection of logistics companies and third party logistics on their own pros and cons. Different types of business should be conducted in logistics outsourcing decision-making. It is useful to form a clear understanding of the conditions which will help the logistics companies to obtain an outsourcing win-win business and also increase social welfares.

articleTitle: The Composition and Advantages of Financial Consultation Mode Based on XBRL and Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The XBRL's methods, which include drawing up Financial reporting of enterprise, publishing, data exchanging and financial statements publishing, will be applied to the financial consultation of enterprise and it will generate a new financial consultative mode. The basic idea is based on the traditional method, fully using information exchange platform which provided by network environment and introducing the XBRL's powerful capabilities of processing financial information , forming a new network consulting operation system about financial consultation. Starting from information standards and requirements which is peculiar to XBRL and appropriate introduce theory of financial consultation, meanwhile, simulating network operation, forming a new financial consultation operating mode which meet the XBRL format and application requirement. This new operating mode and the advantages on financial consultation have been proposed and discussed.

articleTitle: The Empirical Research on the Correlation of Knowledge Transformation and Core Competence in China's Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to reveal the micro-mechanism of enterprise-related knowledge management and cultivate the core competencies of the enterprise's management activity, the structure equation model is used in this paper. By research assumption, the decomposition of index system, model design, model confirmation and confirmation analysis, the SEM can effectively reveal the correlation between knowledge transformation and core competence in Chinese enterprises. For illustration, the collected copies are 292 enterprises, in which 255 copies are valid. The empirical results show that the minimum value among the 28 load factors is 0.52, the minimum T value is 2.02. Therefore, the model is well fitted and there's no need to be corrected. The empirical research has revealed that the knowledge management activities in China's enterprise have obvious incentive effect on the formation of core competence.

articleTitle: Research on Brand Equity of Automobile Industry - Based on Customer Experience and Modern Service
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Facing the rapid development of China's Automobile industry, the construction of independent brands, and accumulation of brand equity, expansion of brand influence have become the key factors for China's Automobile industry's further development. The brand equity, as enterprise important intangible asset, lacks accurate measurement standards. What's worse, it has no quantitative measure indicators. Automobile industry collects characteristics both from manufacturing and service industry, which makes the customer experience become an important dimensions of measure for brand equity of automobile industry. This paper define brand equity as part of enterprise assets, and from the angle of customer experience and perception measure brand equity. This paper furtherly explored customer experience as a breakthrough point and key factors, using empirical analysis of the data collection, applying calculating statistics method to analyse customer's satisfaction index from multidimensions. In conclusion, we proposed enterprise that more attention should be paid to the modern automobile comprehensive service level, which is mainly based on customer experience. This is significantly beneficial for promoting customer's brand loyalty, and the overall competitiveness of China's Automobile industry.

articleTitle: The Evaluation and Construction of Enterprise Financial Management Target Based on the Scientific Outlook on Development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Different enterprise financial management target will have a different financial operating mechanism. To determine a financial management target scientifically is of great significance to optimal financial behavior, rational allocation and efficient use of financial resources, reasonable arrangement of financial system, as well as to proper treatment and coordination of financial relationships. Based on the relationship between the scientific outlook on development and the enterprise financial management target, this article evaluates the traditional financial management target and constructs a new target guided by the scientific outlook on development.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Game Research on Enterprises Tacit Knowledge Transposition from the Perspective of Reciprocity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge transposition is an important part of knowledge management. The tacit knowledge transposition is the effective means to improve enterprises' knowledge management efficiency. The reciprocal enterprises environment provides an effective means for the implementation of the tacit knowledge transposition, which overcomes the numerous obstacles in the process of the tacit knowledge transposition. The tacit knowledge transposition efficiency between individuals under the reciprocal preference environment are significantly higher than tacit knowledge transposition efficiency under the rational economic environment, which improves interest payments of knowledge transposition subjects, and create the conditions for the evolution game analysis of the tacit knowledge transposition in enterprises under the reciprocal enterprises environment. The evolutionary game analysis results showed that in some external incentive mechanism, the tacit knowledge transposition subjects in general have the development tendency of the reciprocal knowledge transposition subjects in enterprises, so that the tacit knowledge transposition between individuals enter into the dominant steady state, and ultimately improve the efficiency of enterprises' knowledge transposition.

articleTitle: A Competency Model of R&D Personnel in High-Tech Manufacturing Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Taking high-tech manufacturing R & D personnel as an example, this paper established the competency model of high-tech manufacturing R & D personnel and validated the model. The model consists 22 competencies of 5 dimensions.The result of the study provide theoretical support for optimizing human resources management of the high-tech manufacturing enterprises based on competency of R & D personnel.

articleTitle: Strategies for Design-Build Process Optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The design-build contract style has large growth in construction industry. There are several advantages and disadvantages ascribed to the design-build contract. Many new process strategies are proposed to address many of the contract's shortcomings. In particular, the strategies facilitate concurrent project development in the design-build process through the integration of all project participants into a multi-functional matrix team.

articleTitle: Research on Railway Project Material Procurement Plan Based on Inventory Coordination
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The importance of inventory coordination in dymamic demand was discussed, so was the process of allocating scheme, then the precondition of inventory modulation was presented. Considering the balance of supply cost and satisfactory, costs of united reorder and inventory modulation were researched in terms of inventory shortage, inventory excess and transportation cost. Advantages of united reorder and inventory modulation were synthesized and the optimized model of material allocating was constructed, also optimized allocation scheme was presented. At last a reasonable plan of example was present, which testified the practicability and validity of the scheme.

articleTitle: Study on Development of the High-Level Innovators in Science and Technology Matching the Industrial Transformation and Upgrading: Take Wuhan as a Case
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Advanced technologies in science and management are admittedly important to the industrial transformation and upgrading, but it is more important to hold a high-level innovative talent team in science and technology that can lead the industrial development and create scientific and technologic outcomes which are competitive in the market. So, to achieve the target of industrial transformation and upgrading in China, it is urgent to build such a talent team matching the industrial development. The paper takes Wuhan industry as a case, analyzes the issues as input intensity and focus, platforms, supporting measures, and the humanistic environment, etc and finally puts forward the correspondent countermeasures to solve these problems.

articleTitle: Teaching Quality Evaluation Based on Student Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The teaching quality has been one of the main focuses in universities, and the evaluation from the students is an indispensable part. Benefiting from the previous experience of teaching evaluation index systems, this paper did research based on information entropy and student satisfaction; defined student satisfaction on the viewpoint of service quality definition; established a rating scale consisting of 5 fist-class indexes, 20 second-class indexes ; took industrial engineering profession of Nanchang University for example, by conducting cluster sampling, and using the entropy analysis to determine the weight of each index. The results show that, according to the method, students' satisfaction matches the fact which proves that this method in the evaluation of student satisfaction and in the field of teaching evaluation is scientific and feasible. In conclusion, based on the weights obtained in the analysis, some constructive comments were put forward in favor of teaching professional development and improving the teaching quality.

articleTitle: New Method for DCPM by Substituting Critical Path
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new method for DCPM by substituting critical path is presented in this paper. A substituting critical path is defined as the new critical path when the former critical path is interrupted in CPM. Based on the Total Float Theorem and the Characteristic Path Theorem, the Substituting Critical Path Theorem is proposed, showing that when a critical activity is interrupted, the new critical path is the characteristic path which the paralleling activity with the least total float lies on. On the basis of this principle, a new method for DCPM is introduced and a numerical example is presented to illustrate the method. The new approach in this paper can simplify the existed procedure for DCPM.

articleTitle: Assessment Research of Credit Risk in Commercial Bank Based on Fuzzy-VaR
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research introduces the fuzzy mathematics in the VaR foundation, to express the indefinite factor with the membership function. Thus makes the research of indefinite factor change to the quantitative analysis from the qualitative analysis, so the commercial bank's credit risk measurement is more objective and realistic.

articleTitle: Research into the Dynamic and Equilibrium Relationship of Henan between Consumer Demand in Rural and the Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper, based on the data in Henan from 1985 to 2008, through the method of Cointegration analysis, and Error Correction Model, focuses the research on the dynamic balanced relationship between the rural consumption demand and the economic growth. The research result shows that there exists a dynamic balanced relationship between the consumption expenditure of the rural people and the per capita GDP. The rural per capita life expenses have a greater leverage effect on the economic growth than the per capita household managecosts. In the stagnant period of one, two, four and five years, the per capita GDP growth constitutes a uni-directional cause-effect relationship with the rural household management cost; in the stagnant period of three and four year, the per capita GDP growth and the rural household life cost form the two-way directional cause-effect relationsh. Finally, this paper, proposes policies suggestions based on the results of the research.

articleTitle: On British Culture Industry Investment and Financing Patterns
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the "soft power" of a country's economic development, culture industry has caused great concern around the world. British perfect investment and financing system and diversified investment and financing patterns provide important protection for the sustainable development of cultural industry. On the basis of introducing the development situation of British major culture industry,this paper specifically summarizes and analyzes British current investment and financing patterns, and obtains enlightenment to perfect our country's culture industry. The enlightenment of British culture industry investment and financing include:to construct the multiplex investment and financing subject;to utilize capital market to finance actively;to perfect the policy environment to attract venture capital.

articleTitle: Study on the Knowledge Alliance's Collaborative Contracts Based on Differences in Power Structure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the process of inter-organizational cooperation in knowledge aliiance, there exists two power structures, which are core enterprise-led structure and agent-led structure. Our research indicates that in the two structures, the agent's required unit pay of innovative products is positive correlation to its marginal innovative cost, and is negative correlation to its technical capacity growth earnings. The core enterprise's optimal marginal profit is negative correlation to the agent's marginal innovative cost, and is positive correlation to the agent's capacity growth earnings. Under the situation of the agent-led structure, if the difference between the agent's unit innovative cost and capacity growth earnings is little, the agent's required pay is higher than pay of the core enterprise-led structure, and the core enterprise's marginal profit is lower than profit of the core enterprise-led structure, and vice versa.

articleTitle: To Strengthen the Role of Social Security in Emergency Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the face of increasingly frequent types of emergencies, emergency management, as an important part of the government's public administration, is a new topic to build a harmonious society. In the emergency management, social security plays an important role. At present, emergency social security system has not really taken shape. There are still some problems about the preparation and supervision of capital, and the preventive effect is not very clear. Therefore, we should recognize the links and differences between the emergency social security system and the existing social security system. And emergency social security system should be improved to give full play to the emergency management.

articleTitle: The Shaping Machine Reformed by Numerical Control System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is introducing the shaping machine reformed by numerical control system and self-developed CNC system for shaping machine. The NC shaper is reformed by the numerical system and shaping machine, the control system is adopted by the open PC bus organized structure as its hardware; the design of its software is adopted modularization and structuralization, with graphic characters menu user interface, and functions of Graphic Programming, tabulated curve programming, simulation run, auto-checking instrument, tool abrasion automatic compensating, real-time processing control and dynamic tracking display system.

articleTitle: Establishment of Negative Corporate Income Tax to Enhance SMEs' Independent Innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: How to strengthen the capability of SMEs' independent innovation is becoming a study hotspot. After analyzing the characteristics of enterprise's independent innovation and of China's SMEs' independent innovation, this paper mainly analyzes the concept and operation mechanism of "Negative Corporate Income Tax" tax expenditure.

articleTitle: Research on Low-Carbon Tourism Scenic Authentication System's Construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The low-carbon tourism scenic zone authentication standard's construction, is the low-carbon tourism scenic zone construction and the development important safeguard. The low-carbon tourism scenic zone authentication is establishing a series of corresponding standard and the standard system, carry on the appraisal to the low-carbon tourism scenic which reduce the greenhouse gas emissions and save the energy, give certain form approval to the tourism scenic zone which through the appraisal. The domestic and foreign related green tourist scenic zone authentication standard, or the eco-tourism scenic area authentication standard, formulates the low-carbon traveling authentication standard important reference. The low-carbon traveling authentication standard's formulation, should refer to these authentication guarantees, and unifies the local actual situation. Low-carbon tourism scenic zone authentication project including tourism resources development, tourism scenic zone low-carbon management, scenic area system construction and training.

articleTitle: The Comparison of R&D Personnel Competency in Different Technology Innovation Strategies - Case Study of High-Tech Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the R&D personnel competency model in the high-tech enterprises, which developed by author in recent research, this paper designs the requirement degree questionnaire of R&D personnel competency in high-tech enterprises. Taking R&D personnel in the high-tech enterprises as an example, this paper compares the R&D personnel competency of Leading Innovation Strategy, Following Innovation Strategy, and Imitating Innovation Strategy. The result of the study reveals that there are differences of R&D personnel competency in the different technology innovation strategies context. The article searches ways to increase technology innovation ability in Chinese high-tech enterprises, from competency prospective, and give theoretical and tool support for enterprises to select, training and inspire related competency according to the technology innovation strategies.

articleTitle: On the Robustness Test of Border Effect Gravity Model for Shipping Trade
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Border effect gravity model for shipping trade is introduced to investigate its theoretical foundation using China-US shipping trade data over the period of 2005-2009. Different ways of robustness tests are conducted to test the validity of the model in this regard. The results show that the established model proves to be useful and border still matters for China-US shipping trade.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Price of the Candidate in M&A Based on Multiple-Kernel SVMR
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In Mergers and Acquisitions, forecasting the price of the candidate is a very important step, which decides whether an acquisition continues to advance. In this paper, multiple-kernel SVMR is applied to predict the price of candidates in mergers and acquisitions. In the model, we adopt a two-stage multiple-kernel learning algorithm by incorporating sequential minimal optimization and the gradient projection method. By this algorithm, advantages from different hyperparameter settings can be combined and overall system performance can be improved. Experimental results show that SVMR performs better than other methods which a strong tool for M&A decision-making.

articleTitle: Model of Determination for TOPSIS-Based Global Value Chain Governance Structure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the analysis on existing research achievements of global value chain governance structure, this article aims to establish characteristics of various global value chain governance structure types, apply fuzzy statistics on assessments of experts on various characteristics in connection with the fuzziness of the characteristic itself, build a model of determination for global value chain government structure by TOPSIS comprehensive evaluation approach based on fuzzy approach degree.

articleTitle: The Research of Identification and Determination for Sports Industry Cluster
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The sports industry cluster is one kind of production network which constituted in some region by amount of enterprises and supported institutions that produce and correlative sports products. The identification and determination methods of sports industry cluster is as other industrial cluster, and would combine the qualitative and quantitative analysis method. This paper introduces several general industrial cluster quantitative identification index, and use several international recognition technology of industrial clusters for sports industry cluster for the quantitative analysis and determination methods, and combine front concepts and reasonable methods of quantitative operable, and more in-depth understand sports industry clusters.

articleTitle: Issues on the Transfer of Multinational Pollution That China Is Confronted with in Conditions of FDI
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the constant expansion of FDI, some high energy consumption industries with serious pollution in developed countries have been moved to china, leaving china faced with problems like ecological degradation, retard of elimination of controlled substances, and rigid industrial structure, etc. the causes of the problems above are, the quantity expansion of the single foreign scale, the low environmental standards, and the deficiency of relevant legal system.

articleTitle: Current Situation and the Strategic Enhancement of the Power of Chinese State-Owned Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Independent innovation is closely related to the survival, rise and fall of enterprises, and the enhancement of the power of independent innovation provides a good guarantee for the sustainable development of state-owned enterprises. Generally speaking, Chinese state-owned enterprises are rather weak in independent innovation. To enhance this power, it is necessary to foster an awareness of independent innovation from a strategic point of the state-owned enterprises; and funding for independent innovation should be increased; more importance should be attached to the training and introduction of technology professionals; cooperative innovation with other organizations should be strengthened; meanwhile emphasis should be laid on the integration of internal resources.

articleTitle: A Study on the Synergistic Effect of Commercial Bank Business Innovations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After subprime crisis, researchers are turning to study the business innovations of China's financial banks. And in the paper, we discuss the synergistic effect of business innovations. Firstly, we discuss the definition of synergistic effect. Then we present the functions to test the synergistic effect of financial bank business innovations. Lastly, we use the data of thirteen financial banks to test the effect of economy of scope. With the test, we find that there exists synergistic effect, such as economy of scope and economy of scale in financial bank business innovations. With the synergistic effect of old business and new business, financial banks can acquire more rewards and reduce the costs.

articleTitle: Approaches to Build Brand Personality for Chinese Corporations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The unique and distinctive brand personality can strengthen consumer's brand loyalty, thus form the long-lasting brand competitive power. Brand personality development passes through four stages: introduction, growth, stability and maintenance. The paper revealed several approaches to develop brand personality according to the characteristics of each stage: accurate brand positioning, build brand culture, constantly spread brand personality and take intensive care of it, and beware of the blind brand extension, etc.

articleTitle: Human Resource Systems and Organizational Performance: A Multilevel Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The linkages between human resource (HR) system and organizational performance is still an unanswered question. From the perceptive which argues that employees perceived HR system plays a vital role in explaining this relationship. A multilevel model links among human resource system; organizational climate and organizational performance is proposed.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Effect of Consumer Preference on Consumer Decision
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The market survey is the foundation for enterprise to establish marketing plan and carry on decision, particularly in the current consumer-oriented under the buyer's market. The consumer preference reflects the subjective desire of consumers directly, and the result of consumer's subjective desire often influences consumer's choice immediately. Through empirical analysis the paper shows the uncertainty is importance in preference and decision. Consumer decision depends on not only consumer preference, but also uncertainty. Ignore the existence of such uncertainty may makes enterprises are in decision-making errors.

articleTitle: Equivalence Checking in Information System Hardware Design
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Equivalence checking is playing a significant role in Intelligent Circuits design. However, the common models for verification either have their complexity problems or have applicable limitations. In order to overcome the deficiencies, a model WGL (Weighted Generalized List) is proposed and based on WGL we give an algorithm for checking. Comparing the model WLDDs, the experiments show that the WGL is more efficient.

articleTitle: An Investigation of the Relationship among Tunneling, Asymmetric Information and Discount of Private Placement: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper develops a model of private placement, then explores the discount of private placement under the control of controlling shareholder and how to influence company's value. We find that private placement is used to a mechanism for tunneling, Whether and how much to tunnel may depend on the discount and the percentage of private placement which purchased by the controlling shareholder. At the same time, asymmetric information has an important influence on the discount of private placement, and the discount is larger when it exists more asymmetric information.

articleTitle: The Path Analysis of Diversification Strategy and Capital Structure in the Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Corporation diversification strategy is a trend. Will the past and existing diversification strategy choice affect the company's now and future decision? Moreover will the past and existing capital structure also affect the company's now and future strategic choice? This paper tests the causality of diversification strategy and capital structure by four structure equation models and AMOS6.0 software. The results reveal there is a significant causal relationship among capital structures and among company strategies. There exists a interaction between capital structure and company strategy.

articleTitle: Applying Excel VBA to Implement Comparison among Physical Experiment Data
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In many physical education teaching experiments, we often need to compare the difference among all the data. When doing these comparisons, variance components method has been our indispensable tool. However, even though the Excel in Microsoft Office has already covered one-factor analysis of variance, it is still lack of multiple-comparison function. Our research works out a Excel tool which has both function. We insert data analysis tool into the Excel, and then take the advantage of VBA language to accomplish the judgment function of data-analysis. In this way, we can make one-factor analysis of variance and multiple-comparison at the same time, in other words, it enables us to compare the different groups of data. This research reset and improve the data-analysis tool though VBA program and Excel. We simplify the Operating System and optimize calculation procedure. Our invention can accomplish the comparison among different samples, which, creates a more accurate and more convenient tool to make physical education data-analysis.

articleTitle: Enterprise Group Governance Model Decision
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Enterprise group will inevitably encounter organizational capacity absence and resources attenuation in its ongoing expansion process. But good governance model can guide enterprises development better. In this paper, we introduce the mainstream governance model of enterprise group, and then make use of fuzzy comprehensive mathematical methods to build a decision-making model for business choice. Select the main influencing factors of enterprise group governance as decision-making model index system and calculate index weight by latent root method in group. Finally calculate group company degree of membership to different membership functions, according the principle of maximum membership degree, and choose the appropriate governance model for enterprise group.

articleTitle: Research on the Tactics of Service Recovery Based on Customer Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although many people have suggested that organizations should aim to offer 'zero defects' service, some service failures are inevitable. It appears that, while marketing of products and services differs in many ways, customer satisfaction with services is particularly tied to the resolution of problems. Both practitioners and researchers have come to acknowledge that customer satisfaction will go down when encountering service failure, which will result in the number of customer decrease and corporate profits decline. Once service failure occurs, enterprises need to perform service recovery immediately. Service recovery is unavoidable; it is of great significance in maintaining customer relations, improving customer satisfaction and strengthening enterprise good image. In order to do a good job in service recovery, enterprises must develop perfect tactics of service recovery.

articleTitle: A Study about the Fit between SHRM and Business Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: 1960s, with the published works of Chandler and Ansoff, strategic research started; 1980s, study about Strategic Human Resource Management (SHRM) is of the rise of the best human resource perspective, contingent perspective and configuration perspective. There are two views about the relationship between Strategic Human Resources and business strategy: the contingency scholars think, human resources strategy is determined by the organizational strategy, organizational strategy and human resource strategy is a one-way relation; and Resource-based view that organizational strategy and human resources strategy is a two-way influence relationship. Based on the contingency scholars, this paper explores the path that the strategic human resources support business strategy, not only to focus on internal and external matching, but also pay attention to the specific content of match.

articleTitle: The Concept, Model and Function Expression about Patient Perceived Value
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the research on customer perceived value, this paper proposed the concept of patient perceived value (PPV) in medical service. Then, we constructed the model of PPV and studied about the function expression of this concept. Finally, we summed up the possible results which patients evaluated the overall value according to their perception.

articleTitle: Exploring on the Industrial Market Competitiveness of Tea in Mingshan County Based on the Perspective of Analytic Hierarchy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Mengding mount of Mingshan county is the cradle of the world culture, which has super physical geography resource, But its market is not very well although this county has been promoting industrialized operation strategy all this years. Built on field research, this paper has constructed the builds index system of market competitiveness, and then it uses AHP to research all the competitive factors of this county and finally put forward some specific measures and suggestions.

articleTitle: A Research on the Mechanism of Action of the Knowledge Management to the Core Competitiveness in Publishing Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper tells us the content of core competitiveness of publishing enterprises on the basis of summary of different expressions to the core competitiveness in publishing enterprises. Then, it analyzes the mechanism of action enhancing the core competitiveness in the publishing enterprises from two aspects which is the process of knowledge management and the framework of knowledge management in publishing enterprises in detail and builds a model of the Mechanism of action of Knowledge Management to the Core Competitiveness in the Publishing Enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Beer Market Based on Quantitative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China beer industry has been developing rapidly for years. Chinese market is known as the fastest growing beer market in the world. In order to analyze the Chinese beer market and find the way out to establish new brands, we have done a research and quantitative analysis on the Chinese market.

articleTitle: Cost Imitation and Instant Decision Based on Speed Competition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to the changes in the business environment, it requires dynamic strategy and new source of competitive advantage, it needs to predict the trend of cost and market objectively, and respond quickly to change. This paper discusses the method of cost imitation and expands cost category based on the theory of speed competition, and finally puts forward how to build a dynamic competition mechanism of instant decision.

articleTitle: The Factors Analysis Influencing on the Service Quality Disparity of the E-Banking Information Security Ensuring Products
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The drastic development of E-Banking business has brought great cost saving and enormous rise of profit for commercial bank entities, so that every commercial banks are actively developing E-Banking business, and more attention and capital have also been inputted upon the development of information security ensuring products to ensure the safety of E-Banking. Because the information security ensuring products provided by each E-Banking is comparatively mature, and with similar functions, to a great degree, the competition of E-Banking customer acquisition has turned into the service quality competition of the E-Banking information security ensuring products. Based on the service quality disparity analysis model of the service marketing theory, this paper attempts to analysis the concept, detail performances and reasons of service quality disparities in the E-Banking information security ensuring products, and discover some valuable arguments for the subsequent researches on the service quality disparities bridge strategies.

articleTitle: Dynamic International Executive Logistics Talent Attributes Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study explores the skills that construct the international executive logistics talents in China. It proposes international executive logistics talent attribute model based on the enterprise dynamic capacity.

articleTitle: The New Measurement of Chinese Urban Residents Precautionary Motive and It's Interpretation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The extraordinary growth of savings in China has been to the attention of all walks of life. This paper derived new formula to measure residents precautionary saving their intensity based on the theory of the precautionary saving and the hypothesis that a rational consumers maximize one's utility, measure of. Then, we did empirical analysis by making use of annual data of 30 provincial regions from 1992 to 2009. The results showed that there exist obvious precautionary saving motivation in urban residents, and provincial difference of precautionary saving motivation intensity did exist.

articleTitle: The Participation of Social Organizations in the Environmental Reconstruction after Wenchuan Earthquake
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From one of the worst catastrophes of the century -Wenchuan earthquake, the environmental reconstruction effects of social organizations are evaluated in the paper. Social organizations are always engaged in spreading knowledge and mobilizing the public, so as to accumulate social capital for environmental reconstruction. Some social organizations will assess the environmental impact of the disaster, and undertake ecological programs. In the future, China's domestic social organizations are supposed to accelerate their process of role-transformation from "propagator" to "advocator", and step towards the way of "check and balance" by means of public participation. Social organizations should carry out the strategic measures focusing on their responsibility of environmental improvement, and promote the experts and think-tank to provide professional services. What is more, it is significant for social organizations to communicate with the government agencies and try to construct the legal and political environment in favor of the development of social organizations, and thus establish their cooperative relationship.

articleTitle: An Audit Decision Aid System for Management Fraud Risk Assessment Using AHP-CBR
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In today's world economy, auditing has become more critical than ever. It was found that the use of audit decision aid systems to identify the risk of management fraud has become a promising solution. In this paper, a hybrid model of integrating case-based reasoning (CBR) and analytical hierarchy process (AHP) is proposed as fraud assessment model. In particular, the frame of the management fraud risk assessment system based on the CBR-AHP model is given. The system can facilitate auditors in performing the task of management fraud risk assessment in auditing.

articleTitle: The Research of the Current Situation about the Sports Stars as Spokesperson in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By using the methods of documentation, expert interview and related sports economics principle, the author made a research of the current situation about the sports stars as spokesperson, and also offered some suggestions on how to develop this behavior healthily. The purpose of this paper is to improve the market development of sports stars as spokesperson and to prompt the development of China's undertakings of sports culture.

articleTitle: Study on the Logistics System Optimization Strategy of Steel Enterprises Based on Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the context of the post financial crisis, the steel trading and export become more difficult, the steel enterprises attention is attracted to the steel logistics.
