This paper analyzes the problems in steel logistics system development, and then proposes some measures to optimize the steel logistics system based on supply chain. These will enable the logistics to be the third profit source of the steel enterprises, which will continuously enhance their competitive strength.

articleTitle: Study on the Innovation of System of Financial Management of the Public Sectors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Currently, there exist in the construction of system of public financial management certain problems and inadequacies, which cannot meet the public sectors' demand for financial management and fiscal management. Under the supervision of the government and with support of relevant theory, efforts should be made to sort out the problems existed in the system of public financial management to establish a combined mechanism that consists of expenditure decision, budget management, process control management, financial supervision, and achievement evaluation and etc to promote the Public Financial Management System to be more scientific, standard and precise.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis on the Successful Factors of Implementing Enterprise Resource Plan System in Chinese Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to reveal the successful factors of enterprise resource plan system implementation, the exploring factorial analysis (EFA) model is used in this paper. By the theoretical analysis on model construction, data collection and model examination, the EFA model can effectively reveal the interrelation between ERP implementation and five factors such as the organization supports, the BPR, the construction of the professional team, the IT support and the continuous innovation in Chinese Enterprises. For illustration, the collected copies are 100 enterprises, in which 97 copies are valid. The empirical results show that both the confirmation data of the independent variable system and the confirmation data of the dependent variable have the satisfying reliability. The organization support and the leadership support are first essential factors of affecting ERP implementation success in Chinese Enterprises. The empirical research provides the theatrical reference with the feasible value for Chinese enterprises to improve the ERP-related operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Landscape Pattern Change in Coal Mining Subsidence Area of Shandong Province, China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By using GIS and RS techniques, landscape pattern dynamics of coal mine area of Shandong Province of China were studied from 1988 to 2008. The results showed that (1) Arable land could be taken on as the landscape matrix, as dominating in the landscape with the area percent of 91.71% in 1988 and 71.13% in 2008; construction land accounting for 7.65% in 1988 and 10.83% in 2008. The area of coal mining subsidence land increased from zero to 5300 hm2 markedly, and the area of mining land increased from 200 hm2 to 937.25 hm2 owning to coal mining work. (2) The number of land patches of the total landscape was 5982 in 1988 and 7798 in 2008, meanwhile mean patches area decreased form 5.19hm2 to 3.98hm2, which showed that the landscape fragment degree increased due to coal mining work, economy development and population increase. (3) The total area of arable land decreased 7024.28 hm2, of which 61.34% was subsidence land, 24.42% construction land, and 14.24% mining land that was the typical characteristics of land transition in coal mining area.

articleTitle: Research on the Product Whole Lifecycle Management under the Perspective of Integrated Innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Integration is the trend of innovation. Enterprise resources can be optimized allocation through integration innovation. In this paper, the Innovative Approaches will be integrated into product whole lifecycle management with the theory of integrated innovation, and a integration system based on innovation approaches will be built in product lifecycle.

articleTitle: Empirical Research of Internal Marketing in China's Star Hotels
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to reveal internal marketing effect in China's Star hotels, structural equation model (SEM) is used in this paper. By employee satisfaction index system, customer satisfaction index system, data collection and model validation, SEM can effectively reveal the effect of internal marketing of the hotel industry. For illustration, 276 samples were selected from seven provinces and cities, in which 192 valid data were obtained. The empirical results show that the minimum value of load factor of 24 indicators was 0.56, and were significantly stronger (T value of the minimum was 2.76). Therefore, the validity of findings was good. The minimum value of the Cronbach α coefficient was 0.8818, so the reliability was higher. The empirical research has revealed that because China's Star hotels carry out internal marketing, they has achieved satisfying results, but the potential expansion can be still much in the future. Face of the global hotel market competition, China's hotel industry is still to have some underlying strength. The conclusions can provide scientific and reasonable theory reference for internal marketing in China's Star hotels.

articleTitle: Exploring Internet-Based Crisis Communication Management in the Public Sector: A System Dynamics Approach
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the emergence of the Internet and the World Wide Web, how to effectively deal with dissemination of crisis information in the public sector has become an urgent and practical problems for government practitioners and other participants. Based on the System Dynamics approach, this study developed the concept model, the logical model and the system dynamics model to describe the public crisis information dissemination over the Internet. The hypothesis, the mathematical functions and the flow diagram for the Internet-based Public Crisis Communication Model were provided. Some managerial implications were also proposed.

articleTitle: The Perspective of the Development of County-Level Enterprises under the Background of Global Financial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper focuses on the financial crisis over the global economy, which greatly impacts the development of county-level enterprises. The paper analyzes the severe market distress country-level enterprises facing and points out the way for county-level enterprises to seize the opportunity and seek for new growth factor.

articleTitle: Studied on Weights of Performance Evaluation Index for Middle-Level Cadres of Enterprise Based on Analytical Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Middle-level cadres of state-owned enterprises (or in senior management) are the backbone of the enterprise, but Personnel (Human Resources) department needs to focus on the issue that how they can assess and evaluate middle-level cadres scientifically. One of important parts of appraising middle-level cadres is to establish evaluation index system, and to determine the weights is the key to establishing evaluation index system. This paper discusses the related issues about index system and weight, and how to empowering the weights of indicators with AHP method will be discussed.

articleTitle: Some Suggestion on Gasoline Conservation Management Policy - An Empirical Analysis Using Cointegration and Error-Correct Model Techniques
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is of great significance to study gasoline conservation management policies for that the demand for gasoline continually grow rapidly and the high dependence on oil imports in China. In this paper, the relationship between gasoline consumption, national income and price of gasoline is empirically examined using cointegration and error correction techniques. And with a comparative analysis, this paper gets conclusions as follows: A one-size-fits-all national management policy is not appropriate for the purpose of gasoline conservation, and the gasoline conservation management policy should pay more attention to its long-term effects. The management policy of increasing the price of gasoline (such as fuel tax, etc.) is very limited in reducing gasoline consumption, and is not highly recommended in most of the provinces. In some province, management measures improve both the current and future gasoline consumption behavior will be effective, while in others measures improve current gasoline consumption behavior will be better. And the Publicity instrument is recommended in most provinces.

articleTitle: A Parallel Genetic Algorithm Based on TBB for Resolving the Bin-Packing Problem
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper presents a novel Three-tier Parallel Genetic Algorithm (TPGA) based on multi-core computer with Threading Building Blocks (TBB). The purpose of a new parallel function is to improve the running efficiency. TPGA is decomposed into three-tier: data coding parallelism, task processing parallelism and data decoding parallelism and it can improve the convergence rate. TBB offers a rich and complete approach to express parallelism in a C++ program. Sequential Genetic Algorithm (SGA) and TPGA are implemented based on TBB with C++ for bin-packing problem. Experiments show that the optimal solutions of TPGA and SGA are Consistent and the running efficiency of TPGA is also sooner than one of SGA.

articleTitle: Value Analysis of the Foreign E-Government Development Strategies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the ICT and Internet, the E-government has been adopted by many nations which are aiming to reform their traditional management in the public sector. This paper aims to analyze the value of E-government development strategies in various nations. By making research on the core values of E-government strategies in these nations, this paper tries to generate some valuable suggestions on how to reinforce and improve the E-government strategy and better its utilization in the context of globalization.

articleTitle: Study on the Financial Predicament of Small and Medium-Sized High-Tech Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Financial support plays an important role in the development of high-tech enterprises and industrialization. Meanwhile, financial predicament has been the key obstacle to small and medium-sized high-tech enterprises. This paper introduces industrial and financing characteristics of high-tech enterprises and analyzes the financial predicament of small and medium-sized high-tech enterprises. Then the authors put forward policy suggestions.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Development of China's Trade in Services Based on International Financial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the adjustment of world economic structure and upgrade of industrial optimization, trade in services has become a new driving force to promote the global economic growth, and its development has become an important symbol to measure a country's foreign trade and national strength. This paper focused on the impact of the international financial crisis on China's trade in services, the factors influencing the development of China's trade in services, as well as the countermeasures which should be taken in the development of China's trade in services during the post-financial crisis period.

articleTitle: Do Firms' Projectizing Businesses Boost Their Growth Performances?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: 79 firms were empirically tested on the relationship between the organizational projectizing management factors (OPMFs) and their growth performances with an assessment indicator defined as the comprehensive organizational projectizing level (COPL). The result of the cross-section data analysis in their temporal dimension gives off the hint that the firms in different growth stages may be required to match certain COPL.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Integrated Risk Management and Early-Warning System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the more uncertainty of the internal and external environment, the enterprises are aware of the importance of the risk early-warning management. However, currently, the development of the risk early-warning management system of enterprises in China is relative laggard. Based on this background, this article builds integrated risk early-warning system the enterprise risk management system. The author hopes that it can offer some use to researching on enterprise integrated risk early-warning management.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Construction Mode of Chongqing Public Rental Housing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays in China, The development of Public Rental Housing (PRH) has become the main content of the construction of Subsidized Housing. Chongqing took the lead in the large-scale construction of PRH and accumulated meaningful experiences in the PRH construction mode and policy measures. This paper explicitly depict the Chongqing PRH construction in its significance, land guarantees, money assurances and etc., and concludes several policy suggestions to the perfection of the PRH construction system, which could be enlightment nationwide.

articleTitle: Accounting Problems of Safety Investment of Enterprise in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The situation of the safety production of enterprise is very severe in China due to the insufficient safety investment. The accounting has unique effect if using it to manage the safety investment activity. However, the accounting function in safety investment of enterprise in China does not effectively mobilized. Based on the factors, Current situation of accounting of safety investment of enterprise in China is analyzed. The accounting problems of safety investment are investigated. The improvement measures of accounting of safety investment are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Outsourcing Decision Model and Modes of Television Media Asset Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the drivers of television media asset management outsourcing in China, establishes a decision model for outsourcing in television media asset management from three dimensions - strategic position, heterogeneous resource and media capability, and constructs four outsourcing modes, which are learning-oriented mode, cooperation-oriented mode, entrustment-oriented mode, and transfer-oriented mode.

articleTitle: Perceptions of Chinese Negotiation Behavior: A Quantitative Study of Differences in Perceptions between Chinese and Western Managers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Chinese-Western business negotiations often fail because of cultural differences. Our research aims at investigating whether and how the self-perception of Chinese negotiation behavior differs to the perception of Western managers. This contributes to identifying possible areas of conflict. For this reason a quantitative survey was conducted among managers from German speaking countries and from China. Our results show that the impact of Confucian values and external conditions on Chinese negotiation behavior are perceived similarly by Western and Chinese managers. However, the Western perception and interpretation of Chinese stratagems thinking differs significantly. In particular, our results show that the purpose of the principal agreement is perceived contrarily.

articleTitle: When Will Employees with High Impact Quit? The Interactive Effect of Impact and Supervisor's Monitoring on Chinese Employees' Turnover Intention
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By collecting data from employees of Chinese organizations, this study examined the relationship between employee's impact (one of the dimensions of psychological empowerment) and turnover intention, and the moderating effect of supervisor's monitoring on this relationship. Results show that impact did not decrease turnover intention and, rather, increased turnover intention when supervisor's monitoring was high. These findings demonstrate that psychological empowerment's effect on job behavior may not be universal, but culturally specific. Practical implications for Chinese managers to more effectively empower employees were also discussed.

articleTitle: HIV Related Stigma and Collectivism Orientation Acting as Predictors of Unemployment of People Living with HIV/AIDS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: HIV related stigma is regarded as one of the major barriers that prevent PLWHA from returning back to normal life. The current study builds on previous research regarding barriers to employment among PLWHA by investigating the role of perceived incompetence in addition to the fear of contagion from the viewpoint of employers in charge of recruiting new employees, which is crucial in verifying the perception of PLWHA and helpful in overcoming employment barriers. The function of collectivism is also discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Case Study of Analyzing the Brand Strategy Implementation of Zhengzhou Yu Tong Bus Co., Ltd.
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article focuses on the implementation tactic for brand strategy of Zhengzhou Yu tong Bus Co., Ltd. Based on analyzing on the implementation of its brand strategy, we get the following conclusions: (1) Business should subdivide market to locate brand accurately; (2) Business should use marketing innovation as implementation path of business brand strategy; (3) Sustaining technique innovations are life of business brand strategy; (4) Business should set up corporate culture to embody the brand worth of business; (5) Brand maintenances are the keys of business brand strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the Relations between Managerial Self-Efficacy and Job Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Previous studies have shown that the level of managerial self-efficacy (MSE) could affect many working variables, such as the job performance, leader behavior, occupation tension, turnover intention. But studies couldn't reach an agreement when testing relationship between MSE and job satisfaction. Meanwhile, with economic growth, banks have more and more important position in China's economy. The level of managerial self-efficacy and job satisfaction concerned the victory in the competition. In this paper, we studied MSE's effect on job satisfaction and sought positive effecting factors from six dimensions of MSE, aiming at providing managerial guidance for corporate.

articleTitle: Eastern and Western Innovative Conception Differences Embodied in "Mouse" and "Mickey Mouse"
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper has analyzed the differences in the concept of innovative thinking between the East and the West by using a common animal in people's daily life. Through mouse and Mickey Mouse, it shows a deeper cultural phenomenon about innovative thinking of the Chinese and Westerners. This paper analyzes mouse which ranks first in the Zodiac of Chinese, successfully transformed into Mickey Mouse in the Western world. And by enlarging the internal factors of this phenomenon, it reflects the differences in thinking innovation between Chinese and Western cultures. First of all, rich culture of China and Western world in politics, religion and different beliefs reflects the different ways of thinking between Chinese and Westerners. Secondly, there will be a discussion and reflection of differences in innovative thinking between the East and the West. Finally, with the development of the global village environment, innovative thinking will promote the Eastern and Western development and it will have a more harmonious integration.

articleTitle: Risk Perception of Interpersonal Relationships among Employees
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The types of risk perception and the factors influencing it when employees establish and maintain interpersonal relationships within organizations in China were explored. The result showed that the factors influencing the risk perception of interpersonal relationships included four categories, namely, spillover effects, features of the other side, personality fit, and status fit. The risk perception was composed of two types: life-affection related risks and career-benefit related risks. On subordinate-supervisor interpersonal relationships, the relationship among influencing factors of risk perception, types of risk perception, supervisor commitment, and closeness were explored.

articleTitle: Establishing Scientific and Reasonable Performance Evaluation System of Fiscal Expenditure on Science and Technology - A Study Based on the Current Performance Evaluation System of Fiscal Expenditure on Science and Technology of Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: the performance evaluation of fiscal expenditure on science and technology is an indispensable work in the management of science and technology. However, through analyzing the current situation of the performance evaluation system of fiscal expenditure from Zhejiang provincial government on science and technology, we've identified the following problems: the evaluation attitude proves to be eager for quick success and instant benefits; be lack of independent performance evaluation organizations; the evaluation system is incomplete, lack of separate evaluation system with strong pertinence. Therefore, it's time to sort through the minds for the purpose of establishing the performance evaluation system of fiscal expenditure on science and technology; meanwhile it is necessary to design organizational architectures and systems for the government and consummate its methodology system.

articleTitle: The Investigation of Health Investment Environment for Part of Small and Medium-Sized Fitness Clubs in Wuhan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the wake of awareness for health issues, people have paid more and more attention to the health investment for themselves. In recent years, joining the fitness clubs has been a popular way for people to invest health. Fitness clubs' investment environment has a significant impact on the health investment benefit of the consumers and profit of fitness clubs. Therefore, fitness clubs' investment environment is an important issue of common concern to the consumers and insiders. In order to provide necessary information for the consumers and the fitness clubs, this study conducted a field survey on part of the small and medium sized fitness clubs in Wuhan. We analyzed these clubs' fitness items, profit brought by the investment intention of consumers and its investment environment' practical utility and value for the consumers.

articleTitle: Long-Term Effect of Thinning and Creating Gaps on Tree Regeneration and Understory Vegetation in Larch Plantation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The influences of different management operations on tree regeneration and understory vegetation were tested 20 years after thinning in larch plantations in the Loess Plateau of China. Five treatments were conducted: unthinned, uniform light, moderate, heavy thinning, and creation of gaps. Creating gaps noticeably enhanced tree regeneration and understory vegetation development. In contrast, the effect of light and moderate thinning on tree regeneration was slight. Shade-tolerant species dominated seedling communities in unthinned and lightly and moderately thinned stands, while the importance value of shade-intolerant species increased with the intensity of thinning. These results suggest that creating gaps in larch plantations can be an effective way of improving tree regeneration and increasing the diversity of shrubs and herbs in the long-term. However, the results also suggest that uniform light and moderate thinning are probably too slight to improve either of these outcomes. Thus, periodically variable density thinning should be considered for both biodiversity conservation and timber production in larch plantations.

articleTitle: Research on the Performance of Foreign Capital Merger & Acquisition of Chinese Listed Companies Based on EVA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper uses economic value added (EVA) as a tool to analyze whether foreign-capital merger and acquisition (M&A) can effectively improve the performance of listed companies in China and the impact degree of the type of foreign-capital M&A on its performance, which will provide investment decision support for a listed company before its acquisition in order to achieve the rational use of foreign capital to integrate the resources. Using the modified EVA system, the paper compares vertically and analyzes the performance of M&A listed companies by foreign capital during 2003-2006 according to one year before, the year, one year after, and two years after the foreign-capital M&A, and examines the performance before and after M&A of the listed companies of horizontal, vertical and mixed M&A to verify whether foreign-capital M&A can bring value creation for listed companies in China. The results show that all the sample companies' average EVA is increased year by year after M&A from one year before to two years after the M&A. Foreign-capital M&A activities helps to improve the performance of the listed companies, and it creates value for the company; Different types of M&A results in different M&A performance, seeing from the average EVA, horizontal M&A companies' performance is increased year by year in the three years from the year before to the year after M&A, which demonstrates horizontal M&A can promote the company's development by scale economy effect in a short of time and create M&A value. The performance of vertical M&A and mixed M&A companies are all first decreased then increased, which shows that performance producing needs a process for both the vertical M&A focusing on the transaction costs reduce and the mixed M&A designed to achieve diversification operations of the company, in this process, the company's performance may even fall down temporarily. Both vertical M&A and mixed M&A have certain of risk, the successfully integration after M&A is the key to the expected effects. Through internal market transactions, vertical M&A can expedite supply and marketing channels, reduce the uncertainty of risk and cost, obtain the purpose of enhancing the stability of company development; while through diversification operations, mixed M&A can realize industry transformation of the company to foster new earnings point, thus disperse risk, and improve corporate performance.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Behavioral Factors of Using Mobile IT Service According to Attribute of Platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this research, we have studied how each IT mobile service platform characteristic affected subjective norm, attitude towards purchasing, perceived behavioral control, and other intentions for purchasing. This research carries out an analysis of the consumers who accommodate innovative technology through characteristics of next-generation mobile communication technology by applying the Theory of Planned Behavior stated by Ajzen (1991), which carried out a socio-psychological study of causal relationship in regards to humans' behavioral intention. First of all, participants were categorized into innovative group and non-innovative technology group based on the characteristic of accommodating the innovative technology by the customers to compare the characteristics of consumer behavior according to each category. Second of all, this very research categorized consumers into four different potential consumer group consumer groups according to four different characteristics of next-generation innovative technology to analyze and compare the difference for influencing factor that differs from each consumer group.

articleTitle: The Effectiveness of Negotiated Agreements and Its Inspirations for Chinese Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science

authors.preferredName: Theo J. N. M. De Bruijn

abstract: Negotiated agreements have become a widely used management model with respective covenants for different social network context in European countries. Negotiated agreements between government and industry in which industry obliges to take 'voluntary' action to help realizing regional management objectives. This paper describes and analyses development of the use of such covenant model in European public administration practice. After an extensive evaluation of the effects of the covenants in the European social network context, the paper conducts a comparable study of the Chinese knowledge management also in social network context, and expose that Chinese knowledge management policy and knowledge management practice is still in the first stage of Europe public administration evolution. As a conclusion, the paper explores the possible application of covenants model in Chinese knowledge management.

articleTitle: Comparison Study of Construction Model of Innovative City: Pittsburgh, Tsukuba and Singapore
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we compare the models of three innovative cities - Pittsburgh, Tsukuba and Singapore, which belong to transformative innovation city, scientific and technological innovation city, and comprehensive innovation city, respectively. Three are seven differences - such as risk investment mechanism, etc., and four similar aspects - such as context, etc. The conclusion is that, The critical factors of innovative city are risk investment mechanism, policies and regulations, and innovative culture.

articleTitle: Financial Risk Management in Infrastructure Energy Projects
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Risk is a concern for any project whereas infrastructure energy projects are considered more sensitive. The complication of such projects is deepened by great deal of required capital, lots of interfaces and diversified stakeholders. While capital is of the essence, its provision could be done through 'project finance' or 'traditional finance'. The two streams of lending are elaborated while the prominence of risk management is justified in the context. Thereafter risk factors affecting energy projects are detailed and result of a survey from Iranian managers are briefed i.e. 'Host country risk', 'Weak feasibility study' and 'Unclear regulation' are among the most effective risk factors.

articleTitle: Strategy and Execution: A Study on Process Management in an Enterprise Based on Value Innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Innovation based on customer value is necessity when an enterprise wants to develop. While a successful innovation needs excellent execution, and what's more an integrated and harmonious operation process. This paper first reviews much existing literature on multitudinous facets of the subject, and then puts forward that a value innovation enterprise should have a process management capability, and provides some suggestion to future study.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Consumer Satisfaction Based on Experiential Marketing of Communications Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This thesis attempts to study the consumer satisfaction of communications enterprises from the perspective of experiential marketing. In order to make the study more targeting and convincing, this thesis selects China Mobile as its studying object, adopts theories from management, marketing, consumer behavior and other courses theories, and employs the research method of integrating theoretical and empirical studies. First, this thesis proposes the model and hypothesis about consumer satisfaction based on experiential marketing. Secondly, through the factor analysis, the variance analysis and the related analysis, this thesis establishes the hypothesis advanced earlier. Finally, this thesis analyzes the result of empirical study and brings forward a series of marketing strategies accordingly.

articleTitle: Parametrical Regulation of Economic Growth Based on the Stochastic Computable Model of General Equilibrium with Knowledge Sector
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper aims to present one new method of parametrical identification, the results of development of the parametrical regulation theory and to show the application efficiency of the proposed method of identification and theoretical results for solving the respective problems of application. The paper describes the proposed method of parametrical identification, we formulated and proved the theorems about the conditions for the existence of one of the problems of variational calculus on the synthesis of the optimal law of parametrical regulation and about the conditions for continuous dependence of optimal values of the criterion of the given problem on unregulated parameters applying the mathematical objects of a discrete stochastic control system. The problems of parametrical identification of the calculated general equilibrium model with knowledge sector were solved effectively. Also we show the efficiency of determining the optimal values (in sense of the criterion, that characterizes economic growth) of the parameters of deterministic and stochastic versions of the computable general equilibrium model with knowledge sector.

articleTitle: The Availability of the Credit Finance: The Influence of the Entrepreneurs Different Characters and the Marketization Degree - Based on the Non State-Controlled SMEs Verifying
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper discussed the impact of entrepreneurs' wealth concentration, their risk aversion, and the degree of financial marketization on credit finance availability for SMEs. This paper found that entrepreneurs' wealth concentration of SME was significant indicate a signal from control rights to outside investors. Furthermore, The degree of financial marketization has a positive effect on the credit financing availability, but we have no evidence on the significance between entrepreneurs' risk aversion and debt availability. Finally, it found that the operating performance and the size of the SMEs are important factors to affect credit financing availability. The empirical study showed that, under current capital market, the differences of entrepreneurs' characters of non state-controlled SME have become one of important criteria when getting credit financing, and have become one of good reference to improving the efficiency of credit financing. Moreover, increasing financial marketization will help to amplify the entrepreneurs' characters

articleTitle: Business Valuation Based on Intellectual Capital: A Hierarchical Clustering-MARS Approach
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The traditional valuation methods developed in industrial economy can't accurately appraise firms in knowledge economy due to their ignorance of intellectual capital. Based on the value creating mechanism of intellectual capital, this study proposes a novel valuation approach named hierarchical clustering-MARS approach. The method intelligently searches similar firms as target firm through hierarchical clustering, and utilizes nonparametric multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS) technique to estimate the value creation function for target firm. Then the target firm value is forecasted using the estimated value creation function. The study also investigates the effectiveness of the new approach by a sample of Chinese high technology firms listed in A-share market. The empirical result proves that the hierarchical clustering-MARS approach meets the accuracy requirement of appraisal and is of practical use.

articleTitle: Is Low-Carbon Together with Pollution Reduction? - Calculation of CO2 Emissions from Municipal Wastewater Treatment Plants
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Municipal wastewater treatment plants (WWTP) are recognized as an important source of carbon emissions. Previous studies have calculated the CO2 emissions in the operating process of WWTP in the sight of engineering technology and the CO2 emission which is driven by the pulling effect of investment in WWTP are ignored. This paper calculates the CO2 emissions of wastewater treatment plant from the macroscopic view based on the input-output method and the fixed log-liner model. The study discovers that Compared to the indirect CO2 emissions from WWPT, the direct carbon dioxide emissions from WWPT are negligible. It calculates that in the year 2007, China's CO2 emissions of WWTP in construction process amount to 98.23 million tons and the emissions in operating process is 11.24 million tons. The indirect emissions are 8.74 times the direct emissions; and the reduction of 1 ton of COD pollutants generates about 14.7 tons of carbon dioxide emissions.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Influencing Factors of Cooperation Mode Selection for ERP Project Implementation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes the influencing factors of cooperation mode selection for decision-making on ERP project implementation, based on expert interviews and theoretical analysis. Employing the questionnaire and survey, we further extract eight key factors of this mode selection through the exploratory factor analysis approach.

articleTitle: The Study on the Relationship of Team Boundary Management, Cohesion and Attitudes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are limitations of studies on team building from different perspectives. The conclusions of relations between the internal processes, boundary-spanning activities, cohesion and effectiveness are contradictory in those studies. A survey was used to collect relevant data for study of these issues. Path analyses were conducted for hypothesis testing. There are some conclusions as follow: First, inward-facing boundary management has a significant effect on outward-facing boundary management, which means the mutual supportive and synergic relation between them. Second, inward-facing boundary management has a significant effect on cohesion and attitudes, and the mediating roles of team cohesion to the relationship between inward-facing boundary management and team attitudes are supported. Third, the assumption on relationships between outward-facing boundary management, cohesion and attitudes is supported partially.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Development Feature and Competitiveness in Anhui Industrial Cluster
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial cluster, a new spatial form of economic organization, has played an important role on regional economic development. Based on the industrial cluster theory, This paper analyzes the status, competitive strengths and weaknesses of industrial cluster in Anhui Province, and proposes a way to enhance its competitiveness. The conclusion shows that industrial cluster will become an important driving force for Anhui to achieve the strategy of "Rise of Central China".

articleTitle: The Co-Evolution of the Knowledge Networks and the Learning Pattern of Core Enterprise in Cluster: A Case Study of Chint Electric
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the role of the core enterprise in cluster becoming increasingly prominent, the study on the knowledge network and learning patterns of core enterprise in cluster has great significance. Based on previous research and theoretical illation, we obtain a theoretical framework. We then choose Chint Electric for case studies, and the research shows that the knowledge network and learning patterns of the core enterprise in cluster exists coupled relation, and this relation will evolve with Corporate Life cycles . In addition, for the core enterprise, which is in it's ascension and spanning period,the main source of it's knowledge is from the outside of cluster. These conclusions have a strong practical significance.

articleTitle: "Hands On - Hands Off": Centralized vs. Decentralized Management of Economic Systems by Nonlinear Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study is proposing a semi-quantitative, unbiased "hands on - hands off" partition of the economic systems on the bases of whether they are or are not exhibiting structure as revealed by non linear time series analysis. The analysis is performed on the corresponding exchange rate time series with respect to the United States Dollar. The structure is related to the impact of the ongoing economic crisis upon several economic systems. By assessing the effect of the financial hit as "recession / no recession", the analysis of 26 economic systems has revealed that almost all systems suffered financial shock but not all financial shocks were followed by economic recession. The evidence of the financial shock is addressed in terms of the specific quantities of time series analysis i.e. flatness and Holder exponent. Under the assumption that the "hands on" economies are more robust against the crisis, the crossing analysis emphasizes that systems that do have such a structure could be assigned to a certain degree of centralization imprinted by an unspecified influential entity in the decision making process.

articleTitle: A Relative Green Degree Evaluation Model for Equipments of Iron and Steel Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To implement the sustainable development in iron and steel industry, many iron and steel enterprises have begun to explore the way of green manufacturing. In this paper, a relative green degree evaluation model for equipments of iron and steel enterprises is established. A five-dimension evaluation index system for equipment is created which is TPCRE (T-Time, P-Performance, C-Cost, R-Resource, E-Environment). On the basis of the index system, relative green degree evaluation of the equipments of iron and steel enterprises is made by data envelopment analysis (DEA). Taking three steelmaking & continuous casting equipments for example, the relative green degree of equipments is evaluated using the evaluation model. And the status of equipments whose green degree is weak or invalid is analyzed and some improving suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on the Effects of Structural Factors of Population, Employment and Industry on Regional Economic Development: An Empirical Analysis Based on Cross-Sectional Data of 31 Provincial Regions in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the 2009 year-end cross-sectional statistical data of 31 provincial regions in China, the positive research of econometrics model shows clearly that, the major macroscopic structural factors to significantly influence regional economic development level (Per Capita GDP) in China are the urban-rural population structure (Urban Population Proportion), the employment structure (Employed Persons Proportion of Nonagricultural Industry) and the deviated degree of industrial structure to employment structure (Industrial Structure Deviation), while the influences of other factors or variables such as Value-added Proportion of Nonagricultural Industry, Urban/Rural Consumption Ratio, Final Consumption Rate, Capital Formation Rate and Natural Growth Rate of Population are not significant. Therefore, in order to further increase regional economic development level in China, it is necessary to quickly remove the institutional obstacles of dual urban-rural segmentation in various regions and establish the urban-rural integrated labor market, to accelerate the course of industrialization and urbanization, raise the urbanization rate based on strengthening service economy and perfect the urban-rural population structure, to increase the potency dimensions of urban-rural human resource development, promote the nonagricultural employment level, optimize the employment structure, and improve the rationalization, upgrading and service degree of industrial structure.

articleTitle: On the Failure of Monte Carlo Simulation and "Catastrophe Insurance"
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper argued with empirical evidences that insurance and reinsurance are never panacea in the realm of risk diversification in that the very tools based essentially on risk pooling which fails in the universe where occurrence of a single extreme event churns the pool. The author proves "catastrophe insurance" irrelevant and Monte Carlo simulation in cat-pricing fallible, concluding that cat-risk retention, as is employed by developing countries, might be optimal before innovative techniques dealing with randomness of extreme consequences is in sight.

articleTitle: The Governance Structure and Innovation System of Chinese State Firms after the Fundamental Reform: The Mid of 1990s to the First Decade of 2000s
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After the fundamental reforms, Chinese state firms' governance structure is similar to the coordinated firms' governance structure in coordinated market economies (CMEs) (like Japan, Germany and other Germanic countries). Therefore, the coordinated firms' governance structure in the Chinese state sector generates the organizational competitiveness and the coordinated type of innovation system as that in the CMEs. FDI and technology transfer from CMEs to China drive the convergence of the Chinese state sector towards CMEs. It contributes to the superior performance and technology modernization of the Chinese state sector. The reform of the state firms also makes the state play the coordination role in the technology modernization based on its controlling shareholding in the state firms.

articleTitle: Research on Product Manufacturing Cost Estimation Based on Materials Information Extracting from Parts List of Drawings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the method and techniques of extracting material information from engineer drawings and establishing product structure. In order to deal with the materials which don't have material code in the drawing, we build a statistics model based on materials being collected. We can gather the material list by making a medium template, and then integrate the CAD and ERP system with the information of the material list. A practical example is also introduced to describe the Manufacturing cost estimation with the obtained information of material lists.

articleTitle: Empirical Studies on City Innovative Capacity: Take Example for Tianjin Binhai New Area
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper is focused on the innovative basis of Tianjin Binhai New Area. With the index system which is made for the national innovative experimental city by the National Technical Department, the author use fuzzy synthetically evaluation to do empirical studies on and analyzes the innovative capacity of Tianjin Binhai New Area.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Evaluation of Scientific Research Team Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper mainly establishes a set of input-output evaluation indexes for the performance of scientific research team. And use DEA method to evaluate the performance effectively.

articleTitle: Customer-Oriented Supply Chain Integration in SMEs
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In today's demand-driven economy, enterprises should pay more attention to customer needs, and use the market information to impenetrate all processes to make the products/service satisfy the customer needs more efficiently and effectively. In order to satisfy the needs of customer and improve the performance of organization, managers(often in partnership with consultants) have resorted to a variety of new methodologies and techniques. As the concept of supply chain(SC) becomes widely accepted, supply chain integration(SCI) is gaining more attention among both academics and practitioners, especially for small to medium-sized enterprises(SMEs). The SCI includes internal integration, supplier integration and customer integration. This article used the key components that should be considered when integrate SC in SMEs. In the case of ADairy, after the integration of customer-oriented SC, its performance improved greatly.

articleTitle: The Nutrition Supplier's Technical Service Level, Feed Transfer Pricing and Profit Distribution in the Pig Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Apart from nutritional suppliers provide hog feed, but also provides technical services to help the raising enterprise to improve the technical capacity and raising standards, thus improving breeding efficiency. And nutritional suppliers also obtain benefit for the breeding efficiency improved; share the increase of the whole supply chain profits. The supplier will make the select decision for the investment of technical service based on the maximization of whole supply chain profit, according to the relationship between technical service investment and pig survival rate. Then, the increasing profit that brought by the investment of technical service will be distributed between the nutrition supplier and porkers enterprise. When technical service cost is less than the optimal cost, the increased profit of supply chain due to increase technical service investment and improve the survival rate, are greater than the technical service investment cost. That means the whole supply chain's profit will be increased. And the increasing profit would be distributed between two nodes. While the service cost equals the optimal cost, profit of whole supply chain is maximum; And when service cost is much more than the optimal cost, profit of the whole supply chain began to decline, and reduced part would be shared by two nodes.

articleTitle: The Contractor's Incentive Management Based on Interface Payment for the Owner
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the maximum interest of the owner and contractor, this paper introduced mental accounting theory and the principle of timely incentive, and made use of which in the interface payment incentive management to the contractor ; in order to make sure of the incentive time and payment to achieve the greatest incentive effect to the contractor, this paper focused on a psychological point of view by building incentive model to make the two parties win-win.

articleTitle: Comparative Evaluation and Regional Development Strategies of Guangxi Sports Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the theory that the development of sports industry is an important step to pick up the pace of sports industrialization and promote the sports reform and put the two-strategy program in practice, this paper analyzed the current situation of Guangxi sports industry, studied and discussed some measures to develope the sports industry in Guangxi.

articleTitle: Difficulty to Eliminate the Crux Problems with Illegal Advertising via the Advertising Management: An Information Economics Framework
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The advertising industry is one of the fastest growing industries after China's reform and opening up. The phenomenon of illegal advertisements in advertising industry has been growing show the impact of the normal order. To seek treatment strategy, first of all, we have to understand the root causes of it. From the special perspective of information economics, we analyzed the causes of illegal advertisements. We think, information goods attribute of advertising, 'illegal advertisement lemon', 'sub-adverse selection' and 'sub-moral hazard', optimal individual rational choice, externality theory of information networked, all these are major reasons for illegal advertising.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Consumer Adoption on 3G Value-Added Services in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Focus on the 3G value-added services market, influence factors of customers' adoption intention are discussed in this paper. Through reviewing on the previous research papers, a conceptual model of customer adoption is developed and nine important factors are proposed, namely perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, perceived price, perceived security, perceived enjoyment, need for uniqueness, network context compatibility, use experience and social influence. Then we conduct a big sample of questionnaire investigation in 3G value-added services market in China. Our empirical findings are as follow: (1) security and social influence are two of the most important factors in 3G market, (2) 3G value-added services should be perceived as enjoyment and useful, and (3) using context should be friendly and compatible.

articleTitle: Research on the Transference of the Surplus Rural Labor in New Rural Construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article, taking Wolong District in Nanyang city of Henan province as an example, has tried to give some suggestion to the problem of accelerating the transference of rural surplus labor force under the construction of new countryside by investigating its situation and factors related.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism of Rail Transit Construction Digital-Plat
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Rail transit has a great impact on society and economy, but the building difficulty is huge. The traditional project management has been unable to provide an effective way to meet these great challenges. It is necessary to establish a new management system. Virtual reality, dynamic control and decision-making support are three major functional modules of Digital-Plat. The application of platform could effectively strengthen the integration of Projects, promote knowledge management and promote the accuracy of construction, and it is fit for the project management of rail transit. This paper will analysis the mechanism of the three functional modules in depth, and draws the flow charts of them. Finally, measures and recommendations for implementing digital-plat are proposed.

articleTitle: Third-Party Payment Problems and Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the middle part, online payment is the most concerned problem in e-commerce transactions. Represented by third-party payment, online payment largely eliminates the concerns of people in online transactions, promoting development of e-commerce in China. However, third-party payment in practice also exposes some risks, and it is necessary to build secure third-party payment system, and promote the healthy development of third-party payment.

articleTitle: Bank-Enterprise Project Risk Evaluation Model Based on Risk Overlay
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: When a bank wants to invest the project that another forerunner banks has invested, the bank can judge the investment risk and make the decision independently by considering the forerunner bank's risk and project itself risk comprehensively. It refers to bank-enterprise project risk measurement problem. Here the forerunner bank is named counterparty or trading partners. Because it is impossible for bank to master all project information of different countries, different regions or different areas, it is important for all the commercial bank to assess the enterprise project risk by the counterparty bank's management style and risk. This research established bank-enterprise project risk measurement model based on the risk overlay in the condition that the bank can not master project information completely. The feature of the paper lies in that the counterparty risk and enterprise project risk can not add directly when they are linear correlation according to the standard method of risk overlay. We define the counterparty risk as the first random variables, the project risk which subtracting correlation part as the second random variables. We reveal that the project overall risk equals the counterparty risk plus enterprise project risk, minus correlation part by proving that the correlation coefficient of two random variables is 0.

articleTitle: Navigation Algorithm Reference to Real-Time Traffic Information
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The current communications and navigation products have been introduced real-time traffic, only referenced by users. But the performance is not good. This paper presents a solution on how to improve the existing navigation algorithm to adapt to the introduction of real-time traffic navigation products, and describes the specific technical issues encountered during the improvement process.

articleTitle: SMEs' Crucial Cruxes: A Perspective from the IPO Failures of GEM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: GEM provides an important financing channel and a selection mechanism for the growth enterprises. Only those that meet some certain standards such as continuous profitability and growth capability can go public on GEM. In this paper, we sum up the IPO failures of GEM to analyze why they didn't successfully go public on GEM. And by this means, we try to find out the existing crucial cruxes of China's SMEs . We come to the conclusion that being short of continuous profitability and growth capability is the main crux of China's SMEs. Based on this conclusion, we give some suggestions at the end of this paper.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of the Customer Equity Driving Factors Model of Travel Agency and Its Measurement
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer equity is the important content of firm management. Recognizing the driving factors of the customer equity, and exploring the relationship between the factors and customer equity, also the relationship among the factors, could provide theoretical support for the travel agency of customer management and customer maintenance. The study constructs the customer equity driving factors' conceptual model of the travel agency, and starts an empirical study. The research finds out that the relationship equity has the strongest impact among the three factors; the brand equity is significantly and positively impacting the customer equity; the value equity has a significant and positive impact on relationship value too.

articleTitle: The Engineering Construction Standard and Economic Benefits
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The engineering construction standard has covered the whole life cycle of construction projects. The application of the standard has brought every participant immense economic benefits. However, systemic researches on relationships between construction standard and its benefit are rarely seen by now. This paper will discuss, from the period, quality, and cost, the economic benefits that the engineering construction standard brings, and finally give some suggestions on the future development of the engineering construction standard.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Causes of Juvenile Delinquency - Based on the Sociological Angle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Juvenile delinquency has become one of the greatest social concerns. Its causes vary and are rather complicated. This article attempts to analysis the causes from a sociological angle.

articleTitle: Accounting Information, Stock Prices and Capital Market Efficiency - From the Automobile Industry of Chinese Listed Companies Empirical Data
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Stock prices are affected by many factors. Analyzing the correlation of accounting information and stock price is not only beneficial to enterprises and investors making related decisions, but also play an significant role to verify the effectiveness of capital market and to explore its operation rules. In this thesis, based on the relevant theory we selected 2009 annual reports of 40 listed companies in the automotive industry as a research sample and constructed an empirical model and used statistical software Eviews to do an empirical analysis. It shows that stock price is significantly associated with earnings per share and liquidity ratio, and has a weak correlation with asset-liability ratio, growth rate of total assets and net profit growth rate. That is to say the investors think a lot of the enterprise profitability, pay close attention to corporate solvency and enterprise growth ability, but take no count of investment. However, accounting information can reflect 70.6% of stock prices. China's capital market is basically in a semi-strong status.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Labor Conflict of Transnational Corporations under Globalization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since 1990, it is obvious that strong floating resources dominate the allocation of weak floating resources. Multinational corporations which take strong floating productive factors such as capital, technology and entrepreneurial ability are pursuing profit maximization in globalization. However, relatively fixed resource such as labor force is faced with more impact, and traditional labor market and industrial relations are subjected to severe challenge in different countries. Firstly this paper analyzes industrial relations, then discusses the behavior and the conflicts of tripartite mechanism. Finally, this paper brings some opinions on how to settle the industrial conflict.

articleTitle: Thinking on Deep-Seated Problems and Solutions in Higher Education Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In China, universities usually review their seconsdary sectors' work by means of performance assessment. It results in difficulty. To overcome it, it is critical to establish a unique assessment and evaluation system for secondary units and leaders, which is goal-oriented and based on the dissembled tasks and core performances. And it is also critical to classify and compare and balance departments' work and performances . And it is a must for us to attact teacher and student representatives to take part in the assessing activities. And it is necessary for us to use check and feedback for commendation and honor and reward for the unit, individuals and the team. All these steps will make the performance assessment more goal-oriented and stimulating.

articleTitle: Application of the Data Mining in the Personalized Information Service
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the explosive growth of the information in the WEB, people can have an easy access to information while also being plagued by a lot of spam. How to analyze and judge the real needs of the users, and provide the personalized information service for the users has become the concern for the information providers. This thesis introduces the application of the Data Mining in the personalized information service and illustrates the process of the Data Mining.

articleTitle: On the Appeal to the Public from Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The concept of sustainable development reflects the common, fundamental needs and interests of the human, and the values of sustainable development can not put aside the interests of the human, so, the fundamental interests of mankind are the ultimate value of sustainable development. However, sustainable development with the overall interest of human and the fundamental interests as its ultimate values can hardly effectively implemented and achieved in existing framework of markets and governmental. Facing market failure and government failure, sustainable development calls for public active, broad and deep participation.

articleTitle: Study on Automobile After-Sale Service Matching Based on Ontology CBR
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper firstly constructs an ontology model of automobile after-sale service to analyze internal relations among customer, automobile and after service; then it retrieves the most similar case (or cases) based on similarity measurement and CBR. Thus, active service is achieved.

articleTitle: Innovation in Green Technology Research of Forest Products Trade in the Context of Ecological Civilization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the ecological civilization background, the green technological innovation of forest products trade has been an emerging issue. The meanings of ecological civilization and green technical is different, based on domestic and overseas scholars, but the opinions that green technology innovation is an important trade strategy of sustainable development has been academic consensus. In order to realize the sustainable development of forest products trade, this paper puts forward the end-treatment technology innovation, green technology innovation and green product innovation of forest products trade green technological innovation, combining the characteristics of forest products trade.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanism of Collaborative Innovation between KIBS and the Client
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Outsourcing knowledge-intensive business service has become an important way for the enterprise acquiring knowledge as the development of specialization and informationization in contemporary production. However, there are some particularities in knowledge intensive services production, and enterprises have to face unique challenges when outsourcing knowledge-intensive service. This paper starts from analyzing the specialties of knowledge-intensive business service, and outline the decision process of enterprise outsourcing knowledge-intensive service and its motivation. This paper systematically examines the mechanism of collaborative innovation between KIBS and the client.

articleTitle: The Optimization of Empty Shipping Container Reposition Based on the Network Simplex Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The cost for the reposition of empty containers is very high. These issues from different angles have been researched by many scholars. According to the current realities, this paper researches the optimization of empty containers reposition from the angle of reducing the cost, and make use of linear programming method, formulate relatively model for in and out the ports or transferring of empty containers, and give an example to prove the model. At last, according to the results of the example, the model is reasonable and useful to solve these issues of the reposition of empty containers, and there is also a new quantitative analysis method for the research of the problem of single product low price.

articleTitle: The Research of the Nonlinear Relationship between Institutional Ownership and Capital Structure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Institutional investors impacting the capital structure of listed companies is an indisputable fact. However, previous studies using the linear method come to different conclusions. In this paper, using the 2006-2008 A-share listed data of China we find that: in current and lagged one year, the relationship between institutional ownership and capital structure of listed companies are non-linear and a reversed N-type. Institutional investors impact the capital structure both in the current and lagged year with a reversed N-type relationship. The study of institutional investors unified the differences in other researches, and helps to know the real relationship between institutional ownership and the capital structure.

articleTitle: High-Tech Virtual Industrial Cluster Resource Sharing Platform Based on Grid Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Resource sharing is one of construction aims of high-tech virtual industrial cluster (HTVIC) and furthermore is the key factor to keep cluster competitive force. This paper analyzes current situation and problems in resource sharing in HTVIC, and indicates the necessity of constructing a resource sharing platform in HTVIC. Combined with these studies, this paper puts forward a concept of resource sharing platform of high-tech virtual industrial cluster based on grid technology and sets up its architecture, and then discusses the platform's constitution and advantages.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Female Employees' Gender Role on Their Job Performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: SPSS software is used to analyze the statistical results of the investigation on the gender role and job performance of 485 female employees across the country. This paper discussed the distribution of the female gender role and finds out the significant differences in job performance between different gender roles and finds out that the level of masculinity is positively related to the job performance while the level of femininity is positively related to the contextual performance through Pearson's correlation analysis and stepwise regression analysis. Thus, the study not only enriches the theories related to the gender role and job performance, but also brings certain practical help to the daily management.

articleTitle: Inventory Risk Management of China's Manufacturing Enterprises - A Study Based on a Single-Period VaR Risk Measurement Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By using a single-period VaR risk measurement model in the risk management of manufacturing enterprises¿Cthe author of this article analyzed the influence of inventory risk on the performance of enterprises . Under the guidance of VaR model, and through studies on the impact of unit holding costs¿Cunit ordering cost and unit shortage cost¿Cand with managers' risk appetite, the author quantitatively analyzed enterprises inventory risk, and discovered that VaR risk measurement model is of operability and applicability in practical applications.

articleTitle: The Effect of Moral Consciousness of Employees on Their Counter-Productive Work Behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article is about how employees' moral consciousness affected their counter-productive work behavior. The present paper investigated 227 employees on the relationship between their moral consciousness and counter-productive. The result showed that employees with moral consciousness of high Idealism is less likely to engage in counter-productive work behavior for both organization and individual. However, for employees with moral consciousness of high Relativism, moral consciousness just can predict their counter-productive work behavior for individual, but has little relation with their counter-productive work behavior for organization.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Petroleum Enterprise Knowledge Management Performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper established the index system of petroleum enterprise knowledge management performance evaluation on the basis of analyzing factors of petroleum enterprise knowledge management performance. And it comprehensively evaluated petroleum enterprise knowledge management performance with the analytic hierarchy theory and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation theory. It can overcome the subjective defect of qualitative evaluation method and improve the management efficiency of petroleum enterprise.

articleTitle: The Strategic Development Research of Chinese Fire Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Selecting the planning and development of the new strategic industry as the breaking point, this paper analyzed the fire industry's present situation. Taking the following aspects as the study point, national industrial safety, technological innovation, personnel training, and management perfect, it has been pointed out that the establishment of a unified and effective fire industry system can be of help to fire modernization reform, can support the national industry development, and can be beneficial to the nation and its people.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis on the Competitiveness of Service Trade in China and Japan and Its Enlightenments for China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has analyzed the development of service trade in China and Japan, and has made a comparative analysis on the overall service trade and industrial structure in the two countries. The results show that the overall service trade in China and Japan both does not have a comparative advantage, and there are some differences in the competitiveness of service trade among various industries. At last, the corresponding strategies have been proposed about how to promote the competitiveness of service trade in China.

articleTitle: An Evolutionary Game Analysis of Hidden Rules on Accounting Standard Change
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The process in formulating accounting standards is practically the process of stakeholders achieve active equilibrium. Hidden rules are playing the vital role in our country economic reform and the system switcher aspect. This paper based on the evolved game theory analysis frame and analyzed the hidden rules to accountant criterion evolution gambling influence. This paper thought the initial condition and the current condition have the important influence to the production and the evolution of accounting standards.

articleTitle: The Construction of Grass-Roots e-Government in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The quality of grass-roots e-government not only directly affects the overall development of national e-government level, but also directly determines the ability of e-government public services. Therefore, via e-government, the government can improve the overall planning, organization and coordination, inspection and supervision as well as the ability of providing public services, establishing an efficient and streamlined government to promote political, economic and social progress. In this paper, based on the analysis of the present situation of Chinese grass-roots e-government, it gives the recommendations about construction of grass-roots e-government.

articleTitle: Analysis on Influence Factors of Agricultural Products Logistics Enterprises Development Based on DEMATEL Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The factors that influence the development of agricultural products logistics enterprises are determined, and the index system is built. The Delphi technique is used to determine the relationship between the factors, and the direct-relation matrix is built. Then the effects of the factors are analyzed quantitatively by decision making trial and evaluation laboratory (DEMATEL) approach. Based on this, the importance of the various factors that influence the development of agricultural products logistics enterprises is drawn.. Finally the corresponding strategies are present.

articleTitle: Structural Decomposition Analysis of Domestic CO2 Emissions from Export Products of Industrial Sectors in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article reviews the related documents about CO2 emission of import and export trade , and deduces and improves the input-output model to eliminate foreign influence of CO2 emission from import product in intermediate investment.. By means of two-pole decomposition method, structural decomposition analysis is conducted on changes of CO2 emission from 1997 to 2007. It has been revealed that improvement of efficiency effect contributes to CO2 emission reduction; reduction effect of productive structure and export structure in corporation has not yet been played, and scale effect increases CO2 emission.
