At last, the policy based on in-depth calculation on carbon emission of industry sectors has been proposed.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Relationship between Stock Market Returns and Macroeconomic Variables: The Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study will investigate whether current economic activities in china have explanatory power over stock returns, or not. Monthly data of Shanghai Securities Exchange Composite Index and a set of macroeconomic variables, including money supply (M2), Value-added of industry (VAI), are used in this study. Engel-Granger, Johansen-Juselius co-integration tests and Granger Causality test are used to explain the long-run relations between macroeconomic variables and stock index.

articleTitle: Study on Safety Green Barriers Based on International Trade
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Green Security Barrier is a non-tariff barriers in currently international trade which is applied by more and more developed countries to comply with, the barriers are in compliance with relevant national trade agreement and nominal reason is reasonable, especially China has been accession to the WTO, and unable to avoidable. At present, our country's many products have great lost because of suffering "green safety barriers". So, how to break through other countries' "green safety barriers" and establish our's "green safety barrier", and how to actively use "green safety barrier" to improve the level of production safety in China, which has the important practical significance for optimization and upgrading in the industrial structure. This paper firstly analyzes the essential connotation of safety green barriers. Second, further analysis differentiation green safety barriers and general trade protection, and analysis the essential difference between trade protection safety protection methods, Finally, Finally, this paper holds that the safety green barriers level of a country or region is mainly decided together by its productivity, the level of economic development ,and scientific and technological level. Safety green barriers in different countries or regional may differ slightly, and in different social economic development stage in the same countries or regional , its security green barriers may also have different. As one country or regional raise the productivity development level, its security green barriers should be gradually improve.

articleTitle: Study about Influence Factor of Credibility Dissemination of Internet Mouth
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Firstly, the article defined the concept of internet mouth in different research fields; on the base of realistic condition of Chinese electron commerce, the influencing factor model of internet mouth of dissemination credibility was built. In the analysis validated, website credit, information frame, the character of information disseminator, the specialty of information embracer, the connection intensity between information disseminator and embracer, and interaction factor were found, which infected the internet mouth of dissemination credibility. Through correlation analysis of six factors and the internet mouth of dissemination credibility, it was found that different factor show different correlation degree. In the same time, it was also pointed out that the forms of website and information had direct influence on the internet mouth of dissemination credibility by compare means. At the final, this research built credit measure equation across analytic hierarchy process, and provided some advices for internet mall.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Social Responsibility of State-Owned Enterprises and Their Approaches to Success
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the practice of building a harmonious society in China, the special nature of the state-owned enterprises and their special status in the national economy determined they must play a leading role in commitment to social responsibility. On the basis of defining the content of the social responsibility of state-owned enterprises, combined with the actual situation of China's state-owned enterprises, we propose some recommendations to strengthen the construction of the social responsibility of state-owned enterprises, including fostering the legal control and government guidance, building evaluation system of the social responsibility of state-owned corporate, improving the supervision mechanism of the social responsibility of state-owned enterprises and enhancing awareness of corporate social responsibility.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism of Knowledge Transfer Based on the Implicit Contractual Relationship
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The performance of knowledge transfer in different enterprises is very different, this difference is caused by the coupling degree of knowledge transfer institutions and mechanisms. Based on the implicit contractual relationship the author point out that the knowledge transfer mechanism has the following characteristics: the trading of knowledge is a futures market not the spot market; the high transaction costs of knowledge trading only can be resolved through long-term contracts; reputation is a valuable payment; the third party payment is conducive to the implementation of the long-term contracts of knowledge transactions. According to this mechanism, the author established a game model of knowledge transfer based on the implicit contractual relationship, and makes the corresponding conclusions.

articleTitle: A Study on the Effects of Demand Uncertainty Based on Stackelberg Game in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Demand uncertainty is the main problem of supply chain. It will do harm to enterprises of supply chain. Effect of uncertainty in a two-echelon supply chain system with one supplier and one retailer is discussed in this paper. The equilibrium of game indicates the bad effect, and leads to bullwhip effect, but when the condition changed, it will bring about some benefit. So it is necessary to analyze idiographic condition and appraise the effect of uncertainty when making decision in supply chain.

articleTitle: Characterization of Iran Stock Market Indices Using Recurrence Plots
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Market data analysis in Iran stock market has been considered in this paper. The experimental data are the shares prices from Iran stock market covering a period of 5 years which is long enough to take the properties such as non-stationary of the market into account. The analysis tools are the time series analysis methods such as power spectral density analysis, time series histogram plot, and the recurrence plots. Nonlinear analysis over the shares' prices time series' for some companies such as Iran Khodro Co, Persian bank and Niro Mohareke Iran is performed. The results indicate a deterministic, un-stationary and seasonal behavior in addition to unstable periodic orbits and even chaotic behavior in these time series'. These observations imply just short-term predictability of stock's shares' prices behaviors.

articleTitle: Comparison of Unsafe Behaviors and Accidents Attribution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Analyzing the attributions and characters of unsafe behaviors and incidents can help to select pre-control measures more targeted. First, using the original material analysis, scale investigation and sampling interview, the characters of time, place, unit, main causes, shift, frequency of unsafe behaviors and accidents are discovered in the researched enterprise; secondly, the attributions at different levels and temperaments are obtained and discussed also. Thirdly, the close relevance between individual variable, risk, injury are discovered , date shows that risk and accident are equal to everyone, safety is concerned with everyone's vital interest and that the more risks, the more accidents. Lastly, the methods of preventing unsafe behaviors and accidents are suggested according to those research results.

articleTitle: How to Protect China's Environment While Keeping Coal in the Game
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China is both the largest consumer and producer of coal in the world; while coal fueling China's economic growth it has already been causing severe pollution and huge carbon dioxide (CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) emission. Of three main alternatives to reducing CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions without hampering economic growth, the paper proposed a practical way to shrink the carbon footprint; it has given a "Chinese definition" of the low carbon for the coal enterprises, its practices also can be extended to other coalmines.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Large Shareholders' Private Benefits from Control Power
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, by introducing the concept of 'tolerance level of small shareholders', we analyse the large shareholders' private benefits from control power in dynamic equilibrium from a micro-angle. We identify the positive sides of the private benefits and provide the factors that affect the large shareholders' infringement behavior against the benefits, and the relations between them. What's more, this paper gives an argument that the large shareholders' risk preference itself would constrain their infringement behavior.

articleTitle: Public Housing Service of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article analyses the housing models of Hong Kong and American, and researches the traits of services, put forward a model to the housing policy in China, which include two parts, we treat housing as a commodity, we let the market to decide their price; we treat housing as a necessity, we can turn them to a public service. The article focuses on the servitization of housing in China and the policy of public housing services.

articleTitle: Attribute Reduction of Mobilization Alliances Partner Selection Based on Information Entropy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mobilization alliances are efficient organizing patterns to make full use of social resources through rapid response to the demand of interfering events. The index system of mobilization alliances partner selection reflects the basic requirements for the organizations which are involved in the mobilization activities. According to the emergency characteristics and the mobilization capacity, a set of ways is proposed for index designing and simplification using information entropy algorithm of attribute reduction in mobilization alliances partner selection index system.

articleTitle: Energy Conservation & Emission Reduction of Coal Mining and Value-Added Tax Preferences
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the process of coal mining, people waste resources rashly as well as ruin environment. Therefore, energy conservation and emission reduction are roads which we must get through to actualize the sustainable development of coal industry. Under this background, this article puts forward the main approaches to energy conservation and emission reduction for coal industry, and then analyses the important significances of giving value-added tax (VAT) preferences to them. Detailed conceptual design for VAT comes up in the end, which is also the main body of this article.

articleTitle: The Progress and Future Directions of Social Stratification in the Scientific Community
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Many scholars focus their research interest on the problem of social stratification. This paper reviews the theoretical and empirical literatures on stratification in science and then gives the future research directions: Study this topic from different perspectives: Pay more attention to the effect factors for the scientific and technological personnel flowing from the lower levels to the higher levels and adopt appropriate motivation measures.

articleTitle: The Research on Sustainable Development-Based Model for Engineering Guarantee of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China promotes engineering guarantee system vigorously to standardize the construction market, performance the construction contract and realize the claims. And the market of engineering guarantee becomes active. This paper analyzes the implementation situation of china's engineering guarantee and the present situation of the market, and summarizes the problems of the engineering guarantee system. The biggest significance of this paper is the sustainable development-based model for engineering guarantee has been put forward based on the function of engineering guarantee and all the problems.

articleTitle: Specific Human Capital and Optimal Design of Pension Plans
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The optimal design of a corporate pension plan should be able to balance employee incentives and the profits of the enterprise. Given the existence of specific human capital, an employee has a certain "bargaining power" in the enterprise, and this bargaining power must be taken into account in the pension plan design. We set the model based on such considerations, and we first studied the attractiveness of a specific pension plan with respect to the type and the degrees of effort of employees. The following comparative static analysis showed how the changes in a pension plan's factors influenced the employees' participation and degree of effort. Finally, we studied the optimal design of a pension plan, which maximizes the profits of the enterprise under different combinations of factors.

articleTitle: Research on Coordinative Efforts between Enterprise and Project Team Based on Theory of Principal-Agency
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In POO (Project-Oriented Organizations), the efforts from enterprise such as attention and support on the project as well as coordinative efforts between enterprise and project team are greatly influence the outcome of the project team. However, in traditional principal-agency theory, only the efforts from project team members were considered, while the efforts from enterprise were neglected. Therefore, this paper brings forward the principal and agency model between enterprise and project team under POO situation, considering the efforts from enterprise as well as coordinative efforts between enterprise and project team. It also analyzes the interactions of behavior strategy choices between enterprise and project team besides their effort and coordination behavior under different revenues. The results showed that: 1) the project team will always choose high effort when the amount of punishment is high enough; 2) the relevance between the efforts of enterprise and project team is not always positive; 3) the relevance between expected revenue of enterprise and project team and profit share is not always positive. According to theoretical results this paper has provided strategies and suggestions on how to enhance the cooperation between project teams and consequently raised the team performance. Finally, a case study is used to test previous theoretical results.

articleTitle: Listed Company's Share Allotment Size Decision-Making under the Total Circulating Expectation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyses how listed companies make Share Allotment size decision theoretically and empirically based on maximizing controlling shareholders' revenue under the total circulating expectation. The empirical results show that listed companies have impulse to the expansion of large-scale financing as the financing market discipline and regulatory mechanisms are inadequate. The controlling shareholders also take advantage of equity prices overvalued when they make financing size decision, and they can select the appropriate level of participation of allotment combined with their self-interests in the allotment funding process to maximize their revenue.

articleTitle: On the Safety Measurement Standard of Grain Logistics in Hubei Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By analyzing the changes of population growth and grain production, as well as per capita grain possession of Hubei Province, this paper aims to ensure grain reserves rates and fluctuations security index in grain demand and its supply.

articleTitle: A Research on Brand-Recognition Dimensions of Online Store
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Online store brand recognition refers the global senses of shop functional attributes and affective properties formed by the consumers according to their own psychological characteristics, namely overall feeling to the online store brand image.In order to construct the dimensions of brand-recognition of on-line store and drawn up corresponding questionnaires as well, This paper formed prediction questionnaire by using the method of interview and literature review. Through the analysis on exploratory factor of the prelim inary questionnaire,a formal questionnaire including 6 factors from 28 items was built, and the 6 factors were produced:credit degree, distribution performance, social relations, practicality, credibility, design style and service quality.Itwas proved that the dimensions,reliability and validity of Online Store Brand-recognition questionnaire meets the need of psychometrics.

articleTitle: Study on Factors Affecting Building Costs of Navy Ships
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The ship building process is affected by many factors from ship itself and the objective environment, so find out the rule of every factors and manage them can effectively control the building cost of ships. Based on analysis of factors which affect building costs of navy ship, introduce the grey correlation analysis method to analyze the mutual correlation and important degree of every factor, point out main external factors and internal factors. At last, give policy and management advice based on the current work.

articleTitle: The Role of Xinyong in the External Financing Performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper seeks to illustrate the role of Xinyong in external financing performance of firms in clusters and to explore how Xinyong reduces the information asymmetry between banks and firms to help family firms get good external financing performance. Using survey data from a sample of 194 firms from Yangtze River Delta region, we demonstrate that Xinyong has a positive impact on financing efficiency. Further, institutional support positively moderates the link between Xinyong and external financing efficiency. Theoretical and managerial implications are discussed.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Social Role of Science and Technology Museum under Service Sciences Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an important national science popularization infrastructure and an organization serving the Socio-cultural development, science and technology museum is facing unprecedented opportunities and challenges. How to meet the requirements of the times and achieve sustainable development? Service Sciences theory provides a new visual angle for us. Firstly, this paper introduces the connotations and meaning of SSME and analyses the goals and functions of science and technology museum from SSME perspective. Then, it turns to explore the multiple social roles of science and technology museum under SSME theory.

articleTitle: Cost Overrun Control during Tunnel Construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Cost overrun is common in tunnel projects. During the construction of a tunnel, overrun is mainly related to unpredicted geological conditions as well as prolonged time schedule. The uncertainty of the ground conditions is one of the main features of tunnel design and construction. The main reasons for cost overrun during tunnel construction are analyzed and the measures of controlling cost overrun are presented, with especial reference to the period of tunnel construction. An object-oriented and balanced cost risk system is vital to cost overrun control during tunnel construction under difficult geological conditions.

articleTitle: Profit Models of Social Networking Service
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Social Networking Service is an online service, platform, or site that focuses on building and reflecting of social networks or social relations among people. It's developing by leaps and bounds, and has some notable features in the information economics, such as abundant resources, high user viscosity, interactivity, network externalities, and herding effect and so on. Three possible suitable profit models are put forward for SNS: the effect advertising, third-party co-application platform, and the combination of mobile terminals and network services.

articleTitle: Prediction and Management Research of Hi-Tech Enterprises' Marketing Risks - An Empirical Analysis of 35 Hi-Tech Enterprises of Communication and Relevance Equipment Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper gives a method and finally gets twelve marketing risk assuming factors based on 35 middle-sized Communications and related equipment manufacturing enterprises by statistical methods like PCA, D-S evidence theory, and fuzzy evaluation. Then we build marketing risk assessment model by probabilistic reasoning model based on Bayes network. Also there is an example to prove the method's feasibility and practicality through the analysis of five companies of that field.

articleTitle: Defects and Improvement of 5S Implementation in the Workshop of MTO Electronic Assembly Industry at the Pearl River Delta Economic Zone
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although 5S is an effective approach for enterprise management, perfect implementation of the management approach needs more efforts. The paper presents discussions about defects found in 5S implementation based on investigations carried out in workshops of three make-to-order (MTO) electronic assembly companies located at the Pearl River Delta Economic Zone in China. Aiming at the defects, the paper proposes specific measures to improve 5S implementation, which could be used as a reference to improve on-site management in the MTO electronic assembly industry and some other similar industries in China.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis on the Function of Avoiding Risks for Stock Index Futures Market in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: What is focused by most investors is how to avoid capital market risks. This paper aims to explore the relationship between the stock market and the stock index futures market by stationarity test and co-integration test. It is indicated in the research that there has been a long-term equilibrium relationship between the two markets, and the stock market price coincides with the price of the stock index futures market which is the precondition for hedging. On this basis, the introduction of error correction model aims to explore the discipline of the short-term price volatility of the two markets. The research finds that the price of the stock index futures market fluctuates more fiercely than the stock market, and there has been a larger space for arbitraging in a short term. Therefore, the function of avoiding risks for stock index futures market should be strengthened further.

articleTitle: Elasticity Control of Labor Costs Based on Virtual Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The virtual value chain analysis used in corporate labor cost control in this paper to analyze the controlling factors of labor Cost in the virtual value chain. From the point of view of the Flexible control analysis the labor costs in the virtual value chain, using the flexible control method rebuild the value chain, proposing the Labor cost control methods ,from a strategic point of control reduce labor costs.

articleTitle: Construction of Visualization System Based on Grid: The Integration of Visualization and Grid
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Along with the social information and network widely applied, information visualization as the basic tools are widely applied. As the calculation methods for the Internet, the grid expands the resource utilization and service providing scope of visual application. This paper put forward basic frame about constructing a visualization system based on the integration of information visualization and grid, and elaborates its designing goal, working model and system structure, etc.

articleTitle: Study on Dynamical Mechanism of Industrial Agglomeration Innovation System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The innovative advantages of industrial agglomeration lie in innovation cluster. From the perspective of innovation network system, industrial agglomeration innovation system is a special system,which includes enterprises, governments,universities, research institutes, financial institutions, and intermediary service agencies. The realization of industrial agglomeration innovation depends on the stress and motivity inspired by the clusters' innovation.It is affected by special requirement, promotion from competition and cooperation, cluster learning mechanism, organization innovation mechanism, as well as the stimulation of local resources and industrial circumstances.So we should apply the dynamical mechanisms of industrial agglomeration innovation,and take some appropriate measures to ensure the effective operation of the mechanism.

articleTitle: Systematic Methodology for Coping with the Information Asymmetry of Eco-Industrial Parks Planning and Construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Coping with the information asymmetry of eco-industrial park plays a significant role in EIPs planning, construction and sustainable development. This paper presented a systematic methodology for coping with the information asymmetry in EIPs planning, construction and sustainable development, based on analyzing the information flow and its asymmetry phenomena, as well as the impact on EIPs construction and sustainable development. This systematic methodology contains 8 steps: background survey in planning region (environment, society, economy); information network analysis of the EIPs; assessment and adaptability analysis of the information connection among the industrial network; advantages and disadvantages of the information connection of the EIPs; improve the information network construction of the EIPs; construct the information management system of the EIPs; improve the information infrastructure; ultimately improve the efficiency of the information flow of the EIPs. And the corresponding measures are also proposed according to China's status and policies of EIPs.

articleTitle: How the Snowball Implementation Strategy Influences on the Individual Level ERP Assimilation: Based on Cognitive Load Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: ERP systems have been widely adopted by most of the companies in the world. Most companies adopt a step-by-step approach to implement ERP which is known as the snowball ERP implementation strategy. By now, most studies on the snowball ERP implementation strategy focuses on the organizational level. Few studies focus on how this implementation strategy influences ERP users' ERP assimilation from the perspective of individual level. Involving cognitive load theory as a theoretical foundation, this paper studies how the snowball ERP implementation strategy influences ERP users' assimilation towards the ERP systems through an exploratory case study. Interviews with the IT manager in a frozen food company in China revealed that the snowball ERP implementation strategy can largely reduce the cognitive load of ERP users, thus contributing to the assimilation level of ERP users. Based on the interview evidence, we build a theoretical model on how the snowball ERP implementation strategy influencing ERP user' assimilation towards ERP systems. Further theoretical contributions and managerial implications are discussed.

articleTitle: A Study between Value Congruence and Employees' Coping with Organizational Change
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper tries to find the relationship between value congruence and employees' coping. It explores the structure of employees' coping strategy and classifies coping into confronting coping, planning, behavioral disengagement, and wishful thinking, with two dimensions of positive-negative and behavior- cognition. This paper tests relations among four sub-dimensions of value congruence and coping strategies. The results show that human relation, open system and internal process influence employees' coping strategy significantly, and human relation has the most important prediction power. We also discuss the moderation effect of properties of change event. The results show that the perceived scope of change enhances the relation between value congruence and coping strategy.

articleTitle: The Study of Developing Modern Logistics Industry Chain in Qinhuangdao
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper confronts the modern logistics industry, plans the development directions of four industrial chain of modern logistics industry, and provides directional guidance for the development of modern logistics industry, points out the development approach for logistics enterprises in Qinhuangdao.

articleTitle: Research into Valuation Model of Unitized With-Profit Contract with Surrender Option
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The value of Unitized With-Profit contract is affected by surrender, guaranteed interest rate and bonus strategy. This paper is intended to construct a valuation model for Unitized With-Profit Contract considering all these factors. In this model, these elements can be valued separately underpinned by Monte Carlo techniques. From the numerical results, we concluded that the effect of surrender option shouldn't be overlooked while pricing this kind of contracts.

articleTitle: Research on the Problems and Countermeasures of the Socialization Reform of College Logistics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The goal of this paper is to analyze the content, the development status, the existing problems, and the strategic choices for the socialization reform of college logistics in China. Firstly, we make an introduction about the overall situation of the college logistics, and also make an analysis about the status and role of the socialization reform of college logistics. Then, we make a discussion about the existing problems such as the ideology drop behind reality and the service consciousness is weak, the property rights are unclear between school and enterprise, the conversion of the administration function is back behind the requirement, and the contingent of support staff is large and the management for them is difficult. Finally, we put forward the strategic routes and corresponding suggestions for the development of the socialization reform of college logistics.

articleTitle: Analysis the Influence of Performance Evaluation on University Teacher's Psychological Contract
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper constructs a psychological contract mechanism model to analyze the affecting process of psychological contract on the teacher. Through anglicizing the process of the university organization payment and the teachers' perceptive value are affected by the change in performance appraisal way, this paper anglicizes the change process of the psychological contract balance and puts forward improving strategies on this basis.

articleTitle: Differential Effects of Cognition- and Affect-Based Trust on Leader Empowering Behavior in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The current research extended previous study by exploring the differential effects of cognition- and affect-based trust in subordinate on different dimensions of leader empowering behavior. The survey was conducted in a sample of 615 matched leader-subordinate dyads in seven cities of China. The analysis results of structure equation model indicated that both of cognition-based trust and affect-based trust in subordinate had positive influence on three dimensions of leader empowering behavior, including participative decision, informing, and coaching. But the influences of two kinds of trust in subordinate represented differential. In specially, cognition-based trust in subordinate had strongest effect on participative decision, while affect-based trust in subordinate showed stronger influences on informing and coaching. At last, the implications for the theoretical research and management practice were discussed.

articleTitle: A Study of the Working Mechanism of the Workplace Emergency Capability Immune System Based on Bio-Inspired Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To enhance adaptability of the emergency capability of safety production, and establish the system for defending production accidents invasion and regulating emergency system stability, with reference to the bio-inspired theory, immunity theory is introduced into safety production emergency capability system. Firstly, the concept of the emergency capability immune system is defined. Secondly, the system involves emergency peripheral immune system, emergency special immune system, and emergency central immune system. Thirdly, the working mechanism involves emergency immune identification, emergency immune defense, emergency immune memory, and emergency immune feedback. Finally, the future study trend for the emergency capability immune system is proposed.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Enterprises Competitive Interaction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on ecological theories, this paper constructs a Logistic model for enterprises competitive interaction and explains the practical significance of the model's stable point in the process. Moreover, it simulates the process's dynamic characteristics by applying numerical simulation. Finally, the paper put forward strategies for enterprises competitive interaction under different stable circumstances.

articleTitle: SP4SLM: A Synthesized Platform for Services Lifecycle Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the 21st century, modern service industry has mushroomed around the world, and the application systems in modern service industry are usually built based on the reuse of other third party services in a distributed and loose-coupled way. Consequently, there will be a greater need for the provisioning and lifecycle management of services. In this paper, we analyze the drawbacks of current service repository, propose a framework for services lifecycle management with many capabilities covered, including services registration and annotation with semantic information, flexible categorization and clustering of services, accurate and efficient services query and matchmaking based on interface and behavioral semantics, service orchestration and verification, and service execution and monitoring. The proposed framework SP4SLM provides a comprehensive management for the whole lifecycle of services in accordance with the demands in modern services industry.

articleTitle: Extension of Channel and Optimization of Management of Knowledge Sharing in Science Group - Based on Analysis of Interpersonal Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research paper is devoted to the research on the relationship between locations of members in the science groups and their behaviors in knowledge sharing. Social network analysis has been used in the study of characteristics of the knowledge sharing and management of the science group members. The analysis of network density, centrality and intermediary features as well as the structural features can lead to the mastery of the direction of knowledge flow and management location from the perspective of quantity measurement. This can make it possible to detect the problems existing in the knowledge sharing and management of science groups. What has been done can promote the exchange of scientific information between members and enhance the communication and cooperation between members, thus optimizing the strategies of forming and managing science groups.

articleTitle: The Reasonable Strategic Reserves of China's Much-Lacking Mineral Resource Copper
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The strategic reserve system of much-lacking mineral resources should be established urgently and the reasonable reserves should be determined firstly. After analyzing the roles of much-lacking mineral resources' reserves, the model for calculating much-lacking mineral resources reserve is built based on the fluctuation relationship between actual supply and trend demand. Taking refined copper as an example, it is expected that the reasonable reserve scale of refined copper in our country would be 461.1 thousand tons at the beginning of 21st century.

articleTitle: An Advertising Model of Duopoly with Consumer Searching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the Tirole(1997)'s analysis of informative advertising ,with the two-phase gaming model applied to it. This paper puts forward the informative advertising model based on consumers' information searching in which consumers have heterogeneous preferences, and consumers' costs of information searching can influence the product price and advertising level of enterprises. In the discussion of model equilibrium, the conclusions are: when high discovery cost, in equilibrium, duopoly have the same price and advertising level will increase firstly then decrease if the reservation value increases.

articleTitle: The Construction of Shopping Website Cultural - Case Analysis of Taobao
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The thesis is based on the theory of enterprise cultural construction, through the analysis of Taobao's high-speed growth process and carry on the case study from the outstanding quality, meticulous website perfect customer service, "six pulse divinesword" website cultural values, localization strategy of free competition strategy, etc. The article shows that the key to win the competition for Taobao is valuing the cultural construction, and shape its corporate culture is the most important for the cultural construction.

articleTitle: Empirical Study of Lean Production in Rationalization of Equipment Layout
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the management situation of the D company and the model of cellular equipment layout, the improvement plan for D company is proposed. Through the study and waste analysis about the current equipment layout plan, this paper introduces 3 alternative plans and then confirms the final desired plan by comparing and analyzing. The final plan has been applied in D company to make improvement and the result of the data indicates that the project has a desired improvement. Moreover, the plan provides a reference value to similar companies.

articleTitle: An Asset Allocation Model with Social Insurance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Every person or family will face a series of important expenses. In order to avoid shocks from these expenses for individuals or families, people will probably have precautionary saving incentives which influence their strategic asset allocation. This paper reviews domestic and foreign literatures about asset allocation and precautionary saving. This paper proposes a new asset allocation model framework including both social insurance and precautionary saving. At the same time this paper gets two-period model from previous model framework and obtains analytical solution. The main innovations of the paper are combining social insurance and precautionary saving with asset allocation model, and explaining the significance of analytical solution.

articleTitle: A Study on Module Selection: Based on Transportation Programming
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Considering the limited productive capacity and supplying capacity, this paper gives a linear programming model on module selection problem in assembly industry. We use the method of transportation programming and LINDO system to solve the model, and give an example of application of this model to laptop assembling industry. We are convinced that the model can be widely used in assembly industry under the condition of certain demand.

articleTitle: A Study on Teacher-Student Communication of Online Education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The communication between teachers and students is an important educational activity, which plays an vital role in online education. This paper mainly presents some new changes, traits and then puts forward the problems about the communication between teachers and students in online education, and at last proposes some feasible measures.

articleTitle: Independent Certification Agency for Supplier Selection under Incomplete Information Market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is a strategic decision-making process to select suppliers in supplier management, especially under the circumnstance of incomplete information market. The relevant government agencies, various intermediary organizations and other independent certification agency can efficiently convey the related information from enterprise, which would facilitate the supplier selection. So a signaling game model is established after analyzing the bahavior of the purchasers and suppliers, and its separating quilibrium and pooling equilibrium is worked out and analyzed. The result shows that the efficient suppliers certified by authoritative independent certification agency would be encouraged and selected by the purchaser. And the speculative supplier has to give up for the prohibitive costs. So independent certification agency could give some package of criteria of the suppliers and convenience to supplier selection.

articleTitle: Design Image Retrieval Based on Nonsubsampled Contourlet Transform and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, an image retrieval method based on nonsubsampled contourlet transform (NSCT) is proposed. Firstly, the image is decomposed into different scales and different directions subbands by the NSCT. Then, texture features and shape features of subbands are extracted. Finally, BP neural network is used to retrieve images through using extracted features. The experimental results over car accessory images demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Business Valuation in China's Transitional Period
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China is undergoing a transition from a planned economy to a market economy, where market forces start to set prices rather than a central planning organization, and a business valuation profession is being established to facilitate the process. In this paper, we examine how this process has come about, and its current practices as well as challenges it is facing.

articleTitle: Simulating Study on Controlling Policy Mechanism about Yangtze River's Pollution Induced by Water Transportation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to control Yangtze River 's pollution induced by water transportation, this paper establishes a system dynamics model by using tree-structure methodology to analysis the system that including water-transportation factors¿Aenvironment factors and controlled policy factors. We can gain some rational policy to modulate and control pollution by emulating the SD model. The results are helpful to the sustainable development planning in water transportation and Yangtze River environment.

articleTitle: CSM Homogeneous-Interaction Innovation Model Based on Small-World Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article explores how to use complex network theory and method to perform dynamic analysis of enterprise innovation network and build CSM homogeneous-interaction knowledge-flow model based on small-world network.

articleTitle: On Knowledge Service and Knowledge Management of Social Service Organization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Social service organization is a structure that mainly provides knowledge service and regards knowledge management as the kernel part of its management system. Through knowledge management, which includes explicit and implicit knowledge management, the knowledge reserve and knowledge value of the organization as a whole can be increased. Knowledge management also helps to improve technique and the performance of product and service through knowledge application, promote knowledge circulation within the organization, improve the efficiency to acquire knowledge, point out the direction of knowledge innovation, assist the organization with developing technology, give full play to individual's ability and potential, increase the learning ability of individual and organization and improve corporate IQ.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Objective and Subjective Decision Making Method by Non-Linear Normalizing and Weighting Operations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The aim of this paper is to develop a new methodology for solving fuzzy multi-attribute decision making problems with subjective and objective information, fuzzy numbers and non-linear normalizing and weighting functions. Contribution of this paper is shown with implementation of a real life example on supplier selection field.

articleTitle: Research on the Value Reengineering of Failed Projects Knowledge Resources Based on Knowledge Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are many failed projects in enterprises, but people ignore many available and effective knowledge resources in failed projects. According to defining the implication and characteristics of knowledge resources of failed projects, we define the contents of knowledge resources of failed projects to value reengineering, and then come up with the chain model of the value Reengineering of Failed Projects Knowledge Resources based on knowledge value chain. Through the study of this model, Failed Projects Knowledge Resources to get recognition and value rebuilding ,enterprises can reduce the waste of resources, creates more interest for the long-term development of the enterprise.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Motivational Factors for Knowledge Workers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study model of motivational factors for knowledge workers is constructed based on literature review and basic hypotheses. With knowledge workers from the knowledge enterprises in Liaoning-Shenyang Region as the object of this study, the author has drawn a conclusion through the empirical study that the motivational factors for knowledge workers have a positive correlation with the incentive degree for knowledge workers. In addition, the author has also found that sex, age, educational background, service year, salary level and nature of work of knowledge workers have a significant influence on the sensitivity to every motivational factor.

articleTitle: "Two Working Parts with One Spare Parts" Principle in Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper provides the "two working parts with one spare parts"(abbreviated to "two with one" ) principle which can improve reliability of system , taking digital information system and engineering real-time system as an example, that is ,we analyze the "two with one" principle in risk management in the two situations described above. In particular, proof of asymptotic stability of solutions of systems has been obtained according to the stability of operator semi-group theory.

articleTitle: An Overview of the Stakeholder Approach - Maintaining and Building the Effective Relationship Management for Value Seeking Strategies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The relationship management for stakeholders can be extremely complex. Stakeholder analysis can be a key tool to identify stakeholders, specific identification, level of influence and value seeking for management in relationship management. Indeed, stakeholders are becoming more and more essential for analyzing both internal and external corporate environment, identify secondary and primary stakeholders and their power and influence in management strategies. An overview of stakeholder concept, approach and matrixes is shown for a holistic view in the application of strategic relationship management.

articleTitle: The Application of Principal Component Regression Models in Air Quality Analysis Based on SuperMap GIS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to make better use of existing environmental data resources and enhance regional environmental management and improve the environment, this paper uses the work method which is effectively integrated by GIS and multivariate statistical analysis technology, through the regional air pollution relevant data of the combination of urban and rural areas in western Beijing, using the principal component analysis and regression analysis based on SuperMap GIS Platform of this paper prophase development method. The corresponding regional environmental problems in the region are targeted extracted, classified, concluded, and analyzed, and rapid exploration and summary of regional environmental pollution rules. This work has some reference value to the improvement of the environmental quality of urban areas.

articleTitle: The Research on Knowledge Workers' Tacit Knowledge on TRIZ
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Because of the scenario-dependence and complexity of management problems, we do not have a fixed model to settle the management problems. To some extent, it is an innovative problem to solve the management problems. Therefore, we can use the theory of TRIZ to solve some complex management problems and build a complex model based on TRIZ to solve management problems. On the basis of this idea, this paper draws upon the theory of TRIZ to propose several specific solutions to the problem by using the theory's ideology and system tools and combining the characteristics of knowledge worker and analyzing the problems existing in teamwork. It can help the team to complete the project faster and better.

articleTitle: Study on the Development of Grape Wine Tourism Based on Industrial Clusters: Yantai City as an Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Clustering is the development direction of grape wine tourism, but also an effective way for its sustainable development. In this context, the paper firstly illustrates the formation mechanism of industrial clusters in tourism industry using the related principle of industrial clusters theories. And then, the paper takes Yantai city as an example, analyzes the feasibility of clustering development of grape wine tourism from the basic elements and the basic conditions. In the end, the paper discusses the paths for clustering development of grape wine tourism from the following three aspects: extending the industrial chain, exerting government functions and strengthening clusters management.

articleTitle: A Qualitative Study on Safety Reporting in the Chinese Shipping Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The aim of this paper is to explore the key factors affecting ship to shore safety reporting. The data were collected from two major shipping companies in China. The result indicates the safety reporting is affected by organisational, cultural, individual and occupational factors. It is suggested that these factors should be well concerned by the industry for the re-shaping and re-orientation of ship-shore communication system.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Relationship between Pay Gap of Management Personnel and Corporation Manangement Structure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The pay gap of management staff to be interpreted as a variable, ownership structure, board of directors, supervisors, management remuneration, shareholdings and so on to be the explanatory variables, the conclusion is made that the major factors influencing the management staff's pay gap are the scale of enterprise assets, board size and directors' remuneration.

articleTitle: A Study on "Boxed Pigs" in Behavioral Economics with Linguistic Analysis - Based on Complex Scientific Management Methodology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a classic example for static equilibrium game-theory, "Boxed pigs" is widely used. But in empirical methods, the legitimacy of "Boxed pigs" also has attracted widespread debate. Through the analysis of epistemology and complex scientific management methodology, it is proofed that "boxed pigs" not only belongs to empirical proposition, but also belongs to analytic proposition. In knowledge management and economics research, we need to pay attention to the Linguistic Turn.

articleTitle: Study on the Collaborative Tactics of Informationization Planning and Enterprise Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: How to realize the collaboration of informationization planning and enterprise strategy to make the informationization better serve the enterprise strategy has become the focus problem of every enterprise. Based on the inner link between enterprise strategy and informatization planning, the article established respectively collaborative strategies of informatization planning with competition strategy, diversification strategy and internationalization strategy, which promote the realization of enterprise strategic objective and finally realize the collaboration development of informatization construction and enterprise strategy. The article finally established the collaboration evaluation index system of informatization planning and enterprise strategy.

articleTitle: Construction of Travel Agency Service System Based on Service Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service management which includes the analysis of service profit chain, service interaction and quality interaction, informative technology in service quality management and contract product marketing in service industry with which in manufacturing, aims to study how to manage enterprises successfully in service competition. This paper discusses the formation of service management background, and analyzes the measures on how to structure travel agencies'' service system on the basis of service management theories.

articleTitle: Consumer Satisfaction, Trust and Seller Loyalty in C2C Marketplace: The Moderator of Involvement
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer satisfaction, trust, loyalty and their relationship have been considered extensively. However, Consumers' loyalty to market seller has not well understood in consumer to consumer electronic marketplace. This paper focuses on purchase involvement, consumers' transaction satisfaction, trust and loyalty to seller in marketplace. It was found that customers transaction satisfaction influence trust, trust influence loyalty, Trust is the mediate of satisfaction and loyalty, while purchase involvement moderate the relationship of transaction satisfaction and seller's trust.

articleTitle: Financial Risk Evaluation for High-Tech Enterprises in China - Based on the Perspective of Grey System Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to superior difficulty and uncertainty of technological research and development, high-tech enterprises have greater risks than traditional enterprises in operation and finance. For sound and rapid development of high-tech enterprises, it is necessary to carry out financial risk analysis on an overall basis. Based on the Grey System Theory, the paper, by constructing financial risk evaluation index system, has established grey correlation model. It is feasible in terms of risk evaluation, which is demonstrated by empirical test.

articleTitle: Development Strategy and Countermeasure of Capital College and University in High-Level Track and Field Event
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By analyzing superior and inferior events of college and university attended in group a of Beijing college and university track and field meeting held during 7 years as research object. The finding illustrate that game theory have an effect by wise choosing on potential events, and such a characteristic employed in specialized training got a good achievement. College or university should put more attention on management of training, and one of the measures of improving achievement of training is rational choosing in the process of enrollment in athletes. The function of center of china is shown from derby between Beijing colleges in nation college track and field meeting.

articleTitle: Studies on China's Foreign Reserves - Its Adequacy and Investment Strategy Suggestions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since China's reform and opening up, its international status has been enhanced with the rapid accumulation of national wealth. A great quantity of foreign investments has been attracted into China because of its preferential policies, as well as broad market and population. They push forward China's imports and exports, and also accelerate the accumulation of foreign reserves. China replaced Japan as the world's largest foreign reserves holder at the beginning of 2006. Since then, its adequacy and investment strategies had become a popular topic. This paper is focused on above thesis. After applied several ratio-benchmarks studies the results illustrate that China's foreign reserves are adequate. Its investment strategies should focus more on foreign equities.

articleTitle: Public Human Resources Development and Management under the Background of Knowledge Economy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Along with the coming of knowledge economy era, intelligence and human resource have been the vital stratagem resources. The public sector has changed the managerial emphasis to the track of knowledge and human resource. It is clear that the innovation of public human resource management is the new challenge to adapt the changing of inner and outer environment. Based on the analysis of the difference between public sector and private sector in the area of human resource and compare the human resource practice of public sector between China and Western countries, it studies the innovation of the development and management of public sector human resource and presents some opinions about establishing the Chinese characteristic public sector human resource management.

articleTitle: Review of Decision Support System Devoted to the Management of Water Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the water environment problem become more and more complexity, many different decision support systems (DDS) are currently available or under development to support water environment management. In this paper, several DSS, developed for water environment management in the USA, European, China and other countries, are reviewed, after the description of the definition of environment DSS. Great progress are made in research and application of DSS in water environment management during the last decades in China, but there are still many difficulties such as the optimal way to make decision and public participation in decision-making.

articleTitle: Emergency Communication in a Network Environment: An Example of Micoblogging
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Emergency communication in a network environment shows some new characteristics. Some advantages effectively of microblogging meet the requirements of emergency communication. This paper analyzed based on microblogging's emergency communication. And some suggestions were proposed for the emergency communication using the microblogging.

articleTitle: Will Large-Scale High Speed Railway Construction Push Chinese Railway Industry over the Edge of Self-Development Capability?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: High speed railway (HSR) of more than 17000 kilometers will be put into operation by 2020 in China. With its astronomical investment and high ratio of debt to equity, large-scale construction is pushing Chinese railway industry over the edge of self-development capability. The emphasis on their amazing speed and technology complexity has been used to justify the investments as a stimulus to the domestic economy, while by and large, the financial sustainability has been neglected. The paper applies Commercial Feasibility Study (CFS) model to analyze the effect of HRS investment on financial sustainability, the result shows that financial crisis will break out by 2014, and refunding of RMB9.69 billion is needed to close cash flow loopholes. Chinese railway has to struggle for a hard time period of 23 years before cash flow returns to normal, and Chinese railway industry will suffer losses no later than 2023, and the net debt will account for 8% of GDP. HSR system is the main source for self-development capability degradation. The financial risk of Chinese railway lies in the fact that it is being constructed to a too high a standard especially with respect to the speed. The HSRs exceed the current social economic needs and will lead to the overall financial deterioration. Triple Analysis Framework manifests that railway industry self-development capability will greatly influence monetary system and fiscal system and can be the last straw to break the camel's back that salvage measures should be taken to countervail possible negative impacts.

articleTitle: The Study of the Core Competitiveness's source and Formation Path of the Professional Sports Club in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Starting with the conceptand connotation of core competitiveness and taking into consideration the status quo and model for Chinese professional sports clubs, this article scientifically analyzes the origin and formation of its core competitiveness to provide theoretical reference for designing the development strategy of the clubs and choosing the development direction of its core competitiveness.

articleTitle: The Legal Regulations of E-Government
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-government is a new thing developed in recent years. Different from traditional government, it is a new administrative approach, which achieves government management and service with the benefit of electronic information and digital network technology, and has the characteristics of real-time, high efficiency, openness, transparency and so on. In China, because of the uncompleted laws and regulations, liability determination principle and information security have mounted to the primary obstacle to its development. Therefore, legislation and related legal systems should be established as soon as possible to safeguard and promote the healthy and rapid development of e-government in China.

articleTitle: The Gray Correlation Analysis of Scenic Spot Customer Satisfaction Degree: A Case Study of Lianyungang City
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Tourism has become a new industry of China. Scenic spot customer satisfaction degree plays a very important role in the development of tourism industry. How to measure tourists' satisfaction degree with scientific method? Through analyzing the characteristics of tourism products, the method of gray correlation analysis was selected. The first, the theory of the method was introduced. The second, the four famous scenic spots of Lianyungang were studied using gray correlation analysis. The third, calculation results were described and analyzed. At last, some developing strategies were put forward to provide references for the decision making of the government.

articleTitle: Research in Reform Efficiency of Rural Credit Cooperatives Based on the Dual-Goal
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper constructs efficiency of evaluation index system to estimate the technique efficiency, pure technical efficiency and allocative efficiency in samples of rural credit cooperatives (RCCs). It is based on dual goals that develop for itself and service on the "Three Rural Issues" in reform of RCCs by using the CRS and VRS models in the data envelopment analysis (DEA) methodology. By a comparison between the efficiency values, slack variables on outputs and inputs before and after the reform, this article reveals that reform does not make a difference on the improvement of efficiency on RCCs unless to reduce net value of fixed assets and strengthen the efforts in supporting agriculture. The innovations and characteristics are as follows, the first is that the agricultural loans, as an output factor to represent the influence of agriculture supporting, is added to evaluation index system in efficiency, which reflect favorable the implement of dual-target in the reform of RCCs. The second is to make a province as a group to estimate efficiency so as to indicate the overall achievements by reform around the whole province and the effect of increasing the efficiency of RCCs by establishing the provincial cooperatives as a significant measure in the reform. The third is that by comparison between slack variables on outputs and inputs, theoretical references have been provided for the further reform in RCCs quantificationally.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Brushless DC Motor Drive Based on PWM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The brushless dc motor has a permanent-magnet rotor, and the stator windings are wound such that the back electro motive force(EMF) is trapezoidal. The paper develops a phase variable model of the BDCM and uses it to examine the performance of a BDCM speed servo drive system when fed by hysteresis and pulse width modulated (PWM) current controllers. Particular attention is paid to the motor torque pulsations. Some experimental verification is given.

articleTitle: Study on Theory and Practice of Transboundary Water Resources Management - A Case Study of the Great Lakes Watershed
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Integrated River Basin Management(the abbreviation is IRBM)is a mode of water resources integrated management. In many countries it has been researched for a long time and adopted effectively. It takes river basin as control units and has become general tendency of water resources management at present. Based on theory and practice of IRBM for the Great Lakes of USA and Canada, the paper makes a systematic research on water resources management and gives an empirical analysis from four aspects, namely, establishment of watershed management organization, ecosystem approach application, dealing with environment emergency, cooperation of Environmental Impact Assessment (the abbreviation is EIA) in transboundary watershed. The conclusion could provide references to transboundary water resources management for other countries.

articleTitle: Research on Complementary Diffusion Model of Innovations in Interfirm Networks from the Perspective of Networks Learning and Communication
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, a complementary innovation diffusion model was constructed from the perspective of communication and learning between enterprises in interfirm networks.The internal mechanism in the diffusion of innovation are being discussed first .Then the paper analysis the equilibrium points of this model and its stability and economic significance .Finally, the factors impact of interfirm networks innovation diffusion are being discussed. Our analysis shows the complementary relationship between innovations has significant influence on innovation diffusion, and the learning ability of enterprises exerts significant influence on speed of innovation diffusion. The model can be used for inquiring the innovation diffusion when the networks exist two kinds of innovations which can complement each other, and providing a reference proposal for the enterprises in the networks.

articleTitle: Based on Service Oriented Primary and Secondary School Teachers Training Mode Innovation - The Hubei University of Education as an Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To service the service object of the professional skills development is one of the main features of service science. Full service scientific service functions in our school, over a network to strengthen school education, career planning services for students; modernization of laboratory professional skills training, and skills training for professional services; building online teaching resources and management platform, helping student independent learning; full using computer and network functions, independent training service for students. These practices greatly improves the efficiency of student teachers ' professional skills, effectively promoting the reform of primary and secondary school teacher training in our school model, effectively increasing the level and quality of education in our school.

articleTitle: High Intensity Concrete Construction Technology and Management Mode of Large-Scale Hydropower Project
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Three Gorges Project (TGP) is the largest concrete construction in the present world. The project, with a total amount of approximately 28 million m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> of concrete, is characterized by complicated structures, intensive construction and high technical standards, which should meet the requirements not only of stability but also of special flood releasing, power generation and navigation improvement. Through engineering practice, a management mode that embodies the characteristics of TGP construction has been formed. Various new techniques and technologies have been used to ensure the concrete quality. Design, construction and management measures were adopted for the concrete works of the project. It is shown that, a scientific and reasonable management mode is crucial for planning, controlling and coordinating a large-scale construction project, which is the key to the success of hydropower development.

articleTitle: SWOT Analysis of Popularization of Straw Densification Briquette Fuel (SDBF) in Rural China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By SWOT analysis method, combining with investigation, this paper discusses strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats in detail in the popularization of Straw Densification Briquette Fuel(SDBF),which is one of the substitute of fossil energy. On the basis of analysis, this paper gives suggestions, which are useful to the department concerned to make policies about SDBF¿Chence, speed up its multi-application, finally, make the adjustment of energy structure come true and energy shortage problem is solved.

articleTitle: Strategies to Boosting the Development of High-Tech Industries of Tangshan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the scientific and technological level of Tangshan and the situation of new and high technology industries, the author analyzed the restraining factors impeding the development of Tangshan's new and high technology industries. Furthermore, new strategies for the development of Tangshan's new and high technology industries will be discussed on basis of the construction of the demonstration area of scientific development.

articleTitle: Network NC Equipment Fault Diagnosis Research Based on Expert System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The NC machine is a tool which is indispensable in industrial manufacturing. In recent years, with network, computer and other related technical development, It provide a new power to numerical control technology. The main idea of this article is description the networked CNC machine fault diagnosis which based on expert system

articleTitle: The Project Investment Control Based on Virtual Partnering Organization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The excessive competition in bidding of current large-scale projects might lead to lots of negative problems, distorted relationship between the inviters and the bidders and decrease of the project investment control. Based on the virtual partnering organization model for project management, the procedures of project investment control for the management of large-scale projects during the design and construction phases were analyzed. The results show that the project investment control based on the virtual partnering organization is an effective and reasonable control of project investment and operation mechanism.

articleTitle: An Investigation of Knowledge Sharing on Campus among Teachers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: the knowledge sharing among teachers has been receiving increasing attention, while there are less empirical researches in China now. This study analyzes major factors for knowledge sharing among faculty members. The authors suggest that the achievement of individual motivations is the most influential factor for faculty knowledge sharing, and both the affiliation and collaboration of organization factors affect the faculty knowledge sharing too.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Evaluation of Heilongjiang Coal Enterprise Financing Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Financing is a capital allocation process, the financing efficiency determines the capital allocation efficiency, affects the enterprise operating efficiency. In order to discuss the present situation of Heilongjiang coal enterprise financing efficiency, The paper established a factor set composed of capital cost, cash utilize efficiency, freedom degree of financing entity, normalization of financing mechanism, capital repayment capability and evaluated Heilongjiang coal enterprise financing efficiency with fuzzy mathematics method, and pointed out that it is in the middle level, and needs to improve further. And it proposed some measures to improve financing efficiency from the aspects of supply and demand.

articleTitle: The Service Quality Research from the Perspective of Fuzzy Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The evaluation and management of service quality is the emphasis of service science. The purpose of this paper is to establish the evaluation model on the basis of fuzzy evaluation.

articleTitle: The Construction and Management of Horticulture Experimental Teaching Demonstration Center Laboratory Team
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Laboratory is an important base for teaching and research in higher education institutes. As a core task of laboratory construction, to build up a well-qualified team of technicians has become an urgent task for higher education institutes.
