articleTitle: Customer Retention Based on Trust and Commercial Friendship - Taking Financial Sector for Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on relationship marketing paradigm the trust mechanism of the impact of customer retention, trust are creatively divided into two dimensions of personal and enterprises, moreover it adds commercial friendship variable, then develops a structural equation model involving commercial friendship, trust of personal and enterprises and customer retention. The relationship among trust, commercial friendship and customer retention has been verified by empirical study from banking. Findings of this study provide not only theoretical guidance for marketing research, but also empirical evidences for marketing practices.

articleTitle: Research on Coordination Process Model of the Enterprise Network Resources
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Enterprise network resources can be divided into physical resources, intellectual resources, cultural resources, and relationship resources. The degree of relationship resources in the enterprise network resources affect the get and use to the other three resources directly, and relationship resources play a key role to the management of enterprise network resources. The coordination process of enterprise network resources includes: opportunity discovery process, communication process, strategy consultation process and common network learning process of actors.

articleTitle: Adaptive Backstepping Speed Control for a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The application of the backstepping feedback design technique to the speed control of a PMSM is investigated. Using backstepping method, both feedback laws and Lyapunov based designs are applied in the controller design. The proposed stabilizing feedback law for the PMSM is shown to be globally asymptotically stable in the context of Lyapunov theory. It takes into account nonlinearities of the system and uncertainties of the parameters. To validate the contribution of this control, the performances are analyzed and highlighted by simulation results.

articleTitle: A Human-Machine Interaction System: A Voice Command Learning System Using PL-G-SOM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a voice command learning system for partner robots acquiring communication ability with instructors. Parameter-less Growing Self-Organizing Map (PL-G-SOM), an intelligent pattern recognition model given by our previous work, is used and computational feeling of robots is also adopted to improve the human-machine interaction system. AIBO robot was used in the experiment and the results of real environment showed the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Dimensions of Consumer Perceived Value in Green Hotels
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Consumer perceived value has become increasingly important for hotel marketers and operators due to the highly competitive environment. This paper attempts to answer the following questions: (1)What dimensions do consumer perceived value involve in hotel context? (2)What's the relationship between these dimensions? A total of 202 samples were analysed with exploratory factor analysis(EFA) and conﬁrmatory factor analysis (CFA). SPSS 18 and AMOS 17 were used as data analysis tools. Findings indicate that consumer perceived value comprise of functional value(performance/quality), functional value(price/value for money), social value, emotional value, epistemic value dimensions, and correlations between these value dimensions are tested. Implications and suggestions for future research are discussed in the end.

articleTitle: Evolution Properties of Beijing Urban Rail Transit Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an effective method to alleviate the traffic congestion, urban rail transit system has been extensively studied recently in which the structural properties are the most important aspect to understand the functions of urban rail transit system. Here, from the dynamic viewpoint, five measure characteristics of the complexities of Beijing urban rail transit network (BURTN) and the evolution properties are studied in this paper. According to the statistical results, we give the reasons of crowded passengers observed every day from the topology perspective. These results may induce to nice advice for the plan of BURTN in the future.

articleTitle: China and Foreign Countries Electric Vehicles Industry Current Situation and Development Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the current whole world automobile industry faced with the financial crisis and in energy environmental issue's huge challenge situation, development of electric vehicles, realize the automobile energy dynamic system's electrification, impetus tradition automobile industry strategic reforming, internationally had already formed the comprehensive consensus. Therefore, follow the development trend of the international automobile industry, grasps transportation energy dynamic system reforming strategic opportunity, insists to innovate independently, mobilizes the strength of various aspects, speeds up to impetus electric vehicles industry development, to seize the automobile industry competition commanding point, to realize our country's automobile industry from big to strong and independent develop very important, and also very urgent.

articleTitle: Application of Quality Function Deployment to Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To improve cultivation quality of undergraduate, the principle of quality function deployment (QFD) was applied to higher education system in this paper. After describing what QFD is, this paper discusses in detail the various aspects and tools associated with QFD. It is hoped that the paper can serve the needs of researchers and practitioners for higher education institutions of QFD studies and applications, and hence promote QFD's future development.

articleTitle: Energy Management in the Perspective of Global Environmental Crisis: An Evidence from India
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Electricity is the key factor for industrialization, urbanization, economic growth and improvement of quality of life in society. Today, India is poised with opportunity for urbanization and industrialization. In India electricity is mostly generated from coal based thermal power despite the fact that stock of coal is likely to last till 2050 and CO2 emission is contributing alarmingly to global warming and health hazard in the society. Besides, forbidding import price of coal and crude oil is compelling India to look for alternative renewable source of energy like solar, wind power, etc. Unfortunately, India is constrained with technical know how, requisite technology and capital crunch for this change over of power generation from coal to renewable energy. In this situation, the researchers have developed a model with the use of Multi-objective Fuzzy Non-linear Goal Programming to depict future prospects of Indian power sector and recommend gradual change over of power generation from thermal to renewable energy for sustainable development of Indian economy and containment of global environmental crisis. Application of this Model indicates that in the long run Solar power should be the most ideal and viable alternative renewable source of energy.

articleTitle: Failure of State-Owned Enterprises in Benin
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper investigates the importance of government owned enterprises in the development process and try to find out the main factors of its failure in developing country like Benin. Two mains objectives are developed and constitute the essential elements of the competitiveness of those companies: the first is to identify a web of variables associated with failures of SOEs, and what are the potential factors contributing to SOEs growth and the second is to figure out appropriate set of recommendations to avoid SOEs failure. Each of these should be considered as critical to the success of the companies. The paper also provides practical implications for creating a competitive advantage in modern state-owned firms.

articleTitle: Using Learning Styles to Implementing Personalized e-Learning System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to discuss how learning styles and theories are currently used within personalized adaptable e-learning adaptive systems. This paper then aims to establish conditions for creating versatile online courses adjusted to individual learner's needs which enabling the students to choose their own learning path

articleTitle: Vision-Based Real Time Guidance of UAV
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents vision-based estimator and a new guidance method for standoff tracking by unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). Vision information obtained from a single camera, fixed to the vehicle as well as navigation and communications hardware, UAVs are capable of surveying, identifying and tracking ground, sea or aerial targets. The visual measurements of the target can be transformed into bearing measurements using the vehicle position and orientation, camera orientation with respect to the vehicle, and the pixel location of the target. Lyapunov vector field-based guidance law system is utilized to generate airspeed and heading rate control inputs which guide the UAV to circle about a designated ground target with a desired standoff radius. A vector field guidance law is designed for a stationary target with no wind and then modified with a correction term that accounts for a moving target and constant back-ground wind.

articleTitle: The Application of Expertise Knowledge Map in Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the age of knowledge economy, knowledge has become the most important intelligence assets for enterprises. Knowledge workers are the key strategic resources in modern organizations. Human resource management becomes very important for the organizations in the competitive environment. Managers are seeking for the ways to better manage the human resource in order to improve the performance of organization. Expertise knowledge map, as a tool of representing employees' competency, can be used to manage the human resource in human resource planning, human resource use, human resource appreciation and so on. In this paper we discuss the process of constructing an expertise knowledge map and illustrate the different visualization styles of expertise knowledge map for different purposes.

articleTitle: Understanding ICTs Adoption from an Evolutionary Process Perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development and deployment of emerging Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs), there appears an upsurge of interests in studying ICTs adoption and diffusion. As a result, a substantial amount of papers have been published in this area. This paper aims to provide a critical review of the current literature on ICTs adoption with identified gaps and suggestions for future research. Findings from literature reveal that although significant efforts have been made to study ICTs adoption and diffusion, the diversity of the research in terms of theory and methodology is very low. Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and its extended models and deductive approach using survey based method have dominated the ICTs adoption studies for decades. It is argued by the authors that as the ICTs are constantly evolving and innovating, the adoption of the emerging ICTs is also a continuing process. Therefore, future adoption research should focus on understanding the adoption from a dynamic and evolutionary process perspective. An evolution-based model of ICTs adoption is discussed and proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Customer Perceived Risks in Internet Group Buying
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The research and elimination of perceived risks by customers shopping online in groups furthers the development of the business model. With the review and summary of perceived risks by customers in traditional e-commerce environment, special risks resulted from online group buying ware discovered by interviews with customers and experts in order to develop initial scale of perceived risks by online group buying customers. Through data collection and factor analysis by SPSS, five perceived risk constructs are concluded: risk of choosing partners, core services risk of website, risk of information service, performance risk and financial risk. Finally, measures to eliminate perceived risks are suggested from both website and customers perspectives respectively.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of the Scope of Influence of Urban Rail Transit on the Values of Real Estate in Different Surrounding Regions: Taking Zhengzhou Subway Line 1 as a Case Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, both the qualitative and the quantitative analysis methods are used to analyze the scope of influence of twelve stations of Zhengzhou Subway Line 1 in the Zhengzhou West District and Central District on the surrounding real estate values. Moreover, the scopes of influence in these two regions were compared to find out the rule of influence, thus providing a reference for further study on the impact of Urban Rail Transit on the surrounding real estate values.

articleTitle: Noncooperative Game Theory Based Curb Parking Policies Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Some big cities are now facing a dilemma which one side there are lots of illegal parking on the road, on the other side the off-road parking lots are not used effectively, these are all due to the unreasonable parking policies. This paper has analyzed reasons for the game occurring in parking problem from three respects, and bring forward that the essence of parking policy is to adjust the objective factors influencing parking choice to equilibrate the parking lots used. From the game theory perspective, this paper analyzed the reasons that produce the problems of congest parking in on-street parking lots and insufficient of berths. Finally a concrete policy measures is given to enhance the efficiency of parking lots using and find a way out of illegal parking.

articleTitle: Bifurcation Analysis of Attractors of Complex Systems Based on Matrix Decomposition Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new method of bifurcation analysis of chaotic attractors on the basis of the proposed matrix decomposition theory of vector functions in state space of complex systems is developed. Decomposition relationships for attractors of complex nonlinear dynamical system based on matrix series are considered. Bifurcation analysis of attractors of complex dynamical systems using the obtained decomposition relationships is carried out.

articleTitle: Carbon Tax Policy and Technological Innovation for Low-Carbon Emission
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through allowance limit of carbon emissions and carbon tax policies the Government can encourage enterprises to invest low-carbon technologies and decrease the carbon emissions. Considering the low-carbon technology spillover, the three-stage game model shows that the equivalent carbon tax is not a definite value, but a variable in the certain interval. The maximum tax rate is that the small firms cannot afford but to close. And the minimum value of carbon tax rate is that ensure large enterprises to invest in low-carbon technology. Meanwhile, the carbon emission limit and time are relevant to determine the balance of the carbon tax. At first time, the initial tax rate may be higher in order to promote the large enterprises to invest in low carbon production technology. After a certain period, the Government can reduce the tax rate appropriate in order that can avoid the low-carbon technology transfer fee is too high and prevent the formation of low-carbon technology monopoly. Meanwhile, the government will further use carbon emissions tax to subsidize research and development of low-carbon technologies to decrease low-carbon emission technology transfer prices.

articleTitle: Studying Formal Methods Applications in CBTC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Formal methods are mathematics-based techniques, often supported by reasoning tools, that can offer a rigorous and effective way to model, design and analyse computer systems. Up to now formal methods in railway systems have mostly been used for interlocking applications. We are interested in studying and describing some possible formal methods applications in CBTC (Communications-Based Train Control). The main goal is to meet the safety requirements of railway signalling systems by reasonable safety evidences. At a basic level, formal methods may simply be used for a high-level specification of the system to be designed (e.g., using the Z notation). The process of specification is the act of writing things down precisely. The main benefit in so doing is intangible gaining a deeper understanding of the system being specified. The next level of usage is to apply formal methods to the development process (e.g., VDM, SMV), using a set of rules or a design calculus that allows stepwise refinement of the operations and data structures in the specification to an efficiently executable program. We want to try modelling multi-tasking applications in real-time operating system of MCU (Micro Controlling Unit) in CBTC with Z notation, and the model will be analysed by exhaustive simulation with the SMV model checker. Besides, we select a feasible way to the verification of interlocking system. At the most rigorous level, the whole process of proof may be mechanized (e.g., B-tools). A major conclusion of the study is that formal methods, while still immature in certain important respects, are beginning to be used seriously and successfully by railway to design and develop safety-related systems.

articleTitle: Safety Evaluation and Control on Underground Pipeline Influenced by Metro Construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Influence of metro construction on underground pipelines adjacent to tunnels is a key technical issue demanding urgent solution in metro engineering. Considering the effect induced by metro excavation on the underground pipelines at Huangzhuang Station of Beijing Metro Line 10, the recommended control values of ground surface settlements are determined by sections according to the characters and buried depths of pipelines, the relative positions between pipes and station, and the potential risks in construction. The safety of the underground pipelines is analyzes and predicted on the basis of relevant pipeline safety evaluation standards, and specific measures are also put forward to control pipeline settlement. According to the monitoring data, the settlements of pipelines adjacent to Huangzhuang Station are successfully controlled within 30mm, and the maximum differential settlement is 1.123<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>/<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub>, which cannot overrun the safety request of pipeline. It concludes that the control criterion of pipeline settlement is reasonable and the control measures play an effective role in guarantee of normal use of the pipelines.

articleTitle: The Psychological Stress of Employees - A Questionnaire Survey
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of field investigation and analysis of document materials, research has revealed that the source of stress for junior staff (the new generation of urban migrant workers) was mainly associated with overtime work, thousands times of repeating the same action in an assembly line, the work short of challenge and lower management level of primary level managers. Finally some suggestions for employee stress management were offered: 1) attention should be paid to the effective measures to train junior managers and enhance psychological health level and the level of production management, 2) reform the management style and find out new ideas suitable for the new generation of urban migrant workers, 3) focuses on the staff who has excessive stress and 4) set up a specialized institution to study the stress of staff.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Performance of Urban Domestic Sewage Treatment Plants in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Performance evaluation of urban domestic sewage treatment plants includes evaluation of sewage collection, sewage treatment effectiveness, efficiency and fairness. Establishing a scientific performance evaluation model is of great significance to ensure the sewage treatment effect and to improve the sewage treatment efficiency. An evaluation index system is to be established according to the urban domestic sewage management objectives; city's centralized treatment rate is to be evaluated according to the serving population; the urban domestic sewage treatment effect is to be evaluated according to the sewage discharge permit; the urban domestic sewage treatment efficiency is to be evaluated according to the unit pollutant reduction cost; urban domestic sewage treatment investment is to be estimated based on the most efficient plant's sewage treatment cost.

articleTitle: Items and Process Management of Libraries' Digital Information Service - A Case Study on Tsinghua University Library Homepage and Its Academic Information Resource Portal
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: [Purpose] We carry on a research to study the optimization of the items and process management of libraries' digital information service. [Method] By examining Tsinghua University Library Homepage and Academic Information Resource Portal from the perspective of items and process management of libraries' digital information service, authors analyze the status of items and process management of libraries' digital information service. [Results] Our results show that the items and process management of Tsinghua University Library has many advantages, but there is still rooms for improvement. [Conclusion] Based on the analysis, we provide advices for improving service items and process management.

articleTitle: The Lowest Hardness Point Calculation by Transient Computer Simulation of Industrial Steel Bar Quenched in Oil at Different Austenitizing Temperatures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Quenching of steels in general has been and continues to be an important commercial manufacturing process for steel components. Temperature histories must be performed in order to obtain accurate transformation kinetics. The modelling of an axisymmetric industrial quenched steel bar based on finite element method has been produced to investigate the impact of process history on metallurgical and material properties. A two dimensional axisymmetric model has been adopted to predict temperature history and consequently the hardness of the quenched steel bar at any point (node). The lowest hardness point (LHP) is determined, which is at half the length at the centre of the bar. Experimentally, this hardness value is almost impossible to determine and previous methods only calculate hardness at the surface. This surface hardness value is normally higher than the (LHP) which can cause deformation and failure of the component under certain conditions. The model can be employed as a guideline to design cooling approach to achieve desired microstructure and mechanical properties such as hardness.

articleTitle: A Proposed Framework of eWOM and eTrust in Online Hotel Booking: The Influence of an e-Intermediary
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Internet has become deeply rooted in our daily life and is affecting the way people behave and the way they impact their communities. Hotel industry worldwide is among the first industries that adopt the new technology quickly and make online hotel room booking available. Evidences however show that consumers are still reluctant to use online transaction due to various factors. This study will first analyses factors that may influence travelers' online hotel booking intention and then proposes a research framework for further study.

articleTitle: Modifying IPA with Fuzzy DEMATEL
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study employs Regression analysis to establish the implicit importance of quality attributes and the overall satisfaction, and adopt the fuzzy DEMATEL, which consider the fuzziness of human thinking, to calculate the causal relationship and the influential degree among each quality attribute, and then proposes a new methodology of decision analysis, which modifies the traditional IPA model and obtains the accurate importance and the improvement the quality attributes, in order to make the improvement of quality attributes and resource allocation more relationable.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Fuzzy MCDM Approach for Market Segments Evaluation and Selection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Market segments evaluation and selection are crucial marketing activities of all companies. This paper proposes a fuzzy multiple criteria decision-making (MCDM) model for the evaluation and selection of market segments. A set of essential criteria for evaluating market segments and selection are identified based on the literature survey. Two MCDM methods are then used in the decision model. More precisely, Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is used to calculate the weight of each criterion, and fuzzy technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) approach is proposed to prioritize market segments from the best to the worst ones. The use of fuzzy set theory allows incorporating qualitative information and imprecise linguistic terms into the decision model. A case study on a dairycompany is put forward to illustrate the performance of the proposed methodology. The proposed model could help companies to evaluate and select market segments.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation on MPEG-4 Streaming Media Digital Rights Management System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces functions and features of the MPEG-4 streaming media, combine its media properties with Microsoft's digital rights management component WMRM, design and implemented the digital rights management system based on MPEG-4 streaming media, this system possessed a higher Security and stability, it has a high application value on development of streaming media in e-commerce.

articleTitle: Research on Entrepreneurial Orientation and Entrepreneurial Behavior: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The relationship between entrepreneurial orientation (EO) and entrepreneurial behavior (EB) is important to the success of entrepreneurial firms. More than 200 enterprises were surveyed through research questionnaires and the conclusions are as follows: (1) EO had a significant positive effect on EB. (2) "Innovativeness", "proactiveness" and "competitive aggressiveness" had significant effects on "sustained regeneration". (3) "Autonomy", "risk-taking", and innovativeness" had significant effects on "organizational rejuvenation". (4) "Proactiveness", "risk-taking", and "innovativeness" had significant effects on "domain redefinition".

articleTitle: Extension of VIKOR Method with Interval-Valued Intuitionistic Fuzzy Sets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Multi-criteria decision making (MCDM) is the process of determining the best feasible solution according to the established criteria. Practical problems are often characterized by several non-commensurable and conflicting criteria and there may be no solution satisfying all criteria simultaneously. VIKOR is an efficient method to solve this kind of MCDM problem. But in many practical situations, there usually exists incomplete and uncertain information, and the decision makers cannot easily express their judgments on the alternatives with exact and crisp values. Therefore, an extended technique for VIKOR method with interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy sets is proposed to solve MCDM under incomplete and uncertain information environment in this paper. And the feasibility and practicability of the extended VIKOR method are further manifested through a numerical example. The results also show that this extended VIKOR method with interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy sets is more flexible and suitable to cope with MCDM under incomplete and uncertain information environment than extended TOPSIS method with interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy numbers.

articleTitle: New Changes and Effects of Korean Investment in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper describes the regional distribution, industry structure and new features of South Korean enterprises investment in China. It also analyzes the economic effects of their investment by using the quantitative analysis method, while pointing out some existing problems and finally making the relevant recommendations.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Contractors' Safety Performance Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Contractor safety is the key to success for construction projects, the contractor safety goals and performance evaluation system has become the important task of safety management of current building construction. This paper based on experts linguistic assessment and multi-granularity language fusion method of qualitative indexes to evaluate and rational quantification, through the C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R DEA model and "projection" method of contractor safety performance objective and reasonable evaluation and analyzes the causes of the ineffective DMU to improve its safety performance. With a project of four contractors for case study, explain that the method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Poor Risk Management as One of the Major Reasons Causing Failure of Project Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Poor risk management is currently a blazing issue in project management, it is counted as a major aspect contributing to project failure. This paper is focused much more on how poor risk management leads to failure of projects, it also examines the major reasons that are associated with failure of project management. In more details of the article is the literature review that supports how poor risk management is linked to the major reasons causing failure of project management as well as the strategic efforts to overcome it.

articleTitle: Water Quality Prediction of Changjiang of Jingdezhen through Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to obtain the water quality trend of Changjiang of Jingdezhen and prevent water pollution events, a water quality prediction model is built. Water quality index data, which are observed from a section of Changjiang, are taken as training samples. And eight indexes are selected, such as PH, chloride, sulfate, dissolved oxygen (DO), ammonia, permanganate, iron, total phosphorus (TP). Radial basis function (RBF) neural network model is optimized by particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm, and then the model is used to predict water quality indexes of Changjiang. The experimental results indicate that the deviation of predicted values calculated by the model and observed values are almost less then 4%, and we could infer that RBF neural network model optimized by PSO is a reliable and effective method for water quality prediction.

articleTitle: The Role of Advertising and Promotion Strategy of Media Firms in Two-Sided Markets with Negative Network Externality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Regarding to the dynamic game relation between media and manufacturer (advertiser) in practice and to the enhancement of marketing awareness about media brand in itself, We intend to explore the role of advertising and promotion strategy of media firms in two-sided markets with negative cross-market network effect. Two Stackelberg game models composed of one manufacturer and two competing media firms are developed and compared. This paper examines the influences of advertising and promotion strategy of media firms on its own competitive advantages and the manufacturer's advertising strategies.

articleTitle: Research of Ventilation Design for Highway Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The gas of vehicle emissions contains large amounts of harmful gases. To sustain the quality of the air in tunnel, we need ventilation, which is a systematic project. We should take into account not only construction costs For ventilation planning, but also should consider the development of future maintenance and management of the transport costs and the corresponding need for phased construction. This article discusses various aspects of ventilation and ventilation calculation method of choice, which provide the base for ventilation design of highway tunnel.

articleTitle: Analysis on How to Enhance E-Democracy through E-Government
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-government is one of the buzzwords in discussing modernizing public administration. With the help of the information and communication technologies (short for ICTs), especially the internet, the resulting new and better government is seen to be more responsive to the needs of citizens and enterprise, more democratic, and more efficient. One of the most important benefits of e-government is that it can enhance e-democracy. This paper will show you in what ways e-government enhance e-democracy.

articleTitle: University Dormitory Management System Based on Agile Development Architecture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of management and to meet the demand of automation management on dormitory at university, a university dormitory management system based on agile development architecture is built, which adopts Brower/Server mode and the idea of agile development, and makes full use of agile development architecture technologies and related technologies, including agile architecture, automatic code generation technology and asp.net technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of Environmental Tax Being the Optimal Method offsetting External Cost
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through the economic analysis of optimal social pollution control measures, such as government's direct control, pollution charges regulation, trade of pollution right system, financial subsidies, coase theorem and environmental tax system, it is found that only the environment tax system is best way to solve environmental pollution and external negative effect.

articleTitle: A Study on College Teachers' Personal Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The highly developed globalization and new technology are leading us to the information era and bringing up many more requirements for the college teachers' personal knowledge management. An effective management on the teacher's knowledge is an important method to promote their growth and development. Based on the interpretation of the knowledge management and personal knowledge management, this paper analyses the contents of such kind of management, and strategies to improve the college teachers' knowledge management are put forward.

articleTitle: How to Better Protect Biodiversity in Land Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Land use has inevitable responsibility for the loss of biodiversity, especial for fragile ecological environment. Therefore, it's necessary to promote the concept of biodiversity conservation into the traditional land-use planning. Exploring the combination between biodiversity protection and land use will be the focus of this article. The first section mainly describes the necessity of biodiversity protection in land use; The second indicates major innovations in land management; Part III, IV, V can be considered as the core of this article, with the introduction of engineering measures, political measures and other measures in biodiversity protection respectively. The sixth part briefly represents the received effects, and some further improvements.

articleTitle: A Study of Competitive Advantage on Services Package-Based Economy Hotel: "7 Days Inn" as a Case
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Economy hotel is a typical service-oriented enterprises, the paper take "7 Days Inn" for example, the use of services package theory, not only analysis the hotel's three levels of basic services and the specific practices ,but also shows the hotel efforts to improve service availability.In addition, the use of Internet technology to improve customer's interaction and participation during service, which extends the basic services to augment service offering, thereby enhancing the level of customer perceived service quality as competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Application of AHP in the Selection of Our Country Wind Farm's Location
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Wind power is a renewable clean energy which has huge reserve.According to the relevant data,1% of the wind on the earth will be able to meet the world's energy needs.In recent years, as the rapid development of China's wind power industry,wind farm site selection has also become an important research subject. This article is based on the AHP model to analyze the many indicators which impact on the wind farm site selection.

articleTitle: Customer Knowledge Management of Mass Customization Enterprises Based Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mass customization has become the main mode of production and management in the 21st century. Customer knowledge becomes important strategic resources of enterprises, it is an urgent problem for academia and business community that deeply studying of customer knowledge of mass customization enterprises and effective manage. Revealing the characteristics of customer knowledge of MC enterprise through analyzing customer knowledge of MC enterprise, studying the management process and forms of customer knowledge in main links of mass customization value chain, and establishing customer knowledge management process model of MC enterprise based on value chain.

articleTitle: Is the Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises' Credit Default Behavior Affected by Their Owners' Credit Features?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Identifying and measuring credit risk of small and medium-sized enterprises should be different from that of large firms, for SMEs appear to be influenced by their owners more directly and significantly. This paper attempts to testify the relationship between default behaviors of SMEs and the credit features of their owners, so that a more appropriate and effective way of credit management of SMEs could be applied in practice. After segregating the owners' characteristics data into variables of basic features, credit capacity features and credit will features, this paper implement an empirical study of logistic regression analysis with repeat sampling data. The result demonstrates that, compare with the owners' credit will variables, variables reflected credit capacity features share more significant relationship with the SMEs' credit default behavior. Specifically, the age of owner, the inquiry frequency of owners' credit information for post-loan risk management and pro-loan approval purpose, and the proportion of overdue loans are the extreme significant variables which are valuable indicators in default risk estimate model.

articleTitle: Study on Critical Chain Project Portfolio Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Project portfolio is a firm's collection of projects that are simultaneously implemented, which share a common strategic purpose and the same scarce resources. Project portfolio schedule is extremely complex because of resources competition and conflict. Based on the introduction to the theory of constraints, it is discussed that the theory of constraints is applied to the project portfolio management. The paper analyzes concept of critical chain project management and rules of buffer in critical chain, and then put forward the methods and process of designing critical chain project portfolio scheduling.

articleTitle: Search Engine Optimization of E-Commerce Websites
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Search engine optimization, called SEO for short, is important to websites, which will improve the rank for search engines and get more page views. This paper puts forward its principle, basic strategy and emphasizes the special aspects of e-commerce website optimization, such as dynamic web pages, redirect web pages and similar or repeated pages, then gives some tactics, such as making dynamic pages static, reducing redirect pages and revising similar pages.

articleTitle: A Comparison Study on the Evaluation Criteria for Corporate Social Responsibility
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: All over the world the topic of corporate social responsibility (CSR) is becoming more and more important. Currently, there are nine different sets of CSR evaluation criteria being used worldwide. As each of the different evaluation methods vary from one another, it is difficult to compare the results from two different tests in order to evaluate the CSR scores of one company against another. This research selects four sets of CSR criteria, three which have international credibility, the SA8000, the GRI, and the ISO26000, as well as the Corporate Social Responsibility Best Practice Principles for TWSE/GTSM-Listed Companies (known as the TW Principles) released in 2010. In our research, we will review the current literature on the evaluation criteria to compare and contrast the different CSR evaluation criteria, present our results and make conclusions.

articleTitle: Green Design and Humanized Design in High Speed Train's Industrial Design Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: High speed train, been as a new transportation, revealed its advantage in speed and clean energy of power when compared to the other modern transportation means. Meanwhile, green design and humanized design have drawn a great concern within contemporary design trends, such trends originated from the rising environmental consciousness and continuously focusing on the needs of human-being in modern age. In the process of high speed train's industrial design development, the introducing of green design and humanized design could benefit this new transportation to adapt itself better to meet the contemporary social requirements. But it can only be achieved in maximum under the instruction of effective design management, and in this way, the expected macro-economical and social profit will be produced successfully.

articleTitle: Optimization of a Continuous Stirred-Tank Chemical Reactor System Using Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Continuous Stirred-Tank chemical Reactor (CSTCR) System is a chemical reactor system with a complex nonlinear dynamic characteristic. Optimization of CSTCR system by using classic optimal control theory lead to solve nonlinear Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman(HJB) equations. However, the nonlinear HJB equations are very difficult to solved .So it is necessary to employ numerical methods to solve nonlinear optimal control (NOC) problems. In this paper particle swarm optimization algorithm and improved particle swarm optimization algorithm were employed to solve a continuous stirred-tank chemical reactor problem, numerically. The PSO is a powerful evolutionary computing technique used to optimize various continuous and discreet value problems. Result show that the improved particle swarm optimization(IPSO) algorithms are much more efficient and generate higher quality solution than PSO algorithm.

articleTitle: Competitiveness Comparative Analysis of China Development Bank in Its Reform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Competitiveness of China Development Bank is evaluated from the perspective of commercial banks in this paper. By establishing competitiveness evaluation index system, China Development Bank is compared with nine commercial banks. Analytic Hierarchy Process is combined with Entropy Method, and the result of comprehensive evaluation shows the two methods are complementary to each other. The empirical results show that the security, profitability and development capacity of China Development Bank are more prominent, but the liquidity is poor. Finally, improvement suggestions are given.

articleTitle: The Research of Web Mining in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The World Wide Web is a huge, information center for a variety of applications. Web contains a dynamic and rich collection of hyperlink information and Web page access and the usage of information and provides numerous sources for data mining. Web mining's goal is from huge collections of documents to discover the pattern of access and hidden information. The Web mining research is at the cross road of research from database, information retrieval and so on. This paper gives an overview of Web mining and Web mining techniques.

articleTitle: Measuring Service Quality of Car Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The survey was based on SERVQUAL, a diagnostic tool developed in the 1980s, which measures service quality in terms of customer expectations and perceptions of service. This research paper focuses on the link between customer expectations and service quality. The survey results have provided information showing how the industry of car maintenance service can manage its service quality. The findings indicate that customers consistently rank 'reliability' as the most important service dimension.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Software Development Risk Based on Grey Decision-Making Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the diversity of software development risk, the complication of evaluation indexes and the comprehensive evaluation hardly with the present evaluation method, the software development risk was divided into three grade indexes. 13 risk evaluation indexes were constructed based on the different stage of real situation in the course of software development. Based on the grey decision-making theory, the method of grey relation decision-making in the process of software development was proposed. Finally, an example demonstrated the application process of this method, and the results conformed to the real situation. Compared with the qualitative risk evaluation model, this method had better persuasion and referring value.

articleTitle: Research and Application on Data Description Standard of Virtual Experiment Scene
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Constructing virtual scenes is one of the important parts in the virtual experiment system. In this process, it's essential to define the standard of related data description, this paper mainly introduces what needs to be included in the standard, based on the whole system of virtual experiment. In the end, it introduces the application for testing the standard through the whole platform.

articleTitle: Research on Innovation-Generating and Innovation-Transferring
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The existing studies of innovation focus on the combination of innovation-generating type and innovation-transferring type, which generates inconsistent empirical results. In this paper, we assume that the difference between these two types of innovation can be clarified. We first define the conception of these two types of innovation: innovation-generating refers to the supplier of new technology, services or products, whereas innovation-transferring refers to assimilation of existing technology, services or products. Based on the difference between these two types of innovation, we propose three factors that may affect the choice of innovation type in management world.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Logistics Outsourcing Risk Based on Supply Chain Circumstances
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on analysis the cause of the logistics outsourcing under the environment of the supply chain management, the article studies the physical distribution outsourcing risk origin and proposes a four stage risk control's strategy of logistics outsourcing under the supply chain circumstance to deepen the enterprise cooperation of the supply chain, reduce the risk of the physical distribution outsourcing, enhance enterprise's market competitiveness.

articleTitle: The Research of Personalization E-Commerce Model Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of supply chain and logistic, the commodity classification and amount provided by E-commerce system rise increasingly. The traditional web-centered searching commerce model has become the bottleneck hindering value-adding of e-commerce enterprises, while personalized e-commerce system is one effective way to solve this problem. Incorporating the demand for personalized e-commerce system and data mining technology, this paper explores personalized e-commerce model based on data mining. The practice proves that this model can realize one-to -one service for the customer provided by e-commerce system, shorten the shopping time of customers, maximize the attractions for customers and increase the loyalty of clients.

articleTitle: Investigating Mediators between Customer Orientation and Customer Citizenship Behaviors: A Conceptual Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A conceptual model is developed in order to investigate how customer orientation influence customer citizenship behaviors. The concepts of customer orientation, customer satisfaction, customer commitment and customer citizenship behaviors are identified. Five hypotheses are advanced based on literature review. Finally, this research points out that the conceptual model needs empirical examination.

articleTitle: Online Marketing of Luxury Goods - Take Chinese Market as Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Network technique development promotes the prosperity of e-commerce. All kinds of companies have being exploiting the online market. In the luxury field, enterprises are trying to use the website as a new marketing tool. This article will focus on the online marketing issues of luxury goods. The present situation is introduced, and some proposals of enhancing online marketing are talked about.

articleTitle: Using DEMATEL to Implement LibQUAL+TM in Evaluating Library Service
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Library administrators can realize how the users access services and propose strategies for improvement by LibQUAL+TM survey data. Through a Decision Making Trial and Evaluation Laboratory (DEMATEL), causation across items of LibQUAL+TM is inquired for locating core key items, which effectively and accurately offers library administrators information for assessing and improving services. The outcomes indicate that respective key items of Affect of Service, Library as Place and Information Control are willingness to help users and giving users individual attention, quiet space for individual activities, and easy-touse access tools that allows me to find things on my own, a library website enabling me to locate information on my own and making information easily accessible for independent use, respectively.

articleTitle: Study of Mobile Payment Business Model Based on Third-Party Mobile Payment Service Provider
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the fast developing mobile commerce, mobile payment is springing up as a new industry. It is obvious that replacing traditional cash or bank card with mobile will cause a payment revolution. However, some factors such as individual demand, rapid change of external market environment, complicated industry chain, and numerous business models are barrels of a successful mobile payment. This paper integrates the theory of business mobile, value net and industry chain to present a framework of mobile payment value net and propose three mobile payment business models suiting for current market environment. Among these models, we focus mainly on the mobile payment business model based on third-party mobile payment service provider, and a relative case is introduced to a detailed exploration.

articleTitle: Low-Cost RFID: Security Problems and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Data security and privacy of Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technique are becoming increasingly acute, and as a bottleneck hinder the father development of RFID. This paper first briefly introduces the data security and privacy problems existing in RFID system from the perspectives of label, network and data security etc. then, discusses the solutions for the existing security and privacy problems from the perspectives of physical security mechanism and protocol of RFID system. And at last puts forward the suggestions for the development of RFID security techniques.

articleTitle: Study on E-Commerce Post Express Service in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Express companies is development very quickly with e-commerce in China. But there are more people complaints about their services. I compared Post express service with private and foreign companies, and found out that the delivery time, fees and value-added services were not very well. In the last, I analyzed the Post express SWOT (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities and Threat).

articleTitle: Board Independence and Accounting Conservatism: Evidence Based on Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Conservatism are regarded as a fundamental characteristic to measure financial statements, and board independence is viewed as an important tool among corporate governance. Both of them have been academic focuses. The paper examines the impact the independence of board of directors has on accounting conservatism, with the data of all the listed companies of A share market in Shanghai and Shenzhen from 2007 to 2009. The results demonstrate that in generally, listed companies in China have accounting conservatism in their accounting policies. Moreover, the increasing percentage of independent directors in the board benefits the improvement of accounting conservatism. However, CEO/Chairman separation won't work on that.

articleTitle: Several Thoughts on GHG Emission Reduction and Traffic Congestion Control in Urban Transport
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: urban transport is one of the most outstanding problems facing urban development in the world. On the one hand, with accelerated urbanization and mobilization processes, the issue of traffic congestion in urban areas is becoming increasingly prominent. On the other hand, with the continuous growth of vehicle stock, as well as the aggravation of traffic congestion, GHG emissions in urban transport sector keep increasing. To effectively tackle the problems of emission reduction and traffic congestion is the most important and difficult task in urban transport sector, and is the requirement for addressing climate change and improving the people's livelihood during China's twelfth five-year-plan period. Drawing on extensively the international experience as well as relevant policies concerning urban transport development and carbon market formulation during China's twelfth five-year-plan period, this research work puts forward policy recommendations for easing traffic congestion and reducing GHG emissions in China's urban transport sector from the perspective of establishing comprehensive transport planning, developing public transport, utilizing clean fuel and implementing gradually the emission trading system.

articleTitle: Hotel Performance Evaluation Based on Cross-Efficiency DEA Models
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Tourism industry has excellent prospects in 21 Century because it contributes to GDP, provides employee positions, and be denoted as smokeless industry, etc. So, tourism industry takes pivotal roles in the whole economy. Hotels are the most important component in tourism industry. To enhance the running efficiency of hotels, we need to know the performance of hotels. A comprehensive evaluation methodology, named as Cross-efficiency DEA, is applied to measure the performance of hotels. By using the calculation results, we can rank the performance level of different hotels.

articleTitle: The Research of Development Models Based on Culture Creative Tourism Industry: Example as Fujian Nanjing Tulou
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays, creative tourism industry that based on the culture becomes an important trend in the tourism industry development. Through the description about the creative tourism content and distinction between the traditional tourism and creative one, the Fujian Nanjing Tulou was regarded as an example to discuss the topic from the perspective of characteristic culture. Many designs ideas about creative tourism and recommendations of the further development of creative tourism of Nanjing Tulou were proposed accordingly.

articleTitle: Study on the Relation between the Board Characteristics and Financial Fraud of Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper takes Chinese financial fraud listed companies which happened in 2001-2009 as a sample, and makes an empirical analysis between the relationship of the board characteristics and financial fraud with the paired-samples T test. The findings indicate that the company leadership structure and the board shareholding proportion of financial fraud and non-financial fraud listed companies have great differences, and they are significantly correlated with financial fraud. The board size, the proportion of independent director, the frequency of board meeting and the audit committee are not significantly correlated with financial fraud.

articleTitle: Technology and Management of Improving Appearance Quality of Fair-Faced Finishing Concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Some drawbacks in the appearance quality of fair-faced finishing concrete that may easily appear are analyzed in this study, including the non-rounded outline of bolt holes, more 'panda eyes', irregular pore blocking, non-smooth construction of seamless convergence, exposed sand in decorative gaps, uneven and non-straight cicada seam, and more bubbles, clouds and sand at the concrete surface, etc. To solve these problems, some systematic technical improvements and management measures are proposed with respect to plugs, outseam stripes, clamps, making and mounting of templates and so on, with which the appearance quality of fair-faced finishing concrete is enhanced effectively.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle: The Hope of the Green Future
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the predicted data of lightweight vehicle production from 2010 to 2040, this paper evaluates the environmental and economic impacts of widespread use of electric vehicles. In this paper, the time series, combining membership function, is firstly used to obtain electric vehicle production, and environmental impacts of widespread use of electric vehicles is described. Then, after modeling the economic benefit of widespread use of electric vehicles, the investment cost of renewable energy electricity generation and subsidy cost, the economic impacts are obtained. The result suggests electric vehicles have a promising future with numerous environmental and economic impacts.

articleTitle: The Implementation and Application of Mobile Online Games in China: A Marketing Perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the implementation of 3G technology and the popularity of high performance mobile phones, mobile online games have a great potential to develop in China. This paper focuses on the implementation and application of mobile online games in China from a marketing perspective. It first analyses the characteristics and the status quo of mobile games in China. And through the first hand survey and the data, this paper points out five barriers to the development of mobile games in China. Accordingly it puts forth five solutions to address the problems, which can serve as references for mobile game operators and researchers concerned.

articleTitle: Agent-Based Modeling Approach to a Team Creativity Pattern Analysis Based on Heterogeneity and Network Structure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Recently organizations have paid more attention to team creativity as a strategic resource for innovation and performances improvement. The purpose of this research is to find out the evolution pattern of team creativity longitudinally in order to explain how heterogeneity and network structure - degree centrality and structural hole - can affect team creativity. Through the pattern analysis by Agent-Based Modeling (ABM) simulations, it was found that both heterogeneity and network structure - degree centrality and structural hole - positively affect team creativity. Furthermore we also found that degree centrality and structural hole are more effective than heterogeneity in the long term perspective. This research can provide foundation for future research and expand the research coverage on team creativity by conducting longitudinal analysis, while previous researches mainly addressed this topic with cross-sectional approach.

articleTitle: Forecast of Subsidy for Purchasing Agricultural Machinery Based on Life Cycle Theory in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Subsidy for purchasing agricultural machinery in many developed countries showed the periodic characteristic. In order to learn their experiences, trace the laws for the financial support of China, provide theoretical support in policy making in developing countries. The characters of subsidy for purchasing agricultural machinery in China have been analyzed in this paper. There are three stages of the central financial subsidy since 2004 when the policy came into effect, including the initial stage, growth stage and maturity stage. The speed of increasing is slow, high and stable respectively in the three stages and the growth curve is approximately "S-shape". After analyzing the typical characters of the investment scale, implement region, subsidized machinery types and subsidized groups, the subsidy for purchasing agricultural machinery is forecasted by Life Cycle Theory and Logistic Growth Model. The result shows that central financial subsidies are expected to total about 97 billion RMB from 2011 to 2015. And it will reach 19.8 billion RMB in 2015.

articleTitle: Financial Distress Prediction Models of Listed Companies by Using Non-Financial Determinants in Bayesian Criterion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on Bayesian Criterion, non-financial indicators were introduced in this paper to establish an early warning model for financial failures¿D Studies were carried out over 61 companies actually under Special Treatment (ST) and indicated that 54 of the companies were correctly judged (accuracy: 88.5%). The results proved good prediction effectiveness of the financial distress prediction model.

articleTitle: Contribution of Ice Storage System to Electricity Sector: Carbon Dioxide Emissions Reduction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A method was presented to calculate CO2 emissions reduction of electricity sector resulting from the utilization of ice storage system. A typical ice storage system in an office building under East China power grid was analyzed. The results show that by the utilization of ice storage system, the load factor of power grid could be improved and thus electricity sector could reduce CO2 emissions. CO2 emissions reduction per unit of storage capacity for the typical ice storage system is 0.557kg/kWh. It's proposed that CO2 emissions reduction be used as an indicator to assess the externalities of ice storage system to electricity sector.

articleTitle: Researched Customer Requirements Representation and Mapping on Ontology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of product design based on the customer service is oriented customer requirement to get the highest customer satisfaction products. This paper proposed a model to mining customer requirement based on customer service data, and use ontology to represented the five type requirements. Finally, the customer requirements layered and proposed a model about customer requirements mapping to product design feature.

articleTitle: An Investigation on Security of Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Cognitive Radio Networks (CRNs) emerge as a possible solution for the lack of spectrum, and make different networks merge. However, security becomes the key problem need to be solved. Cognitive radio networks face not only traditional network security intrusion problems, but also unique security risks. In this paper, we investigate security issues in different classes which including spectrum security and security of network merge. Countermeasures are given from three aspects: security mechanism, key management and identity authentication.

articleTitle: Negative Binomial Model with an Application to Special Treatment Count Data
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Special Treatment (ST) is a particular regulation for the exchange to prompt the risk to investors. Since ST count data are discrete, traditional Orthogonal Least Square method cannot get better goodness of fitting. However, Poisson regression is appropriate to be used to analyze discrete data. In addition, once it is over-dispersed, Negative Binomial (NB) regression model is more suitable. In this paper, we study the influence of non-financial factors on ST occurrence event count with NB model. Result shows that China Interbank Offered Rate, Import, Export, Deposits of Enterprises and one-period lagged ST count are evidently associated with ST risk.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on the Money-Supply Effect of Inflation Expectation When Managing Inflation Expectation in China - Based on Cagan Model and Lucas Microeconomic Rational Expectation Equation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Today, every country's economic policies now are causing inflation and strengthening Inflation Expectation. Without doubt, comprehending appropriately Inflation Expectation effects, especial its money-supply effect, is the important basis to manage Inflation Expectation and suppress inflation. The paper first introduces briefly rational expectation and its econometric expression; gives monetary supply's response to inflation expected by rational expectation by the model combined Cagan model and Lucas microeconomic rational expectation equation; points out that estimating and researching the mechanism of Inflation Expectation in China and its influence to monetary supply when managing Inflation Expectation is crucially necessary for achieve the goal of the economic policy.

articleTitle: An Approach of End User Regression Testing for Semantic Web Services
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In web services-based applications, Web applications can be composed of hundreds of web services. Hence, application system quality depends on the quality of the involved web services. When the service evolves, it may not satisfy anymore the requirements of end user (anyone who use the web service). Any change of a web service, it must be re-tested at the unit level, and re-used to form services-based application systems. As a result, we proposed WSRTM (web service regression testing model) for semantic web service. The semantics of the web services are defined using the Inputs,Outputs, Preconditions, Effects (IOPEs) paradigm. Based on WSRTM, This paper focuses on WSDL interface and IOPEs information changes and impacts, and proposes a test cases generation approach for operation sequences of semantic Web Services. The approach may verify the sequential functional behavior of semantic web services for end user in concrete usage scenario. Finally, the paper presents an application example.

articleTitle: Investment and Financing Mechanism of Public Transport in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study analyzes the existing investment and financing mechanism of China's public transport and the updated demand for its innovation. A new investment and financing mechanism is proposed to promote public transport priority. Innovated investment and financing modes, channels, regulations and performance evaluation systems have been used to form the new mechanism.

articleTitle: The Correlation Studies of Agricultural Investment Elements and Agricultural Benefits
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the agricultural data from 1990 to 2009 of Heilongjiang province, with Cobb-douglas production function, SPSS software using multiple regression equation for the establishment of agricultural investment main factors of influencing agricultural investment efficiency. Analysis showed that the biggest influence factors on agricultural investment efficiency are chemical fertilizer inputs, land sown area and labor. Meanwhile, analyzes the social benefit and ecological benefit of agricultural investment. At last, puts forward for improving agricultural investment benefit measures and suggestions, such as adjust the industrial structure, strengthen the government on rural infrastructure investment, strengthen the education and training of farmers.

articleTitle: A Gray Correlation Analysis of China's Industrial Structure and Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on China's rapid industrial growth and unbalanced structural development, this article selects the gross output value of China's three industries and the gross domestic product as the empirical data to calculate the the generalized gray correlation of China's three industries and economic growth, to analyze the contribution degree of China's industry to economic growth. The results indicate that there is a strong correlation between secondary industry and economic growth in China, and it reveals that China's economic growth was mainly driven by secondary industry, which provide a reference for China's industrial structure adjustment and the formulation of industrial policy.

articleTitle: Reflection on Mode of Construction of Government Investment Projects
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzed the basis of construction and management of government investment projects theoretic, and summarized from developed countries and regions in their construction and management of government investment projects mature approach. Furthermore, on the basic of China's government investment projects in construction management for the pilot, proposed three basic management modes that suitable for China's reality. Finally, pointed out the implementation in real construct process in five areas require special handling problems and corresponding countermeasures.

articleTitle: Risk Management and Consumer Willingness of eBanking in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the global ebanking flourish, many ebanks areworrying about the status quo because of the high risk. Some ofthem are closed, or sold, or losses. Faced with this situation, national network of ebanks and financial supervision departments have to strengthen researches and supervision ofebanking. The main purpose of this study is to discuss how risk influence the Chinese customers make decisions whether adopt ebanking and to what kind of extents, the risk influence customers adoption intention. Firstly, Base on overview basic concept, the study classifies different types of ebanking risk, summarizes the new risks characteristics.Secondly, the study applied Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB)model to suppose that three factors cam influence customers' adoption intention: Attitude, Subjective Norms and Perceived Behavior Control. The tesing results show that consumers'attitude and perceived behavioral control have significant influence on behavior intention, and relations are positive.Subjective norms have low influence on behavior intention.

articleTitle: Research on Yield Risk Analysis and Management Control of Power Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyses the main reasons of yield risks, combined with the tariff recovery problems and the particularity of electricity market in power enterprises. Relative measures and methods are proposed to lower yield risks according to the analysis results. Besides, a yield risk management control evaluation system is established combined with Risk Control Theory. The management control measures and evaluation system proposed in this paper have a certain reference to reduce yield risks and to improve risk management control standard of power enterprises.

articleTitle: Application of ESB on Telematics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Telematics provides customers with vehicle diagnosis, remote control, the road, as well as all kinds of information, entertainment, and other functions. Telematics integrated by numerous systems, and for peripheral system management, especially CP/SP management has become the key of the Telematics System. This paper introduced the ESB Telematics system, and gives the ESB technical structure scheme, solves the current problems. The scheme can support the future development, expansion of Telematics system.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on CSI 300 Index Futures Hedging
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper takes CSI 300 index futures as the research object, bases on actual market data, it calculates the optimal hedge ratio with VAR model, VECM model and GARCH model, analyses the hedging effectiveness, gets some corresponding results, and puts forward some recommendations for investors.

articleTitle: The Optimum Model and Case Analysis for Working Station Installation in Clothing Assembly Line
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the quickly changed trends of fashion and the shortened clothing product cycle, clothing enterprises often face the situation of urgent delivery period and heavy task. In order to meet the delivery period and business efficiency, enterprises must arrange for clothing production reasonably.
