Based on the actual constraints of clothing production, the paper set up the minimum number and the balance time of working station as the objectives, establishing the optimum model for working station in clothing assembly line, simply analysis the practical application of the model through a case application, and offering the reference for actual product arrangement. Combined with the model and computer-aided program, the efficiency of the production preparation can be greatly improved and simplified.

articleTitle: Audience Distribution, Logistics and the Information Dissemination Boundary: Newspaper Valid Issuance as an Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Taking newspaper Valid Issuance as an example, A theoretical model, Regarding the spatial distribution of the audience and Logistics, with "cost - benefit" decision for the constraints, has been built to analysis the information dissemination Boundary. The boundary is exactly existed. Newspapers Valid Issuance boundary can be determined in accordance with its goal of positioning.

articleTitle: International Experience for SME Credit Risks Identification: Based on Monitoring-Cashflow Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Information opacity of small and middle enterprises (SMEs) always leads to great difficulty to identify their credit risk for commercial banks. With the help of combining the results of overseas research, our study introduces the SME credit risks identification technology based on the method for monitoring their cash flow, which takes advantage of banking accounts information. This method contributes a lot to relieving the difficulties of SME financing and banks' credit identification, which is more accurate and cost not that much. We come to the conclusion that commercial banks has effective access to monitoring cash flow situation, such as information from bank accounts or other financial products, to identify the SMEs' credit risk, and finally propose the specifics and approaches that recognize SME credit risks based on monitoring cash flows.

articleTitle: Stratified Activity-Based Budget
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article proposed the stratified activity-based budget with the reference to the organizational structure, and based on the job centre, designed the stratified activity-based budgeting procedures; and derived the activity-based stratified resource demand computing model and the stratified activity-based budget costing econometric model; through case studies on the above analysis, the conclusions were verified. The information provided by the stratified activity-based budget, could be used as a basis for control in advance, and ex-post evaluation standards, and also for the matter of control. Particularly the easy-measurement characteristic of the non-financial information, which enhances cost control's timeliness, effectiveness.

articleTitle: Algorithm Optimization of the Project Internal Rate of Return Based on the Dichotomy and Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Internal rate of return is an important indicator to evaluate the financial profitability and feasibility of the project. Currently, the prevailing algorithm is to use linear interpolation to approximate its value, but it will take large amount of calculation and low accuracy. Therefore, the article introduces the dichotomy to achieve fast convergence of estimated range and further completes the final operation with the computer technology programming. The actual shows that internal rate of return calculation based on dichotomy and computer technology is simple, effective, and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on the Basic Process and Form of Consultation Service System for Human-Machine Interaction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research tries to search and establish a customer-oriented process and form of consultation service system for human-machine interaction according to the induction of service process and relevant constituents. Basic form of consulting service system design is studied on the planning and designing sketch of consultation system based on the service system relevant elements.

articleTitle: New Rural Old-Age Pension Program, Liquidity Constraints and Human Capital Investment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The new rural old-age pension program is a mixed one. It can relax liquidity constraints through pension income, and strengthen liquidity constraints through pension fee at the same time. Its impact on liquidity constraints and hence on human capital investment is uncertain. This paper constructs a basic two-period household model to analyze human capital investment with or without liquidity constraints. When there are not liquidity constraints, the pension program has no impact on human capital investment. And when there are liquidity constraints, the impact of the new pension program depends on comparison between decreasing return of human capital investment and cross derivative of pension income on the first-period consumption and pension fee. Under perfect credit constraints, households will not participate in the program if return to investment in human capital is high enough. This leads to the vicious reversal financial subsidies to those relatively well-off households, which have no credit constraints and are willing to participate. One way to overcome this effect is to allow for late pension payments for poor rural households, but with an interest rate higher than market interest rate.

articleTitle: The Empirical Research on Relationship between Critical Thinking Disposition and Transformational Leadership
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Correlative researches between critical thinking disposition and transformational leadership are very scarce. The paper mainly adopted empirical study method and analyses 396 managers' condition of critical thinking disposition and transformational leadership. It also inspected differences of personal background variables and investigates differences of critical thinking disposition dimension level influence on transformational leadership. The research found that managers' critical thinking disposition would have differences in terms of gender, age, marriage, education, years of working, position and unit properties. Managers' transformational leadership would have differences in terms of gender, age, marriage, years of working, position and unit properties, but it wouldn't have obvious differences in terms of education. The whole critical thinking disposition has significantly positive correlation with the whole transformational leadership, so did three dimensions of critical thinking disposition and transformational leadership.

articleTitle: Grey Relevancy Analysis on the Configuration Optimization of Scientific and Technological Funding Input for Fujian Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of the scientific and technologic statistical data of Fujian province from 2001 to 2008, the present situation of scientific and technological funding input was comprehensively analyzed, then the optimization and configuration of scientific and technological funding input was studied by Analytic Hierarchy Process and Grey System Theory. The result shows that the grey relevancy of funding input and output was the maximum for research institute in different activity subjects, and was the maximum for fundamental research in different activity types. So we should optimize the funding input configuration in these two aspects to get the larger output.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Sustainable Development Level of the Marine Fishery in Shandong Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Surplus production model is used in estimating maximum sustainable yield and optimum catch per unit effort of marine fishery in Shandong province. The result indicates that Shandong marine fishery resources are facing with severe situation, in order to achieve the sustainable development, Shandong province should strengthen management of marine fishing, protect the marine environment, and establish healthy marine aquaculture systems and so on.

articleTitle: The Countermeasure and Suggestion of the Cultivation and Development of the Contemporary Ningbo Businessmen's Entrepreneurship and Innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article analyzes the heritage of the Ningbo Group's spirit and the Ningbo businessmen's rising up. It points out the difference of entrepreneurship and innovation between the contemporary Ningbo businessmen and the other business groups; going by the successful experiences of other business groups' entrepreneurship and innovation; combining with the practical situations of the contemporary Ningbo businessmen's growth environment and growing up that in order to make some suggestions to strengthen the development and cultivation of the entrepreneurship and innovation.

articleTitle: Consumer Behavior, Expectation and Retail Sales in Service Economy: Based on Household Survey Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retail Sales sector is the most important business in service economy, and also plays an essential role in consumer-driven economy. Consumer behavior and expectation is the key factor to retail sales fluctuations, which have big impacts on spending and consuming decisions on the current and future basis. We construct a consistent Consumer Pricing Behavior Composite Index and Consumer Expectation Index to compare with Retail Sales fluctuation patterns. We also conclude that with appropriate methodology and underlying survey, consumer behavior and expectation could be a useful proxy to predict retail sales growth.

articleTitle: Board Characteristics and Accounting Information Quality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study empirically investigates the relationship between board characteristics and accounting information quality based on a sample of 153 firms listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange main board for the financial year ending in December 31, 2008. Accounting information quality is measured by information disclosure appraisal result released by Shenzhen Stock Exchange. The results suggest that firms are more likely to release high quality accounting information when boards include more independent directors. The results also indicate that firms with less board meeting frequency or higher compensation of directors are more likely to release high quality accounting information.

articleTitle: A Study on the Connotation of Brand Culture and the Updated Advantages of Developing Brand Culture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Brand culture is the core of a brand. This paper introduces the brand culture, elements of brand culture, and the importance of the brand culture and explains the seven advantages of using brand culture to develop the market: guiding function, cohesion function, excitation function, constraint function, radiation function, promoting function and coordination function, which include the main points of the advantages to develop brand culture. Literature review is used to explore the relevant concepts and the analysis of the concepts leads to a new finding of the updated explanations of the advantages to develop brand culture.

articleTitle: Study on Teaching Outsourcing Strategy in Distance Education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, outsourcing strategy which originated from business areas was transplanted to teaching in distance education, the feasibility of outsourcing, advantages, risk, strategy-making process, management of part-time teachers and external security measures in distance education was researched, a new Distance Education model was explored.

articleTitle: The Integrated Application of Improved Methods on the Chaos Identification in Microcosmic Simulation Traffic Flow
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is important for more effective traffic management and control to study on identification of chaos in traffic flow. For requirements of real-time traffic control, the number of samples for time series of traffic flows and the speed of identification are restricted so that the traditional methods can not be applied. The improved small-data method is combined with the improved surrogate-data technique to identify chaos in traffic flow. This approach not only has each advantage, but also avoids some disadvantage. With traffic flow simulation software, some problems can be researched easily and systematically. Thus, the time series of microcosmic simulation traffic flow are used to analyze and validate this approach to identify chaos in traffic flow. Its results are compared with those of the power spectrum method. The results indicate that this method can identify chaos in traffic flow exactly and can be used in real-time.

articleTitle: Measurement of Chinese Enterprises' Social Insurance Financial Burden
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Enterprises were the main finance provider of social insurance system. It was important for government to measure social insurance financial burden precisely. This paper designed an index named "enterprise's social insurance premium burden rate" based on enterprise's balance sheet and made an empirical study based on 842 A share listed companies in Shanghai stock exchange. Result showed that enterprises' social insurance premium burden rate was lower than the sum of social insurance legal premium rate evidently. The social insurance premium financial burden level of enterprises in various regions was unbalanced.

articleTitle: The Operating Mechanism and Supporting Platform for CI of SME Strategic Alliance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we firstly analyzed the importance of strategic alliance and competitive intelligence (CI) to small and medium sized enterprises (SMEs). Then we discussed the operating mechanism and of SME strategic alliance CI. Finally, we designed the architecture of SME alliance-oriented CI platform using Agents technology.

articleTitle: The Effects of Trainee Characteristics on Transfer of Training in Pre-Training Stage
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There have been many literature and studies confirming the effects of trainee characteristics on transfer of training during post-training stage. On the contrary, there are relatively fewer studies on factors having expected influences on transfer of training. This study adopts Holton's Learning Transfer System Inventory (LTSI) to analyze trainee characteristics during pre-training stage. There are totally 181 valid samples. This study applies regression analysis and factor analysis to examine the characteristics. The results show the characteristics have positive effects on Transfer Effort-Performance Expectations. Among the four factors, Learner Readiness and Motivation to Transfer have the most significant effects. The results of this study can serve as requisites for training practitioners to enhance trainee characteristics prior to training.

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Capability Management Model of Industrial Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the aim of avoiding negative impacts generated by traditional qualitative management model, the model on emergency capability is suggested to be transformed to a quantitative management model. Based on emergency capability quantification, Quality Function Deployment is applied to establish a quantitative model on emergency capability. With "data-based" management concept, this paper establishes a quantitative management model on emergency capability.

articleTitle: Modern Logistics of Port: Concept Interpretation, Efficiency Measurement and Appraisal as Well as Enhancement Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In combination with the current situation and development trend of port logistics of Ningbo-Zhoushan Port, this paper discussed the basic concept as well as efficiency measurement and appraisal of modern logistics of port and came up with efficiency enhancement countermeasures on this basis.

articleTitle: Teaching Quality Measurement for XAUT's MBA Program
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Instructors play a crucial role in MBA education quality, where they act as key organizers for teaching activities and disseminators of knowledge and skill. This study seeks to measure MBA teaching quality for Xi'an University of Technology (XAUT) and suggesting countermeasures for improving training performance. The paper reviews and reflects research dynamics in relation to MBA teaching measurement. This paper establishes a model of factors covering target, criterion, and sub-criterion layers to rate instructing quality. We find that teaching quality at AXUT is uncertain, mainly embodied in dissatisfactory educational solicitude, a shortage of human spirit and communication, poorly establishing instructor-student relationships and weakly nurturing students' practical skills and techniques. XAUT should improve instructors' educational level, practical experience and academic performance as well as increasing knowledge of liberal arts such as pedagogy and psychology. The paper proposes that XAUT should take the form of college-enterprise or Sino-foreign cooperation in MBA program.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Network Properties of Beijing Underground Transport System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the capital of China, Beijing subway got high-speed development. In the paper, we present the empirical study on the urban subway of Beijing. The empirical results show that the urban subway network has high clustering coefficient and small character path length, which exhibits small-world behavior, and the degree distributions take power function forms. Furthermore, we also have studied the fractal scaling of this network from different times and find that the subway network exhibits the property of fractal scaling networks.

articleTitle: Regional Specialization, Transportation and Spatial Change of China's Wheat Processing Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the 21st century, China's wheat processing industry has been growing drastically, spatial structural has been changing considerably. The characteristics of the location, movement of wheat processing sector are summaried in this paper. Empirical models are developed and estimated to identify economic determinants of wheat processing establishment growth between 2000 and 2009. Raw materials production, market accession and Seaport are the key factors determining spatial structure of China's wheat processing industry between 2000 and 2009. The ability of to attract wheat processor to create local employment opportunities and market outlet for farmers varies considerably across provinces.

articleTitle: Research on CUG-HBSC Base of Business Administration Practical Teaching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is easy to understand that practical teaching as a necessary part of creative professionals nurture in universities. We offer an analysis on the CUG-HBSC Base of practical teaching, and of the problems that must be solved in this practice. We do so in hope of deepening our understanding of practical teaching and improving our appreciation of the demands that adventurous instruction makes on practitioners. A number of the barriers listed in this report result from consciousness errors, lack of coordination, and from imperfect incentive mechanism and quality supervisory system. Pay more attention to these issues would greatly improve sector performance.

articleTitle: Internal Control Information Quality Framework: Based on the Investors' Information Demand
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of internal control information disclosure theory and practices is all closely related with the internal control information demand of users. Since the investors have the significant impact on internal controls, the investors' internal control information demand should be given more attention. Therefore, this paper firstly puts forward the internal control information quality objectives, namely resource allocation decision usefulness and accountability. Then we discuss the internal control information quality characteristics, which include two basic characteristics: reliability and relevance, two important features: comparability and understandability. Finally, we puts foreword an indicators system of internal control information quality.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis on Coal Enterprise Behavior Patterns Based on the Safety and Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction Investment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As for coal enterprise, whether it should maximize profit, or maximize sales for the target that more beneficial to development of coal enterprise and coal industry, which is always a study problem in economy circles. Economics theory is applied in this thesis, infer that coal enterprise' target profit of seeking sales maximization is lower than maximal possibility profit, and more Safety -Energy Conservation and Cut-downing Blowoff Invests than that seeks profit Maximization, which is advantageous for improve safety level for coal enterprise. While safety fixed cost increases, coal enterprise' coal price and coal output are invariable for that seeks profit maximization, but others enterprise that seeks sales maximization will cut down output and improve coal price. For that sales maximization, which will improve coal price, cut down coal output, after increasing safety invests. At last, the thesis bring forward that government ought to guide coal enterprise manage seeking sales maximization, but be no profit maximization, thereby government should formulate the coal enterprise' Safety -Energy Conservation and Cut-downing Blowoff policy according to coal enterprise target, that is beneficial to coal enterprise' increases Safety -Energy Conservation and Cut-downing Blowoff Invests, at the same time, which is beneficial to controlling coal output and price , beneficial to health develops for our country coal industry.

articleTitle: Policy Options of Promoting Integrated Urban and Suburban Passenger Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The CCP Central Committee Decision on Several Issues Related to Promoting Reform and Development for Suburban Areas, passed by the 17th National CCP Congress, stated that China has entered a new and dynamic era in which the development of agriculture is driven by industrial advancement, that is to say suburban areas are led by urban areas, intertwining the two and forcing an increasingly greater need for the integration of urban and suburban social economic development in tandem. During this process, it is important to further unify urban and suburban social economic development, and promote equitable public services to all individuals. In regards to the development of public service and general living quality in suburban areas, road construction should be enhanced in order to ensure the use of asphalt concrete roads leading to villages and towns by the end of the 11th Five-year Plan. Coupled with this form of road development, public transport services connecting the suburban areas to urban ones will be monumental in the establishment of an integrated, national passenger transport network. The development of urban and suburban passenger transport has been separated for a long time, noted particularly by deficient coordination. More and more conflicts arise from the development of both areas separately. Thus accomplishing the integration of urban and suburban passenger transport is an effective way to settle these conflicts. It complies with the strategy of a centralized government for the transport industry, and is a significant move toward promoting the construction of the New Socialist Countryside. The central government has determined to form the new Ministry of Transport in order to dedicate planning, construction and administration of passenger and freight transport in both urban and suburban areas in March, 2008. The Leading Party Members' Team of MOT brought out the initiatives on integrating urban and suburban public transport resources in October, 2008. It aims to achieve a speedy, safe, and streamlined green passenger transport network, improve public transport service levels, ensure an efficient movement of production elements between urban and suburban areas through enhanced coordination, and benefit all individuals by such transport development.

articleTitle: Application of Autocad Graphics Function
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the analysis of structure of DXF graphics exchange files of AutoCAD, this essay introduces the method of extracting graphics information from DXF files and automatically converting into machining program of NC laser cutting, and the interface software designed by using this method.

articleTitle: Reviewing the Barrier Factors of Team Creativity - From the Team Level
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper analyzes these factors from the team level; it includes the atmosphere of cooperation and communication, innovative leadership art, innovatively incentive policy, external characteristic of team members, internal aspects of social network connection. Then it summarizes the barrier factors of team creativity and puts forward the prospect of future research.

articleTitle: Impact of Knowledge Integration on Independent Innovation in Software Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Successful independent innovation depends on the ability to integrate external and internal knowledge. The purpose of this study is to verify the relationship between knowledge integration and independent innovation performance in software industry. Therefore, 132 projects of software industry are chosen as research samples. A theory model is constructed based on literature review, and independent innovation performance is measured with product innovation and process innovation. The statistic results show that external knowledge integration, internal knowledge integration, intensity of user involvement, project knowledge base are significant positive correlation with the product innovation performance, and internal knowledge integration, project knowledge base are significant positive correlation with the process innovation performance. Meanwhile, project knowledge base is acting a moderator between internal knowledge integration and the process innovation performance

articleTitle: Cooperation between the Manufacturer and the Retailer in Dual-Channel Based on Free Riding Behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce and the adoption of dual channels, conflict and governance for dual channel is the focused problem. In this paper, we use a game theory approach to investigate this issue; and we explore the manufacturer and the retailer integrate the delivery channel to coordinate channel conflict to realize win-win. We examine how the market share and the relative intensity of the price competition to impact cooperation and implement mechanisms.

articleTitle: The SWOT Analysis and Strategy of Brand Competitiveness about Binhai New Area
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the important growth point of China's economy in the future, the Tianjin Binhai New Area bears the tough task of China's economy development in the 21st century. Developing new brands and enhancing regional brand competitiveness is the inevitable choice. Based on the analysis of the definition of city brand competitiveness and the present situation of Binhai New Area about brand competitiveness, this article puts forward countermeasures to improve brand competitiveness of Binhai New Area.

articleTitle: The Research on Consumer's Attitude to Green Ad Appeal Strategy - The Empirical Study from the Perspective of Attribution Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Previous studies suggested that 95% of Chinese consumers had come across green advertisements and they reacted well to those ads. This paper based on attribution theory investigates the effect of green ad appeal strategy (ad types and green appeal strength) to consumer's attribution and attitude by the format of 2*2 experimental designs. The consequence indicates that consumer's attribution can load on two independent factors, altruistic and self-serving motives. Secondly, the ad type has no effects on consumer's attribution but has effects on consumer's attitude. Thirdly, strong green appeal will generate consumer's altruistic attribution and more favorable attitude. Besides, consumer's attribution has positive relationship with consumer's attitude.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on the International Competitiveness of the Service Trade in China, Russia and Mongolia
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, the trade in services between Mongolia, Russia and China has some increase but the progress is very slow compared with the trade in goods among them. In order to figure out the problem, the paper applied the Grey Relational theory to analyze the international competitiveness of the service trade in China, Russia and Mongolia respectively and found the strengths and weaknesses of each country and the factors that affect the service trade competitiveness among them. Through the comparative analysis, the paper discovered that the FDI plays the most important role in the service trade and the investment in R&D and the number of personnel in the R&D is also a major factor that affects the international competitiveness. Finally, the paper put forward some advice on upgrading the service trade among these three countries.

articleTitle: Research on the Credit Guarantee of SMEs
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article puts forward the third-party guarantee mechanism model with uncertain information. And proved in incomplete information conditions, Guarantee agencies charge premium and reverse collateral will change the profit function and reduce the income of SMEs. It makes partial lower risk SMEs who cannot provide counter-guaranty exit the credit-guarantee market, resulting in the appearance of credit guarantee paradox. The government financing subsidies will effectively relieve SMEs' credit risk. Through the scale amplification effect of loan guarantees, it improved the incomes of bank and guarantee agencies.

articleTitle: Economic Effects of Carbon-Tariff Barrier
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the global climate warming, people are more concerned about climate issues, so that carbon-tariff barrier, as a new green trade barrier, become the forefront of research in the field of trade issues. In this paper, the economic effects of carbon tariff barrier, including the effects of exporting country, importing country, international trade commodity structure were analyzed. By the analysis, we can conclude that the implementation of carbon-tariff barrier will bring adverse influence on both exporter and importer

articleTitle: Classifying and Applying Study on Personnel's Ability Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Brain information processing is a movement process, and its movement characteristics directly control the behavior and action traits of human being. Firstly, the article introduces a kind of method that revealing brain information processing characteristics by the continuous numerical comparing based on computer. Secondly, ability feature on movement characteristics of brain information processing is defined. And then the "common" approach is presented that is used to gain the classes. Lastly, through analyzing the personnel's detection results in a computer company, the article studies personnel ability characteristics' distribution and offers reference data for human resource management. The classifying method has very important academic significance to the study of different individual's ability characteristics. And indexes on features on movement characteristics of brain information processing have the value of practical application to personnel selection and management, mentality health diagnosis and consult.

articleTitle: The Cases and the Mechanism Analysis on Different Development of Service Outsourcing Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China's service outsourcing has become a national distribution, but it isn't so distinctive in each region. The implementation of different development strategy aims to seize the opportunity of international industrial transition. In this way, it will be able to accelerate the step of international service outsourcing to avoid the development of strategic convergence or lower-level formatting among them, and it will be realized the coordinated development of benign competition of the service outsourcing. This paper states the mechanism of service outsourcing's different development, the cases of service outsourcing, and countermeasures for Chinese enterprises to undertake international service outsourcing.

articleTitle: Literature Review and Comment on Entrepreneurial Behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the survival and development process of enterprises, entrepreneurial behavior plays an important role. In view of this, according to the idea which is from inside to outside, the research reviews the literatures of entrepreneurial behaviors, and points out limitations of the previous researches. In the end, we figure out the future research directions.

articleTitle: Integration Model and Approach to Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The complexity of today's business environment has made it necessary for organizations to evaluate all the alternatives before committing your resources to an improvement process and high quality. This paper first analyzes and compares the differences among ISO 9000 series standards, Total Quality Management (TQM) and Six Sigma. Then we combine them into an integrating quality management model. After that we systematically analyze the key factors and relationships among them. And finally, the steps of implementing the integrating quality management approach are provided.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation for Industry Economic Power of Mining Cities Based on Nonlinear Mathematical Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Taking a Chinese north mining city as an example, through to systematic investigation and statistics for its economic data of 12 industry in recent 4 years, A complete set of index system for estimating economy status has been put forward, which comprises the profitability, debt paying ability and development foreground of difference industry. The author has developed a set of fuzzy neural network software system based on the nonlinear mathematical model. These software systems manage initial data through Access's data-base technology, and calculate subordination degree of assessment indices by fuzzy mathematics, as well as achieve industry economy status by virtue of artificial neural network which has been successfully trained. Result demonstration: The synthetic economy condition for the thermoelectricity production supply industry and the non-ferrous metal processing industry is "best" in 2006,the cement manufacturing industry and the coal selection industry is "better", but the transport vehicle manufacturing industry, the textile industry and the diet tobacco manufacturing industry's is relatively "bad". This appraisal achievement may provide reliable auxiliary decision-making for the bank credit.

articleTitle: Management of Zone of Tolerance Based on Weber-Fechner's Law
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer's service expectations are a range of services between desired service and adequate service. Zone of tolerance between desired service and adequate service can either be reduced or be expanded for a customer. Therefore, marketers must not only understand the size of the area and boundaries of zone of tolerance, but also know when and how changes of the zone of tolerance for a given customer. In this paper three problems are studied: when do customers tend to reduce the impact of the negative service quality? When do customers tend to enlarge the impact? When do customers tend to filter the negative impact?

articleTitle: A Study on Determining Marketing Strategies for E-Business
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Marketing Mix (4Ps) is a traditional marketing theory which stresses the mixing of a variety of factors in marketing strategies. Today, with online purchasing gaining its popularity, some factors in 4Ps strategies should be changed to meet the demand of this new business style. This article, based on research results from China's undergraduates, explores 4Ps strategies that company may adopt when sell their products online.

articleTitle: Research on the Governance Role of Institutional Investors in Listed Companies Based on Panel Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The expropriation of minority shareholders by controlling shareholders is the central agency problem in listed Chinese companies. There has been an explosive development of institutional investors in China recent years but the governance role of institutional shareholders is controversial. This paper investigated the role of institutional shareholders in mitigating agency problem by testing the impact of mutual funds' ownership on firm performance, using a sample for the period of 2004-2006. We find that equity ownership by mutual funds have positive effects on firm performance. The result is robust to two mainly measures of firm performance. Our finding suggests that institutional investors play a beneficial role in corporate governance and eventually sustainable development of listed companies.

articleTitle: Using Hidden Markov Switching-Mixed Normal Distribution Model to Study the Distribution of Chinese Stock Index Returns
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Understanding the distribution of financial asset returns is critical for investment and risk management. The traditional assumption of normal distribution does not well describe the skewness and kurtosis of log returns. Most of the currently proposed return distribution models lack the capability to allow time-varying distribution. Thus in this paper, we introduce Markov switching structure into the distribution of Chinese stock index returns, propose the hidden Markov switching-mixed normal distribution(HMS-MND) model, and give the Expectation-Maximization(EM) algorithm for model parameter estimation. The log daily and weekly returns on the major stock indexes of Shanghai stock exchange are used for empirical tests. Parameter estimates as well as likelihood ratio test results show that, the introduction of Markov switching structure could significantly improve the model's fitting capability. It is also shown that HMS-MND model could well describe the statistics of stock index log returns. Therefore, we argue that using hidden Markov switching-mixed normal distribution model to study the distribution of Chinese stock index returns is of practical value.

articleTitle: Transformation of Foreign Trade Growth Mode and Establishment of Harmonious Trade Relations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After China's entry into the World Trade Organization, there are more foreign trade growth opportunities for China. However the traditional foreign trade growth mode with labor-based comparative advantage brings more foreign trade frictions to China and results in disharmony of the foreign trade relation. In the critical period of reform and opening-up policy of China, harmonious trade relation is necessary for China to build harmonious society and be integrated into the world economy. The key point for establishing harmonious trade relation is to transform the foreign trade growth mode and the critical aspect for transforming the foreign trade growth mode is to facilitate "Three Transformations" and improve the competitive advantage of China.

articleTitle: Study on the Affecting Factors of Service Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the affecting factors of service industry in China by using the Granger Causality test, Johansen cointegration test and impulse response function. We found that the economic growth and the increase of employment of service industry can promote the development of the service sector in China. And the growth of the service industry does have a positive effect on urbanization process of China, but we didn't get the positive and consistent result in the opposite direction.

articleTitle: The Breakthrough of Low Carbon Economy Technology Locked-In Research
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Papers from our low carbon economic and technological locked-in phenomenon, analyzed low carbon economy technology locked-in reasons. Aiming at the present situation of the development of low carbon technology proposed low carbon technologies locked-in the breakthrough point. This paper also puts forward the corresponding technology leapfrogging path and technology along-track path, then put forward the corresponding countermeasures for solving two paths.

articleTitle: Optimization Analysis on Investment in Enterprise Human Resources Training
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Human resources training is an important way to improve production efficiency of enterprise. This article based on reviewing the relevant literature of human resources training and efficiency, optimization analysis on investment of enterprise human resources training by Pontryagin's Maximum Principle. It concluded that the investment of enterprise human resources training should distinguish between core and non-core value creation department. There is an optimal allocation proportion of the stock and investment in human resources training between the two departments. The investment in human resources training could not create optimum efficiency if it is fails to reach the optimal allocation proportion. Finally, the paper pointed out that the proportion of investment in enterprise human resources training between the different departments of value creation.

articleTitle: Application Research of Visual Identity Elements in Apparel Design Based on Knowledge Visualization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After the decrease of the export of textile and garment, most powerful production enterprises in domestic with large scale are restructuring and establishing the proprietary brands. But, it is very difficult to develop the brand due to the facts such as lacking of experience in brand management, the threat from seizing the market of international brands, the homogenization of brands. However, those brands with a high degree of brand visual identity elements can be recognized by the market, and it will become the real beneficiaries. This thesis will study on the following aspects--how to satisfy the psychological craving from consumers with left a deep impression on them, establishing a good brand image as the solution to the problem, and the visual identity as an important part of the brand image. In today society, with the rapid development of the knowledge economy, those who own the knowledge and translate it into productivity through knowledge management as soon as possible can be in an invincible position in the fierce market competition. The purpose of this study is about how to apply the visual identity effectively within the enterprise. Within enterprises, we can design and research brand better through these ways such as introducing the concept of knowledge visualization to the building of brand image, guiding the garment enterprises to develop the ability about acquisition, integration, sharing and even the creation of the visual identity in management process of the design, effectively shortening the process of product development with making the consumers have the association and memory to brand trough visual identity.

articleTitle: Environmental Protection and Energy Savings in HVAC Systems from the Higrothermal and Air Quality Standpoints
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For indoor environments, thermal discomfort must be clearly distinguished from the air pollution caused by outdoor air as well as by inside polluting agents. Full air conditioning of a room requires the introduction of a minimum ventilation air flow whose characteristics depend on the expected thermal room conditions, the cooling and heating loads and the estimated concentration of pollutants. In addition, it must make possible that users carry out their activities with comfort, safety and pleasure. This research seeks to know the minimum air flow to enter the premises so that the percentage of dissatisfied people would be within certain limits. Since this air flow requires significant energy consumption, the developed method helps to preserve the environment, because it minimizes the percentage of people dissatisfied for a given energy consumption.

articleTitle: Scientific and Technological Innovation Ability: Compare among Different Forms of Ownership in Chinese Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article compares and analyzes the size, R&D intensity, R&D efficiency of Chinese enterprises with various forms of ownership. The article also analyzes the major difficulties that prevents Chinese enterprises from further Scientific and Technological innovation and suggests relevant strategies to solve the issues.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation and the Promotion Strategy of Services Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The goal of this paper is to analyze the connotation of services competitiveness the evaluation method and evaluation index system of services competitiveness, and the countermeasures and strategies for the promotion of services competitiveness. Firstly, we make an introduction of the connotation and relative research on services competitiveness. Then, we make a comparison of the evaluation method and treat factor analysis as a more suitable method. We also build the index system for the evaluation of the services competitiveness. Finally, we put forward the strategic routes and corresponding suggestions for the promotion of services competitiveness in China.

articleTitle: The Research on the Poyang Lake Eco-Compensation Mechanism Based on the beyond Property Right Stimulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper focuses on the Poyang Lake Ecological Economic Zone, and tries to discuss the design of a marketized eco-compensation mechanism in Poyang Lake, which was based on the Beyond Property Right stimulation. On the one hand, owing to the inadequate fund, the governmental compensation works ineffectively in terms of the conservation of biological resources in Poyang Lake; on the other hand, the market compensation doesn't function well for it is hard to define the property ownership. Therefore, this paper proposes to build an eco-compensation property market, directed by the governments at all levels, concentrating on the trade members or agents of eco-compensation target, which aslo can be supervised by some non-profit and non-governmental organizations. Besides, it can promote the building of a marketized eco-compensation mechanism by the introduction of a competitive and incentive mechanism of Beyond Property Right.

articleTitle: A Novel Combination Forecasting Model for GDP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Forecasting of GDP is considered using a novel combination forecasting model. Firstly, we establish a combination forecasting model based on three individual forecasts, in this model the individual forecasting errors can be updated over time. Secondly Ningxia per GDP from 1985 to 2010 is analyzed employing this novel combination forecasting, the empirical results show that combination forecast can improve forecasting performance significantly.

articleTitle: The Study of Electronic and Communication Equipment Intra-Industry Trade and Effect of Technical Progress in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the economic globalization, intra-industry trade has gown rapidly all over the world , and the intra-industry proportion of china has constantly increased. As electronic and communication equipment products play an important role in technical progress, it is vital to study the relationship between electronic and communication equipment product intra-industry and technical progress effects under the circumstance of upgrading industries of our nation. First of all, the paper ensures the concepts of IIT and measurement methods of IIT, elaborating and analyzing the development condition of electronic and communication equipment product intra-industry of china from 1995-2009. Econometrics models based on Computers and telecommunications, Electronic have established to analyze the relationship of electronic and communication equipment product intra-industry and technical progress effect. Through the empirical analysis, it can be concluded that: the electronic and communication equipment product intra-industry trade has a positive impact on technical progress, and the effect of export is more significant than import. However, as the relatively low level of electronic and communication equipment intra-industry trade of our nation, the technical progress from trade is limited, therefore China should improve IIT degrees; insist on the principles of independent innovation; imitation and absorption; expanding export and domestic demand, form the technical progress mechanism that possessing our nation's characteristics, enhance the competitiveness of products and realize the technical upgrading of industry.

articleTitle: The Research on Contextual Performance Management of the Core Employees
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is the focus of our business that how can we manage the contextual performance of the core employees which can create 80% of the profits for enterprises and effectively promote the development of the organization. From the unique contextual performance of the core employees which is different from that of the general ones some advices are proposed to manage core employees' contextual performance on the basis of analyzsing the factors that influence the contextual performance.

articleTitle: Law of Interaction between Urban System and Transport Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Interaction between urban development and transportation network is closely related. In this paper, its were elaborated that space-time non-equilibrium of the Interaction strength, its temporal succession of Interaction mode and its spiral interaction process, etc, which was the law of Interaction between Urban system and transport network and was helpful for a better understanding of the development of relations between the two. All above were to provide a reference for related research and to services the social and economic development.

articleTitle: Adverse Selection and Counteracting Mechanism in Taobao.com
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the network gets rid of the limit of space and bring up the virtual reality in the e-commerce market, adverse selection resulting from the informational asymmetry of the qualitative uncertainty is getting worse, which is restricting the useful and profitable business. Based on the data from Taobao (www.taobao.com), this paper demonstratively analyzes the characteristics of cyber adverse selection problem in e-commerce market and discuss the function of counteracting mechanism such as credit evaluation system , quality-intermediary and reputation. Finally, this paper offers some strategic thought for eliminating the cyber adverse selection problem.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors on Rural Surplus Labor Transfer in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the basic characteristics of Chinese labor market segmentation, the paper put the Export Trade of private sector into Ranis-Fei model and makes inspection utilizing the sectional data from 2007. Empirical results show: the private sector to absorb surplus labor capacity depends not only on private sector capital accumulation, innovation and creative use of labor intensity and bias, and expenditure of labor unemployment insurance funds also play a decisive role in the transfer of labor.

articleTitle: Discriminance of the Possibility of Debris-Flow Blocked the Main River by Grey Correlation Degree - A Case Study on the Upper Reaches of the Min River
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Intensity and range of damage caused by debris-flow which blocks up river are much larger than debris-flow which doesn't block up river, study of this type of debris-flow may provide reference for evaluation, region partition of degree of risk, prevention and cure and etc of debris-flow disaster, and possesses important significance in practice of disaster mitigation and prevention. Grey correlation degree analysis, a potent tool for disposal of uncertain system of small sample or poor information, is applied to analyze possibility of river block by debris-flow in this paper, and four debris-flow ravines of river-block type, each two debris-flow ravines of block type and non-block type at upper reaches of the Min River are selected as sample. A typical debris-flow ravine of river-block type is selected with its characteristic parameter as canonical sequence, degree of association between characteristic parameter and canonical sequence of other sample of debris-flow ravine is calculated. The result manifests basically that the higher degree of river block by debris-flow ravine, the more grey correlation degree with canonical sequence, therefore possibility of river block by debris-flow can be analyzed by grey correlation degree.

articleTitle: Intelligent Management Model Research in Enterprise CIMS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: CIMS (Computer Integrated Manufacture System) is a unified system that the production process control, production management and intelligent decision are composed. It is used to improve the economic benefit of enterprise, realize flexible production, adapt to market changes. Therefore, intelligent management of CIMS plays an important influence. This paper has analyzed the functional structure of enterprise CIMS, established the hardware and software model of the intelligent management in CIMS, provided the useful help to better develop the CIMS for the enterprise.

articleTitle: Locality Sensitive Hashing Based Service Classification
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Technology of Web Service Classification can be widely used in the area of service applications. With the rapid growth of services, service classification turn to work in a poor performance. In this paper, we propose an efficient algorithm based on Locality Sensitive Hashing (LSH) to solve the service classification problem. This method is capable of high dimensional service classification as well. It is introduced that how to convert WSDL to vectors based on VSM. Then services are classified using LSH. We evaluate our approach and KNN method through experiment on different datasets. Two standards precision and recall are adopted to check the quality of service classification. The experiments have shown that our algorithm has a high performance and works stably.

articleTitle: Incentive Mechanism and Countermeasures Research on Knowledge Sharing among Knowledge Alliance Members
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Recent years, there are more and more organizations choose to join knowledge alliance to acquire knowledge that they needed. Based on the description and analysis of knowledge sharing among knowledge alliance, established the expected profit function of the core members and other relevant organizations, then transforms the symmetric and asymmetric information to the optimization model, finally discussed the design of incentive mechanisms through the model solution, and put forward some suggestions based on the findings.

articleTitle: Theoretical Study on the Relationship between Technology Standardization and China Economy Growth
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Technology standard not only can accumulate continually itself as a production factor but also can bring far-reaching effect on Chinese new round economy growth due to its dual nature of technique and system. Based on the technology standardization, this paper discusses its accelerative effect on Chinese economy growth according to the present economist's consensus of determined factors of economy growth and the practice of Chinese economy growth. Finally, the technology standardization strategy is raised to a new height; the technology standard innovation is regarded as the tiptop form of the independent innovation.

articleTitle: The Customer Satisfaction Assessment Research of YTO Express Wuchang Branch
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the customer satisfaction theory and previous research, this paper has carried out research on the customer satisfaction of Yuantong Express Wuchang Branch(YEWB) from micro-level perspective; constructed the customer satisfaction assessment model and used questionnaire survey combined with analytical hierarchy process to carry out customer satisfaction calculation as well as propose improvement suggestions and methods on the basis of customer satisfaction status.

articleTitle: Calculation of Contribution in Advanced Manufacturing and Key Choice for Development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper measures and analyzes the contribution of advanced manufacturing to the growth of high-tech industry and the contributions of the internal industries in advanced manufacturing during 2005-2008 in Hebei Province using mathematic model. According to the calculated results, it points out the status of the advanced manufacturing to develop high-tech industry of Hebei province, in which eight industries are divided into three categories: key developed, accelerating developed and accelerating reformed. The subdivided industries are also divided like this. These are important references to formulate scientific development strategies of advanced manufacturing for the relevant departments.

articleTitle: The Impacts of Modern Logistics on Shandong Foreign Trade
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since China's economic reform and opening-up, the foreign trade of Shandong has been developing rapidly The study is to analyze the role in promoting foreign trade of Shandong based on the factor of logistics including port throughput, total amounts of imports and exports and other relevant data. Using co-integration theory and Granger causality test methods, the author empirically analyzes the relationship between foreign trade and modern logistics of Shandong. In conclusion, some applicable measures for developing modern logistics and promoting foreign trade of Shandong are proposed.

articleTitle: The Reasons and Countermeasures of Lacking Discourse Power of China in International Iron Ore Price Negotiations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper first analyzes the disadvantaged position where China is situated in the international iron ore trade negotiations, and then probe into the reasons resulting in the lack of iron ore pricing right from six points of view. Lastly based on analysis above, the paper addresses five suggestions to win over discourse power in international iron ore negotiations.

articleTitle: Bank-Based versus Market-Based Financial Systems: Effect on Financial Markets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This essay discusses the differences between the bank-based and market-based financial systems. The comparison between these two systems implicates the merits and shortcomings of each type in conjunction with the application of the competing theories of financial structure. The paper indicates that it is less advisable to distinguish which type of financial system is better than focus on the optimization of managerial efficiency and the impacts on financial markets under the distinct financial circumstances.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy AHP Approach for Prioritizing Indicators and Sub-Indicators for Greenhouse Locating
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The greenhouse locating has become one of the most important problems for investors; it is a complicated problem and a decision under a variety of factors. This study aims at prioritize indicators and sub-indicators that effective in greenhouse locating. Analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is applied to formulate and prioritize the indicators and sub-indicators, most of the indicators are basically qualitative. Using fuzzy set theory we incorporate qualitative and partially known information into the decision model. A fuzzy approach is integrated with AHP method to make up the vagueness about the degree of importance of decision-makers on judgment.

articleTitle: The Predictive Analysis of the Comprehensive Value of New District Housing Projects
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, China's urbanization is in a stage of rapid development, resulting in the existing "single-core" urban spatial structure has been unable to meet the requirements of the dense population and various economic and social activities in the cities. Therefore, to alleviate population pressure in urban centers, many new districts have been gradually risen around some big cities, and these cities gradually formed a "double-core", or" multi-core" urban structure. The development of residential projects which related to the housing problem of the new urban residents, become an important development project in the building new districts. And as a real estate development business, how to seize the favorable opportunities for developing new districts, and through the development and construction of residential projects, get high profits, become a hot research issue by many real estate companies. In this paper, using the residential project of new districts in Harbin City, through researching and studying 20 residential projects of new districts in this city, analyzing and summarizing the important factors which affect the value of the residential project in the new district, and establishing a model to predict the comprehensive value of the residential projects in new district, which will provide an effective basis for the real estate business when they make the investment decision for the development of residential projects in the future.

articleTitle: Business Model Research of Chinese Groupon Development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This thesis analyzes groupons which are springing up in China and their growing trend according to the Chinese groupon market research report. Through the contrast of corresponding domestic and foreign situation, The article will find a new business model adapting to China's domestic market. Finally, a development strategy of groupon will be put forward.

articleTitle: Structural Equation Model for Influencing Factors on Basic Old-Age Pension Level
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The treatment level cannot the only index to evaluate basic old-age pension development. So it demands an integrated evaluation index system. The paper established structural equation model for basic old-age pension level based on the analysis of pension level influencing factors. The conclusion is that economic foundation has a positive effect on system design factors and the degree is 0.85; the relationship between economic foundation and population structure is correlativity and the related coefficient is 0.76; population structure has a negative effect on system design factors and the degree is 0.646. Therefore, the structural equation model can effectively analyze the influencing factors on basic old-age pension level.

articleTitle: Education and Teaching of Accountancy Ethics in Universities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The quality of accounting information, which is vital to the modern economy, is directly related to the accountants' ethics. However, the importance of the accountancy ethics education is neglected by the universities in China. This study is to research the situation and the improvement approaches of the ethics education in terms of the curriculum provision, course content, the teaching methods, the evaluation mechanism and the teaching process, to ensure the quality of accounting information ultimately.

articleTitle: Internet-Mediated Participation in Public Policy Setting and Its Effect
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on statement on that internet, as a rising public sphere, provides a new platform for political participation; this paper presents the great significance of internet-mediated political participation to the democratization in public policy setting in China. Due to such existing defects as irrational, non-normative participation and all public wills represented by public opinions in the internet in internet-mediated political participation, in order to guarantee the effective development of internet-mediated political participation and its healthy and orderly promotion, Government needs to guide the public opinion in internet-mediated political participation, perfect the channels where internet-mediated political participation influences policy setting, and assure the authenticity and reasonability of internet-mediated opinions to make rational decisions.

articleTitle: Promotion in the Israeli High-Tech Industry: Managers' and Workers' Perceptions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study focuses on the promotion process in the Israeli high-tech industry from the point of view of workers and managers. A questionnaire containing series of factors related to promotion (education, tenure in the organization, professional experience, success in projects/ missions, politics, multi-disciplinary professional knowledge, pressure on the supervisor, age, gender and luck), was conducted to 131employees in an international high-tech corporation's subsidiary located in Israel. Some of our findings were to be expected in the high-tech company examined, but others were surprising. The findings reveal significant differences between workers and managers in seven of the ten factors influencing promotion. Workers and managers agreed that the most important factor influencing promotion was success in projects. While workers and managers gave similar rankings for the most and least important factors influencing promotions, there were substantial differences in the ranking of the other factors. Among managers, education and multi-disciplinary knowledge were ranked second and third, whereas among workers, politics and pressure on the supervisor were ranked second and third. The meaning of the findings and their implications for human resources management (HRM) and organizational performance are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Foreign Direct Investment and China's Service Economy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The service economy is an essential part of China's economy. To a certain extent, China is export-oriented now and actively court foreign direct investment (FDI) to advance its economic development. This paper describes the current situation that China's service economy takes advantage of FDI, analyses the challenges and opportunities that China's service economy will meet when it makes use of FDI in the context of financial crisis, and proposes the corresponding policy for China's service economy FDI (SFDI). China should stimulate the demand for services, expand service market openness, attach great importance to personnel training and the upgrading of service economy, and advocate attaching equal importance to development and environmental protection.

articleTitle: The Regional Road Traffic Flow Forecast Based on Collection and Distribution of Port
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of port logistics, container throughput has been improving gradually, the conflicts between collection and distribution system of port and regional road traffic have been deepening. According to the case of Huangpu port of Guangzhou, the study proposes a conversion model between port throughput and truck traffic volume, applies time series method to forecast port freight and truck traffic volume and forecasts the traffic flow of peak hours of Huangpu district of Guangzhou in 2011 by the simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Ownership Concentration Degree and Corporate Performance - From the Empirical Evidence of Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Abstrac---After the share structure split reform, the relationship between Ownership Concentration degree and corporate performance is the focus of the community. In this study, we select 300 Index companies listed in Shanghai and shenzhen stock exchange during 2007-2009 as samples, and use regression models to inspect the the relationship between ownership concentration degree and corporate performance,it found that Ownership Concentration degree and corporate performance show a positively correlation in generally:The shareholding proportion of the largest shareholder, The shareholding proportion of the top five largest shareholders and the Herfindahl index and company performance show a significantly positively correlation; Z index and company performance show a significantly negatively correlation, that is, The greater the difference between the shareholding proportion of the largest shareholder and The shareholding proportion of the second largest shareholder, the worse the firm performance.

articleTitle: Impact of Low Carbon Agriculture on the Employment of Surplus Labor in Rural China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The aim of this paper is to investigate whether low carbon agriculture could create new jobs for surplus labor in rural china. A path analysis model is used to analyze the determinants of rural labor demand. The result shows that chemical fertilizers and energy consumption have significant negative correlation with employment in primary industry. To reduce the consumption of chemical fertilizer and industrial energy could create job opportunities for rural labor. Agricultural mechanization needs to be improved in China, which is benefit both to the development of low carbon agriculture and the transfer of rural surplus labor.

articleTitle: Balancing Exploration and Exploitation in Technological Context: The Role of Strategic Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Exploration and exploitation represent two fundamentally different approaches to organizational learning, but recent literature has increasingly found the importance to achieve a balance between the two. Added with competency trap, we propose an integrated conceptual model which involves existing technological capability, existing technology base, strategic flexibility, technology exploitation and technology exploration. In this study, we emphasize the moderated role of strategic flexibility in balancing technology exploration and exploitation, and balancing the relations between existing technology base/capability and technological exploration/exploitation.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on the Quantitative Evaluation of Government Performance: Using Break-Even Analysis to Estimate the Performance of Visible Public Goods
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In many aspects, the estimation of government performances manifested as public finance expenditure and quantitative analysis of visible public goods in all level governments' management activities. Concretely, there is a difficulty that what kind of method can be adapted to process quantitative analysis to estimate the government performances. This paper takes real and material decision-making as example to demonstrate how to use break-even analysis to estimate the government public goods management performance. It also analyses the Theory mechanism and resolves the practical application.

articleTitle: Integration of Standardized Management System for Tourism Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Standardized management of tourism enterprises is a complex integrated system, this paper applies the theory of integration management to discuss the integration conditions and modes of standardization management system for tourism enterprises, and some specific measures are proposed.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Administration-Oriented and Customer-Oriented Electronic Government
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Electronic government has mushroomed in recent years along with the development and utilization of information of communication technologies in public sector. A lot of attentions are attached to the technical end. However, participants are active factors in the evolution of e-government. Different kinds of participants play important but distinct roles in every project of e-government, which leads to different approach in the process of evolution. According to the decision-making authority, resources allocation authority, strategic emphasis and ultimate purpose in the initiative and implementation of e-government, there are two principle approaches of e-government. A comparative analysis is given to these two distinct approaches. Each approach originates in different environmental context and serves different administrative purpose. The two approaches are not necessarily successive stages in one evolution process, which could influence the destination in evolution of e-government.

articleTitle: Model of Forewarning Risks of the Land Reserve Projects: A Case Study in Xi'an City
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Land reserving enables the government to control land market easily and reduces the rent-seeking behaviors in the process of assigning the right to the use of the land. The land reserving could move the stock of urban land and improve the land utilization. However, the land revserving projects also belong to investment activities and the amount of investment is huge. In the same time the investment cycle is long. Operation of the land reserve, there is a lot of uncertainty, is likely to lead to investment failure. So, The purpose of this paper is to calculate the value of risks, build forewarning risk control models and judge the fluctuation of risk values in the process of decision-making for multiple land reserve projects and the trend of risks and the center of land reserve preference in decision-making. Integrated methods of documentation, model and case study are employed. The result shows that the forewarning control limits are built based on the reliability series model in a non-repairable system and Shewhart control charts and the time series regression judgment model is built after the limits.
