It is concluded that through the measurement, forewarning and judgment of time series regression of risk in the land reserving projects of some city, the method is validated.

articleTitle: Forced Caving Technique for Gas Disaster Prevention in Coal Mine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The coal seam being mined by #3103 working face of Shangzhuang Coal Mine is relatively close to its adjacent seam. Moreover, the adjacent seam contains considerably high gas content. Therefore, in order to prevent excessive gas exceeding the stipulated limit as a result of massive gas emission from the adjacent seam during the initial collapse of the roof, forced caving scheme is worked out to deal with the roof of the working face based on the site conditions. On the one hand, pre-breaking blasting with deep holes adds up to the fissures in the upper adjacent seam, which not only enhances the effects of gas drainage in the adjacent seam in high position roadway, but prevents coal and gas outburst accident arising from floor collapse in large area. The practices proved that the forced caving scheme is feasible and effective to prevent outburst in the working face with upper adjacent seam.

articleTitle: Research on Electronic Commerce Readiness of Small and Medium-Sized Tourism Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper establishes index system of electronic commerce readiness of electronic commerce readiness of small and medium-sized tourism enterprises, uses analytic hierarchy process to determine the weight of each level index, establishes the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model of electronic commerce readiness of small and medium-sized tourism enterprises, finally the case study shows that it is reasonable and credible to evaluate electronic commerce readiness of small and medium-sized tourism enterprises with analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation.

articleTitle: Research of Water Prices Based on Two-Part Water Pricing with TTWP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Transfer of Taohe Water Project (TTWP) in its reasoning stage did not put in place a lot of schemes for the selection of water price. This article applies the theory of two-part water pricing and designs 12 selective schemes, after the analyzing, determines the three specific water prices of village life, agricultural irrigation and city water consumption. Further analysis shows that the scope of water price of rural life water consumption and city water consumption are affordable; meanwhile, the water price of agricultural irrigation consumption exceeds what the people can afford, and there is a need of government subsidy.

articleTitle: Study on the Application of M-Commerce in the Reconstruction of Enterprise Value Chain in Guangzhou, China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper conducts the preliminary study on the current role and influence of m-commerce technology in the reconstruction of enterprise value chain in Guangzhou, China with interdisciplinary analysis and mathematical analysis, as well as the statistics and analysis on the data gained with mathematical model, Excel and SPSS. The results show that e-commerce has accelerated the evolution of modern business organizations, and prompted businesses to replace the traditional "pyramid" structure with the network organization structure of "flat and thin", thus enabling the enterprises to participate in the global market competition with maximum flexibility and adaptability. It proposes the platform model of e-commerce based on J2ME, and demonstrates its reliability. Meanwhile, it also proposes the view that the acceleration of e-commerce technology process can greatly optimize the enterprise value chain. The innovation of this paper is that it conducts preliminary study on the enterprises in Guangzhou, China, and proposes feasible program of e-commerce system based on J2ME.

articleTitle: Minimum Cross-Entropy Transform of Risk Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Transform is an important method of risk analysis in actuarial science. In this paper, a new transform method is proposed by the minimum cross-entropy principle which is used widely in information theory. The more moment information of loss variable can be considered in the bounds of the optimization model. The solution of the constructed model,which is a transform of original probability distribution,can be obtained easily by the way of Lagrange parameter. The essence of risk shift is indicated by distributing more weight to unfavorable events. The study shows that the new minimum cross-entropy transform (MCET) is correlated closely to Esscher transform. The relationship between them is also established here.

articleTitle: A Cognitive Semantic Study of Transferred Epithet
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the former studies of transferred epithet and Fauconnier and Turner's conceptual integration theory, this paper adopts a cognitive semantic approach to the in-depth analysis of the on-line meaning construction of transferred epithet. This study explores the meaning construction of transferred epithet from a new perspective. It can help the language learners have a better understanding of transferred epithets, and thus they can use and translate them proficiently.

articleTitle: The Application Study on the Appraisal of Corporate Performance Based on the Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To strengthen enterprise performance management can effectively improve the competitiveness of enterprises. By analyzing the factors affecting enterprise performance, on the basis of enterprise development, staff satisfaction from three dimensions which are friendly with the social enterprise performance evaluation index and a decision tree evaluation model is established. Applying this model to Zaozhuang Mining Group, we have find out the effects of enterprise performance and the key factors, then put forward the corresponding countermeasures.

articleTitle: The Principal of the Rebate
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Rebates are a post-compensation approach used by manufacturers when the distributors' sales volume reaches a certain standard. Compared with price discount, the rebate is an indirect way of discounting and the value of this method has yet to be given a reasonable explanation in industrial organization theory. Preliminary Study of the economics principles of rebates shown in this paper shows that rebates can overcome problems caused by double mark-up and achieve the goals of vertical structural optimization. At the same time, rebates can also eliminate the defects resulted from traditional vertical price restraints. From the principle point of view, combined with Quantity Fixing and Franchise Fees, rebates can replace the vertical restrictions. However, as an incentive for the distributors, rebates have their own characteristics. For example, rebates make reasonable distribution of benefit to all parties, and the mechanism to realize objectives is closer to the market rules, so fewer legal and social risks will arise. These practices, which are different from traditional vertical restrictions, should be grouped under the concept of vertical incentives, so as to illustrate the vertical measures which have with common features.

articleTitle: Research on Personal Income Tax System Reform from the Perspectives of Equity and Efficiency in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper focuses on the problems and improvement suggestions in the process of personal taxable income. China's current personal income tax, whether from the perspective of tax fairness or efficiency, is contrary to these two principles. Therefore, the authors believe that, for the improvement of personal income tax, China should take into account all factors, from the principles of fairness and efficiency, combining practical problems, adjust the system, make the income tax better promote China's economic development. By theoretical analysis, based on the tax theory of fairness and efficiency, the paper analyzes the tax deduction, charge mode, tax apply and other issues, provides a theoretical basis and reference for adjusting China's personal income tax. Secondly, using the method of comparative induction, combined with the tax system reform, the paper proposes China's personal income tax adjustments recommendations.

articleTitle: The Study on Ecological Environments Safety in Chongqing One Hour Economic Circle Region
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, the conflict between landuse and ecology environment tends to be more and more intense .In this paper, environment quality of "Chongqing one hour economic circle" was given detailed evaluation in quantitative way with AHP and PSR in 2000 and 2006. Study results show that as a whole, some districts in the West Chongqing region such as Tongnan, Tongliang, Dazu, Bishan, Yongchuan and Rongchang which was in a lower level of ecological environment, but the district of Fuling was in a high level. It shows that within two years, areas that were ranked as excellent and good accounted for 62.56% and 60.96% respectively. Form 2000 to 2006, the overall quality of the ecological environment of the area was clearly declining, significant deterioration area ratio reached 31.71%, and significantly change good regional area ratio was only 5.24%. The dropped ecological environment of research regional area ratio reached 59.72% and the increased ecological environment of the region area was only 27.02%. Regional changes in the quality of the ecological environment had obvious spatial difference. Most significant deterioration of regional distributed in the southwest of Chongqing where belongs to regional of Cheng-Yu Traffic Route and the large parts of the capital city.

articleTitle: Forecast on Shanghai's Input-Intensity of R&D Based on the Model DGM (1, 1)
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the statistical data of R&D input-intensity from 1995 to 2007 in Shanghai, the paper forecasts the medium-term and long-term R&D input-intensity in Shanghai based on a kind of improving form of grey forecasting model GM(1,1), that is DGM(1,1) model. The calculation results show that DGM (1, 1) model has some advantages, so as higher predicting precision, the better fitting with actual situation and so on. The construction and application of the model have a positive reference value to Shanghai's future strategic decision-making in science and technology investment.

articleTitle: Study on Financial Personnel Training of Binhai New Area
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the supply and demand theory, this thesis analyzes the supply and demand contradiction of financial personnel training of Binhai new area adopting the methods of data analysis and survey research; seen from the perspective of Tianjin colleges and universities, this thesis explores innovative financial talents who can meet the requirements of financial industry in Binhai new area.

articleTitle: Construction Project Transaction Mode Comprehensive Evaluation Based on Stochastic Weight Assignment Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Considering the shortcomings of the attribute weight setting method used currently in the decision model of choosing project transaction mode, which is typically characterized by precise weights, the stochastic problem of index weight of multi-attribute comprehensive evaluation is researched. Under the weight interval information is chosen, the stochastic weight assignment method is used to determine the value of weight. Then, combined with Monte-Carlo simulation, which can analyze the impacts of changes of weights on comprehensive evaluation results to enhance the applicability of the model. At last, an real example is proposed to demonstrate such model and solution are efficient.

articleTitle: A Competitiveness Analysis on Chinese Construction Companies in the Global Market Using Diamond Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In line with China's accession to the World Trade Organization (WTO), largely due to the encouragement and support by the Chinese government, the last decades have witnessed a dramatic growing trend of Chinese construction companies making significant inroads into the international market. A Diamond Model is developed in this technical note to analyze the factors that have significant impacts on the competitiveness of the Chinese International Construction Companies (CICCs) in the Global Market. Data was collected from multiple sources including literature survey, statistics and policy review. The results show that Diamond Model is an effective method for the CICCs' self-competitiveness-assessment, which has great potential to be applied to any international contractor's competitiveness study in the global market.

articleTitle: Study on the Influences of Corporate Governance Characteristics on the Corporate Social Responsibility Information Revelation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the relationship between corporate governance characteristics and corporate social responsibility information revelation (abbreviated as CSRIR) by using index analysis. The results show :1) there are significant negative relationships between board size, board independence and CEO duality and CSRIR; 2) there are significant positive relationships between management salary, the proportion of outstanding shares, the proportion of state shares and CSRIR under the level of 5%; 3) there is no significant relationship between ownership concentration and CSRIR.

articleTitle: Designing an E-Learning Course in C Language Based on Knowledge Management Perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-learning courses has been adopted by universities as an alternative teaching method. By development of computer based devices and new methods of teaching, e-learning courses have emerged. However, the synergies, functional effectiveness and integration of knowledge management within an e-learning course have attracted little interest for serious research. In this paper, we discuss designing an e-learning course in C language on a knowledge management perspective. Constitutive elements of designing e-learning course in C language are analyzed. The course is supported by the virtual learning environment which integrates various tools, and it is easily operated and accessible through the internet web browser. Knowledge management can be used effectively in e-learning course in C language and it can provide a learning grid to enable the students to identify the right learning objects in C language which is based on the student's context and personal preferences.

articleTitle: The Connotation and Characteristic of Service Economy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Against the background of economic globalization, information technology and knowledge industry has been undergoing rapid development. It leads to a new kind of economy which unveils a new era for major western developed countries post-industrial society. First of all, this article mainly introduces the connotation and characteristic of service economy in the postindustrial economy era and puts forward the criteria for determining the service economy. Finally, the paper introduces the content and basic characteristics of the service economy and provides the core driving force of service economy.

articleTitle: Chinese Company Managerial Entrenchment Effect Governance and Corporate Debt Maturity Structure Choice
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper deduces: when the current final liquidate residual of a project is greater than the next period of expected revenue, investors will choose short-term debt and take it as supervision on managers; under the corporate debt maturity structure option game equilibrium between managers and shareholders, the higher the corporate governance level, the better the legal system environment, and the lower the corporate debt level, the more effective will be the restrict of management entrenchment effects. In addition, this paper adopts data of Chinese listed companies of 2008-2009 for empirical test, and this empirical results support the theory and assumptions in the paper.

articleTitle: The Design and Development of the Degree Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Degree Management Information System for Graduates is a synthesis management system developed by using advanced design concepts and development technologies. It is established in the real degree management work of China Agricultural University and it involves every stage of the degree management work for different users. The system is used to solve a series of realistic problems effectively such as the data redundancy, the resources waste, the imperfect surveillance mechanism, the statistical work detention and so on. The goal is to achieve management of the whole process of the degree management work, So as to improve the impartiality and efficiency of thesis appraisement and degree information management work.

articleTitle: Social Security Fund Portfolio Risk Measurement Based on Dynamic Diagonal BEKK-MGARCH
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Taking into account the current social security fund primarily invested to stocks and bonds, we construct the portfolio based on Shanghai & Shenzhen 300 index and bond index on behalf of pension fund investment portfolio, compute the risk of portfolio based on dynamic diagonal BEKK-MGARCH, carry out Kupiec test, compare the result with CCC-MGARCH model. The result shows that dynamic diagonal BEKK-MGARCH is better than CCC-MGARCH model in the aspect of measuring the risk of social security fund portfolio. The result also shows that, if invest one hundred units,the daily VaR and ES are 2.4056 and 4.1163.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on Factors of China's Household Savings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Saving deposit, recorded as an important indicator of GDP, has important effects on the national macro-control. For a long time, China's saving deposit occupies an important place in the total GDP, which is different from the economic model in developed countries where consumption and investment are dominant. So, analyzing savings has important significance to the national economy. This article selects the residents savings data from 1992 to 2009, tries to analyzes the influential factors of residents in our country empirically, and presents corresponding policies with the specific model.

articleTitle: Research on Ownership Structure and Earnings Management - Based on Investor Relations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under Chinese institutional background, block holders have the incentive to make non-efficiency decision and to manipulate earnings information, which would affect the company's the capital market response and future profitability. After reliability testing of the main variables, this paper examined whether the implementation of investor relations could constraint the earnings management behavior of inners and improve the quality of the information. According to the results of empirical analysis, we got the following conclusions: The higher the level of investor relations, the lower level of earnings management. The implementation of investor relations increased external communication, which could be able to force the company to improve the information quality. This could enforce block holders to re- consider the cost of encroaching the interest of small and medium shareholders, and the containment of investor relations to the behavior of controlling shareholders pursuing private benefits was also supported by the examination result. So, the evidence of this paper supported the theoretical assumptions which investor relations could reduce the "moral hazard", and then optimizing corporate governance.

articleTitle: Research on the Regional Financial Efficiency Based on DEA Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, DEA modeling and efficiency evalutation is employed to assess the financial efficiency in more than 30 province china. The data of financial efficiency in each provinces and vadity in the financial scale as well as input indicators on finance was obtained. Through the comparison evaluations, the paper indicates that there are great difference in regional financial efficiency. At the end the some policy conclusion is summerized.

articleTitle: Study Progress of Producer Services
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The rapid rise of producer service industry within the world draws the attention of many scholars at home and abroad since the middle of twentieth century. The relevant research results are constantly emerging. The article describes the progress of producer services from the following four aspects: (1) the implications of producer services; (2) the contribution of producer services for economic growth; (3) its interaction with manufacturing industry; (4) the relationship between producer services and regional development. The producer service industries can satisfy the intermediate demand and provide intermediate inputs for other enterprises. The producer service industry outputs usually conclude knowledge capital, technology capital and human capital. And they can promote economic growth and regional development. Otherwise, the relationship between producer services and manufacturing industries becomes more and more affinitive.

articleTitle: Green Construction Bid Evaluation System Research Based on Comprehensive Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper made green construction tender evaluation system as an entry point. Analysis and decomposition green construction targets system, to establish green construction comprehensive evaluation index system, to ensure the best bidder won.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prediction on Household Savings in China Based on ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on ARIMA model, this paper discusses the household savings of residents in China. By the ARIMA model and statistical analysis, the empirical research shows that ARIMA(1,12,0) model can fit better the sample data from January to December in 2008.

articleTitle: Rough Neuro-Fuzzy Network Applied to Traffic Flow Breakdown in the City of Sao Paulo
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years the market behavior has changed, influenced by several aspects like: increased competitiveness, electronic commerce, environment concerns, among others. The new consumption habits have brought products with a shorter life cycle. These behavior increases the amount of discarded and aimlessly items. Predict the traffic behavior could help to make decision about the routing process, as well as enables the improvement in effectiveness and productivity on its physical distribution. This need motivates the search for technological improvements in the Routing performance in metropolitan areas. The purpose of this paper is to present computational evidence that Artificial Neural Network (ANN) could be use to predict the traffic behavior in a metropolitan area such Sao Paulo (around 16 million inhabitants). The proposed methodology involves the application Rough-Fuzzy Sets to define inference morphology for insert the behavior of Dynamic Routing into a structured rule basis, without human expert aid. The attributes of the traffic parameters are described through membership functions. Rough Sets Theory identifies the attributes that are important, and suggest Fuzzy relations to be inserted on a Rough Neuro Fuzzy Network (RNFN) type Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), in order to get an optimal surface response. To measure the performance of the proposed RNFN, the responses of the unreduced rule basis are compared with the reduced rule basis. The results show that by making use of the RNFN, it is possible to reduce the need for human expert in the construction of the Fuzzy inference mechanism in such flow process like traffic breakdown.

articleTitle: The Data Exchange Research of E-Government Application System Basing on Spatial Information
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the promotion of e-government application system, the important effect of data exchange brings more and more concern and discussion. This paper proposes the data exchange system model which is composed of the data transmission services, data exchange adapter and task processors, aiming at data sharing and automatic data exchange application of GIS and other non-spatial data. We introduce XML as a logistic expression and intermediate data standard format of spatial data to make it have the capability of heterogeneous GIS which shares the data resources and services crossing platforms. The data engine model as the transaction processing center between GIS and other non-spatial data uses workflow management technology definite complex analysis model and business process and makes drive-algorithm design and implementation for different data types.

articleTitle: A Modeling Method of Role-Based Team Organization Structure in E-Business
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Realization of e-business is based on business process management system (BPMS). In BPMS there are a large number of event logs recording the performers and corresponding activities. Team organization structure is so flexible as to be more suitable for implementation of e-business. However the existing organizational structure modeling methods are difficult to model team structure. This paper design a modeling method of role-based team organization structure based on event logs from BPMS. Usually if the role of performers is similar, they can be classified as a same team. This method analyzes activities type and activities frequency of different performers in the event logs in order to judge their role similarity. Firstly, a PA (performer-activity) diagram is designed to describe the relations between different performers and activities; secondly, the role relation mining rules are designed; At last, the measures of the role similarity among performers are designed based on which a team organization structure can be modeled.

articleTitle: Transmission Effect between PRC International Trade Credit and Its Monetary Policy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Credit rationing is an important manifestation in the monetary policy transmission. This paper focuses on the analysis of the transmission effect of China's international trade credit on the monetary policy in the foreign trade domain, and with empirical evidences we come to the conclusion that the international trade credit assets is the Granger cause of export, and still further that the volume of international credit assets is positively correlated with exports. Likewise, international trade credit liabilities and imports are in positive correlation as well; yet they are reciprocal Granger causations to one another. The conclusions above can be applied to realize the balance of China's international payments via credit rationing.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Self-Adapting Process of Urban Land-Use Structure Based on Land Value Indication: A Theoretical Demonstration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper sketches a methodology analysis for the assessment of the urban land-use structure (ULUS) that adopting land value as the key criterion. The research includes two parts: firstly, introduce and analyze the mechanism of the ULUS self-adapting; then detailed models including pivotal formulas are developed for the simulation of the mechanism. The research can provide both theoretical analysis and feasibility demonstration for building a physical ULUS simulation system.

articleTitle: The Key Elements of Department Industry Service System: An Empirical Analysis Based on the Department Stores in GuangZhou
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service increasingly becomes the key factor that China's department stores improve their competitive advantages, and all of its content is how to attract, maintain and strengthen relationships with customers. On the basis of systematic analysis of constructing the department store service system, this paper carries out empirical research on two typical department stores in South China, and uses factor analysis method to identify several service elements which consumers are most concerned about , and further puts forward measures to perfect service system construction of department industry .

articleTitle: Study on Soft Information and Relationship Banking
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Information is an essential factor in financial markets and financial transactions, generally divides into hard information and soft information. These information play important role in lending activities of commercial banks especially. Relationship banking is a lending technology in SMEs financing, mainly focus on the lending relationship between banks and SMEs, reflecting how banks establish long-term, sustainable relationship with SMEs to obtain soft information. As the special characteristics of soft information, literatures on soft information in banking are very few. Therefore, this paper reviews and analyzes soft information and relationship banking in related foreign financial literatures comprehensively and systematically, provides useful references to in-depth researches on soft information and relationship banking in SMEs financing.

articleTitle: An Examination on Environmental-Economic Relations in China with Nonlinear Specifications
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between economic growth and environmental pollution in China over the period 1989-2007. Conventional linear methods including the linear model and the log-linear model, and nonlinear methods with the Weibull and Gamma specifications are compared. It is shown that the nonlinear methods perform better than conventional linear methods. The results also suggest that with the rise of per capita GDP, per capita waste water emission appears an inverse U-shaped relationship, while per capita solid wastes generated and per capita waste gas emission take on unclear relationships, depending on different methods.

articleTitle: A Structural Model of Value Cognition for Evaluating New Technology-Based Firms Based on RBT and BSC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this study we develop a structural model of value cognition for new-technology-based firms (NTBFs) based on resource-based theory (RBT) and balanced score card (BSC). The value cognition of venture capitalists (VCs) is considered as a procedure of information processing, and the input variable consists of two aspects, namely resource and performance. The indicator system of resource, which is established according to RBT and determines the profit potential, is a prospective indicator and also, is a determinant factor of enterprise value. While the indicator system of performance, which is established on balanced scorecard (BSC), is a lagging indicator and reflects the previous operation abilities of enterprises. The model simplifies the existing cognition structure of VCs and contributes to further study.

articleTitle: Exploration in Openness of Laboratories of Electronic Information Training Base of Beijing Union University to Students
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In higher education, theory and practice are closely related to each other. Electronic Information Training Base of Beijing University is playing a vital role in the students' acquiring theoretical knowledge, training themselves and making breakthroughs. By opening computer rooms for students, Electronic Information Training Base of Beijing Union University makes it work meet the demand of higher education, thus improving students self-awareness and skills.

articleTitle: A Research on Project Management: Hot Topics and Main Knowledge Groups
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: When theories and research fields become much mature, it is important for researchers to understand and grasp the development and trends of a field or discipline. Based on studying of former research, and used the method of social network analysis, this paper revealed the project management discipline's development from the network's interior structure and the fifteen hot issues in this field. The paper also discussed about the dynamic switch process of these hot topics. Then based on key words' co-word matrix, Multi-Dimensional Scaling Map analysis and main component analysis summarized four main knowledge groups in the project management field, Project management's knowledge domain, process domain, innovation domain, and public domain. At last, the new trends were analyzed and the conclusion was drawn and discussed.

articleTitle: Acrylamide-Based Cationic Polyelectrolytes and Their Potential Applications: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Polyelectrolytes are water soluble polymers bearing ionic groups along the polymeric chains. In terms of their charges, they can be divided into anionic, cationic, nonionic and amphoteric types. These polymers open a lot of applications in different fields such as paper-making processes, water and waste water treatment, oil and drilling industries, mineral separation, paint and food industries, cosmetics and pharmacy. The cationic polyelectrolytes are one of important classes of these which bearing positive charges. These polymers are widely used as flocculants and rheology control agents. These polymers are especially employed in oil field operations as viscosity control agents for enhanced oil recovery and also as modifying flow and stability properties of aqueous solutions. Mining and water treatment processes also benefit from the use of acrylamide-based polymers to flocculate solids in aqueous dispersions. These polymers are made by free radical polymerization of acrylamide and their derivatives by copolymerization technique which include of solution, precipitation, and emulsion methods. The Mannich reaction is another important method by which the cationic polymers can be made. The cationic polymers may interact with particles in aqueous dispersions in several ways, in which their interactions may result in stability or instability of dispersion. The particles can be destabilized through three different main mechanisms namely polymer bridging, charge neutralization and polymer adsorption.

articleTitle: Application Approach of Energy Management Contract in Hebei
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Energy Management Contract is an advanced energy management model and a new mechanism of market-oriented energy-saving operation. Based on the situation of energy and environment in Hebei province, this paper discusses the urgency and significance of building a market mechanism to reduce energy, suggested that Energy Management Contract is an important approach to achieve the objective of energy reduction. With an analysis of the important fields of propelling Energy Management Contract in Hebei province, the specific measures to implement Energy Management Contract in Hebei province are further discussed.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Recovery Scoring Model Using Multivariate Adaptive Regression Splines and Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims to devise a cardholder recovery scoring model which enables card issuers to identify creditworthy debtors recoverable from delinquency without misclassification risks. Taking advantage of integrating such highly performed classifiers as artificial neural networks (ANNs) and multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS) with a relative efficiency evaluation tool, data envelopment analysis (DEA), a classification model with a more desired accuracy is built in the first phase for predicting delinquents' future credit status, and then DEA model are employed in the second phase to verify the preceding-stage predicted results as well as gain managerial implications on the inefficient delinquents for improvement in the efficiency of card utilization.

articleTitle: Analysis on Building Chinese Corporation Green Responsibility System in the Process of Ecological Civilization Construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, the globalization ecological crisis is increasingly serious; then, human have to review their own behavior activities, and start to appeal to construct a new civilization mode-Ecological Civilization, Ecological civilization is a civilization manna that can realize sustainable development and achieve harmonious development between man and the natural environment, and ecological civilization is the most important approach to solve the globalization ecological crisis. Extensive researches and practices show that the corporation is the mainstay of the market, their activities have an important influence on the development of the whole community; meanwhile, corporation social responsibility is the main reason of global and critical ecological crisis, especially, the corporation green responsibility is the most important reason. So, the corporation green responsibility construction becomes the necessary measure and course in the process of ecological civilization construction. At first, this paper expatiates on the correlative concepts of ecological civilization and corporation green responsibility, and analyzes the real status of our corporation green responsibility; then, this paper put forward some suggestions on building Chinese corporation green responsibility system for helping the construction of ecological civilization.

articleTitle: Prevention of Accidents in Public Transport Corporation at Madurai City
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Accidents and the fatalities on road are the result of inter-play of a number of factors. Road users in India are heterogeneous in nature, ranging from pedestrians, animaldriven carts, bi-cycles, rickshaws, hand carts and tractor trolleys, to various categories of two/three wheelers, motor cars, buses, trucks, and multi-axle commercial vehicles etc., The vehicle population has been steadily increasing because of change in the style of living of people. Increase in vehicle population with limited road space used by a large variety of vehicles has heightened the need and urgency for a well thought-out policy on the issue of road safety. In India the rate of accident is directly proportional to growth of vehicle population. But this paper is indented for that the accident rate should be indirectly proportionate to the vehicle growth by way of finding prime reasons of accidents and finding solutions to tackle the reasons. This paper analyses the major factors for accidents and preventive measures in respect of Public Transport Corporation at Madurai City, Tamil Nadu, South India where heavy passenger vehicle population is around 2737 and people population is 12 lakhs. Out of 2737 heavy passenger vehicles population, Transport Corporation operates 1420 vehicles which is nearly 52% of the above.

articleTitle: The Application Research of Description Logic in Civil Aviation Domain Ontology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to improve the reasoning ability of Civil Aviation knowledge, this paper describes Civil Aviation domain ontology based on Description Logic, reasons subsumption and consistency of ontology and retrieves individuals. By using the reasoning theories of Description Logic, the hierarchy of concepts is automatically classified and the rationality of ontology is guaranteed.

articleTitle: A Thermal CAD Tool for Technical Risk Management in Power Projects
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Thermal risk is a prominent technical issue in power related projects which has significant impacts on a variety of deliverables including efficiency, reliability and manufacture cost. In today's commercial market there is no industrial standard on power products' thermal behavior, which makes it extremely challenging for a project manager to control technical risks. A CAD (Computer Aid Design) tool is presented in this paper that efficiently evaluates and mitigates thermal related risks in power projects.

articleTitle: The Concept and Model of Apparel Design Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Apparel industries need design management, so does the apparel design. The paper focuses on the need of introducing design management (DM) into apparel industries. It analyzes the modules of design task and system in design management, proposes the models of style and product positioning, organizes the design process, and provides methods on how to implement design management into apparel industries.

articleTitle: Symbolic Analysis of Shanghai Stock Market Returns
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Symbolic time series analysis method is introduced into the study of financial market returns. On the basis of symbolizing time series and coding the symbolic time series, the characteristics of symbolic series can be described by symbolic series histogram and symbolic tree. The method proposed is used to analyze the daily return characteristics of some indices of Shanghai Stock Market including Shanghai stock exchange's composite index, industrials index, commercial index, real estate index and utilities index.

articleTitle: Study on Size of Vertical RJVs
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For a two-tie market structure with oligopoly upstream firms and completely competition downstream firms, analyzes the optimal RJV size on the view of upstream firm, downstream firms and social welfare under fixed fraction cost-sharing mechanism, and the effect on the optimal RJV size by the total R&D cost, cost-sharing parameter. Some conclusions are acquired: the upstream member desires a larger RJV compared to the downstream members; an industry-RJV is also the optimal size under social welfare analysis; government cost subsidies make none use of enlarging RJV, while macro-monitoring to incentive more upstream firms to compete effects well.

articleTitle: Contract Designing about Multi-Agent Technology-Transformation Project with Difficulty in Quality Identification
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In many cases, IPR holders of technologies have control rights in negotiation while they should take consideration of reasonable requests from partners. If customers have difficulty in quality identification, how to design the cooperation contracts influenced by both adverse selection problem and moral hazard problem for multi-agent technology-transformation projects? The results show us that negative effect relating to partners' high effort and security benefits promised to partners will influence the final designing result.

articleTitle: Grey Correlative Degree Analysis on Logistics Industry and Steel Industry in Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Grey correlative degree analysis was used to research the relationship between Logistics Industry and Steel Industry in Hebei Province in this article. According to the statistics of 2004-2008 in Hebei Province, The analytical result analyzes the coordination between two sides. The result indicates that all aspects of the steel industry and logistics industry has a very close relationship,High to low order of importance of various aspects: industrial added value, profit, output of pig iron, finished steel output, steel output sales revenue, industrial output value, cost of sales, iron ore output. Concluded that in order to make steel industry great progress, we must attach great importance to the logistics industry

articleTitle: The Evaluation of Agriculture Products Wholesale Market Modernization Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Agriculture products wholesale market is an important part in agriculture circulation system. It plays a significant role in improving agriculture circulation efficiency, developing China's rural economy and promoting the process of agricultural modernization. Agricultural products wholesale market, with diversified circulation main bodies, linked urban and rural, agriculture and commerce, domestic and foreign trade together effectively, in the central of agricultural circulation system. This paper selected agricultural products wholesale market in Heilongjiang Province as the research object, established the evaluation system of agricultural products wholesale market modernization, applied Delphi and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), built a hierarchical structure model. Through establishing and approaching the system, combined with the status of agricultural products wholesale market in Heilongjiang Province, we found and analyzed problems in the development process, and finally proposed specific countermeasures to the matters.

articleTitle: Henan Textile Industry Low Carbon Economy Development Path Selection and Decision Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Low carbon economy, which is proposed as a new development concept, has had an influence in various fields of economic and social development. At the same time, low-carbon model has gradually become a standard with which people take a deeply thinking of economic and specific industrial development. Based upon the current situation of China and Henan textile industries, the following article is trying to focus on the research on the necessity of Henan textile industry's low carbon textile development and the specific model in the process of Henan textile industry's receiving the textile industrial transfer, and to put forward the countermeasures and suggestions for the choosing of low-carbon development path combing with the actual development of Henan textile industry.

articleTitle: What Features of HRM System Can Build an Entrepreneurship Team
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper explores HRM system features used to build an entrepreneurial team which fits with strategy and contingencies. Our findings include: recruitment channels of personal social network; selecting through interviews and paying great attention to the years of employment, position and achievement; no trainings during the initial stage of entrepreneurship; no short-term performance assessment system but still having the requirements of strategy goals and performance; the overall compensation structure featuring low basic salary, more share, no bonus and welfare.

articleTitle: Development of Service Industry and Rising of Service Economy in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industry evolution has a far-reaching effect on the economic structure, and the development of the regional economy is just a pattern formed by gathering and spreading of spots and lines by enterprise. The service industry in China is showing great promise, so the best choice of the city for the development of the regional economy is the modern service industry. We need not only the "Made in China " but also the "China Services". The city should take the service industry as the dominant one, scientifically adjust industry distribution, spread the functions of the city service, and transfer the service industry into the service regional economy.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Incentive Mode of Power Enterprises Based on Incentive Compatibility Principle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the problem of lacking incentive in the power enterprise's performance management system, a performance incentive mode design is put forward, based on incentive compatibility principle. First, the individual rationality condition and incentive compatibility condition are founded; then, according to the different information disclosure situation in stated-owned enterprises, performance incentive models are established in the symmetric and asymmetric information condition respectively; on this basis, the performance incentive mode in power enterprises is designed; at last, a practical example is introduced to testify the effectiveness of this design.

articleTitle: Research on the Status of China's Processing Trades - From the Perspective of International Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the accelerating process of economic globalization and the steady growth of international division of labor, the mode of market competition has shift from competition between enterprises to the competition between supply chains. Meanwhile, the international production mode also contributed to the development of processing trade enterprises in China. Especially after China's accession to WTO, in order to adapt to the economic environment and improve their competitiveness, more and more Chinese processing trade enterprises apply international supply chain management in their enterprises' management.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Impact of the Internet-Aided College English Teaching on the Learners' Motivation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After the issue of the Requirements for the College English Teaching by the Chinese Ministry of Education in 2004, college English teaching in China has witnessed tremendous changes not only in teaching materials and pedagogics but also in teaching modes and instruments. The mode of internet-aided college English teaching has been widely adopted in Chinese universities and colleges in hope to foster students' communicative ability in English and autonomous study capability. This study on the basis of an investigation of the students in Hebei University of Economics and Business demonstrates that this mode has had a positive influence on the motivation of the students in their College English learning and that their motivation is mostly instrumentally oriented.

articleTitle: Corporate Governance and Agency Conflicts: GOME's Control Contest
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After Wong Kwong Yu was arrested, main agency conflicts of GOME transformed from agency conflicts of controlling shareholders and minor shareholders to agency conflicts of controlling shareholders and managers' actual control rights. This transformation has made the level of agency conflicts of GOME increased from operating risk, ownership structure and debt contracts. The increase of agency conflicts may result in perfecting GOME's internal corporate governance mechanism in ownership structure, board of directors, executive compensation and promoting the increase of corporate performance.

articleTitle: Current Situation and Countermeasure of Sustainable Development of SPA Tourism Industry in Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article basic in the Henan Province actual situation of tourism development, analyzes the status of SPA tourism development of Henan Province, and then summarizes the constraints and defects of SPA Tourism development. Finally, based on present situation and problem analysis, proposing some suggestions of how to developing spa tourism in Henan province.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Mechanism of Urban Community Economic Development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The urban community economy is a basic component of the urban economy. The development of community economy is useful to achieve the urban construction, orderly management, consummated serve, and civilized and harmonious society. The development of urban community economy needs motivation. This study aimed to analyze the urban community economy system, establish the dynamic model of urban community economic development, and formulate the measure to accelerate the urban community economic development. The urban community economy system is an open system, which is made up of community resident, community administration, community enterprise, local government, community financial organization, and business administration. The developing motivation of community economy comes from community residents need and outer power push. The dynamic system of community economic development includes self-organization dynamic system, policy dynamic system, management dynamic system, and fund dynamic system, various kinds of power are worked in coordination with each other, which forms the combining power network. Based on the dynamic system, the measures of developing community economy are pointed out, that is to establish long term mechanism, perfect management system, develop community enterprise, arrange community resource and finance in many ways to develop the urban community economy. The study result can accelerate the urban community economic development.

articleTitle: A Study on the Consumptive Behavior of Innovative Property Services Products - Based on the Construction of Two-Orientated Community
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Community is the basic unit of the society. The construction of a community calls for not only the effort by community organizations and property companies, but also the owners' active cooperation . In order to understand the owners' awareness to two-orientated society and the two-orientated community , we analyze the relationship between the cognition of two-orientated community and consumptive willingness of innovative property service products, inspect the correlative relationship between owners' personal traits and the cognition of innovative property services products, and survey owners' consumptive willingness of innovative property services products based on two-orientated community's construction. Results showed that most owners agree with the construction of two-orientated community, and had a certain awareness . But to different products, they had greater differences in cognition and consumptive willingness.

articleTitle: A Study on the Strategic Positioning of China Service Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to promoting the development of China service outsourcing, optimization the service trade structure, pushing modern service industry forward, this paper first analyzed the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats of China service outsourcing, and then identified the strategic positioning of China service outsourcing. On the basis of above studies, the paper respectively from country, industries and enterprises perspectives, provided several strategies and countermeasures.

articleTitle: Research on Application of DEA in the Selection of Virtual Enterprise Partners
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The selection of VE cooperative partners is a pivotal and complicated issue in the process of the establishment of VE, because it needs to consider not only large amounts of quantitative elements but also many non-quantitative elements such as the efficiency evaluation of VE Partners. According to this phenomenon, from the angle of the efficiency evaluation of VE Partners, we present the C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R model of DEA, for and give an example which in turn proves that DEA method is reasonable, scientific and effective for the cooperative partner selection of VE.

articleTitle: Study on e-Service Node for Service-Oriented Manufacturing Execution System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Manufacturing resources are of great importance in service-oriented manufacturing execution system (So-MES). This paper studies the e-service node for the So-MES in equipment level. The node is an integration service model composed of hardware aspect (such as machine tools, fixtures, measurements, etc.) and software aspect (such as scheduling service, quality service, monitoring service, collaboration service and data collection service, etc.). The hardware, which may be provided by the professional third-party service provider to reduce the manufacturing cost and improve the manufacturing quality, is encapsulated as a service item in e-service node. In the aspect of technical service, scheduling implementation, quality control, data collection, collaboration operation and state monitoring are achieved in the e-service node for enabling manufacturing process in high quality and efficiency. Finally, a prototype is developed to demonstrate the proposed models.

articleTitle: Staffs' Perceptions Towards Hotel Organizational Career Management in Hangzhou
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study examined Staff' Perceptions toward Hotel Organizational Career Management in Hangzhou city. Results of factor analysis indicate that hotel organizational career management can be demonstrated by four dimensions: fair promotion, paying attention to training, career self-cognitive and information transparency. Generally speaking, foreign-owned hotel has an advantage over the other two types of hotels in these four dimensions. And its organizational career management has more positive influence on Staff behavior.

articleTitle: Discussion of Need Theories' Applicability across Cultures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In Recent years, need theories encountered many questions when applied in various cultures. The article discusses the reasons why so many questions arises, the cultural effects on human needs, and the approaches to apply need theories in various cultures.

articleTitle: Research and Implement of Redundancy Network Encryption Machine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to reduce the business costs and save social resources, as the representative of the industry chain network taxpayers, the Post and Telecommunications in desperate need of a solution to realize invoice minus coupon. Based on the above situation, many manufacturers make a network of tax control machine as the core of the invoice encrypted electronic stub solution. Therefore, this paper introduces a kind of high performance redundancy double control network tax-controlled encryption machine.

articleTitle: Interactions between Cross Border Supply and Commercial Presence: Empirical Analysis on US Bilateral Trade in Service
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We argue that there exists complementarity relationship between supply mode of Cross Border Supply and Commercial Presence of trade in service. By using US bilateral service trade data and gravity equation, we try to quantify these effects. In addition, we further classified the data of Commercial Presence (FATS) into horizontal FATS and vertical FATS, and the regression results also validate our assumptions.

articleTitle: A Multi-Level Model Study of Knowledge Power in Technology Innovation Networks: A Complementarity for the Knowledge-Based View
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Knowledge-Based View (KBV) is one of the main views for studying innovation networks at present. Researches from KBV only, however, have derived some problems. Main of those is neglecting actors' role in the network by emphasizing on static attributes of knowledge rather than attributes of individual organizations and their dynamic movements. This paper believes that an actor' power or influence over other actors in a technology innovation network is one of the main ways to reflect its active role in the network. Therefore, in this paper, 1) by combining the theories of KBV, Dynamic Capability and Power Dependence, the concept of Knowledge Power is introduced into the study of technology innovation networks; 2) a multi-level model of knowledge attributes is provided according to technology innovation networks' characteristics; 3) the impact of knowledge attributes on knowledge power is analyzed based on the multi-level model, with some propositions proposed.

articleTitle: Study of Service Quality Evaluation Method Based on Gray-Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The evaluation and quantization on the service quality is a difficult problem for its research. Hazing discussed service quality evaluation models and methods, the paper constructs a new evaluation method of the service quality based on gray-fuzzy theory. Learning from the advantages of SERVQUAL and SERVPERF, the method designs evaluation indicators. By combining the weighting with the gray fuzzy mathematical model, the service quality is quantificational evaluated. The method allows the qualitative evaluation and quantitative evaluation can be a good combination.

articleTitle: Evaluation for the Performance of Engineering Consulting Service Facing Project Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyze the evaluation for performance of engineering consulting service that can be also considered as the evaluation for project management provided by engineering consulting corporation. Overall the evaluation for the performance of consulting service after the ending of engineering project is evaluated by combining the characteristics of engineering consulting service in China and drawing lessons from the correlate research findings of experts in evaluation for the performance of engineering consulting service. According to the theory of fuzzy mathematics, constructed evaluating system and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model, then confirmed the weighting of all the evaluating by Interpretive Structure Modeling method. Finally, the feasibility of the system is demonstrated through a successful case.

articleTitle: Conditions and Types of the Protection Object of the Physical Education Copyright
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the advent of the knowledge economy, the physical education course develops vigorously. The copyright protection plays a more and more important role in its development. However, the theoretic research on the protection of physical education copyright is always insufficient. After analyzing the object theory of the copyright protection and the object elements of physical education copyright, this article systematically states the types of the physical education copyright and further discusses the object nature of the special types, i.e. the sports games and sports game TV programs to try to clarify the copyright object theory of physical education and the confused understanding.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Different Communication RTK Survey Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study examines different RTK survey systems with different data communication methods. The performances of different RTK are analyzed and compared in terms of system configuration, positioning precision, operation radius, communication method, external information, and cost expense. The results show that RTK data by radio station transmission are with low reliability, high labor-intensity, and small operating radius. In contrast, RTK with mobile communication and network are with high reliability, small labor-intensity and large operating radius. However, the radio station transmission RTK requires neither external information nor data transmission cost, while the mobile communication RTK and network RTK have extra data transmission charges because of their dependency on the local wireless communication and network communication. Radio station transmission RTK and mobile communication RTK have low positioning precision, and cannot provide all-weather survey. Network RTK positioning precision is high, and can provide weatherproof survey, although the investment and maintenance costs of network RTK are higher.

articleTitle: Statistical Analyses of Credit Investment in Transmission Mechanism for Commercial Bank of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By collecting the economic data of four Chinese commercial banks from 1992 to 2006, we analyze the dynamic credit investment relationship among large, medium and small commercial banks, and quantitative describe how large and medium commercial banks play the role in the fluctuation of investment of small commercial banks with co-integration and VAR model. The results show that it is a long-term equilibrium relationship between large-medium commercial banks and small commercial banks in their credit investment, and the investment orientation of large-medium commercial banks is the Granger cause for small ones', and the credit investment of large-medium commercial banks have a positive effect on fluctuating the small commercial bank, and the transmission intensity of medium commercial bank to small commercial bank, in contrast, is much larger.

articleTitle: Long Term Evolutionary Game Analysis of Pricing in Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Currentyly¿Cthe electricity markets of most countries and regions are still at starting or developing stage. Correspondingly, many laws and regulations of electric market are still not complete, and the electricity market is still in dynamic state of development and evolution. In this paper, a electricty market evolution game model is introduced and analysis. The result indicate that by comparing of the revenue matrix of electricity generators, it can be found that PAB is the best way for promoting the stability of electricity price when the electricy is in short supply. While the MCP for electrity supplier can be best choice for promoting the electric market to stabilize the development of the equilibrium.

articleTitle: Local Residents' Attitudes and Ecotourism Development: A Case Study of Zhangjiajie National Forest Park
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research intended to explore the relationship between local residents' attitudes to ecotourism development and theirs demands in Zhangjiajie National Forest Park. The results indicated that residents' socio-demographic factors had a correlation with their perception of tourism impact; residents' community attachment had a correlation with their perception of tourism impact; residents' community attachment had a correlation with their attitude to ecotourism development; residents' perception of tourism impact had a correlation with their attitude to ecotourism development. And some suggestions were put forward that are residents' training, residents ' empowering, community benefits-making and community management.

articleTitle: The Optimization and Simulation of Automobile Production Line Based on Flexsim
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article describes the modeling and design ideas of system optimization. It takes the production line of a car factory in Chongqing for example. According to the production management and simulation theory, we use the simulation software Flexsim to establish the model of painting's key process and use it to analyse the existing congestion bottlenecks of tools, proposing two optimization schemes at last.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on the Determinants of the RMB Exchange Market Pressures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the establishment of a managed floating exchange rate regime, the fluctuations and the movements of RMB exchange rate are increasingly becoming a major concern of scholars and politicions. In this article, the sources of pressure on the RMB exchange market are quantitatively analyzed based on the Girton-Roper model and its extensions. The results show that the growth rate of domestic credit, GDP growth rates as well as the money multiplier are significant factors impacting the RMB exchange market pressure, RMB exchange market pressure is released mainly by the loss of reserves.

articleTitle: The Application of Emotional Experience Teaching Methodology in Tennis Teaching for Colleges
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A teaching program for emotional experience teaching methodology is drawn up regarding the emotional experience of students in the process of tennis teaching, and a model of teaching has been constructed in this paper to carry out the teaching tactics developed in emotional experience teaching methodology. The study reveals that the application of emotional experience in tennis teaching may help students establish good mood, and such emotional experience is of great help for students' living, working, study and health.

articleTitle: Research on Financing Risk and Its Control in BOT Projects
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to analyze the capital structure and present a simplified model to determine an optimum equity level in term of the financing scale, time limit and returns of investment for decision-makers at the evaluation stage of a BOT project, which takes place immediately after the completion of a feasibility study. The resulting model not only can help the sponsor to avoid the capital risk but offer the government a criterion to evaluate the management ability of the sponsor as well. To show the application and availability of this model, a case study is conducted.

articleTitle: The Research on Exploring E-Commerce Model for Academic Library in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the feasibility of E-commerce models in an academic library and focuses on analysis of possible e-commerce modes and the supporting library system platforms and frameworks. It gives some suggestions for an academic library on how to take advantage of e-commerce technology to carry out information service.

articleTitle: The Implementation Issues of Service Coproduction in Public Service
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service has for a long time been viewed as an interactive process during which the customer and service provider co-produce a service. Viewing citizens as co-producers of public service has also been accepted in some literatures. Although coproduction in business service and in public service has different features, the fundamental issues are almost the same when implementing the concept respectively in these two services. The purpose of this paper is from an implementation perspective to discuss the theoretical and practical implementation of the concept of coproduction in public service. A holistic viewpoint of coproduction is introduced and more building blocks for coproduction are borrowed from studies made in business service. Besides the theoretical analysis, the current research also introduces some phenomena and practices that have occurred in China in order to illustrate the issues to be discussed and to support the research.

articleTitle: On Approaches of Improving Service-Oriented Government Construction by E-Government
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service-oriented government is the demand of constructing harmonious society and transforming the function of government, whose aim is to serve the public with higher efficiency. The concept of serving people constructs value orientation for service-oriented government, the function of optimizing organization provides organizational structure for the government, and the actualizing method offers technological support to service-oriented government. Therefore, in order to establish service-oriented government and speed up the construction of e-government, both the improvement of management concept and the scientific, efficient and practical development of e-government should be paid much more attention, by doing which to give full scope to the lead role and exemplary role of informatization construction.

articleTitle: How to Identify the Leading Industry in the Service Sector for Xiacheng District of Hangzhou: Based on BCG Matrix and Location Quotient
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The growth of the service sector is a pivotal index to evaluate the economy of a region. With the development of economy and society, it is inevitable to discuss how to select a leading industry in the service sector appropriately, which is deserved to obtain support from the government. This paper focuses on the case of Xiacheng district in Hangzhou, analyzes the status quo of service sector, and discusses how to choose and support a leading industry in the service sector by using the BCG Matrix and the location quotient.

articleTitle: Monetary Transmission Effect in County Economy: An Evidence in Hubei Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The monetary policy cannot be effectively implemented in counties due to the following reasons: first, the incomplete financial market has blocked the monetary channel; second, the adoption of credit channel has been curbed by the single credit standard and deviant behaviors of county economic agents; next, informal finance has been the main provider for the counties, so that the central bank is hard to control the county credit scale. Therefore, it is imperative to integrate the informal finance into the central bank's regulatory system, making it legalized, opened and standardized so as to achieve the goals of monetary policy in the county economy.

articleTitle: Cultural Diversity and Environmental Protection of National Parks in Perspective of International Law
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Organizational culture is the personality of the organization. When traditional culture declines, the local biodiversity will be under threat, and vice versa. In order to protect national parks and keep the ethnical people to develop, the good ethnic tradition knowledge should be fully recognized and protected.

articleTitle: Study on the Measures and Basic Safeguard for Chinese Enterprises to Implement the Intellectual Property Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Agreement on Trade-related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS) makes the intellectual property right become the source of profit and an important method to measure the wealth and competitiveness of a country, region and enterprise. The transnational corporations are transferring their monopolized technological advantages into market monopoly advantage and international competitive advantage, and trying to control the domestic and international market by intellectual property right management strategy. In order to adapt to the development of knowledge economy and the domestic and international competitive environment, occupy the high point of future science and technology, industry and economy, it is imperative for Chinese enterprises to make and implement effective intellectual property right management strategy. The intellectual property right is not only a statutory monopoly right, but also a strategic weapon for enterprises to have competitive advantage in the market, which is an important part of the enterprise's core competitiveness. This determines that Chinese enterprises have to attach importance to the identification, protection, management and application of the intellectual property right from a strategic view to make it truly become the source of enterprise core competitiveness and competitive advantage. The implementation of the enterprise intellectual property right strategy requires the guidance of national intellectual property right to fully advance the intellectual property right work in respect of creation, management, protection and application. It is also necessary to build a good supporting environment to implement the enterprise intellectual property right.

articleTitle: Multinational Company Talent Localization Strategy Transformation and Enlightenment
