publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on comprehensive analysis method, researches are carried out on the multinational companies' talent localization strategy, from the talent localization levels, talent cultivation, the usage quality of the talent localization, the multinational company's talent localization strategy transformation trends are discussed and the conclusion obtained: in order to get gradually improve the multinational company personnel localization levels, researches are conducted on senior strategic management personnel. To win the battle of the talent localization, it shall pay much attraction on youth elites. To get the quality improvement of the Talent localization, the advantages of the commanding heights of the science and technology shall be taken to control and grasp the initiative for patent. Then it is proposed that Chinese enterprise shall take on the internationalization path, and learn the experience from multinational company personnel localization.

articleTitle: Research on the Problem for Knowledge Staff and Task Assignment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Considering knowledge workers team coordination in the knowledge-intensive enterprises and project task assignment, this paper quantifies the qualitative factor (team coordination) and divides the staff and task assignment costs into team uncoordinated cost, employment cost, employee switching cost and project delaying cost. And then a mixed integer programming model for the knowledge staff and task assignment is established. According to the characteristics of the problem and model, ILOG tool is adopted and appropriate strategies are selected to solve the problem. Finally, an example is used to illustrate the model's practicality and the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of Energy-Saving Service Operating Model for Building Resource-Saving Society
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces the current development status of global energy-saving service industry, and an advanced energy management model and market-oriented operation of energy-saving mechanism - energy management contract (EMC). It elaborates briefly EMC development in China, analyses the existing business operation model and the problems of the energy saving service industry. Finally, a future development model is proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis on Cooperative Game of Iron Ore Price Negotiations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, with rapid development of Chinese economy, China has more and more demands for iron ore, the foreign iron ore dependency rate has reached 70%. Iron ore price increases great high, which has a greater impact on Chinese steel enterprises and the national economy as well. Unlike the other international bulk stock market, iron ore supply market is not only a classic market, but also lacks a corresponding derivatives market. Therefore, iron ore price is decided mainly by negotiations. From the perspective of cooperation, the paper uses cooperative game theory to analyze the problem about iron ore price negotiations and gives the best strategy that Chinese steel enterprises should take in the price negotiations. That is obtains the alliance conditions between Chinese steel enterprises and iron ore supply manufacturers, furthermore, we can measure the distribution of benefits derived from the Union for China's steel enterprises. Finally, the paper gives some suggestions for Chinese steel enterprises to participate in the cooperation of international iron ore market.

articleTitle: Reviews on Why Price Dispersions Exist in Electronic Markets: A Multi-Perspective Analytical Framework
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Electronic markets are inter-organizational information systems that allow the buyers and sellers to exchange information about prices and product offerings, and have become the important virtual marketplaces matching transactions which play an increasing role on the physical markets and absorb eyeballs of researchers and practitioners. In this paper, we incorporate the proxies about price dispersion in electronic markets into the same analytical framework for research, examine the explaining strength of existing literature on electronic markets form different perspectives. Based on that, we point out that price dispersion phenomena in electronic markets result from comprehensive effects of many factors, and it is consumers' search heterogeneity, buyers' preferences including brand, trust and loyal degree factors, service differentiation and market structure characteristics that co-assume the degree of price dispersion, information value and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Management of Bleaching Powder Concentrate Production
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through summing up the actual situation of some bleaching powder concentrate enterprises in the risk management, the materials involved in the calcium production process are dangerous chemicals, and their main inherent hazardous characteristics are fire and explosion, which must not be stored or transported with organics, oils, acids, and reducing agents, and should be kept away from various heat sources, flame and so on, and combined with hazardous characteristics of chemicals, chemical reaction parameters and the status of equipment and facilities, the inherent hazardous characteristics in the production process can also be identified. Taking into account the characteristics of the hidden hazards of calcium hypochlorite and the importance of drying process, safety analysis are focuses on the drying process, and it is improper to apply liquid organic heat transfer material heater in the production process of bleaching powder concentrate, liquid organic heat transfer material heater should be replaced to thoroughly eliminate this hazard. Finally, the production plant and storage warehouse of bleaching powder concentrate belong to A fire classification, and the operation chamber of releasing chlorine belongs to B, and it is not necessary for them to carry through an overall electrical explosion-proof design.

articleTitle: Influence and Countermeasure of the Middle Route of South- to- North Water Transfer Project on the Sustainable Utilization of Water Resources in Xiangyang City
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Middle Route of South-to-North Water Transfer Project is a major strategy in our country which solves the deficiency of water resources in northern areas in 21st century through optimizing disposition of water resources, and which is also a major strategy of building well- to-do society and a systemic project related to development of the human offspring and present. The project can not only realize the optimized disposition of water resources in the areas but also accelerate greatly its sustainable development of society, economy and ecology. At the same time, there are a series of advantageous and disadvantageous affects for areas drawing out water resources with the decrease of water quantity. This paper introduces the present situation and major problems about the development of water resources in Xiangyang, and analyses the influence of the project on water resources in Xiangyang. Finally, we put forward the strategy of the sustainable utilization of Xiangyang water resources in the future.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Overseas Moderate Investment on Economic Growth of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are lots of successful experiences and lost lessons in the course of utilization of foreign capital according all of the nations, the biggest one is a fairly large scale with its national conditions. In China, FDI has its negative influence on economy as well as its contributed, how to deal with these negative influences and where is the fairly large scale will be discussed in this paper, based on the discussion, we will talk about the moderate FDI on economic growth by salary.

articleTitle: Theory and Method Research on Policy Evaluation of Hi-Tech Industrialization: A Review
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Policy evaluation is an important part to test the effects of policy implementation, also the important means to monitor the policy implementation. Policy evaluation of high-tech industrialization is to judge the value and performance of the high-tech industrialization policy, which is the important stage of the high-tech industrialization policy process. Based on the concept and development status of the high-tech industrialization policy evaluation, this paper will analyze the current mode and existing problems of high-tech industrial policy evaluation in China, so as to contribute the development of the high-tech industrialization policy evaluation.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on the Relevance of Fair Value
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Research on the fair value is always the key problem and also the crucial problem of the world accounting research, especially in the financial crisis. This paper provides data support for the empirical research of the relevance of fair value in China. By analyzing the financial data of listed commercial banks in China in 2006 and 2007 through an empirical method, the changes of explanation of book value per share and earnings per share to share price before and after the application of fair value are compared. The results show that earnings per share under fair value measurement have incremental explanatory power to stock prices. That is, the economic effect of fair value is positive.

articleTitle: Research for Crisis Management Plan and Service Types of Library Consortium
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Library Consortium is very important in library crisis management. There are three advantages in crisis event: completeness of information protection, timeliness of the information service, authority of providing information service. Design library consortium crisis plan should be the beginning of crisis event management. Determining organization is the first step, a library consortium crisis management group should include information resource experts, computer network experts, public relations experts and experts in other fields. While establishing the management group, it should be regarded as a complex system. The organization refers to the inner organization, which includes the system goal, the number of involved sections, the number of interactive sections, the durability of the participants, the basic resources. Action plan is the actual action and the priority manual of the library before, during, and after the crisis. The plans for pre-crisis are mainly to recognize and analyze the signs of the crisis, and to alarm. The plans for during crisis moment should be made according to the situation. The plans for after crisis are to find the opportunity in crisis, to learn from crisis, to discover, to cultivate, and to harvest. Several service types of library consortium in crisis event can be used, for example, crisis information release: subject website, forum, information portal. And another type is reference. The third one is crisis safety education. The last one should be community recovery intervention. While drafting a library crisis management plan, we should consider user's expectations, ability to deal with peak values of user requirements. Government regard is still very important in crisis. it should provide library consortium essential financial support and policy support.

articleTitle: Price Recovery after Soared and Slump
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Order driven market, is the main trading mechanism of the most securities markets in the world, including China's securities market. We study the phenomenon of the stock market by computational experiment in limit order model. The typical phenomenon, volatility clustering and fat tail, can be reproduced by our model. Further, after adding the trend of investors and considering various parameters, we found that market price can recover by itself after soared and slump. And momentum investors will reduce the probability of the occurrence of price recovery.

articleTitle: Fast Aggregated Model for Multi-Stage Group Decision-Making Problem Based on Preference Distance Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on horizontal and vertical information of decision, this paper firstly aggregates decision-makers' judgment in single stage to gain in-stage decision-makers' preference and weight, and to compute the preference of groups. Secondly, satisfied preference and stage weight of decision-makers between stages are calculated out according to preference distance model. Finally, the optimized judgment matrix and weight of decision-makers are computed by preference distance algorithm to gain the most optimized group's preference. Numerical example has proved that it is very effective to aggregate multi-stage group decision-making preference by preference distance method.

articleTitle: Green Supply Chain Management Based on Low-Carbon Economy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Green Logistics launched the green supply chain management. Does the green supply chain management really the guidance of the low-carbon economy? Does the green supply chain management accord with sustainable development indeed? The environment system of Green supply chain can be optimized through close cooperation between enterprises and enterprises internal departments on the industrial chain. The green supply chain management will impact the environmental protection globally. This paper analyzes the inherent relationship between low-carbon economy and green supply chain. On this basis, studies the management and characteristics of green supply chain, and last explores the realization of green supply chain based on low-carbon economy.

articleTitle: First-Price Auctions with Risk-Averse Bidders
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We consider first-price auctions with asymmetric independent private values and risk-averse bidders. We show that a bidder's expected equilibrium equilibrium bid strategy satisfies that her utility identically equal to her accumulated expected marginal utility. For symmetric first-price auctions with weakly risk-averse bidders, we give the explicit approximation expression of the equilibrium bid strategies by a perturbation method, by which we figure out the seller's expected revenue and each bidder's expected equilibrium utility.

articleTitle: Appearance Properties of Seamless Knitting Fabric Made of Triangular Hollow Nylon
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To study appearance performance of seamless knitted fabric made of triangular hollow nylon, compare with two other kinds of fibers, circular hollow nylon and ordinary nylon, and respectively test appearance performance such as fabric drapability, rigidity and flexibility, and wrinkle recovery of seamless knitting fabric samples, made of three kinds of nylon including triangular hollow nylon, further, comprehensively analyze three different nylon yarn appearance performance of seamless knitting fabric and the influencing factors. Test results show that seamless knitting fabric made of triangular hollow nylon has good appearance properties and lots of appearance properties are related to such factors as knitting structures, fabric warp or weft direction, etc.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Simulation Approach for Investigating the Evolution Pattern Analysis of Digital Creativity Considering Task Diversity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the digital age, a wide variety of digital devices are available for work and entertainment, and digital creativity has emerged as a core source of competitiveness. Thus, companies try to enhance their digital creativities to more firmly establish their competitiveness in the marketplace. The purpose of this research is to longitudinally explore the evolutionary pattern of digital creativity in order to explain how communication effectiveness, task expertise, and the tendencies of digitalists affect digital creativity. To add more rigor to the proposed research model, task diversity is included as a moderating factor. To test the validity of the proposed digital creativity model over time, we adopted multi-agent simulation (MAS) using the NetLogo platform to test the digital creativity model over 48 time lags. The experimental results revealed that the proposed digital creativity model is valid and robust enough to explain the creative activities of digitalists.

articleTitle: e-Government Challenges - From Applications to Complex Solutions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Many big organizations including Government agencies have what can be called a "multi-technological" chaos. They have in many cases hundreds of IT-applications badly coordinated and integrated. A proposed cure for this is often procurement of big and comprehensive software packages like Enterprise Systems. We argue that the procurement of this applications often are done in an old fashion way influenced by old behavior and outdated roles. This paper analyses two Swedish Government cases based on three complementary perspectives that can help the buyer and the seller to better understand the complex solutions of which the software should be a part.

articleTitle: Forecast Model of Civil Aviation Passenger Transportation Volume Based on System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to resolve the traditional forecasting methods which do not consider the factors affecting the civil aviation passenger transportation volume, this paper sets up system dynamic model to forecast civil aviation passenger transportation volume. This model can consider the main influence factors and set up scientific linking between these factors. It will help us make reasonable and scientific decision. The proposed model is also verified by simulation using statistical data and used to forecast the civil aviation passenger transportation volume in China in the next 10 years. The result shows that the model is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Incentive-Based Corporate Governance Led by Entrepreneurship
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Entrepreneurs use innovation and management talents to create rents for enterprises. From the perspective of entrepreneurs to study the corporate governance, incentive, focusing on how to maximize the play of its entrepreneurial spirit, is a relatively new research direction. This paper analyzes the private enterprises, state-owned enterprises and joint-stock companies in three different forms of ownership on corporate governance model that entrepreneurship play, and we find that entrepreneurs can influence the designation and form the governance structure, which direction that Conducive entrepreneurial to maximize the spirit of their own , creating a kind of "incentive-based corporate governance".

articleTitle: Analysis and Prediction of Equipment Manufacturing Industry Development by Gray Forecasting Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Equipment manufacturing industry is the pillar industry of our country, which plays an important role in the development of the social economic. Especially in recent years, it has become the most important engines for the economic growth. For grey forecasting model has the characteristics of a few indexes, operational convenience and can always keep pace of the updating data, so the paper makes a prediction of equipment manufacturing industry in the next five years by the way of grey forecasting model, and the result shows that the future of equipment manufacturing industry is good.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Enterprise Technology Alliance Knowledge Transfer to Promote the Development of High Technology Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to knowledge transfer theory and the characteristics of enterprise technology alliance, we empirically research on knowledge transfer of enterprise technology alliance to promote the development of high-tech industry after qualitative analysis on the basis of previous research results. By using production function model, we mainly use panel data between 2000-2009 years from 26 provinces and cities on knowledge transfer of high-tech industries related to the indicators of effectiveness for empirical analysis. The results indicate that: Knowledge transfer of enterprise technology alliance can promote the development of high-tech industry to some extent. But due to the regional economic imbalances, causing technology alliance enterprise knowledge transfer utility also presents the "east strong and weak in the west" trend, thus the country should strengthen technical alliance between high technology to promote the upgrading of the industrial structure.

articleTitle: The Research of GNH Based on Need-Hierarchy Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Gross National Happiness (GNH) is an index which reflects the quality and satisfaction capacity of the life. Firstly, this paper introduced the concept of GNH. After that, an especial GNH evaluation index system was constructed based on the need-hierarchy theory of Abraham Maslow. And then, we calculated the GNH of China from 2003 to 2007 by TOPSIS and evaluated the GNH comprehensively. In the end of the paper, we proposed some suggestion on how to treat the GNH correctly.

articleTitle: Investigation of Equivalent Axle-Number Coefficient for Asphalt Pavement with Rigid Base
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The equivalent axle-number coefficient for asphalt pavement with rigid base was investigated in this paper. Based on the elastic-layer system theory and fatigue tensile-stress principles, the relationship between axle-number coefficient for asphalt pavement with rigid base and tensile stress under rigid base was obtained. The influences on the axle-number coefficient by different structural parameters such as thickness and modulus of different pavement layers were analyzed by finite element program. And then the calculation formula for axle-number coefficient of asphalt pavement with rigid base was suggested and compared with the axle-number coefficient suggested by AASHTO. It is indicated that the calculation formula for axle-number coefficient suggested in this paper is reasonable.

articleTitle: Strengths and Weaknesses of Excellent Athletes in Track and Field of Capital College and University and Applied Research in Track and Field Training
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By using athletes who have double items in track and field events of Beijing colleges and universities held during 7 years as research object, and by making a study of individual event. The finding illustrate that there is vivid characteristic of double items in high-level amateur, and such a characteristic employed in specialized training and got a good achievement.

articleTitle: Cost Function under Complicated Flow
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The model of product function and cost function based on micro Input-Output theory plays a very important role in describing the Input-Output of the production department. However, the analysis of the Input-Output systems about non-production makes the using of this model become sort of limited. Therefore, based on the micro Input-Output theory and the theory of production and cost, after making a description of the complicated flow based on the advanced system,this paper will put forward the concepts and features of virtual node,and set up the model of cost function .

articleTitle: Environmental Analysis on Developing Productive Service Industry in Shenyang City from SWOT Methods
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With SWOT method, advantage and disadvantage, chance and threaten of developing productive service in Shenyang will be analyzed by this paper, indicating that developing productive service industry on the basis of High-Tech is significant for upgrading of industrial structure in old industrial bases. On that basis, this paper continues to bring forward strategic mode selections of economic condition applicable to different cities, i.e. knowledge development mode; cluster development mode; Chain development mode and relying on central market development mode. And analyzed the mechanism of their formation and implementation of environmental infrastructure.

articleTitle: The Balance Analysis of Institutionalized Management and Human-Based Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper elaborates the beneficial aspect and the shortage of the institutionalized management and the human-based management respectively, and from the angle of combination, studies how to balance the two management methods for building better enterprise environment.

articleTitle: Study on the Evolution Paths and Development Models of Brand Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Brand value chain involves not only micro corporate brands, but also macro industrial, regional and national brands. The evolution of the brand value chain consists of two levels, one from brand perception to brand loyalty, and the other from OEM to ODM or OBM. The brand value chain can create a unique competitive advantage when developed to value network. To achieve the barrier and synergy effects, we can shape the brand's core values to optimize corporate brand value chain, encourage the interaction of industrial cluster to upgrade the brand value chain clusters, and build regional value creation system to expand regional brand value chain.

articleTitle: Stochastic Volatility, Takeover Threats and Defensive Payout Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a dynamic model of the growth firm facing takeover threats stochastically. The formal analysis here focuses on the defensive payout strategy of value-maximizing management under the circumstances of random stock market valuation errors, and the bidders' perceived synergistic gains. By borrowing the concept of "hazard rate" from reliability theory, The model sheds light on takeover activities and the observed defensive payout phenomenon in the financial markets. It also yields novel testable implications concerning the impact of anti-takeover costs on the target firm's value over time

articleTitle: A Competitive Facility Location Problem Considering the Consumer Selection Behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To make a competitive location problem (CLP) more realistic, in addition to the online Shops that provide people another way to buy requirements, we incorporate the conditional logit selection analysis, which is very popular in behavior theory, into the competition model. When incorporating the new behavior principle, we introduce some innovative linearization technology. Using the new location model, we set a case study of Beijing to test the influence of people's behavior on location decision.

articleTitle: Estimate of Eco-Environment Carrying Capacity of Guangzhou
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Guangzhou has been experiencing rapid urbanization while it also faces great challenges in resouces utilization and environment protection. The concept of eco-environment carrying capacity(ECC) is employed to describe and evaluate these challenges. First, population carrying capacity of water resources and land resources are respectively estimated, and then a comprensive evaluation model is established to evaluate the quality or status of ECC of Guangzhou in order to understand the key factors that affect the sustainable development of Guangzhou

articleTitle: Career Commitment of Hotel Employees in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study aims to explore career commitment of employees working in the hospitality industry in China. Data were collected from main tourist cities, and a total of 790 valid data were obtained using quota sampling method. Correlation analysis and descriptive analysis were conducted to examine the relationships between demographic factors and career commitment. The findings indicate that there is a positive relationship between education background and career commitment. Compared with senior staff, young people aging below twenty-four were less committed to their career. The findings would provide insights for hotel operators in Mainland China for retaining qualified staff and practicing effective career management.

articleTitle: A Research of Comprehensive Quality Assessment of Accounting Personnel Based on the BAGA-PPC Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper adopts accelerated genetic algorithm and projection pursuit method of combining model and selects 15 chief accountants of leading enterprises as research samples to comprehensive quality assessment of accounting personnel.The results achieves that make the analysis of the complex problem through optimal cube projection direction into a one-dimensional vector for analysis and draw the assessment rankings of 15 chief accountants among all obtained,,at the same time, reflect the importance of various evaluation indicators for the evaluation of the entire population by optimizing the projection direction. Further we analysis the reasons of differences of the generated overall quality between the accounting staff and the measures of improving the overall quality of accounting staff.

articleTitle: Study on Decision of Supply Chain with Asymmetric Information of Production Cost
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The asymmetric information of production cost and the different bargaining power of enterprises in supply chain have significant impacts on operation of enterprises and supply chain. So decentralized supply chain is concerned which include two collusion manufacturers that sell products through common retailer and supposed demand is depended on prices. Behaviors of manufacturers' misreporting in the cases of manufacturer stackelberg and retail stackelberg are discussed respectively and the impacts of these behaviors on supply chain operation are analyzed. It found manufacturers' misreporting behavior will lower the efficiency of the supply chain.

articleTitle: Correlation between the Technological Progress in Agriculture and the Income of Farmers in Weifang City, Shandong Province in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this study was to assess the correlation between the technological progress in agriculture and the income of farmers in a particular region in China. The technological progress in agriculture played an important role in promoting economic growth, developing agricultural production and increasing the supply of agricultural products. However, it was proved by empirical analysis that a weak and negative correlation existed between the technological progress in agriculture and the income of farmers. That was to say, income of the farmers were not sensitive to the technological progress. Despite of the technological advances in agriculture became increasingly important, but farmers' income that was obtained from the technical advances clearly lagged behind the technological progress.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Weight Evaluation of Personnel Training Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is a conjoint effective assessing method which combines qualitative and quantitative analysis. Since it is uncertain in the process of deal with qualitative object quatificationally. In order to improve the reliability, the process should be improved in appropriate theories and methods. The weight evaluation method is presented combining AHP and computer technology. From the elementary requirement of the personnel, building the evaluation system of training to evaluate the personnel training scientific and rationally. It is shown that the method is simple and easy to operate, convenient for engineering application.

articleTitle: Component-Oriented SaaS Integration Framework Research Based on OFBiz
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Recent years the development of SaaS industry is very well. And with the development and promotion of cloud computing, more and more people come to believe SaaS will become the future model of the software industry. But currently the SaaS application platform architecture and development framework are proprietary, lack of uniform standards, and the applications are difficult to flexibly custom and assemble. In view of this situation, in this paper describes a component-oriented SaaS integration framework based on OFBiz (the apache open for business project).

articleTitle: Evaluation and Empirical Analysis of Logistics Service Quality Based on Dynamic Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In evaluating logistics service quality, some indicators are characterized as uncertainty and dynamics. To solve the dynamic fuzziness of LSQ, a comprehensive, dynamic and fuzzy evaluation method is proposed to measure the indicators. In this way, a customer-oriented logistics service quality system is established. A case problem is used to show the application of proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Behavior of Government to Promote Enterprises' Technological Innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Governments have an irreplaceable role in technical progress, but they can not be the main body instead of business. Goals of governments and enterprises in technological innovation are not consistent, so governments should build a "field" for enhancing businesses the sense of competitive edge and innovative preferences to motivate and guide technological innovation. The optimal behavior of the government should: firstly, improve the market mechanism, secondly, explore the laws on technological innovation and enhance their coordinative ability of resources, and finally conduct a survey to understand the practical needs of enterprises in technological innovation so as to give different guidance to different categories of enterprises. Optimal behavior should be measured by the probability of success, profitability and sustanability of technological innovation of enterprises.

articleTitle: Prediction Gross of China Research & Development Industry and Strategy Choosing: One Emerging Top Service Industry Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Research & development (R&D) industry is a kind of emerging top service industry. This article includes a lot of data that authors gathered, analyzing gross of China R&D industry through added value index. Predict the future gross scale through regression analysis. This can help us to establish the position of R&D industry and put forward strategies. This can also active a positive effect for China strategic emerging industries and China economy.

articleTitle: Analysis of W&F Bird Factors Affecting Group Performance Based on the DEMATEL Methods
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Qualitative more comprehensive analysis of factors that affect performance, but because of defects in qualitative methods, some indicators can not quantitative, so a comprehensive evaluation of the enterprise, while the influence of various factors can not be the size, so the master of each factor time relationship is not clear, but just to supplement the qualitative quantitative analysis of this shortfall. This example of a warm Bird Group of various factors affecting the performance analysis, and methods of using warm DEMATEL Bird Group quantitative identification of various factors to make up for lack of qualitative methods.

articleTitle: Analysis to Industry Agglomeration Degree for Changzhou Hi-Tech Zone Based on an AHP Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-criteria evaluation model for assessing industry agglomeration degree referring to Changzhou Hi-Tech Zone. By using Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) method, the model combines qualitative analysis and quantitative measurement, which is derived from Changzhou Industry Information System for Changzhou Hi-Tech Zone, resulting in a reasonable evaluation scientifically and authoritatively.

articleTitle: Research on the Management and Utilization of Teaching Archives of University
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper proposed the countermeasures and suggestions of university teaching archives Management and Development from the collection scope of teaching archives of school-department, completeness and standardization, edit and research, development and utilization of the effective approaches and the full use of modern information technology etc. Aiming to establish university faculty teaching archives scientific management system and to serve the teaching and scientific research services better.

articleTitle: Discussion on Relative Conception of Sports Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Along with the development of sports market, business operation of Olympic and other games, and reasonable development and use of sports resources after global financial storm, relative practice contents have been ahead of relative theory of sports management. Compared with physical education, sports training, health protection and health preservation, teaching material and relative theories of sports management are short in our country. Theories and practice research on sports management is universal in Occident, Japan and other developed countries in 80s, 90s of the 20th century. Through practice and research of college physical education, writing new teaching material of sports management, referring to information and literatures, and combining with status of sports management in our country, and comparing management characters between sports and other fields, the author makes discussion on relative problems of essential theories of sports management.

articleTitle: Public P.E. Human Resources' Management in Chinese Local Colleges
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In current local colleges of China, there are lots of problems on structural and functional imbalance about the allocation of sports human resource, including the gap of supply and demand between talent structures and social needs being outstanding, the function deviation between supply entity and regulation subject, the idle and lack of human resource, the unsmooth system between schools and the low sharing degree etc., which makes the application efficacy of sports human resource insufficient, what's worse, the lower profits of education are inevitable. For the sake of optimal efficacy of sports human resource and maximized educational profits, this paper reveals the problems of college human resource as to space allocation and discusses the ways to break the administrative and regional barriers of college sports human resource under the market economy condition. Finally, the direct approaches of development and management on college sports human resource are put forward. Impel the optimal allocation of sports human resource, achieve the talent distribution and build mutual helping and complementary interpersonal relationship, and promote the reasonable use of college sports human resource.

articleTitle: Citizen Participation in the Public Policy Making: From the View of the New Regulations Modified by the Ministry of Railways
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The citizen participation is a sort of activities in which the citizens attempt to take part to influence the public policy and life. It is an essential link during the policy-making process and thus causes great concerns. Taking the revised railway passenger transportation regulations by the Ministry of Railways in the end of 2010 as a starting point, this paper analyses both the influence of citizen participation on public policy making and the insufficiencies existed today, and proposes the corresponding measures to improve this condition.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation about Development and Utilization of Public Information Resource Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is a powerful tool for the evaluation of the system and is widely applied. This paper first describes the meaning and the features of public information resources; then constructs model of performance evaluation about development and utilization of public information resource with AHP; finally gives a conclusion concerning influential factors and some suggestions to the development and utilization of public information resource.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Management of Safety Cost for Water Project Construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Much research has been done on construction safety cost. However it is always on a qualitative level, little quantitative research has been done, especially on the safety cost of water conservancy construction project. In this paper, by the combined use of grey correlation model and optimal safety cost model which is under dialectical understanding, a dynamic management model on the safety cost of water conservancy construction project is given on a quantitative level. The result of using it on an earth and rock excavation project of a diversion channel shows that this dynamic management model has practical directive sense on the safety cost management of water conservancy construction enterprises.

articleTitle: The Reflection on Completing the Patterns of Training Marine Management Talents in Chinese Universities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, there are three patterns of training marine management talents including marine management major pattern, public administrative major pattern in marine universities, and marine management related major pattern in other coastal universities. The training patterns in our country's universities are diverse but not perfect, which needs improving through strengthening the talents' practice ability, deepening the curriculum system reform and etc.. Aiming at these existing problems, the paper puts forward a series of improvement strategies, such as running marine management major well, optimizing public administrative major pattern in marine universities, and reforming marine management related major pattern in coastal universities.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis on Common Civil Servants' Competence
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on behavioral event interview, we compile questionnaires to conduct a pretest and formal test, and make a research on the competence that government common civil servant should possess. By exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis, we construct and examine the government common civil servant competence model. The study shows that the government common civil servant competence model is a multi-dimensional construct which can be reflected by behaviors, the model includes 26 items and 5 dimensions as personal trait, professional ability, moral quality, service awareness and legal consciousness.

articleTitle: Early Supplier Involvement in Online Product Configuration for Mass Customization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The rationality of Early Supplier Involvement (ESI) in product development has been well recognized in terms of transforming supply chains into integrated value systems. Despite past advancements in ESI, some of the unique issues have not been addressed for ESI in e-product configuration for mass customization. As far as variety management and online configuration are concerned, the difficulties of ESI in online mass customization manifest themselves through two main aspects: (1) mass customization is facing a variety dilemma resulting from the continuous generation of product variants to meet diverse customer needs. (2) Online configuration is another crucial factor to the success of electronic product configuration. Towards this end, this paper discusses critical issues of ESI for online production customization and accordingly outlines a technical framework.

articleTitle: The Reassignment Planning for Maintenance and Repairment of Railway-Cars in Jinan Railway Bureau
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper first analyzes a few problems deeply and thoroughly. According to the requirement for the car maintenance and repairment in the cause of the transport production in Jinan Railway Bureau, a transport programming was given out for the whole location of the car maintenance and repairment in Jinan West Car-depot with an analysis to the quantity of the car maintenance and repairment task. At the same time, we demonstrated how to set a correct decision-making in the face of new situations and new challenges, and how to optimize the production-organization and how to make a concrete reconstruction scheme in accordance with the railway development as a whole.

articleTitle: Measuring the Green Informatization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Defining green informatization and taking account of China's development status and characteristics, the paper constructs an indicator system with main objective to provide policy makers with useful equipment to effectively assess and monitor the Green informatization developments.

articleTitle: The Training of Innovation Ability in Civil Engineering Education System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Innovation is the essential attribute of engineering education. The training of innovation ability is an important goal in civil engineering education. Training the applications and innovative ability of engineer is the goal of the reform in civil engineering education. "Excellent Engineer Education and Training Plan" and the Registered Engineer System requires the undergraduates and the civil engineers have the innovation capacity. This research based on the questionnaire survey and theoretical analysis, find the needs of the innovative ability of the civil engineers with the new conditions and new situation, and find the problem exists in the training of innovation ability in civil engineering education system, search for a good mothed of the training of innovation ability in civil engineering education system. This research is a new exploration in civil engineering education and training system. The research results can be applied not only in higher education, but also to continuing education.

articleTitle: Agency Costs of Engineering Project Procurement
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on asymmetric information game and principal-agent theory, by analyzing the forming reasons and connotation relationships of agency costs which occurs during the process of engineering project procurement, this paper give out the model of optimal contract and monitoring mechanism. It also analyzes the relationships between the monitoring mechanism and incentive mechanism.

articleTitle: High Turnover of College Graduates in Hotel Industry in China and Its Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to meet the needs of ever-increasing business travelers and leisure travelers, more and more large hotels have been built across China, and Chinese government has been promoting tourism and hospitality education to provide a sufficient and qualified workforce for tourism and hospitality industry since 1990s. Though as many as 181,923 students majoring in hospitality administration graduated from 852 colleges and universities in China in 2009, hotel industry still suffers from staff shortage. One reason is the high turnover rate of college graduates in hotel industry. Although high turnover rate of college graduates is considered to be a major problem in the hotel industry, there is little research examining its influence on the establishment and the reasons behind their decision to stay or leave. This study attempts to address this deficiency by studying a sample of five hotels ranging from three-star to five-star in China. The results indicate that there is an enormous amount of cost involved when losing and replacing an employee with college education, and it may cause service quality to decline and less repeat business. Employees with college education leave their employer mainly because of lack of career opportunities, low pay and the way they are treated etc. Based on these findings various HR strategies are formulated, which have wider implications for the turnover management of college graduates in hotel industry in China.

articleTitle: The Pattern of Chinese University Architecture Research Based on Institutional Research
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the problems in the Chinese university architecture, after saw about and think about, at the view of architecture and pedagogy, the article bring a pattern of Chinese universities and discussed two issues of the pattern of Chinese university architecture study: methods of the research and contents of the research.

articleTitle: The Development Strategies of Energy Service Companies in China Based on the Industry Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a vehicle for promoting energy efficiency, energy service companies play an important role in achieving China's goal in energy conservation. Based on the industry life cycle theory, the paper studies the energy service industry's life cycle in China. And according to the relationship between the industry life cycle and the enterprise development strategies, the paper draws the conclusion that China's energy service companies should take specialized development strategies and build their own core competencies.

articleTitle: Studies Based on Microcharacteristics of Emerging Technologies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Technological economy and managerial science circles are paying particular interested attention to unique micro characteristics of emerging technologies and challenges brought about by them to traditional managerial mentality and methods. This article analyzes market uncertainties of emerging technologies in the sense of concept of and research on emerging technologies; examines random dynamic characteristics of emerging technologies; summarizes influences of uncertainties to research and development of emerging technologies and to marketization process, and on this basis it makes initial choices in research and development of enterprise emerging technologies and marketization mode adopting SPACE method. This article provides us with basis for analysis and reference of decision-making for us to manage emerging technologies effectively through make-up and research of micro characteristics of emerging technologies.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Google' Digital Library and Our Copyright Protection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Google's Digital Library Project brought many prosecutions, China Written Words Copyright Society (CWWCS) has made several disputes with Google Inc.. According to our legal system, Google's digital library could not be regarded as either "Fair use" or "Legal License". While establishing digital library has much value to society, and it is also the trend of network era for information share. Today, the biggest obstacle to establish digital library is how to obtain copyright authorization, which is a legal problem should be solved quickly. Digital library is calling for legal support.

articleTitle: The Implementation Planning of Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the analysis of Chinese present construction procedure and compare it with developed countries', the existent faultiness in our procedure and its blight for project are indicated. We suggest that increasing the process of implementation planning to our present construction procedure could complete it and could improve the ability of decision-making and planning. At the same time, it can decrease the expense due to insufficient prophase prepare work. Finally, the concept, theory, method and the content of implementation planning of construction project are introduced in this paper either.

articleTitle: The Research of Food Safety Rapid Response Mechanism for Liaoning Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, China's food safety incidents occur frequently, "Sudan" incident, "Sanlu milk powder incident," "artificial milk powder incident," "lard poisoning incident," and so series of events to consumers about the discoloration. Liaoning Province's food safety crisis also continued to spread, frequent problems of food, such as "pocket fried snacks" in Jinzhou Linghai, "Golden Harvest vegetables "in Shenyang, "Haicheng soy milk incident" those are all threatening the health of the people. Because of technical backwardness, lack of strict market regulation, information system and emergency warning system is not perfect, there are still exists problems for Liaoning Province. The paper use public management theory, public economics theory, management theory, public policy theory to analysis the problems of food safety for Liaoning Province. The paper use developed countries for reference in rapid response to emergency food safety, put forward a rapid response mechanisms of food safety for Liaoning.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Dynamic Evolution of Academic Researches on Brand Equity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Brand equity has emerged as an important topic in last decades due to the growing realization that brands are one of the most valuable intangible assets the firms have. This paper identifies some of the influential work in the brand equity area, highlighting what has been learned from an academic perspective on this important topic. Getting insight into these achievements would significantly contribute to the further researches on brand equity and brand evaluation.

articleTitle: Study on Impacts of FDI on Competitiveness of China's Food Industries
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the competitiveness of China's food industries tends to decrease year by year, the effects of foreign direct investment (FDI) on the competitiveness improvement is investigated for a sample of China's food industries. Estimates of labor productivity in domestic owned plants are constructed and employed as the dependent variable. The capital intensity and plant-scale economies in domestic owned plants and the amount of foreign ownership in China's food industries are included among the independent variables in the estimating equations. The labor productivity is found to be positively related to the amount of foreign ownership in China's food industries. However, the fact that the major technology obtained by domestic owned enterprises is the outdated technology shows that the impacts of FDI on the competitiveness improvement of China's food industries may be smaller than expected. Meanwhile, the long-term dependence on the technology importation is bad for the competitiveness improvement. Only by combining the importation and learning of foreign technology with the independent innovation, can the competitiveness of China's food industries be improved.

articleTitle: On the Mechanism of Relationship Bonds Affecting Customer Commitment in Service Enterprises: On the Perspective of Personal Relationship
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the focus of relationship marketing, customer relationship may occur at the enterprise level, as well as the interpersonal level, and in some cases, the interpersonal level relationship may even go beyond the enterprise level relationship and become more important. This phenomenon exists not only in the B2B field, but also abounds in the B2C field, especially in the service business. However, there is not much research of interpersonal relationship in service sector. The existing research is mainly about salesman or business agent in retailing. After literature review we choose "bonds" and "customer commitment" as the main variables, and divide bonds into two kinds according to different connecting subjects: enterprise bonds and personal bonds, and based on this we put forward the mechanism model of personal bonds affecting customer commitment to the enterprise so as to guide managers to maintain better customer relationship by making good use of the interpersonal relationship, and to effectively reduce the risk which the turnover of key personnel brings to the enterprise.

articleTitle: An Initial Analysis on the Prevention, Control and Measures of the Financial Risks in Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: the financial risks exist objectively, however they can be managed to control as long as to have preventing consciousness, measures, counterbalance mechanism, responsible team and management. The paper mainly analysis the four kinds of the financial risks often seen. The procedures of the financial risks are normally in four aspects. The prevention and control means of the financial risks. Meanwhile, several specific measures on how to prevent and control financial risks are analyzed as the following as of the kinds of risks and the practices in the enterprises.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Strategic Choice of the Important Industries in Wuhan Based on the Grey Correlation Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Having developed for several decades, Wuhan has set up an industrial layout with steel, automobile, mechanic equipments, electronic information, petrochemical, textile clothing, food tobacco, biological medicine, energy and environmental protection, and paper-making and packing. In the coming five years, the industry in Wuhan will stride forward to the modern industrial base. So, the municipal government in Wuhan has made a strategic choice of its important industries. What is the theoretical foundation of its industrial choice? The paper applies the grey correlation model to study the topic and finally concludes that a close correlation exists between the chosen important industries and the economic development in Wuhan, which verifies the science and the rationality in choosing the important industries in Wuhan.

articleTitle: Research on Trust Governance of Marketing Channel Partnership
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Both the relational paradigm and the network paradigm of marketing channel emphasize the relationship. Namely, how to develop mutually reinforcing, long-term relationships. Under this background, trust as the means to reduce uncertainty and risk is considered to be the key factor of building and maintaining channel partnership. According to Chinese actual situation, the paper takes a theoretical exploration from the behavioral level of inter-organizational trust. The findings of theoretical analysis indicates that the five dimensions of trust: relationship investment, influence acceptance, communication openness, control reduction and forbearance from opportunism have obviously positive relationship with channel partnership; The construction of channel partnership is helpful to promote economic achievements, non-economic achievements and enterprise achievements. According to the relationship among economy variables, a conceptual model on trust governance is put forward in the end.

articleTitle: DCC Analysis of Two Stock Returns Volatility with Two Factors of MSCI Global and Europe Market Indices: Study of Thailand and Malaysia Stock Markets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper uses the Thailand and the Malaysia's stock prices of material from January, 2004 to December, 2009, discussing the model construction and their association between Thailand and Malaysia's stock markets, and also uses Student's t distribution to analyze the proposed model. The empirical results show that the mutual effects of the Thailand and the Malaysia's stock markets may construct bivariate IGARCH (1, 1) model with a DCC. The empirical results also show that Thailand and Malaysia's stock market returns present the positive relation. Namely, these two stock market returns' volatility are synchronized influenced, and the average estimation value of the DCC coefficient of two stock market returns amounts to 0.326. Also, Thailand and Malaysia's stock markets do not have the asymmetrical effect in the research data period. The variation risk of the Thailand's and the Malaysia's stock markets does not receive the effect of the MSCI global index and MSCI Europe market index.

articleTitle: Evaluation for E-Service Quality of Taobao Mall Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service has become a key to the success of a company , so does in the online-shopping , in order to improve the e-service quality and gain more economic benefits of Taobao Mall , Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to evaluate , Firstly calculate the weighted value through AHP , then use Fuzzy method analyze the example , eventually the reliability of the evaluation system is proved through examples.

articleTitle: To Exert the Role of Enterprises Culture, to Achieve Effective Human Resources Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In today's global economic integration, the competition of enterprises is the competition of talents. Today is also the era of knowledge economy, the management enterprises is the management of culture and talents. Human resources management (HRM) has a vital role in the development of enterprises. In the HRM of enterprises, enterprise culture should serve as the spirit guidance. Managers should improve the level of talent management and development, fully exert the role of enterprises culture in HRM and increase talents' core competitiveness in enterprises.

articleTitle: The Model of Trust Repair Mechanisms in Business Relations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years trust repair research was believed more and more important by Western scholars. The existing literature for interpreting the trust repair mechanism remained deficiency. Based on cognize-emotion theory, attribution theory, perceived risk theory and perceived equity theory, from the perspective of injured party, the author designs the Model of Trust Repair Mechanisms to describe the ways of repairing trust and identify the key variables in trust repair processes. Finally, the paper provides valuable insights for the corporate management and points out the limitations of this study and the future research directions.

articleTitle: Service Recovery Strategies Based on Customer "Second Satisfaction"
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service failure is determined by the characteristics of the service, so it is inevitable. This paper discusses customer buying behavior that it based on the intention of the customer service response pattern, response forms, response to the cause of complaints (or do not complain) after service failure, which discusses the formation mechanism of the customer "Second satisfaction ", and the service recovery strategy is proposed by the fair of result and the process and interaction-oriented.

articleTitle: Identification and Quantization of Core Capabilities in Third Party Logistics Based on Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid economic development, the logistics industry plays an increasing important role in China. But China's logistics enterprises lack of apparent core competitiveness. Compared with some advanced countries. through identifying and quantifying competitive factors, logistics enterprises can understand their core capability, and thus can provide higher level customer services. The study takes competitive factors of logistics enterprises as targets, identifying and quantifying the key competitive factors of third party logistics in Zhejiang of China based on Principal Component Analysis (PCA). Moreover, the study put forward focal competitive points and developing methods of third party logistics in different stages, and these findings will be useful to the development of third party logistics. The results may be have some reference for some logistics enterprises.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Performance Assessment in Mobile Commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study applies an evidential reasoning (ER) approach for risk evaluation in Mobile Commerce (MC) development. The evidential reasoning (ER) methodology is used to model the uncertainties inherent in MC risk evaluation and to aggregate the assessments of MC risk elements and components. At last, an example is solved to illustrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the suggested model. The empirical study has demonstrated how the approach can be used for the risk evaluation in MC development.

articleTitle: Principal Factors of Financing Structure: A Case Study on the Factors' Selection, Contribution and Sequence
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Abstract-To provide proper advice, we studied the principal factors of financing structure for the corporation we have chosen, including their selection, contribution and sequence in this thesis.

articleTitle: Study on Performance of the Rotor Dynamic Classifier
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to coal-fired power stations with lime limestone flue gas desulfurization of property, developed the rotor dynamic classifier, and use classification performance test model system, the influence of different operating parameters on the classified performance of the rotor dynamic classifier is studied. Analyze "the fish-hook effect" in on the partial classification efficiency. The results showed that limestone is better graded using this classifier. Serving the application of lime stone powder system provides theoretical basis.

articleTitle: Research on Food Proper-Packaging via Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Developing food proper-packaging is an important approach to solve the excessive packaging problem. The main study methods of commodity proper-packaging are concluded. Based on the requirement of proper-packaging definition, fuzzy evaluation is a good appropriate method to estimate the rationality. The evaluation system is established from the five aspects including function, economy, environment, resource and energy. The weight of items and estimation degree of each index are gained by expert opinions and analytic hierarchy process (AHP). The good case of white wine results demonstrates that the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation(FCE) method is easily operational and credible, which can provide improvement direction of packaging rationality research, and the relative factors to proper-packaging are considered in the establishment of the evaluation system, so the system is fit to evaluate different kinds of foods. Furthermore, the evaluation system and method has much reference value to evaluate other commodities.

articleTitle: Analysis & Optimization on Employee Performance Assessment Indicator System in Xuzhou Coal Mining Group
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Xuzhou Coal Mining Group is the large provincial state-owned coal enterprise groups. Its performance assessment did not realize full coverage, pertinence and clarity of assessment indicator are not high, lack of quantification and weight distribution and other issues in terms of employee performance assessment. To optimize the performance indicator of Xuzhou Coal Mining Group, scientific steps should be taken to the formulation to develop targeted performance evaluation indicator system. Indicator system should be clear, weight differently according to different job requirements, cover all employees and other measures to improve the validity and reliability of the performance assessment and achieve organizational goals.

articleTitle: Research of Port Enterprises' Cooperative Strategy on Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Emergencies have seriously affect the normal business activities of port enterprises. Aiming at using the situation of their service ability deficiency caused by unexpected events, the decision-making model in which port enterprises deal with emergencies through ability cooperation were established, and the model was solved, then the results were analyzed.

articleTitle: Multivariate Kernels in GWR Model to Identify Climatic Micro-Basins
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The aim of this work is to quantify the effect of temperature and precipitation on Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI). The relations between variables are analysed at the local level by estimating three GWR models. In an innovative way we apply some multivariate kernels to GWR models to better understand and examine the effect of spatial dimensions on spatial weights. Estimated models show a strong spatial variability of the parameters which highlights the importance of local models for this kind of studies.

articleTitle: Analysis of Operating Cost Efficiency of Sewage Treatment Plants
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recently years, the number of sewage treatment plants and the ability of sewage treatment in China have increased, but the problem of low operating efficiency still exists. This paper, by using New-Cost-DEA model to construct the operating cost efficiency model of sewage treatment plants, calculated the operating cost efficiency of 13 sewage treatment plants in Henan Province of China, trying to find the reasons of operating cost losses. The results show that factors affecting the cost efficiency of sewage treatment plants are not only related to the quantities but also to the prices of input factors. The low cost efficiency of some sewage treatment plants is not caused by the quantities of input factors, but by the prices and allocative efficiency of these input factors. Therefore, in order to reduce operating cost and raise efficiency, it is necessary to cut down the prices of input factors and optimize these factors.

articleTitle: Nonmyopic Game Analysis on Quality Control of Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to analyze the effect of different behaviors of quality control department and construction contractor on the construction project quality management model, an Nonmyopic game model of construction project quality management was established. In this model, the effect and position of social responsibility and fines were carefully discussed and the dynamic Nonmyopic procedure and stable equilibrium of construction project quality control was analyzed. The result shows that the systemic equilibrium stability has a very important and profound connection with the length of foresight which represent the influence by the utilities in the future, and that Nonmyopic equilibrium have much better performance in finding pareto optimal solution of quality control game than the traditional Nash equilibrium in quality control game.

articleTitle: Relationship between Economic Development and Environmental Pollution of Resource-Based Cities in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are few studies on the relationship between economic development and environmental pollution of resource-based cities in China. Taking SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> as a case, this paper tests the relationship using panel date from 2003 to 2008 of 46 prefecture-level resource-based cities. The results show that category of natural resources influences the pollutants emission, shapes and turning points of Environmental Kuznets Curve in resource-based cities. Non-ferrous metallurgy cities emit the most SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, while forest cities emit the least. The curve is inverted U-shaped in coal cities, ferrous metallurgy cities and non-ferrous metallurgy cities, while inverted N-shaped in oil cities, and N-shaped in forest cities. Under the same environmental policies, the city which emits the most SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> has the lowest turning point.

articleTitle: Research on Marketization of Chinese Civil Servant Training - A Case Study of Nanning City
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the scientific-technological progress and economic development, the human resource development of the Chinese government departments is faced with more and more challenges. Therefore, the major issue faced with the Chinese government is to create a high-quality talent team which is capable of adapting to new situation. Adopting Nanning city of Guangxi province as the case study and focusing on the problems existing in current civil servant training such as inadequate investigation of training needs, lack of training motivation and difficulty in assessing the training effect and etc, this paper analyzes the causes of the problems and proposes corresponding solution, which is to improve training performance through training marketization. Meanwhile, in order to promote and guarantee the marketization process of civil servant training, the government needs to Implement the Marketization of Training and Government Guarantee Mechanism and Establish evaluation and certification System of Civil Servant Training, thus comprehensively improving the civil servants' capability of coping with the challenges of the new times.

articleTitle: Application of Point Method in Job Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Job evaluation is the base for salary system design, while point method is one of the most scientific among all the evaluation methods. However in practice the effectiveness of the method is largely ignored by users. The paper aims to improve the validity of job evaluation model based on point factor method by putting forward the 12-step operational work flow, which expounds how to select the appraisal factors, how to determine factor weight and how to classify factor's grading. In the paper it is proposed that a systematic analysis and statistical procedure should be utilized to determine the compensation factors of the evaluation system; a modified analytic hierarchy process is used to determine the weight of the factors; and procedure of pretest and executive position ordering to absorb expert experience is done to modify the above mentioned methods. All the work is based on enterprise practice so the appropriateness of the method is testified. In the ends, proposed eights judgments for the work of job evaluation.

articleTitle: Researching on the Impact of the Medical Power Supply to the Electric Safety and Quality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By analyzing and studying the data of quality testing on general electric safety of the monitor and using various statistical means to analyze the impact of medical environment on the data, this paper concludes with factors on the regular pattern of the data and part of the statistical feature.

articleTitle: Service Composition Decision in Competitive Market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
