abstract: We consider the development of new service compositon product will bring expansion of demand, but also competition to service products available of integrator itself and its competitor. Therefore,we establish a model with two object, one is to maximize benefit growth by introduction of new service composition ,the other is to minimize erosion to market share availabe of the service integrator. Algorithm to solve the model and an example are given , the result indicates that the model and algorithm can get approximate solution effectively .

articleTitle: Research on the Co-Branding Strategy of Sports Event and Host City
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Development of modern sports is always accompanied with the progress of society. Sports event, as an important part of the modern sports development, has made more and more important influence on the urban and national development. As the idea of city marketing is attracting significant attention from the government, the way of upgrading city image by holding international influential sports event is extremely popular. The paper summarizes the most recent theoretic achievement in the field of sports event image and city image, analyzes the characteristics and the mutual promotion relationship of sports event and host city from the perspective of co-branding. And then, drawing on the "corporate identity system (CIS)" theory, the paper seeks to find the methods of maximizing the co-branding effect from the three aspects of philosophy fitness, behavioral fitness, and visual fitness.

articleTitle: The Office Automation System Research Based on the Product Engineering Department of an Institute
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the role of product engineering department and relationship with relevant other departments.from the communication management, project management, personnel allocation management, service management, etc., this paper analyzes, summarizes and concludes the department's management tasks. It also tease out management framework for business process optimization. It Integrates "BBSXP forum"tTechnology,"EXCEL interoperability and data processing" technology, "OUTLOOK mail management" technology, gives a practical web-based office automation systems integration design

articleTitle: Research on Customer Attributions of Service Failure and Strategies of Recovery
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service failures are inevitable in services industry. Service recovery is recognized by researchers and managers as a critical element of customer service strategy. Attribution theory provides the framework for predicting consumer responses to service failures, and plays an important role in service fields, especially in the case of service failure. Based on the large number of literature studies and analyzing customer attribution process on service failure, the authors sum up the core connotation of service failure, analyze the reasons for service failures, and propose service recovery strategies in dealing with service failure in this research.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Factors Affecting the Organizational Study Effect of the Textile Original Equipment Manufacturers in the Global Value Chain System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The global value chain system provides a possibility for the textile original equipment manufactures (OEMs) to study, absorb and learn the advanced technology, management and marketing knowledge of the transnational corporations in developed countries. The guidance of transnational corporations and the study of the textile OEMs is a kind of interaction existing in the subcontracting model, while the quality and level of such interaction affects the step of the textile OEMs in technological progress and management innovation to a large degree. To achieve the sustainable industrial upgrade of the textile industry, it is far from enough to only depend on learning from the transnational corporations. The textile OEMs should extend the organizational study and use many study methods at the same.

articleTitle: FDI and Economic Development in China: 1978-2008
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Endeavors have been made in this paper to discern the long-run relations between FDI and economic development in China in the comprehensive framework, which incorporates determinants as output, FDI, capital formation, employment, human capital and international openness. VAR Impulse Response, Variance Decomposition, Johansen Co-integration and VECM have been estimated, focusing on the long-run structural relations; findings indicate that in the long run, FDI tends to decrease economic growth; economic development in China seems to be fueled by domestic capital accumulation and employment growth; FDI inflows do crowd out domestic capitals, and reduce employment growth, whilst the latter increases the former.

articleTitle: Status Quo and Management Strategies of Chinese E-Government
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-government is the organic combination of information technology and government management function. The significance of carrying out E-government construction in China mainly include: upgrading officials' operation ability; changing official's thinking; unifying officials' working style in backward regions; promoting officials' consciousness of contributing efforts to the people. In order to promote the development of Chinese e-government, the high-level political leaders should advance the performance management and appraisal legalization. The government should offer public services through Internet. It is also necessary to make full use of advanced technologies, establish post-relief system of the government performance management and appraisal, and make a basic law about governments' performance management and appraisal legalization. Moreover, the government should also build a scientific and reasonable evaluation system for Chinese E-government performance.

articleTitle: Driving Mechanism for Service Industry Cluster in E-Business
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-business service industry is a new branch among sections of service industry and mainly provides service for e-business applications. Though e-business has broken the space limitation, cluster is an obvious feature. This paper, through deep analysis of its driving mechanism for cluster, found that knowledge spill-over, learning effect and innovation requirements are the endogenous mechanism, while market mechanism, scale economies and the effect of absorption and polymerization are the exogenous one. The cluster of the service industry in e-business is developing under the mutual effects of the two mechanisms.

articleTitle: Study on Establishing the Ensuring Policies of State-Owned Forestry Tenure System Reform Based on Forest Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: State-owned forest property system has broken the state of a single operating management mode. It has formed the state of the private property of the diversity of management body , it provides the opportunity and challenges for the sustainable development of state-owned forest resources . The natural trait of forest resources is not suitable for the implementation of the decentralized family management, but in view of the development of country and the state-owned forest resources and implement the reform of the state-owned forest property system is an effective measure for solving all problems and conflicts of state-owned forestry development. From the complication of state-owned forest resources, it needs government's policy of effective control to reform for the State-owned forest property system to ensure success ,at the same time, it can protect forest resources' sustainable management .The essence of state-owned forest property system reform should be to improve forest management efficiency. Therefore, it needs to establish, and gradually perfect the relevant policies, institutions and protect forest sustainable management and ensure the success of the reform of state-owned forestry right.

articleTitle: Interests Analysis of IPO for China's Listed Small and Medium Companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article analyzed IPO data of China's 561 companies in SME board and 186 companies in GEM board, and claimed that the new IPO system implemented in June 2009 provided opportunity for high-priced, high price-earnings ratio IPO. Underwriters and the former major shareholders became the beneficiaries and the largest driving force because of their profit-driven behavior. In the current external environment, to implement market-oriented IPO pricing system, we must address two key questions: (1) the inefficiency or weak-form efficiency of secondary stock market, and (2) irrational quote tendency of institutional investors who involved in inquiry.

articleTitle: On Preservation Notarization of E-Contract
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the Internet economy, more and more transactions are carryoing out by means of conclusion of the electronic contracts which result in all kinds of special risks in electronic contracts, and which need to be controlled by the law. Preservation notarization builds security barrier for electronic contracts through its legal power and notarization technology, effectively reducing the legal risks of electronic contracts, protecting e-commerce activities.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis on Shanghai Service Industry Foreign Direct Investment's Effect on Industrial Structure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, foreign direct investment focus from manufacturing to service industry.This article has tested the Cointegration and Granger causality between the growth of FDI in Shanghai's service industry and the optimization of Shanghai's industrial structure.And the result shows that there is long-term relationship between them and the growth of FDI in Shanghai's service industry can promote the upgrading in Shanghai's industrial structure,but the optimization of Shanghai's industiral structure doesn't cause the growth of FDI in Shanghai's service industry. Based on the results,the article also gives some suggestions on how to utilize FDI efficiently.

articleTitle: How to Build up Company-Managed Online Brand Community to Implement SMEs Branding? Inspirations from Empirical Investigation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: One of primary factors that hinders the development of SMEs (small and medium-sized enterprises) is their relatively backward brand building. The traditional view is that SMEs, because of their limited resource, cannot make great achievements in branding. However, the increasing impact of Internet leads to great changes in models and means of brand building. Currently, with their online brand communities developed, a certain SMEs have won the brand awareness among the customers, and thus promoted the development of the enterprises. Based on the case studies of MEIZU Technology Co., Ltd., a local enterprise in Zhuhai, China, this paper proposes some strategies and methods as references for SMEs to implement their online brand communities in digital age, in support of their brand building.

articleTitle: Evaluation for Efficiency of the Innovation of Shenyang Economic and Technological Development Area
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By using the three-stage model, this paper divides the innovation activities of regional innovation system into the technical output stage, the economic output stage and the social benefit output stage, and uses the model in the Data Envelope Analysis method model to make the evaluation of technical efficiency, economic efficiency and social efficiency of innovation activities of regional innovation system respectively, and propose policy suggestion.

articleTitle: Urban Risk Management Based on Urban Climate Analysis - Take Dalian as a Case
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Take Dalian as an example, analysis the urban climate environment and find out the factors that affect urban climate change characteristics. Propose the recommendations of urban planning and management in Dalian to guide the city development pattern, adjust and improve city spatial planning on different scales, in order to build a healthy and comfortable living environment.

articleTitle: Study the Evolution of Emerging Technologies from Multi-Agent Perspective: A Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Today science and technology takes an increasingly important responsibility in promoting economic growth and social development. For developing countries, the development of emerging technologies is a shortcut to catch up with developed countries. In order to help government better manage emerging technologies, it is necessary to understand its evolution process. However, the existing research approaches have some limitations. This paper proposes to explore the evolution of emerging technologies from a multi-agent perspective, surveys state-of-the-art studies and points out some future research directions.

articleTitle: The Cluster Matrix of Bank Personal Financial Customers Based on Perceived Risk and Perceived Benefit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Basing on the special characteristics of financial products, this study develops the dimensions of perceived benefit and perceived risk and explores the impact of various dimensions to overall perceived benefit and overall perceived risk. Meanwhile, according to perceived benefit and perceived risk, financial customers can be divided into different groups. This study develops the cluster matrix of bank financial personal customers innovatively.

articleTitle: Research on Foreign Exchange Risk Management of China's Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The People's Bank of China announced on July 21, 2005 that China would begin to implement a managed floating exchange rate system based on market supply and demand, with reference to a basket of currencies. This means that the RMB exchange rate fluctuations will become more frequent, the exchange rate risk faced by enterprises will increase. The study validated that risk management is a tool used to protect shareholders' value and ensure the company's continued successful operation. This paper made identification and measurement of foreign exchange risk and it propose that by adopting appropriate foreign exchange risk prevention tools, the enterprises can establish foreign exchange risk precaution mechanism with their own characteristics so as to reduce the loss caused by exchange rate change.

articleTitle: The Impact of China Industrialization on Higher Education - Based on Investigation to Reality in Inner Mongolia
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The book "China Industrialization Progress Report" shows that China has entered to middle stage of industrialization. One of the prominent features of the industrialization is development of industry and continuous increasing of employee number for industry in the total employee number. Through relevance study it is proved that mutualism relationship exists between the industrialization development and education. The article mainly analyzes the industrialization takes pushing role to higher education development by taking the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region as an example.

articleTitle: Experience from Social Assessment of Investment Projects Financed by International Financial Organizations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: International organization's policy system for social assessment is a relatively sophisticated policy framework, under which social assessment follows the sociological paradigm in terms of policy, concept and operating standard, social factors are well incorporated into projects for investigation, attention is paid to the interests of vulnerable groups such as the poor, women, displaced persons and ethnic minorities, the positive and negative impacts of a project are studied, and necessary social actions are taken to forecast an d evade potential social risks. The need for social assessment has developed gradually with foreign investment in China, social assessment was started lately and there are still some gaps from the requirements of the international financial organizations, Accordingly, it is very necessary to draw experience from international financed projects and build a policy system and operation manual for social assessment conducive to China's development.

articleTitle: Analysis of China's Oil Self- Sufficiency
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, with its sustained and rapid economic development, the contradiction between supply and demand on China's petroleum is daily outstanding, and it makes the dependence rate of foreign oil resources going higher and higher. With the method of time series analysis and based on the data of China's oil self-sufficiency and proven reserves from 1980 to 2009, ARIMA models which is used for forecasting China's oil self-sufficiency in this paper is established, and solutions to deal with the oil problem are proposed.

articleTitle: The Incentive Mechanism of AA Company
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the background of incentive mechanism of AA Co., first analyzes the current situation of incentive mechanism, and then has an in-depth understanding of incentive mechanism of the company. Based on motivation theory analyzes the incentive situation in qualitative and quantitative way, and find the main problems existing in the incentive mechanism, and the reason of negative of staff. Work out a corresponding adjustment strategies according to the problems. It can be attract talents, and motivate employees to a great extent, and form a set of good incentive mechanism and enhance the overall competitiveness of the company AA.

articleTitle: Research on Web-Based Evaluation Information Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper built an integrated network information service platform for group of graduate candidates, and integrated the information resources on the the evaluation of personnel and educational by web technology, and provided the information service about personal diagnosis and consulting, exploited the values of information on evaluation fully. This paper constructed an evaluation model, which implemented the automatic matching of the user's psychological characteristics (the object of personnel evaluation) and the subjecs and professions (the object of educational evaluation).

articleTitle: A Quantitative Model of Transformation of Project Organization in Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A four-phase model based on Markov chain is developed by this paper to describe the transformation process of project organization. Compared with existing research methods, the proposed model, which combines the advantages of both qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis, provides a new approach into managing organizational transformation and it shows that the transformation of a project organization is influenced by different factors but mainly depends on the comparison of operational inertia and changing pressure. Finally, an example of simulation given by this paper validates this proposition.

articleTitle: Research on Measures of the Disaster Prevention and Rescue in Super-Long Railway Tunnels
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Disasters that may occur in the super-long railway tunnel were summarily described and a study focused on the measure of the disaster prevention and rescue when the train gets fire inside the tunnel was conducted. First, the characteristic of the railway tunnel fire was introduced, and the measures of the disaster prevention and rescue to relief the disaster when the tunnel fire occurs were discussed secondly in this paper. Finally, it summarized the scheme of the disaster prevention and rescue to relief the disaster when the fire occurred in the super-long railway tunnel, and the basis for optimizing the design and the construction was provided. It may have a vital practical significance to the perfection of fire emergency rescue and safe evacuation plan in super-long railway tunnels in China.

articleTitle: A Study on the Main Restricting Factors in the Construction of Central Town in Tangshan and Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The construction of central town is one of the important task of Tangshan in the process of the coordination of rural and urban development, restricting factors involved are as follow: separate urban-rural household registration system, short of construction land resources and the imperfection or missing of financing system ,etc. To solve these problems, the following countermeasures should be taken: growing economic strength of central town, reform the central town household management system, perfect the intensive land use mechanism, perfecting social security system and upgrade rural production factor value.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism and Evaluation of Fiscal Revenue Policy's Employment Effect
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an important mean of macro-economic control, fiscal policy is used to promote employment, which is feasible and effective. After briefly introducing the unemployment theory of development economics, employment theory of anti-classical economics, and unemployment theory of Marxist theory, this paper analyzes the China's employment situation, and discovers that the urban unemployment is expanding, employment declining in rural areas, and employment for college graduates not optimistic. With the empirical formula proposed by U.S. economist Okun, this paper demonstrates the employment effect of fiscal revenue policy, establishes an evaluation model for the employment effect, and comes up with the result that there is a positive correlation between the changes of the unemployment rate and the changes of the taxes, and the correlation depends on the changes of the parameters. Besides, the reason why fiscal revenue policy fails to have employment effect is discussed, and according to the statistics of China's fiscal revenue, fiscal revenue policies are put forward to facilitate employment.

articleTitle: Constructing and Scaling the Gross National Happiness Index of Farmers in New Countryside Building of Shaanxi Province - Empirical Analyses on the Base of Comprehensive Fuzzy Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article explores the meaning of GNH brought up, analyzes the factors effecting GNH of farmer and constructs the Indexes of Farmers in new countryside set up, furthermore, scales it in the sample of survey data of two contrysides in WuGong county of Shaanxi province, with the empirical analyses on the base of comprehensive fuzzy evaluation, and catches up with some suggestions in leving up the Happiness Index of Farmers at last.

articleTitle: Risk Evaluation of PPP Project Based on Matter-Element Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The risk evaluation of PPP project is researched by matter-element theory. Considering each risk factor of PPP project, the risk evaluation index system of PPP project is established. Based on the definition of evaluation grade, it determines the evaluation district matter-element matrix, traditional matter-element matrix, computes the weight of evaluation index and synthesized relating subordinateness. Finally, the risk factor degree of PPP project is obtained and an example accounting for the application of the model is provided. It is concluded that this method has conceptual clarity and simple calculation, it can assess the degree of risk factors and be able to provide with higher precision.

articleTitle: The Realization of the WM8350 Charge Drive Based on WinCE6.0
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the mobile embedded products developed, the power management has becoming an important technical specification. To some extent, it has been the organic composition of the mobile embedded products. In this project, it has realized the WM8350 charge driver based on WinCE6.0, which can supply power for any mobile embedded products by USB, power adapter or other ways.

articleTitle: Land Resources Optimization Allocation Based on Smart Growth
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Land resources optimization allocation has great effect on optimizing the industrial structure and distributing the rational productivity. Smart growth is the theory that mainly solves the problem on uneconomical, improvident, inefficient use of land resources in extensive growth and expansion. Thus it can be seen that smart growth can provide a very good guidance to land resources optimization allocation. In view of this, the paper attempted to make a study on land resources optimization allocation based on smart growth in Tongshan, Jiangsu Province. Firstly, on the basis of penetrating analysis of the connotation of the land resources optimization allocation and smart growth, the paper constructed a theoretical framework of land resources optimization allocation based on smart growth. Then, some optioned schemes were obtained by the traditional model of Grey Multi-Goal and Dynamic Programming. Finally, the optimal scheme for land resources optimization allocation based on smart growth was selected by the grey relational analysis method.

articleTitle: The Research of Port Competitive Strategies Based on Quantified SWOT Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the acceleration of economic globalization and regional economic integration, the competitive surroundings in face of the ports become increasingly complicated. In order to survive in the severe competition, it's crucial to formulate an applicable development strategy by using the scientific and reasonable method. SWOT analysis is widely used in the field of strategic decisions currently, but there is a certain arbitrariness and subjectivity owing to the lack of quantified analytical process. In this context, Quantified SWOT model is established to solve this problem. Firstly, this paper divides the port environment factors into two parts, the internal and external, each containing several factors. Then, Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is applied to divide the factors of the two parts into three levels in order to calculate the weights of all the factors from the bottom to the top. As the scores given by expert's grading method being combined with the above weights, the final scores of each factor are received to classify them into the four aspects: strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats. With the total scores of the four aspects, four-dimensional coordinate system is constructed to choose the right strategies. At the end of this paper, a case of Zhoushan Port is put forward to explain the application of the method, which provides a reliable theoretical basis for the port to make competitive strategies.

articleTitle: Research on the Measurement of IT-Business Alignment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We provide a review of the measurement literature in IT-business alignment, addressing questions such as: What is IT-business alignment? How to measure and assess IT-business alignment? What benefits can reasonably be expected from IT alignment? In this article, the different fit models and capability maturity model perspectives on the measurement of IT alignment are analyzed. We propose integrating views and suggest future directions, the study is intended to be useful to faculty and practitioners seeking to assess the 'state-of-play'.

articleTitle: FDI and Employment by Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aiming at exploring the specific relationship between FDI and employment of three strata industries in the particular literature of china, EG co-integration method and Granger causality test is applied to identify the long-run relations and short-run linkages between FDI and employment in each of the industry via distributed lag model; for further investigation of short-run disequilibrium, first-order and second-order ECMs are created to assess the short-term deviation. Findings indicate that for secondary and tertiary industry, growth of FDI in the long run would promote employment, particularly for the tertiary industry; in the short term FDI has limited and even negative impetus on employment, but the latter indirectly increases the former, which has significant implications for policy prescription.

articleTitle: Modular Biochar Torrefaction System for Rural Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The prototype and a new design of modular biochar torrefaction system were devised here, as a spin-off from "2010 Project on the Promotion of Green Community in Chiayi County" in Taiwan. Results from the batch tests using the prototype confirmed that the ratio of biochar to fuel in terms of CO2eq is greater than 1.0 for densely-packed materials such as camper wood (Cinnamomum camphora (L.) Presl) and bamboo (Dendrocalamus latiflorus Munro), and less than 1.0 for loosely-packed rice straw (Oryza sativa). Note that the dried weight densities are 157.6, 150.4 and 37.4 kg/m3, respectively. Therefore, a new design was proposed based on the 200 kg straw bale of density of 147.1 kg/m3. However, the feasibilty will not be assessed until its completion in the near future.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Consumer Trust in B2C e-Commerce in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Consumer trust has been more and more recognized as an important factor for a successful e-commerce vendor. Based on the previous research, this paper developed an extended model for analyzing the main attributes of trust of the users in China. A survey regarding the trust of e-commerce users is conducted to empirically test the model. The result shows the perceived reputation and size; the level of multi-channel integration, the system assurance, consumers' propensity to trust and experienced-based familiarity are all positively related with consumers' trust in the vendor. The findings may provide the suggestions for the vendors to consider the trustworthy by the consumers.

articleTitle: The Potential Opportunities and Challenges of E-Government
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Electronic government (e-government) intersects many legislative issues, including privacy, digital divide (the lack of equal access to computers, whether due to a lack of financial resources or necessary skills), public access to government information, service delivery, and information security. E-government solutions are prominently represented in efforts to improve the management and efficiency of government information technology resources. This paper defines the definition of e-government, introduces the development and the types of e-government at first, and then outlines some of the major potential opportunities and challenges of e-government.

articleTitle: Research on the Procurement Platform for MRO Materials Based on E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The enterprises are purchasing more and more emphasis on the control of purchasing cost since the competition grew. But many companies paid more attention to the control of purchasing cost since the competition grew. But many companies paid more attention to purchasing cost control only on the production of materials. So that, even though the cost of procurement of materials production declined, but because of non-productive procurement costs of materials not decline. While non-productive cost of procurement of materials procurement costs account for very large enterprises, and possession of a large number of procurement time. This article proposed E-commerce-based procurement of MRO industrial supplies platform that integrates MRO materials suppliers, MRO customers, logistics providers and other related businesses with the MRO materials based on the domestic MRO procurement status. Through the integration, the supply chain of MRO can be achieved lowest cost, highest efficiency, to improve the competitiveness of the supply chain purposes.

articleTitle: Research of the Evaluation and Selection to Human Resource Management Outsourcing Service Provider
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The selection of outsourcing service provider plays a key role in the outsourcing of human resource management. The scientific evaluation to the outsourcing service provider is an important part in reducing outsourcing risk. In this paper, by using the Delphi method we determine the selection criteria of service provider and build a scientific outsourcing service provider selection and evaluation system. We get the result of how to select and evaluate the service provider, which can fully reflect the practical need of the enterprise in Chinese outsourcing market which is still in the initial stage. Besides we provide detailed procedures of selecting service provider, which could be a reference to the outsourcing service provider selection.

articleTitle: Study on Evaluation Indexes and Methods of Construction Project Standardization Level
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to set up evaluation model and criterion, the index system of construction project standardization level were designed by induction. The index system consists of 4 first-degree indexes: Standard level Indexes, Implementation Indexes, Benefits Indexes and Efficacy Indexes, and 14 second-degree indexes. Then some evaluation method were analyzed by antitheses, combining weighed method were put forward to solve weighted calculation of all indexes and grey multi-hierarchy comprehensive evaluation to solve evaluation of efficacy indexes. Finally one composite index can be got to measure construction project standardization level.

articleTitle: The Applied Research of the Spatial Defining Methodology of Metropolitan Area - Taking the Pan-Guangzhou Metropolitan Area as an Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As one of the geographic units in the progress of a country's integrated strength, metropolitan area is the powerful engine in the development of economy. Essentially, metropolitan area consists of a core city which has strong economic potential and radiating capacity as well as several neighboring cities. Due to the "distance decrement", it represents a relatively obvious circle-layer mode as moving outward. For example, the single-center metropolitan area is represented by "nucleus area (layer) - close-related layer - periphery layer" from the inside out. A clear understanding of the spatial scope of metropolitan area is the foundation of research. According to Gao and Luo, there are some basic principles when dividing the regional economy of China, such as centering on the core city, depending on the urban system, linking by the quality of transportation, and considering the consistency of administrative division and economic division. However, the development of Chinese metropolitan area has faced several bottlenecks: administrative barriers, market order, the allocation of interests and so on. It would be difficult to have a breakthrough in the development of metropolitan area unless those key problems were solved.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Perceived Risk Dimensions of Online-Shopping Infant Commodity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, Cronbach alpha coefficient, factor analysis and structure equation model are applied to analyze the reliability and validity of questionnaires and the fitting degree between data and model. Conclusion presents that the online-shopping perceived risk of infant's mother can be divided into 8 dimensions: judgement risk, information risk, product risk, payment risk, data transmission risk, online-shopping operation risk, distribution risk and after-sale service risk. Among them, product risk plays a "veto by one vote" role. So enterprises who sale infant commodity online must propagandize product safety firstly, but other measures are also very necessary for lowering online-shopping perceived risk of infant mother effectively, such as creating online famous brand, more paying attention to feedback suggestion from online consumer, strengthening relationships with medias and attaching importance to details of online-shopping operation, etc.

articleTitle: Performance Measurement of Local Government's Public Service Quality Management Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Local government's public service quality management performance has four fuzziness features: the complexity of performance structure, the non-marketing output of service quality, the non-discreteness of management performance, the uncertain boundary of management performance. So the fuzzy comprehensive model based on the fuzzy mathematics theory becomes the realistic choice to measure its performance. In this paper, we attempted to design the index system in four dimensions: operation performance, customer satisfaction degree, and tried to intercept the index system of operation performance to fix the weight of the corresponding first-level indicators and second-level indicators with the method of experts' opinion, empirically analyzed the local governments' public service quality management performance with the model of fuzzy comprehensive measurement.

articleTitle: Lean Production Assessment: Case Study in Auto Parts Companies from Brazil and Spain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The lack of a coordinated and structured way in the Lean Production implementation may result in poor and disappointing results. In this way, identification and measurement of best practices, followed by the evaluation of its usage level in the organizations, is the way through which the Lean Production may be reached, focusing the elimination or minimization of waste. The purpose of this paper is to present a field research carried out within companies of the automotive sector, analyzing the adherence level in Lean Production implementation, being the data collected in Brazilian and Spanish companies. In order to do so, the main groundings of Lean Production are presented, the analysis on the adherence level is performed by using the SAE J4000 standards and the results are obtained considering a statistical analysis of the data. The obtained results offer to the organizations some outstanding points regarding the Lean Production practices implementation.

articleTitle: Research on Informationalization of Resourced-Based Enterprises - A Case Study of X Steel & Iron Company
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyses the application characteristics of information to resource-based enterprises, illustrated that the informationalization of resource-based enterprises is a crucial approach of developing their circular economy. The paper takes X Iron & Steel Company as an example, analyzed the current situation of informationalization construction of X Iron & Steel Group Co., Ltd, and suggested that to eatablish E-business platform based on supply chain coordination commerce is the current focus and would direct its future informationalization.

articleTitle: Performance Measurement of Knowledge Sharing Based on Knowledge Capital
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: the focus of knowledge management is Knowledge Sharing (KS). But how to measure KS performance scientifically is not defined. Knowledge capital (KC) is introduced to measure the efficiency & extent of knowledge sharing, by analyzing how KS contribute to three dimensions of KC respectively, and finding three dimensions be "main force"," field force", "drive force". Finally its indicators and model are designed & testified by demonstration, and its conclusion is that it is feasible to measure KS performance through knowledge capital angle.

articleTitle: A Study of the Competition and Cooperation on Container Transportation between Shanghai Port and Ningbo-Zhoushan Port in the Age of Big Bridge: From the Perspective of Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Many of the container sources' hinterlands of Shanghai Port and Ningbo-Zhoushan Port are overlapping, so there's no doubt that the competition between the two ports is very fierce. This paper first analyzes Zhoushan and Hangzhou Bay Crossing Sea Bridges' influence on the container transportation of Shanghai and Ningbo-Zhoushan Ports and then studies the issue of competition and cooperation of the two ports' container transportation from the perspective of game theory. At last, this paper discusses the strategies of cooperation between Shanghai and Ningbo-Zhoushan Ports in container transportation.

articleTitle: The Research on the Influence of Foreign Exchange Rate on the Outsourcing: Chinese Case Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The driving factors of outsourcing is always regarded as exogenous variable, but followed by the obvious trends and increased fluctuations of foreign exchange rate, the influence of foreign exchange rate on the outsourcing is changing into an endogenous variable. This paper which based on the labor product rate of Two-country model of Antra`s(2004) and Two-country model of Ping Lo (2007) constructs Two-country model of the influence of foreign exchange rate on the outsourcing. This model has researched the influence of the trend and the cycle of exchange rate and the per wage rate to the outsourcing which is also proved by a derivative process. These propositions have testified by the China case time series data from 1994 to 2009 which conclude that influence of the trend and the cycle of exchange rate, the per wage rate and the per GDP to the outsourcing is remarkable. And so the foreign exchange rate could be not excluded from the analysis framework which should be included to the driving or decided factors of outsourcing.

articleTitle: Study on the Financial Risk Evaluation of Listed Companies Based on Grey System Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of China's capital market, the financial risk profile of listed company is becoming increasingly vital. By taking the financial risk profile of listed companies as a grey system, this paper presents a financial risk evaluation method and a corresponding model according to the grey system theory. The indicator system is built after the analysis of commonly used indicators in financial risk evaluation. The reference series and comparative series are then obtained by building of eigenvalue matrix and its normalization. After that, the level of financial risk evaluation is determined by calculating the degree of grey correlation of the comparative series. Financial data from 11 listed companies are used to verify the proposed method and model.

articleTitle: Study on a Evaluation Index System of High-Tech Development Zone Brand Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the analysis of relevant literature on brand competitiveness, the paper focuses on the design ideas of hi-tech zone brand competitiveness evaluating indicator system, the selection approach and principle of evaluating indicators, and establishes a hi-tech zone brand competitiveness evaluating indicator system containing hi-tech zone brand strength, hi-tech zone brand vigor and hi-tech zone brand charm indexes, from the entry point of the source of hi-tech brand competitiveness. The hi-tech zone brand strength thereof is the basis of the hi-tech zone brand competitiveness, the hi-tech zone brand vigor is the source of the hi-tech zone brand competitiveness, and the hi-tech zone brand charm is the value realization of the hi-tech zone brand competitiveness.

articleTitle: Establishing the Index System for Performance Measurement of Local Government's Public Service Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Performance measurement has become the focus in local government's public service quality management. This paper attempted to establish an index system to measure its performance from four dimensions: operation performance, customer satisfaction degree, financial performance and human resource performance. The methods of membership degree analysis and correlation analysis were used to systematically construct the index system. Through two rounds of scientific evaluation, 37 indicators constituted the final indicators system. The system covered the requirements to the government's organization from the performance results of the Standard of Performance Excellence Measurement, and the quantity was appropriate for operability. The validity and reliability testing had been applied in measuring its content and structure. Most indicators can well reflect main characteristics and measuring requirements of the measuring targets. Meanwhile, its internal structure was basically consistent, and reached the basic requirements of appraisal theory.

articleTitle: The Research Review of Service Innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As far as service innovation was concerned, the paper summarized and analyzed its research achievement at home and abroad from some aspects, such as concept, mode, research method and development. It considered that the basic research represented by innovation database was still inadequate, the research of service innovation tended to unification on the integration method gradually, the research tended to case study and the evaluation system needed to be improved and unified.

articleTitle: Marketing Model Based on Lifestyle: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the degree of market competition intensifies, it is more and more important for a company to do effective market segmentation and to satisfy the consumer's requirement. The lifestyle marketing is very important in our life. Lifestyle marketing has become a new marketing model, and is used successful in many industries. This article studies what lifestyle marketing is and how we can use it in our actual sales by a case study. We gives out a normal pattern that more and more companies can take this pattern as a reference.

articleTitle: Customer Segmentation and Evaluation Based on RFM, Cross-Selling and Customer Loyalty
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the scope of customer value and bring forward special definition of customer value. Also, we analyze customer value according to current value, potential value and customer loyalty. And we propose a model to classify customers into sixteen categories based on Self-Organization Map.

articleTitle: Cost Evaluation for Hydropower Construction Using Multiple Monte Carlo Simulation Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Quantifying and minimizing the risks associated with schedule and cost in hydropower construction are the main challenges for all parties involved. Under the impact of uncertain factors such as meteorological factor, there is a great uncertainty in the construction schedule of hydropower construction, accompanying with the occurrence of cost risk. This paper establishes the cost evaluation model using multiple Monte Carol simulation method discusses the uncertainty and distribution of construction cost. By use of the probability theory and Monte Carlo simulation method, a scientific calculation method and procedure were worked out for construction cost. The 95th percentile project schedule value, its corresponding cost value, and the percentile ranking of the cost were recorded, and the conditional percentile ranking of the cost values were determined. Finally, in order to quantify the relationship existing between the percentile ranking of the cost and its corresponding cost value, the regression analysis models about them were founded and compared, and the high confidence percentile estimating values for cost and schedule were required simultaneously. Having the ability to accurately quantify this relationship enables the selection of high percentile level values for the hydropower construction cost estimate and schedule simultaneously.

articleTitle: AHP-Entropy Weight Method in Investment and Financing Decision-Making of Project - Study on Ecological Restoration Project in Taihu Lake
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Study on investment and financing decision-making of ecological restoration in Taihu Lake is a new proposition. To ensure the sustainability of governance, the optimal investment and financing programs must be established for the long-term process, which from "local improvement" to "General good governance". Through the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) analysis and entropy weight adjusted weight on the ecological restoration project for the Taihu Lake, the best investment and financing program is franchise financing, followed by loans from financial institutions. And in practice, this paper deals with some countermeasures of absorbing the World Bank loans, innovative use of financial derivatives and setting up a funding chain of ecological management.

articleTitle: Insurance Intermediary and Cost X-Efficiency of China's Insurance Firms
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The efficiency of insurance companies directly reflects their core competitiveness. This paper uses a stochastic frontier approach to investigate the cost efficiency levels and their evolution of 23 insurance companies in China from 2005 to 2008. The main objective is to assess whether insurance intermediary's development affects cost X-efficiency. A one-stage regression model is applied to identify the significant variables influencing X-efficiency. The results show that insurance companies are operating 40-50% below the X-efficiency frontier on average and it appears that the insurance intermediary's development and risk status has a notable impact on insurance company X-efficiency.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Model Research of Port Logistics Function Based on AHP-FCE
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The port logistics' development is deserved more and more attention, in order to enhance the competence of the port, we need to evaluate the function of the port logistics and construct the evaluation model.The AHP-FCE method was used which combines methods of the Analytic Hierarchy Process and the Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation, Firstly we determine the weight of every index of the model, and evaluate the port logistics' function, than using the empircial research to verify the correctness of the evaluation model. The results of the empricial research show that the model can evaluate the function of the port logitics, and the calculation is simple, it has some practicablicity.

articleTitle: A Modeling Approach to Hierarchical Location Problem of Vessel Traffic Accident Emergency Resource Station in Yangtze River
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to make the site selection of emergency resources for vessel traffic accident in Yangtze River more scientific and reasonable, this article puts forward two-phase hierarchy location selection process with consideration of the particularity in Yangtze river and emergency stations hierarchy layout model: (1) Ascertain the least necessity of the cost and facilities for demanding stations with the model of location set covering problem (LSCP). (2) Ascertain the high-level Station with the model of maximal covering location problem (MCLP). In the meantime, with consideration of the traffic accidents frequency in different reaches, this essay accesses the risk factors namely the value weight of the selected stations by the equated and standardized accident numbers. By means of application and calculation, the number of emergency resource stations and reasonable station locations covering the reaches will be obtained under the standard crash time of 15 minutes.

articleTitle: A Conceptual Model of Entrepreneurial Intentions of IT Professionals: From an Organizational Embeddedness Perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on P-O fit, self-efficacy and embeddedness theory, this study proposes a conceptual model of entrepreneurial intentions of IT professionals from an organizational ebmeddedness perspective. The model presents the complex interaction among organizational embeddedness, organizational entrepreneurial climate, entrepreneurial self-efficacy and entrepreneurial intention.

articleTitle: Correlation Research Based on Cointegration between China In-Market Social Security Funds and Development of China Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China Social Security Funds is operated in the capital market to meet the needs of the aging population and future health care reform, and the purpose is to preserve and increase its value. In recent years, the Social Security Funds has been investing part of its funds into the stock market, which not only boosting their own development but also playing a very important role in the development and expansion of the stock market. In this article, three indicators and Granger Causality test are used to analyze the cointegration. The first indicator is in-market Social Security Fund investment scale, the second is the Shanghai stock market liquidity indicators and the third one is Shanghai stock market trading volume. These indicators are able to have a better reflection of a country's Social Security Funds and characteristics of stock market. Conclusions of this article are as follows: (1) In-market Social Security Funds investment scale is the Granger cause of the Shanghai Stock market liquidity, and vice versa.; (2) In-market Social Security Funds investment scale is the Granger cause of stock market trading volume, and vice versa.

articleTitle: Carbon Impact of Supplying Energy to Air Curtains via Hot Water. An Assessment of Options to Refit Services in Existing Buildings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With respect to industrial buildings, this study aims to clarify what would be the most efficient way of heating, considering at the same time its economic viability. Therefore, the study presents an integrated approach to heating and ventilation system to identify the most adequate of them in the case of an existing workshop. The object of the study is a solar heating system, with three auxiliary power options: an oil fuel boiler combined with a flue gas condensing unit, an electric boiler and a condensing gas boiler. The heating system is designed so that the primary energy only comes in on line when the solar energy contribution is not sufficient. The conclusion of the study, from the point of economic viability as well as of energy efficiency and impact on carbon footprint, is that the natural gas condensing boilers with solar thermal installation and climatic separation from the outdoor though air curtains systems is the less contaminating and more efficient option in industrial buildings of the described type.

articleTitle: Pension Fund Finance and Management in China: A Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the deepening of reforming China's social security system, the issues on fund finance and management are put on the agenda for the decision-makers to deal with. Many scholars did valuable researches. The objective of this paper is to provide a literature reviews in this domain.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting the Human Behavior Safety in Metal Underground Mines
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From the fact that human behavior is determined by both miners' intrinsic characteristics and external environment, the factors that may affect human behavior safety in metal underground mining are analyzed. Based on the analysis, countermeasures such as choose eligible miners and optimize environment are proposed, consequently to minimize the adverse effect and maximize the efficiency of miners matching the requirements of the job and environment, to perfect the combination of man, machine and environment, and thus the possible unsafe behavior can be reduced and accidents be prevented.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of the Construction Degree of Dalian' Technology Innovation System Based on Fuzzy Borda Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The urban technology innovation system is an important driving force of urban development, this article evaluates the construction degree of Dalian' technology innovation system form four aspects: Organization construction, market mechanism, power mechanism and support system. First, based on these four aspects the author establish an evaluation index system; Second, build the evaluation model of the construction degree of Dalian' technology innovation system; finally, use the result of survey carry on a case study of Dalian's technology innovation system.

articleTitle: Leadership Research for Delivery Project Manger Based on Theory of Project Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After the Second World War, accompanying world economies rapid development, project management emerged as a management discipline to manage complex projects. Project management is an activity which includes knowledge, tools, skills and methods to meet customer and project's demands. Currently, delivery projects are being bigger, and some projects are more than billion USD. These delivery projects' manager will manage hundreds or thousands of engineers. These projects are almost a middle-sized company. However, the existing literatures paid much more attention on project tools and methodology implementation than project manager. This paper offers that Project Manager should also develop leadership. Based on practiced project management and theory of project management, this paper offers five aspects to develop leadership of project manager.

articleTitle: Research of Data Acquisition and Data Mining for Broadcasting and Television Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To fill up the blank of decision support for business operation support system (BOSS) of broadcasting and television, a data acquisition and data mining scheme is proposed. The data acquisition brings out the desiging about data classification, data transformation and data warehouse. And data mining provides object demands of broadcasting and television chain. Under the background of "integration of three networks", this scheme exhibits the excellent function of characteristic service for different objects.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Precaution and Solutions of Crisis in Universities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Current university is in a crisis-prone period. There are many causes, such as Complicated social environment, contradiction between social transition, unrestricted network, university institutional obstacles, daily management service defects, psychological problems of students and so on.At present the main types of university crisis have public health, natural disasters, political events, campus security, landslides College Teachers, the legitimate rights and interests of students and other damage.The leadership in universities should have a sense of crisis prevention and management, willingly learn the ability to deal with crisis from enterprises, set up regular constitution of crisis management, establish spokesman system to ensure the flow of information, build interconnecting system in party, government, public security organs and universities, which are the main solutions to prevent and handle crisis in universities.

articleTitle: Are Satisfied Customers Always Loyal? - A Meta-Analytic Review and Assessment of Moderators of Customer Satisfaction-Loyalty Relationship
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer satisfaction (CS) gains lots of attention since it is believed to bring loyalty. However, are satisfied customers always loyal? Using meta-analytical method and based on 27 studies published from 1980 to 2007, we construct the moderators of CS-loyalty relationship model in four dimensions: cultural context, economic development, industry background and research method; and then put forward the related hypotheses. It is found that the CS-loyalty relationship is stronger in the countries, where individualism, uncertainty avoidance and masculinity are higher, as well as in the industry with high involvement. Furthermore, it suggests that the CS-loyalty relationship is stronger when satisfaction is evaluated by single-item measures than multi-item measures.

articleTitle: Timely Project Completion Probability and Stability Cost on the Interaction among Uncertainty of Random Duration, Service Level and Feeding Buffer in a RCPSP Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The concept of feeding buffer, proposed by Goldratt (1997), has attracted much attention to the world. There are many researches on the feeding buffer size. However, actually in real practice, even the same project may need to insert with different size of feeding buffer as different team with different level of skilled workers and different project environment with different kind of uncertainty, resulting in different kind of safety time (Newbold, 2008). In this paper, we investigate the impact of feeding buffer size, service level (deadline), and uncertainty of activity duration on the timely project completion probability in a stochastic resource-constrained project scheduling (RCPSP) environment. The results indicate that there has a huge interaction between feeding buffer, deadline, and different level of uncertainty in the project activity duration. Extensive computational results will be presented on benchmark library PSBLIB instances and statistic analysis will be conducted by using SAS PROC GLM.

articleTitle: Time Series Analysis of Energy Consumption for Tianjin City
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of industrialization and urbanization, cities have become the centers to address the problem of climate change for China. Tianjin city plays an important role to boost the economy of North China according to the long-term development planning of China. Since a large amount of energy will be needed, the CO2 emission will be much more concerned. And it is essential for Tianjin to promote energy efficiency and reduce the CO2 emission intensity. The study explores the characteristics of the energy consumption of Tianjin city through time series analysis, and compares it with Beijing and Shanghai, which helps give some advice for the energy conservation of Tianjin city in the future. We conclude that the consumption of energy has been increasing continuously, with an annual growth rate of 8.9% during the period of 2000-2008. And Tianjin has been one of the provinces with rapidest growth of energy consumption. The total energy consumption amount has magnified by approximately 3.3 times from 1620×104 tons of SCE in 1985 to 5364×104 tons of SCE in 2008. The energy consumption per capita of Tianjin increases from 2.01 tons of SCE per capita in 1985 to 5.54 tons of SCE per capita in 2008, which is lower than that of Shanghai city and also China as a whole, while it is higher than that of Beijing. In the last ten years, the composition of energy consumption of Tinjian remained relatively steady with 2.6 percent increase for Coal, 8.8 percent decrease for oil and 2.8 percent increase of natural gas. The energy intensity of Tianjin has declined from 9.22 tons of SCE in 1985 to 0.84 tons of SCE in 2008. But it is higher than that of Shanghai and Beijing. Thus, we suggest that Tianjin should pay more attention to improve the technological progress of the industrial sectors. And the composition of energy consumption should be optimized to reduce the CO2 emission intensity.

articleTitle: Policies, Customer-Supplier Relationships and Information Systems and Technologies in the Purchasing Function and Their Impacts on Purchasing and Supply Chain Management Performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research focused on the impacts of purchasing policies, customer-supplier relationships and purchasing-related information systems and technologies on the performance of purchasing and supply chain management in Chinese manufacturing. This research surveyed 384 purchasing staff in Chinese manufacturing enterprises and of these, 124 have offered usable responses. As the results shown, there are positive, significant impacts of purchasing policies, customer-supplier relationships, purchasing-related information systems and technologies on the purchasing and supply chain management performance. "customer-supplier relationships" has the greatest impact on purchasing and supply chain management performance followed by "purchasing-related information systems and technologies" and "purchasing policies".

articleTitle: An Efficient Improved Strategy for the PageRank Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Analyze the traditional PageRank algorithm of the search engine deeply. According to its topic drift and putting emphasis on old web pages, an improved PageRank algorithm is proposed, which is based on the text content analysis and the introduction of time factor. The improved algorithm can effectively meets the correlation requirements and authoritative problem. It can fit all kinds of web surfers' needs. Experimental results show that the modified algorithm performs better than the standard PageRank. Futhermore, it can effectively reduces the topic drift and enhance the satisfaction of web surfers obviously.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship between Corporate Governance Structure and Diversification Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on agency theory, this paper studied on the relationship between corporate governance structure and diversification strategy. Choosing 520 listed companies in Shanghai stock on December 31, 2009 as research samples, the paper did an empirical study on the impact of corporate governance structure on diversification strategy. The result showed that concentration of ownership, proportion of legal person shares and proportion of independent directors all had negative correlation with diversification degree significantly; proportion of state owned shares, board size and management compensation all had positive correlation with diversification degree significantly. The empirical result confirmed the theoretical hypothesises and supported the explanation of diversification discount under agency theory.

articleTitle: Risk-Constrained Optimal Bidding Strategy in Pay-as-Bid Electricity Markets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, an optimal bidding strategy of a generation company (GenCo's) that participates in a pay as bid electricity market is developed. A new method is proposed to obtain the Nash equilibrium point for optimal bidding strategy of GenCo's considering the risk of the bidding of the interested GenCo. For this purpose, the optimal bidding problem is modeled with two optimization sub-problems. In the first sub-problem, each GenCo maximizes its payoff, and in the second sub-problem, a system dispatch will be accomplished. particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to find optimal bidding strategy of each GenCo in this method. For evaluating the risk of the bidding of the interested GenCo, appropriate range of the bidding of the GenCo is found such that the desired payoff is also achieved. The Western System Coordinating Council (WSCC) nine bus test system is used to illustrate the implementation of the proposed method for a typical power system.

articleTitle: New Regional Airport Passenger Throughput Forecast Model Based on Airport Groups
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the new airport passenger throughput forecast, a new forecast model which based on airport groups is put forward in this paper. In this model, the competition ability of airports and the important factors which affect passengers travel choice are introduced into it. Then by constructing passenger utility function, the new regional airport passenger throughput can be forecasted. This model will increase the accuracy of the new regional airport passenger throughput forecast. Empirical results show that the method is applicable and effective.

articleTitle: Analysis on Green Marketing Innovation Motivation under the Two-Oriented Society
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Green marketing innovation is the objective require of the two-oriented society, the inevitable course for company to raise the core competitive power and get upper hand. The inner and outer motivation and resistance power has been analyzed through establishing the model to discuss the effecting factors of green marketing innovation under the two-oriented society, and the solution was provided to make progress on company innovation and development.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Influencing Factors of Team Members' Knowledge Sharing Behavior in Complex Product Development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge sharing behavior is the attitudes and manners that team members do things in the process of complex product development knowledge sharing. This paper analyzes three factors that influence team members' knowledge sharing behavior in complex product development which are self-efficacy, trust and outcome expectation. Then study assumption and study model are put forwarded, and influencing effect that above factors on team members' knowledge sharing behavior in complex product development are discussed empirically using statistics method, at last conclusions are gained that self efficacy, trust and outcome expectation are all positively affected team members' knowledge sharing behavior respectively in complex product development.

articleTitle: A Short Introduction to Data Mining and Its Applications
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid growth of data mining technologies and data mining tools, data mining will be applied more widely in various areas. In this paper we will introduce some models and solutions of data mining, especially we place more emphasizes on the applications of the associated rules and solutions of data mining in e-commerce.

articleTitle: On the Knowledge of Employee Engagement Factors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the progress and development of the global economy, businesses increasingly fierce competitions among the human resources have become the competition's Holy Grail. More and more studies show that employee engagement and business performance of their employees have a positive impact, and access to business performance and solve a brain drain of an effective management tool, especially in knowledge-based employee engagement. This paper summarizes the factors and knowledge workers on the basis of motivational factors, using empirical analysis to explore and validate a knowledge-based correlation analysis of employee engagement, building a knowledge-based model of employee engagement factors, providing a knowledge-based employee engagement the theory of reference, to help business managers in a targeted manner to improve knowledge management and employee engagement.

articleTitle: Research on the Agro-Processing Industry in Yunnan Participating in International Regional Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the background of global economic integration, this paper firstly analyses the privileges of the agro-processing industry in Yunnan participating in international regional cooperation, and then points out the problems and strategic emphasis of participating in international regional cooperation; finally, it puts forwards the measures of participating in international regional cooperation.

articleTitle: The Research on Personal Financial Problems in the Period of Inflation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years a steady growth in personal savings deposits in China, prices rising, the traditional "Money breeds money" financial management has long been unable to meet the people's financial needs. After China joins the WTO, country gradually open up, the financial markets also will prosper. Especially wealth management concepts of the residents change tremendously, the constant renewal of financial products and foreign banks to enter China's financial markets, personal finance market in our country more competitive. This paper analyzes the status of personal finance and development, combined with our current financial market situation, analysis risk-benefit of existing investment tool and make investment advice.

articleTitle: SWOT Analysis of Industry Development Strategy in Yingkou
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is the realistic demand to speed up the industrial structure optimization as a response to the worldwide economic and social development. Yingkou City is the fastest growing region in recent years, and great potential for future development in Liaoning Province. Through analysis of the opportunities, threats, strengths and the weaknesses in the industry development in Yingkou, we should utilize advantages, seize the opportunity to change the mode of economic development, advance industry optimization and upgrading, enhance industry competitive power, and achieve the scientific development goals.

articleTitle: Research on Connotation and Implication of Organizational Resilience - A Comparison Perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Resilience researches can be divided into three levels -micro, meso and macro level. Compared to resilience researches of the macro and micro levels, the organizational resilience researches of the meso level are far less abundant. This paper compares the organizational resilience with the psychological and community/social resilience, and summarizes the common points and differences of the three level researches. Then, the connotation and implication of the organizational resilience are elucidated.

articleTitle: Multimodal Transport Distribution Network Design with Time Window
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are multiple choices of transport modes crossing in logistics process, namely, the existence of multimodal transport issues. The multimodal transportation is used in distributed supply chain environment, and multimodal transport network is deformed. Considerate of the production costs, transportation costs, earliness/tardiness penalty costs and sale price comprehensively, the maximize object optimization mode of distribution supply chain network profit is established. Lingo software is applied to a given example for testing, and it achieved good results.

articleTitle: Governance Environment, Ownership Structure and Investor Relations Management about Coal Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Coal listed companies play an important role in the structure of stock market and investor relations management is the key operation factor in the competition of investment capital.
