By the method of descriptive statistics and least squares regression about the cross-sectional data of 2008, we found that in addition to the company's own characteristics, the quality of investor relations management is a major factor in the governance of coal listed companies. The ownership structure and governance environment significantly affect the level of investor relations management. The equity balance degree on the impact of investor relations management level is significant, and companies in which the nature of the ultimate controller is government, the level of investor relations management is positive, means that government served to protect investors in enhancing the transparency of company information.

articleTitle: Strategies and Case Study of Venture Capital Investment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The uncertainty of venture capital has patterns and rules to follow. This study theoretically analyzes the strategies used in dealing with the uncertainties in venture capital investment, including syndication investment, staged investment, and portfolio investment. And there are two cases followed to demonstrate the theories discussed.

articleTitle: Insights into Social Network Theory and Entrepreneurship
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Social network theory has long been explored not only as an important resource base to entrepreneurship but also as an underlying force on the development of entrepreneur behavior. Besides the general introduction of social network theory, this paper specifically chose several new angles to look closely into the interaction relationship of social network and entrepreneurship. The insights this paper presents are dynamics of social network followed by venture's social network and its impact on entrepreneurial intentions, opportunity identification, entrepreneurial orientation, new venture's innovative capability. These insights analyses the important issues we encounter in the entrepreneurship practice and entrepreneurship academic research development as well.

articleTitle: "Land Ethics" in Hotel Management and the New Understanding of "People Oriented"
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The hotel industry is one of typical industry in service trades. Whether internal employees or external customers, "people" is its main elements. With the improvement of human understanding of nature, the concept of sustainable development has added a new meaning to a number of management theories. The author analyzed specifically the conflict and the connection between "Land Ethics"(a management ethics) and "People-Oriented"(a management philosophy), proposed the new understanding of "People Oriented", and pointed out the need to improve the understanding of human from the "social people " to "natural people " until "ecological people", hope to further improve the "people-oriented" management philosophy.

articleTitle: The Competition of Highway and Railway in the Passenger Transport Corridor Based on Simulink Simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Passenger transport among the passenger transport corridor afforded by the highway and trail. Under the market economic system, there has been existed a competition between highway and trail each other and has a mechanism that is very similar to the ecosystem about changes of biological communities in the nature. This paper took ChengYu Passenger Transport Corridor for example,using Lotka-Volterra model and analyzing the competition relation between the highway and trail, and then make simulation with the software of simulink.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Relationship of Real Exchange Rate of RMB and Chinese Inbound Tourism from America
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Adopting the econometric methodology of unit root test and co-integration analysis, this paper makes an empirical analysis on the relationship of real exchange rate of RMB and Chinese inbound tourism from America. It finds that there exists a long-run co-integration relationship among Real exchange rate of RMB, American economy and Chinese inbound tourism from America. The elasticity coefficient of Chinese inbound tourism from America to American economy is 6.02, on the high side. The elasticity of Chinese inbound tourism from America to Real exchange rate of RMB is small, the elasticity coefficient is 1.62.It also finds that both Real exchange rate of RMB and American real GDP are the Granger causes of Chinese inbound tourism from America, and Chinese inbound tourism from America is also the Granger cause of America real GDP, but Chinese inbound tourism from America is not the Granger cause of Real exchange rate of RMB.

articleTitle: Integration Management Skills at the Expense of Technical Management Skills in the Field of Project Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The most important skills in project management which would ensure that the project is finished in time and all the aims and objectives are achieved include integration and technical management skills. In this article we tried to explain why these two skills are important in project management. This paper will explain the importance of having both of these two skills used in a project.

articleTitle: Research of Construction Enterprises' Incentive Strategies on the New Generation of Migrant Workers with Fuzzy Preference Relation Models
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The new generation of migrant workers will soon become the main force in the construction labor market, but now their will of engaging in construction industry is not very high. This paper is based on Maslow's hierarchy of needs, put the corresponding incentive strategies, use Fuzzy preference relation models, combine the present situation and characteristics of construction enterprises, obtain the most effective incentive strategies on the new generation of migrant workers of construction enterprises, improve the social security system and enhance the skill training.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Public Participation in Environmental Protection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Public participation in environmental protection is an important part of system of environmental management. It plays an important role and has significance for strict enforcement of the environmental policies and laws, as well as for the preventing and controlling of pollution, protection of resources and improvement of nature environment. This paper aimed to emphasize the important role and significance of public participant in environmental protection. Based on the status quo of environmental management in our country, the game model that the public supervises the firm discharging the pollution and complaints it to authorities is constructed. In the model, the strategic behaviors of public, firm and government were discussed. The conclusions provide the theoretical basis for the enforcement of public participant mechanism form the profile of environmental pollution control management.

articleTitle: Study on Guest Satisfaction Based on Brand Promotion of Theme Park - An Example of Ocean Park Hong Kong and Panyu Chimelong Paradise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Brand marketing is a critical part for the success of theme park. This paper aims to explore how brand marketing of theme park affects guest satisfaction by analyzing the efficiency of brand marketing and guest satisfaction. In order to do it, Ocean Park Hong Kong and Panyu Chimelong Paradise were taken as an example and questionnaire was employed as the major method. The study finds: (1)The two theme parks share clear and acquainted positioning. However, Chimelong Paradise does better in the marketing of mascot and slogan than Ocean Park. (2) In terms of brand marketing, the difference on satisfaction mainly presents at guests' perception on the software part of the product, which consists of professional service skills and service attitudes. (3) Guests show higher loyalty on Ocean Park.

articleTitle: Integrating Value and Lean Management in Manufacturing Processes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper a model for an integrated application of Lean Management and Value Management in manufacturing processes is proposed. Its purpose is to reduce some gaps that have been pointed out to Lean Management, namely, lack of ability to understand customer value, potentially negative impact on innovation capability and inability to eliminate waste in small processes. To do so, concepts from both management approaches were integrated as well as some of their most relevant tools, namely, Value Stream Mapping and Function Analysis. The implementation test done to the proposed model indicates that it can improve the understanding of customer value allowing waste to be highlighted and eliminated. The paper briefly reviews both Lean and Value Managements concepts as well as the major tools that were included in the model. The model is then exposed and discussed, the test implementation of the model is briefly displayed and the main conclusions exposed.

articleTitle: Implementing Green Publishing and Printing Process with Workflow Management System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: in this paper, we introduced a workflow management system model for printing and publishing industry. This paper has three parts. The first part introduced the foundation concept of workflow management. The second part introduced the design approach of a workflow management system for printing and publishing enterprises. The third part is a summary of this paper. Reference the workflow management system model, printing and publishing enterprises can implement their own system rapidly.

articleTitle: Structuring a New Mode of Enterprise Operation Management by Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This Operation management has always been one of the key factors to improve productivity for the global businesses. In recent years, supply chain theory has received increasing attention. Future competition in the market will largely depend on competition between supply chains. It is imperative to structure a new mode of enterprise operation management via supply chain management. It can reduce logistics costs, enhance cost advantage, and even upgrade the competitiveness of enterprises. Therefore enterprises should realize the actual flat organization through outsourcing, complete the distributed data and information integration throughout supply chains reconfigure enterprise organization structure in accordance with the requirements of supply chain management, set up an alliance or strategic partnership and structure supply chain management business processes in the support of e-commerce.

articleTitle: Total Cost Modeling and Systemic, Strategic Methods for Purchasing Cost Decision and Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper firstly identifies several total cost concepts and decision modelings within purchasing management practice; secondly, suggests a cost management method system consisting of three levels, namely, cost avoidance, reduction and controlling; finally, based on strategic sourcing and supply chain management, investigates the strategic cost mangement method applied to purchasing cost decision and management.

articleTitle: The Route Choice of the Brand Creation of Chinese Textile Original Equipment Manufacturers in the Post-Financial Crisis Era
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the broke out of the financial crisis, the golden period for the export of Chinese textile and garment has passed, and the process for the global textile and garment manufacture base to transfer gradually from China to India, Pakistan and Southeast Asian countries has started, which is irreversible. It is difficult to finance and find talents; the information flow is not smooth; and the most critical problem is that Chinese textile enterprises which strongly depend on foreign markets can not obtain orders. As such, Chinese garment enterprises have to transfer from original equipment manufactures (OEMs) to brand enterprises to make "made in China" become "brand of China". The upgrade from OEM to brand creation is the requirement for the sustainable, stable and healthy development of Chinese economy, and also the necessary choice of the textile OEMs to respond to the changes of the domestic and abroad market as well as to develop their own ability. However, the transfer process from OEM to the brand creation is not smooth. The co-effect of many factors will make the textile OEMs dependent on the route and locked in the role of OEM in the value chain. This is proved by the industrial development history of some developing countries and regions as well as the fact of the bankruptcy of some Chinese textile enterprises under the global financial crisis. However, such "lock-in" is not rigid. It is absolutely possible for textile enterprises to upgrade from OEMs to brand creation under certain internal and external conditions.

articleTitle: Research on the Problems of the "Labor Contractor" in Chinese Construction Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: "Labor Contractor" as a non-enterprise legal person, it has experienced a long historical period. For development of the construction industry in China, "Labor Contractor" played its historical role, but also buried potential problems for the healthy development of the construction industry. In this paper, it proposed solutions to "contractors" in response by analyzing the advantages and disadvantages and historical evolution of the "Labor Contractor" and combining with the actual situation of the "Labor Contractor".

articleTitle: Business Models Based on Open Innovation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Global economy is experiencing a transition from industrial, product-centered to innovation, service-centered. This paper provides business model which originated from the integration of views of firm development theory, and then we get a business model based on open innovation paradigm. Open business model is an analysis concerns both value appropriation and value creation. Open-source is a special strategy in knowledge economy and we define different open-source business model according to different kinds of licenses.

articleTitle: Competitive Intelligence Service for SMEs: A New Way for B2B Website to Compete
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a B2B-based competitive intelligence (CI) service model for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Based on investigation of CI requirement and B2B's usage situation in China, the B2B-based CI service model is analyzed. Finally, the related suggestion is given. The proposed CI service model is of great significance to both sound development of B2B and SMEs.

articleTitle: Framework of Operation Management of Emergency Response Supply Chain Based on Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For an effective and timely acquisition, deployment, and distribution of needed resources in emergencies, it is crucial to provide the end-to-end visibility of emergency response supply chain to the involved parties and improve its operation management. There are so many factors whose assessment is fuzzy needed to be taken into account when operation management of emergency response supply chain is selected. A fuzzy hierarchical model is presented in this paper based on Analytic Hierarchy Process and Fuzzy Logic on consideration of technical parameters, technical program. By calculation comparison of indicators operation organizations are prioritized from their comprehensive assessment where systems' operation are classified into proper usage scopes and suitable operation systems are recommended. In the end, an optimization framework of operation management of emergency response supply chain based on fuzzy clustering is suggested.

articleTitle: Study on Hotspots Trend Analysis of Humanities and Social Sciences Based on CSSCI Academic Resource Ontology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to the existing linear mode of information organization in CSSCI seriously limits semantic expression of the potential relationship among the academic resources, and implicit knowledge mining and three-dimensional solid academic evaluation services are also hardly enable to be implemented. The ontology mechanism which could provide semantic support introduced and widely applied in field of knowledge organization provides an opportunity for improvement of CSSCI services quality. This paper tries to discuss method and process of research hotspots trend analysis of humanities and social sciences by means of knowledge in CSSCI academic resource ontology, with hierarchical clustering as analysis mean, and on the basis of hotspots detection, from both scholar and disciplinary point of view. In the analysis, Prof. Qiu Jun-Ping and the discipline of library, information and archives are taken for examples, to discuss the development and change in 2000-2006 of their research hotspots, and scientifically predicts their trends in future.

articleTitle: The Interaction Effect between Online Trust and Web Site Interactivity on Highest Purchasing Price
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-commerce in China is fast growing, but online purchase conversion rate is still low. To increase consumer trust to ecommerce Web site and encourage online transaction, ecommerce platform suppliers usually apply high-usability Web site design, and therefore interactivity is frequently used. However, its effect on highest purchasing price might not be always positive. This study tested the interaction effect between online trust and Web site interactivity on highest online purchasing price. Data was collected from 384 consumers through online survey and the result shows that interactivity has positive effect on highest purchasing price only when consumers have high level online trust. Theoretical and practical implications are discussed.

articleTitle: Pattern Analysis of Organizational Creativity Revelation Based on Agent-Based Modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although there are many ways to increase organizational creativity, this study explores the issue of increasing organizational creativity by adopting the knowledge diversity and creativity revelation processes, which have been studied separately in the past but have not been analyzed together in a single research framework. The purpose of this research is to longitudinally investigate the evolutionary pattern of organizational creativity in order to explain how the knowledge diversity and creativity revelation processes - exploitation and exploration - affect organizational creativity. Experiments are used to show the validity of the research questions based on agent-based modeling (ABM) simulation. The results of the experiment confirm that knowledge diversity and exploitation/exploration positively affect organizational creativity. However, with a time factor entered into the simulation, the results show different patterns in the longer term in regards to the effects of exploitation/exploration.

articleTitle: Analysis on Fiscal and Tax Policy of Stimulating Small-Medium Enterprises' Technology Innovation in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Small-medium enterprises (SMEs) have become the backbone of technology innovation in China, and the fiscal and tax policies have played a key role in promoting, guiding and stimulating independent innovation activities and improving independent innovation capability of SMEs. This paper mainly analyzes fiscal and tax policies which support technology innovation of SMEs and existing problems of these policies and proposes some recommendations to further improve these fiscal and tax policies.

articleTitle: An Approach of Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation on Supporting Capacity of Regional Science and Technology with Case Study of Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The regional economic development is promoted mainly by the innovation and progress of science and technology, which is up to supporting capacity of regional science and technology (SCRST). This paper discusses and defines SCRST, which finds that the composing system of SCRST is decided by system guarantee, resource supply and force of transformation. Then, a fuzzy comprehensive model is set up to evaluate SCRST with a case study of application to Chongqing. These research conclusions are inferable for making regional policy of science and technology.

articleTitle: How to Carry out Cross-Marketing: The Enlightenment of Two Cases
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a new marketing strategy that possesses unique advantages, cross-marketing has been attached more importance to and adopted by more enterprises in face of fierce competitions. This essay, combining with relevant theories, intends to explore and summarize some cross-marketing strategies, through detailed description and in-depth analysis of two typical cases-Nongfu Spring's "fresh-keeping" with the help of TCL and Red Apple Furniture's successful cross-marketing through internet-in order to provide references for modern enterprises.

articleTitle: Influence of Aerobic Setting-Up Exercise on Higher Vocational Girls' Subjective Well-Being and the Emotional Management Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From the perspective of emotional management strategy, the survey of 320 girl students from higher vocational schools which adopting experimental method shows, the sports health course intervention model of aerobic setting-up exercises not only helps girl students from higher vocational schools maintain good Mentality and emotion, as well as a positive subjective experience, but also helps them correctly understand personalities, enhance interpersonal skills, form optimistic attitude, and improve the subjective well-being feelings. Compared with the girls from public higher vocational schools, the score of private higher vocational girls' positive emotion and negative emotion as well as the index of overall subjective well-being are low, which may be caused by objective reasons as to economic and public opinion aspects.

articleTitle: A Study on DEA of Resource Efficiencies of Forestry-Paper Firms in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Along with China's gradual changes in developmental model of economy and society, the pulp & paper industry associated with renewable resource exploitation and environmental protection is increasingly becoming the dominant industry. This paper takes 21 listed companies in the pulp & paper industry of China as research objects, builds the evaluation indicator system on the basis of resource-based theory and constructs the resource efficiency evaluation model of the forestry-paper firms based on DEA. According to the annual reports of listed companies and the data of Almanac of China Paper Industry, the paper analyzes resource efficiencies of China's forestry-paper firms and provides a theoretical basis for further improvement in resource efficiencies of the pulp & paper industry in China.

articleTitle: How Could Leader Inspire Front-Line Employee's Trust and Service Performance in Service Team: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on leader character-based and relationship-based perspectives, this paper explores the mechanisms that how team leader could inspire front-line employee's trust and service performance. Using 280 paired samples from 11 service teams, we found that team leader could enhance team member's service performance by leader honesty (character-based perspective) and leader-member exchange (relationship-based approach), which are mediated by follower's trust in their team leader. Implications for service team and HRM in leader training are discussed in the end.

articleTitle: Gender Differences Is Important in the China Mutual Fund Industry?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper shows the differences of the investment ability and styles between fund managers' different genders. The portfolio structure of female managers is not significantly different from their male counterparts; the average performance of male fund managers is better than female managers, but at the same time more variable.

articleTitle: Investigation and Reflection of the Development of Green Advertising in Chinese Automobile Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the Analytical Framework of Green Advertising developed by the U.S. scholar IYER etc. (1992), we made a content analysis on 564 non-repeated green ads published between January 2000 and June 2009 in 7 representative magazines and 8 representative newspapers in China. Results suggest that green advertising in China's auto industry increased year by year. The green advertising strategies are quite different between state-owned and foreign enterprises. The thesis put forward relevant suggestions accordingly.

articleTitle: The Synergy between Technology Scouting and Open Innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article extended the connotation and common modes of technology scouting under open innovation paradigm. After that, technology scouting in open innovation enterprises was discussed. Then, taking knowledge abundance and knowledge importance as assorting criteria, a two-dimension classification matrix for scouting objects was built. Finally, in view of characteristics in different quadrants, a synergic framework between technology scouting and open innovation was constructed.

articleTitle: Study of Power Enterprise Efficiency Based on Simulation and Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The current power industry efficiency focuses usually on the whole industry or the efficiency changes in different periods, and little care about the power enterprise efficiency fluctuation in a single period is taken. Also at present there is little attention paid to the efficiency difference between four types of power enterprise. In the present paper, an improvement of DEA CCR model was carried out to calculate the power enterprise efficiency fluctuation in a single period. This would provide a platform for the improvement of the power enterprise efficiency.

articleTitle: The Application of Analytic Network Process (ANP) based on WBS-RBS in Project Risk Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Construction engineering project often faces from technology, economic, natural and social environment, and many other aspects of uncertainties.These uncertainties once formed risk, often can cause huge economic losses and social influence. In order to avoid such situations, This paper introduces a network analysis (ANP) which is the risk analysis of a large-scale construction project based on WBS-RBS, established risk factors multi criteria and multi-level ANP structure model,and solve the model in detail. Finally taking a large-scale construction project for example, through the application of this method analysis obtains the risk factors for the weight of a large-scale construction project. From the total ranking results ,it is easily found that the project faced the biggest and the most key risk elements. Considering the interaction relationship of risk elements, the final results will be more objective truly reflect the real situation. It can provide an objective reference for engineering project risk control and management.

articleTitle: Optimization of Production System by Simulation Based on UML and Flexsim
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Production system is a highly complex, discrete event dynamic system, so it is difficult to build mathematic model of it, and simulation has become one of good method for studying it. Flexsim, which has been widely used in manufacturing, logistics, transportation, service system and so on, is a DEDS simulation software based on Object-oriented idea. UML is a object-oriented modeling language, which can describe production system. A Modeling, Simulation and Optimization method of production system, which is based on UML and Flexsim, is proposed firstly. Then by this method, An air conditioner manufacturing company's production system is studied. The production system is simulated and improved, and finally the output is improved.

articleTitle: Wave Curve Analysis on the Value Chain of Creative Industries
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an emerging industry, creative industries provide high value-added, knowledge-intensive producer services and consumer services. Based on the value chain smiling curve, this paper first proposed a wave curve, which reflects the basic value chain of creative industries. The new value chain links increase from 3 to 4 by adding a cultural resource conservation link, focusing on the two high value-added links - R&D and marketing. This study provides a basis to further enhance the added value of the industry.

articleTitle: Empirical Study of Coal Industry Circular Economy Park
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper dissertates the basic meaning of circular economy, and discusses circular economy modes at home and abroad and construction and current situation of coal industry circular economy park at domestic and external. It analyzes Datong Coal Mine Group Tashan coal circular economy park, researches and analyses its industrial chain settings, metabolic coupling relationship, model character, environmental, and ecological, social and economic benefits, points out its problems and successful experiences of contemporary coal circular economy park, and indicates that if you want to build circular economy park successfully, you must based on the characteristics and conditions of resource endowment, scientific design, and effectively plan the project types, sizes and technology of each chain node, cohesion, feeding and metabolic relationship between each chain, which is the key to the success of circular economy park. The core of circular economy park is to optimize the resource utilization ratio. The key point is applying the low carbon technology. The aim is to realize coordinated development between economic benefits and social environmental benefits.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Influence of the Rising Housing Price on Resident Consumption
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper explored the impact mechanism of the rising housing price on household consumption. The mathematical model of relationship between consumption rate and housing price index was established, based on which a empirical test was studied. The results indicate that there is a long-term reverse co-integration relationship between these two variables, that is, the rising housing price has really being restrained the resident consumption to some extent. Thus it is necessary for government to control the housing price.

articleTitle: Information Integration Solutions Based on J2EE for Supply Chain Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Supply chain information integration and information sharing are the basis for the implementation of supply chain management. This paper proposed an information integration solution based on J2EE for supply chain enterprises. The solution fully considered the existing information resources the company had invested. In this solution, the supply chain companies can gradually step by step deep the cooperation between partners, which from information sharing to supply chain business process integration. The solution not only can promote the smooth operation of the supply chain but also can create greater value for customers.

articleTitle: Model Driven Plant Modernization: A Vision of Model Based Industrial Engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To support modernization of industrial plants, we proposed a component oriented modeling method, based on a central model sustaining domain specific views. Dependency management should allow predictive re-engineering. We formalized the meta-model in a UML profile, and used OCL to express dependencies. We verified these concepts in an industrial case study with the tool suite that has been developed based on these studies. Investigations about a model driven approach for plant engineering seem to be promising.

articleTitle: An Interaction Model for Organizational Support-Behavior Choice Based on Value Orientation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: on the basis of organizational support theory, introducing the value orientation, this paper analyzed the staff's behavior motivation at a new perspective. A theory model was constructed and verified through questionnaire survey and empirical analysis. It focused on exploring the interaction mechanism among value orientation, perceived organizational support (POS) and organizational support-behavior choice. It found that different value orientations, acting like a switch in the process of "organizational support-behavior choice". Then some exploratory explanations were given to the conclusions. Employees were classified into six types according to outcomes variables. And then motivation modes aiming to different type of employees were promoted.

articleTitle: The Research on Post-Merger Brand Strategies of Chinese Local Brands' Cross-Border M&A - From Weaker Brands Perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this financial crisis, Chinese Local Brands (CLB) M&A many foreign famous and strong brands to accelerate their internationalization. However, "the weaker mergers the stronger" of cross-border M&A leads to consumers' cognitive dissonance (CCD). The extant research concerned is silent on the cross-border M&A of the weaker brands on stronger ones. Thus, based on cognitive assonance and customer-based brand equity (CBBE) theories, this study, from weaker brands perspective, find the way how to attenuate the CCD on the stronger ones. Consequently, it uses focus group, in-depth interview, and experiments to shed light on brand strategies to mitigate CCD, i.e., maintaining country of origin, price and one brand of stronger acquired brands like those before the merger, and its solution mechanism to enhance brand equities of the merger and acquired, that is, brand fitness mediates the interaction effects between brand identity strategy and supporting marketing programs on brand equity of stronger acquired brands. The conclusions enrich the research on cross-border brand strategy and CLB internationalization and offer vital implications for the prevalent cross- border M&A of CLB at present.

articleTitle: Evaluation on High-Tech Industry Competitiveness Based on Factor Analysis and Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: High-tech industry is a leading strategic industry of a national economy.Based on the high-tech industry competitiveness evaluation index system ,this paper uses factor analysis and cluster analysis to evaluate and classify on the competitiveness of the China's high-tech industry in 2008,and analysises the competitiveness of the level high-tech industry combined with local conditions.Finally,according to the empirical analysis conclusion,the paper recommends a number of policy recommendations on the improvement of provincial high-tech industrial competitiveness in China.

articleTitle: Knowledge Management and Innovation for Firms Competitiveness: A Strategic Approach for African SMEs
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper is an attempt to awaken African SME's on the need for them to convert their numerous constraints into strength by a complete overhaul of their business and technology model to discover better ways of creating value through investment in knowledge and innovation management, in order to stay relevant in the neo-economic order. Unlike their counterparts in America, Asia and Europe, African SMEs, have not been able to come up with any innovative product or any globally accepted brand, rather many have only been restricted to their challenges and even gone into extinction. However this paper has taken the route of knowledge and innovation management to create a competitive advantage through new product development, sales growth, profit growth, productivity, etc, using Bulgeman, etal , (2001) and Chiesa, etal, (1998), innovation capabilities audit framework, for evaluating firms innovation performance and competitiveness to create input- output strategy of competitiveness framework used for the discussion and policy implication for African SME's to grow their business and stay competitive like their counterparts in China and India.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Broadcasting and Television Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A decision support system for broadcasting and television is proposed. This broadcasting and television decision support system (BT-DSS) filled the blank of broadcasting and television area under the background of "integration of three networks". This paper designs the model of BT-DSS which based on data acquisition and data mining for solving techniques. This system exhibits the excellent function of characteristic service for different clients.

articleTitle: Chinese Cultural Management Strategies from the Perspective of Cultural Ecosystem Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: "Face" culture is one perspective of analyzing Chinese management environment from four aspects, including the essence, its running mechanism, intrinsic motivation, and functional effects. First, leaders have to be good at "Impression Management", choose the leading style and control strategies that are good for benign interaction; Second, It is necessary to have "roundabout way", with which they can turn disadvantage into advantage, and crisis into opportunity; Third, they must learn how to "give people what they want", and implement emotional management, career management, and democratic management; Fourth, they should maintain flexibility in the use of "face" to integrate and encourage the organization, and take measures to guard against the "Machivellianism" (mianzi kungfu) of the organizations.

articleTitle: Application Study of SaaS On-Line e-Finance under Internet
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science

articleTitle: Study on the Risk Control of Logistic Strategic Alliance in Shipping Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To stabilize the supply and look for new profit growth point, many large and medium shipping enterprises develop logistics actively through establishing logistics strategic alliances. Based on the systematic analysis of risks about the logistics strategic alliance and its influencing factors, the paper discussed how to apply risk matrix in the risk assessment of logistics strategic alliance, developed the application field of risk matrix. It provides a structured risk assessment tools for risk assessment of logistics alliance enterprises. Finally, the paper proposed the corresponding risk control strategies; this can provide important references for the shipping enterprise in formation of logistic strategic alliances.

articleTitle: Construction of a Modern Logistics Support System Based on Sustainable Development of Industrial Park
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial parks shoulder the mission of driving a rapid economic development in its region. So, it is an urgent problem to solve that how to further enhances the competitiveness of the industrial park and realizes its sustainable development. This paper take Industrial parks which shared channels for example to show how to enhance its competitiveness and regional competence ability by construct a modern logistics support system which is based on analysis the different characteristics between different parks, and is also adapt to its characteristics.

articleTitle: Knowledge Competence Appraisal of Old Northeast Industrial
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In knowledge economy time, the underlying reason of economy development falling behind of old northeast industrial zones is its low knowledge competence. Based on knowledge power analysis of three northeast provinces and relational research achievements review of regional knowledge competence, knowledge competence appraisal index system is constructed from derivation and ontology, and empirical analysis of three northeast provinces' knowledge competence from 2004 to 2006 is done by fuzzy integral method. Conclusion is draw that integral knowledge competence of three northeast provinces is comparative low and knowledge competence of Liaoning province is a little higher.

articleTitle: Population Quality and Economic Development Based on Gray Model Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, gray model of optimization of logarithm new developments coefficients forecasted the trends of economic development. Then, analyze on the effect of population quality on economic development with the grey relational model. Main conclusions: science and technology activities personnel and the numbers of college graduates of every million people have the greatest impact on the economy. Based on the model, the paper put forward on some feasible suggestions on how to promote the economic development.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluating of Supply Chain Partners Based on Improved Euclid Norm in Lean Logistics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The weighted vector is proposed based on inferior subordination degrees. The weight and the target value are synthesized as a weighting vector. And the tradition calculating method of weight is improved. A partner evaluating method of lean supply chain logistics is suggested based on the improved Euclid Norm of the alternatives from the worst one. And the quantitative method is introduced for the supply chain enterprise to select right partner in lean logistics environment.

articleTitle: A Model of Flexible Scheduling of Knowledge Workers Based on Stochastic Learning Capacity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper started from an investigation of characteristics of knowledge workers, then moved to an examination of multi-skilled workers scheduling problem under the multi-stage and multi-task conditions, on the basis of stochastic learning capacity. It also introduced the relationship between skill score and efficiency, and constructed a stochastic states transfer equation of knowledge workers' skill score. On this basis the paper proposed a multi-objective flexible scheduling model to maximize skill scores of all knowledge workers and minimize the overall cost. The model can provide decision support in the area of knowledge worker scheduling.

articleTitle: Syndication Network, Centrality and Venture Capital Firm's Performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The uncertainty in the venture capital market contributed to the dependence of venture capitals on syndication network to maintain advantages. While recent research depicted the importance of syndication network to venture capitals as well as local economy, they ignored the differentiation of their position and hence the performance. Based on the example of IDGVC, this paper analyzed the relationship between centrality of syndication network and its performance and proposed that, venture capitals with higher centrality in the syndication network are more capable to identity opportunities and coordinate the others to gain high performance.

articleTitle: The Preliminary Research on Government Involvement and Mechanism for the New Era of Sports
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study was to explore the government involvement and mechanism for the new era of sports. Used the method of document information, comparative analysis and logically analysis, with government involvement and mechanism as the study subject, compare and research the history of the Chinese sports management, in depth explored the government's functions for the new era from the main, power and operation of the three aspects, and finally raised the sports development mechanism of the government established channels.

articleTitle: Road of Brand Innovation for Private Enterprises in Main Tea Production Area - Analysis on "Herding Effect" in Mingshan County, Sichuan Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The current situation of miscellaneous brands in the main tea production area has become a troublesome problem for the government and enterprises, and the "herding effect"is one of the main reasons. This paper analyses the "herding effect"syndrome on the brand building of private tea enterprises in Mingshan County, Sichuan Province, and also proposes an "aircraft carrier"brand innovation and development path from angles of causes and effects.

articleTitle: An Application of Bayesian Nash Equilibrium Model to Quality Surveillance of Service Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As service outsourcing is growing, there is a focus on the formation and development of service supply chain . One of the key elements of service supply chain is concerned with the service quality surveillance.In the paper a service supply chain structure including a service supplier and an service integrator is proposed and a Bayesian Nash equilibrium model under asymmetric information is established based on a basic model of quality surveillance in service supply chain with symmetric information and an equilibrium result obtained, then the impact on quality surveillance is considered with a factor that the service integrator would be punished and the result of the Bayesian Nash equilibrium is realized. Simulation result shows that the quality completion level of service supplier rises up and the quality surveillance level of integrator brings down as above factor introduced. Therefore, in practice, the level of service can be improved effectively and the whole quality of services supply chain would be enhanced through strengthening the punishment of integrator.

articleTitle: Research on Guangzhou Citizens' Perception and Satisfaction Degree of "Urban Greenway"
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Greenway network of the Pearl River Delta provides public with green open spaces for the low-carbon travel and outdoor leisure activities of people. The idea "green, ecological, livable, well-being" of urban greenway changes the citizen's trip mode and consumption concept. Greenway construction and utilization are still in the exploratory period in China, it is essential to research user's perception and satisfaction degree of completed greenway, which provides theoretical basis and empirical support for the planning and construction of greenway, to further enhance residents' well-being index and realize a low-carbon and livable life. Based on the related research findings at home and abroad, this paper takes a questionnaire survey to investigate the citizens' perception and satisfaction degree of urban greenway. It totally analyzes 260 questionnaires, using SPSS17.0 for data processing. Through factor analysis, the research extract 5 types of the principal component factor of citizens' perception from the 12 observation variables of greenway: accessibility, supporting facilities, service facilities, environmental improvement, ecological landscape. Then using correlation analysis and multiple linear regression analysis to identify the factors that have significant effects on the citizens' satisfaction from the 5 factors, the results are ecological landscape, accessibility and supporting facilities. From the analysis, this paper could find out attributes that the interviewee liked and complained about of greenway, then put forward some specific suggestions to the construction and development of greenway, thus promoting livable urban and rural areas construction and improving the citizens' well-being index.

articleTitle: Research on Mass Incidents Leadership Path to Deal with Crisis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, the crisis caused by mass incidents occurred from time to time, having strongly affected the social stability. Based on different periods of crisis, leaders should try to reduce the occurrence of mass incidents crisis by using different methods of leadership, changing leadership path and adopting the "five forces" leadership model in order to ensure the overall stability of society.

articleTitle: The Determinants of IT Outsourcing: An Empirical Investigation of Public and Private Hospitals in France
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to identify the factors influencing IT outsourcing decision of hospitals in France. Considering the difference between public and private sectors, this research aims also to compare the decision factors of these two kinds of hospitals. The results of the preliminary analysis show that, on the IT outsourcing decision factors, there is no significant difference between public and private hospitals in France.

articleTitle: Research on Quadratic Hedging for Stochastic Payment Styled Claims
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By measuring the total risk by conditional mean square error between the terminal valuation of hedging portfolio and the total payment during the hedging horizon, and under the constraint of self-financing strategy, in this paper, at first, we properly construct a hedging model to study the quadratic hedging for stochastic payment styled contingent claims; then, during the hedging horizon [0,T], by dynamic programming and backward recursion, we get the recursive expressions of hedging strategies, which can minimize the terminal risk and may be referential to hedging practice.

articleTitle: Study on Coordination of Port Supply Chain Base on Revenue Sharing Contract
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper considers a two-stage port supply chain consisting of a port service provider and a port and establishes games of revenue sharing contract. Analysis shows that coordination of port supply chain will to be realized both the price is exogenous variable or endogenous variable.

articleTitle: Eco-Economic System Evaluation and Sustainable Management in Gansu Based on Emergy Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the method of Emergy Analysis, in this paper we investigate and characterize the state of eco-economy system of Gansu during 1995-2007 , it could be concluded that the change tendency of output efficiency of economic subsystem get reduced in 13 years, the economic development stage of Gansu is at lower level; people's living standard and life quality is low and has been declining trend; Waste Emergy Ratio(W') and Emergy Waste Rate (EWR) are fluctuating upward trend, waste emissions make growing pressure on environment, meanwhile increase of the renewable resources emergy can optimize the energy use structure of Gansu. Most emergy indexes analysised objectively reveal the unsustainable state of the ecological economic system in Gansu and it's continuously reducing situation of sustainable development ability. In conclusion eco-economic systems of Gansu are evaluated, suggestions are discussed for the transition of economic developmental patterns and sustainability management of Gansu.

articleTitle: On the Development of Rural Human Resources in Sichuan Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Developing Sichuan Province's rural human resources, turning population burden into the Social economic development power are the important practical problems which should be solved during the modernization, they are urgent needs from the new socialist countryside developing in Sichuan as well. Firstly, on the basis of the census information and statistical data, the thesis studies analyzing total quantity and distribution of the human resource in Sichuan province. Secondly, analyze the achievement and existing problems of the human resource development in Sichuan Province. Lastly, the thesis raises the overall idea and strategies in further development of the rural human resource in Sichuan Province.

articleTitle: Analyzing Complexity of Enterprise Production System Based on CAS Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Production system consists of several sub-systems, and there exists complex interactions between sub-systems. Also, the production system itself has to adapt to the environment. Based on the definition of enterprise production system and complex adaptive system (CAS) theory, this paper built a basic structure for enterprise production system, analyzed the components, sources and features of enterprise production system's complexity, broadened the research perspective of production system. According to professor Holland's definition for the 7 basic characteristics of CAS, this study elaborated the CAS characteristics of enterprise production system, discussed the interactions within production system and between production system and environment, revealed the adaptability and complexity features of production system as a CAS. This research will be helpful to further study of enterprise production system.

articleTitle: The Empirical Study of Service Quality in Inner Mongolian Agricultural and Pastoral Banks - Taking a Town-Bank as an Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper makes empirical analysis research on a town bank, aiming at optimizing Inner Mongolian Agricultural and Pastoral financial service environment, taking Town-Bank customer satisfaction as the research object, and using questionnaire survey and data analysis as the research method.

articleTitle: Employee's Emotion and Behaviour under the Circumstance of Emotional Events
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: High interaction is an important feature of service industry. During the process of service, staff would have high-frequently contact with customers, and the value of the corporation is delivered through these interactions. Normally there are some emotional events accompanying the process of service which will affect the emotion and attitude of the staff. Through reviewing literatures, the authors put forward an emotional model based on the high interactive service industry. The model has been proved by quantitative test under the catering circumstance. The paper concludes that the manager's attitude oriented and events attribution will have positive im-pact on the emotion and attitude of the staff when an emo-tional event occurs. At the same time, emotional intelligence differences have moderate effect on the model. At the end of the paper, the authors discuss the conclusions, managerial implications, and the future direction.

articleTitle: Analysis for Construction Project Transaction Methods Decision Based on Fuzzy AHP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The decision made in the selection of a construction project transaction method for a project is one of the key factors determining the success of a project. The Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) has been widely used to select transaction method for project procurement, but this has occurred mainly in crisp (non-fuzzy) decision applications. Furthermore, it is also recognized that human assessment on qualitative attributes is always subjective and imprecise. To make up for the deficiency in the AHP. a fuzzy AHP with an extent analysis approach is proposed for the selection construction project transaction method. The new approach can improve the imprecise ranking of selection construction project transaction method inherited from studies based on the conventional AHP. At last, a case analysis shows that the model and its solution is not only effective, but also feasible.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on US Dollar Circumfluence
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper tests the relationship between the current account deficits and NIIP(net international investment position) in U.S. It discovers that, in the middle of 1980's, trade is issue channel of dollar and finance is its withdrawal channel. Dollar circumfluence exists and largely depends on the sustainability of dollar standard. It is suggested that the dollar standard should sustain in a short period of time, but not for long.

articleTitle: The Effect of Movement of Natural Persons on Bilateral Intra-Industry Trade: An Empirical Analysis of the China as an Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper make an empirical analysis using the panel data of China and 26 trade partners between 2003 and 2007 on the impact of movement of nature person on bilateral intra-industry trade. The result indicate: China's movement of nature person yields more significant positive impact on bilateral intra-industry trade than inter-industry. This positive effect is stronger for manufactured products than for non-manufactured ones. Finally, we make discussion of the result and give some suggestions on polices.

articleTitle: The Management of Competitive Sports and Research on Sustainable Development of in Physical Education Institutes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Modern competitive sports has been no longer the simple competition between the athletes. Its inspiring achievement is the result of the combined efforts of the coaches, management staff and the researchers. Physical education institutes are frequently considered as the place of having and cultivating a large number of high-quality professional talents so as to serve the competitive sports. The paper is to analyze the factors of influencing the serve of the competitive sports and put forward to its guarantee system in PE institutes.

articleTitle: Information Modeling of Product Design Process Module Based on O-O Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To deal with the problem of information modeling of product design process module(DPM), with the object-oriented (O-O)method, an integrated information model of DPM is proposed. This paper, firstly, presents the information necessity of DPM in product design process management. Then, focusing on design task, the information structure of DPM is proposed, which includes six basic class models, such as attribute, interface, designer, quality, cost and schedule. And next, the six basic class models are described detailedly with the O-O method. Finally, by synthesizing the information structure and the basic class information models, an integrated information model of DPM is constructed, which paves a good way to the database modeling and development in the product design process management and optimization.

articleTitle: Web-Service Oriented Computer Audit System Based on Agents
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In service oriented computer audit system, agent technologies are used and a set of components, which have logical functions and are interactive as well as autonomous, are integrated together to form a system framework. Meanwhile, in order to release service to Internet, interaction must be performed between multiple agents with high quality and convenience. We integrate Web-services into intelligent agent framework, proposing service-oriented computer audit system based on agent.

articleTitle: A Markov Regime-Switching Model on Foreign Trade: The Case of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on Hamilton' Markov regime-switching model applied to postwar U.S. business cycle (1989,1994), the paper uses Chinese import and export data from January 1999 to November 2010 to describe and investigate the dynamic growth path of China's foreign trade. The empirical results suggest that the growth path of China's foreign trade can be classified as long term expansion regime (1999.01-2008.08 and 2008.12-2010.11) and short-term recession regime (2008.09-2008.11), which means the growth path of China's foreign trade may experience a shift of regime. The global economic situation and Chinese economic policy during these periods may explain the move of regime. Chinese economy needs to shift from export-oriented economic growth to more reliance on indigenous innovation of firms and domestic demand-pulled growth, which maybe not only the results of the 2008 global financial crisis, but also reflects the need for continual growth of Chinese economy in the future.

articleTitle: Applied Research of Real Option on the Project Valuation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Project evaluation in the process of investment decision-making is of great significance. This paper makes use of Ibbotson extension method to calculate the risk discount rate, and then evaluates NPV of the project. It puts forward an improved method aiming at the lack of real options and resorts to Monte Carlo for the volatility simulation of option, and finally realizes the sensitivity analysis of option value under the factors' disturbance. By comparative study, the reliability and rationality of the real options for project valuation is further proved, which provides a reliable basis for investment decisions.

articleTitle: Industrial Technological Innovation and Intellectual Property Protection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the marketing economy, the protection of the intellectual property rights is one of the basic functions of the government for developing domestic economy, coordinating the international political and economic relations, maintaining the market economy environment. In this paper, the DEA evaluation method and a broadly census was conducted to shed light to the relationship between the intellectual property protection and technological innovation of the enterprise. The research results indicate that the proper protection of the intellectual property is necessary for the technological innovation. In order to incentive the economy growth, the intellectual property protection should strengthen in the future for the economy development.

articleTitle: On the Effect of Brand Attitude on Brand Purchasing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Brand attitude always is one of most important factors influencing consumer behavior. This paper would focus on the effect of brand attitude on the brand buying intention. The results show that the brand attitude can moderate the relative importance of purchasing intention determinants. Detailedly, when consumers own positive brand attitude, the purchase attitude is more important; whereas when consumers own negative or ambiguous brand attitude, the subjective norm becomes more important. At last, the implication and limitations of this paper are presented.

articleTitle: A Study on the Theory and Method of Real Estate Market Harmony-Degree Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes the concept of real estate market harmony-degree, establishes evaluation system for the real estate market and provides method on how to evaluate real estate market.

articleTitle: Governments' Involvement in Internet Governance: A Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Internet governance has been a controversial issue among governments, private sector and Internet users since the US government ended its restriction on Internet in the early 1990s. However, as there is still no academic consensus on its definition, the concept of Internet governance can be very broad, and it is difficult to identify authors' arguments from different perspectives. This literature review paper focuses specifically on governments' involvement in Internet governance, and categorizes previous studies into three perspectives: overall views, technical architecture and public policy issues. By examining and discussing existing studies, this paper concludes that governments are both necessary and inevitable to be involved in Internet governance, but in order to make a better environment for the Internet and to enhance freedom, democracy and economic development in the real world, they need to limit their power, improve their transparency and coordinate with other stakeholders based on relevant international and regional platforms.

articleTitle: Link Analysis of China's Governmental Tourism Websites
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the data retrieved from the search engines Yahoo and Sogou, this paper aimed to study the web page counts, total backlink counts, external backlink counts and the Web Impact Factor (WIF) for governmental tourism websites of Chinese provincial capitals. By studied whether the web page counts, total backlink counts, external backlink counts and WIFs of websites associate with the rating of these websites, it was found that web page counts, external backlink counts and total backlink counts can be better evaluation indexes for governmental tourism websites of Chinese provincial capitals than WIFs. To expect those founding can promote the development of governmental tourism websites.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Equity Governance, Expropriation and Corporate Performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the circumstances of incomplete legal system of China, the equity governance characteristics have important influence on expropriation behavior of the controlling shareholder. This article examines the tunneling effect and relationship of equity governance, the result shows that: in China assets occupied, related guarantees and dividend distribution tunneling prevails in listed firms, which largely reduce the corporate performance. And equity governance factors significantly influence the extent of assets used and related guarantees, in particular, whether investors actively participate in governance which has more significant impact on expropriation.

articleTitle: Influence Factors Analysis & Developing Suggestions on Sport Marketing for Large-Scale & Middle Sized Enterprises in Shannxi Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a carrier of marketing, sport has been applied by many enterprises. This paper makes practical analysis on sport marketing for large-scale and middle sized enterprises with statistics investigation method. The results show that increasing gross incomes is the primary motive for enterprises to do sport marketing. The marketing cost is the important factor for promotion of sport marketing. Financial risks have notable impacts on sport marketing. This paper analyses the influence factors on sport marketing in enterprises and provides corresponding strategies and suggestions to make reference for enterprises' sport marketing.

articleTitle: The Correlation Studies of Economic Development and Environment Quality in Northwestern Areas
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study focuses on Northwestern areas in China. In order to find out the relation between economic development and environment quality in northwestern of China, the author, the author uses Environmental Kuznets Curves and analyzes the data from year 1991 to 2009. Through this detailed analysis the author also aims at predicting the future trend and ultimately finds out the sustainable development mode in northwestern areas. The result indicates that the relation among waste gas, water and per capita GDP displays an N model while industrial waste increases monotonically with per capita GDP. Through this study, the author finds out the cause of environmental problems in northwestern areas, summarizes the relation between economic development and environment quality in northwestern of China and correspondingly puts forward some suggestions to improve the environment.

articleTitle: Research of the Content Product Pricing Method Based on Exploitation of Digital Media Assets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Digital Media Assets are strategic resources with which media organizations could provide content services and face market competition. It is of important theoretical and practical significance to further study and solve content product pricing method based on exploitation of digital media assets Initially, the paper analyzes the pricing mechanism of content products based on exploitation of digital media assets, considering that it is an effective method to carry out market segmentation and price discrimination oriented by customer demand. On this basis, the paper puts forward the pricing method of digital media content products based on customer perceived value and builds a corresponding model.

articleTitle: A Method for Determining and Applying Index Weights in the Sector Performance Appraisal System Based on Process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Establishing the performance evaluation index system which covers the scientific index weight is the key to improve enterprises' performance appraisal reliability and validity. In this paper, it aims at the problem to determine index weights in decision-making process, based on the analysis of now available methods, utilizing grey and fuzzy theory to discuss the problem of enterprises process-based sector performance evaluation index weight, to ensure that index system is reasonable and objective, and enhance the assessment scientific level.

articleTitle: A Study on Travel Agency Brand Management - Based on the Questionnaire of Beijing Customers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the fierce market competition, brand management has become an important job for the travel agency's survival and development. In this paper, four components of brand management were proposed based on the "brand equity drivers" of David A. Aaker. The questionnaire survey of 102 Beijing consumers showed that travel agency should be from brand awareness, perceived brand quality, brand association¿Abrand satisfaction and loyalty to strengthen brand management. Meanwhile, the paper gave some advices according to the travel agency's shortcoming about four components of brand management.

articleTitle: Studies on Large-Scale Traveling Salesman Problem (LTSP) Based on Plant Growth Simulation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to solve large-scale or super large-scale traveling salesman problem efficiently and quickly, according to the general model of plant growth simulation algorithm, a solution method based on plant growth simulation is proposed. By calculating and testing on the real data instances, the results show that the optimum can be reached and the efficiency of the presented algorithm is reasonably, the proposed method has better performance.

articleTitle: Problems and Suggestions on Human Resources Development of China Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To improve effectiveness on human resource development of china enterprises, this paper adopts literature method, deductive reasoning method, and empirical analysis etc, systematically analysis problem on human resources development of china enterprise. It reaches problems that china enterprises resource development exist human resources plan undeserved, content single, basic function missing, development subject single etc. Then, it puts forward suggestions that china enterprises should take measures: strengthen theoretical study, comprehensive understanding of human resource development, setting up modern human resources development idea, building all-round development main body etc.

articleTitle: Strategy Cost Driver Research of Urban Railway Transportation Based on the Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an urban public transport, city railway transportation is far more concerned with its aggressive development in China, especially in recent years. Almost every local government has special interests to own one or more urban railways running across the city, but when they begin to consider the cost of planning, building and operation urban railways, they will find what a black hole they are facing. In order to improve investment efficiency, the strategic cost driver are introduced the urban railway transportation. This paper presented a strategy cost drivers schema of the urban public transport used the analytic hierarchy process.

articleTitle: Discussing on Uranium Resources Development Countermeasures under the Development of Nuclear Power Generation in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Chinese nuclear power development plan was presented, the situation of domestic uranium resources was discussed and the new situation of uranium resources development of related countermeasures was proposed briefly in this article. First, it strengthens uranium exploration; prospecting for deep concealed deposit, fill the gaps, further find out favorable area of uranium mineralization. Second, it actively develop the exploitation of overseas uranium resource and looking for a variety of forms of investments, and adopts the flexible ways of cooperation, in order to increase the uranium resources as far as possible. Third, the mining industry structure was optimized, the technology level was improved, the production cost was reduced, the scale of production was expanded, carried out the dominant role of mining and the subsidiary role of diversified economy of multiple structured management pattern to promote local economic rapid development. Fourth, it should be perfected related policy laws as well as regulations about uranium resources development, and establish a perfect system of assets income distribution.

articleTitle: Research about the Setting of Maintenance Cycle of New Energy Equipment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article aims to research the working life cycle of the new energy power device. The paper established a stochastic model to study the issue. This is useful to the process of power system applications.

articleTitle: A Study on Status and Related Measures of Small Medium Enterprises' Technological Innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Small medium enterprises occupy an important position in an economic development, and the strength of technical innovation ability is directly related to a country's overall scientific and technological innovation. Considering about the characteristics of small medium enterprises, the paper, first of all, analysis the small medium enterprises' technical innovation's necessity and feasibility. On this basis, it sorts out the surveying data of typical provincial, and summarize the situation of technological innovation of small medium enterprises in China. And then, it points out the suggestion of promoting technological innovation, and provides the theoretical basis for technological innovation's policies.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism of Consumer Generated Media
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper examines consumer-generated media (CGM).
