Our research will consider the domestic and global behaviors and findings will be useful for both researchers and marketing practitioners who seek to understand issues relevant to CGM and associated marketing tactics and their ability to accomplish marketing objectives, particularly related to building customer relationships and consumer behavior online. First, we overview the value and CGM aplications; second, we putforwad our hypothesis and research model and last we draw some conclusions and recommendations.

articleTitle: Research on E-Commerce Transaction Cost-Benefit Characteristics and Evaluation Approaches
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The E-commerce economy has become one of the issues in the economic growth for recent years due to many problems to be solved urgently in E-commerce accounting theory and method. The research of evaluation method of economic benefits has been one of the most important content in management theory and methods. Modern manufacturing enterprises and service enterprises are implementing actively in E-commerce strategy, and actively respond to the challenges of the network economy. Evaluate of the economic benefits of E-commerce has theoretical and practical significance in making investment and operating decisions. Because of network externalities and increasing marginal return regulation, the model of E-commerce transaction cost - benefit accounting is different from that of the traditional manufacture and commercial enterprises. This paper studied E-commerce transaction cost - benefit evaluation theory and methods of research by using traditional economic accounting theory and methods and the evaluation principles and methods for cost evaluation, benefit evaluation of combinations, based on this basis transaction costs - the break-even evaluation effective and comprehensive index evaluation method. And this study proposed a specific evaluation model and measurements methods.

articleTitle: Adaptation and Integration as Motives for Business Success in International Exploration: A Case Study of Huawei in Tanzania
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Accurate analysis is needed prior to the decisions regarding business international exploration in relation to the firm's organizational resources and capabilities, emerging industry constraints against the market intended to explore (Macro environment factors). It need to adapt the it's micro environment factors and look for the appropriate integration mechanism knowing exactly the starting point of the chain initiation and termination, chain barriers and it's measures. In this study the author used the structured likert-scale questionnaires to gather the primary data. The Chronbach Alpha was used for reliability analysis of the tested variables and the mean for the average scores of the respondents for each variable assessment. 94% of the responded agreed that Huawei (Tanzania) Tech. Co is well adapted both it's micro and macro environment factors and it employs the appropriate integration mechanisms which enhance the firm to increase it's stake. The micro - macro environmental factors model for integration frame work has been proposed as a continuous chain reaction overlapping one another very systematical and thus any gap between the chains led to malfunction of the firm's exploration. The study disclosed the two firms entered earlier in to the Tanzania market declined its market share but the reasons of its declining have been not studied in this paper.

articleTitle: Study on Valuation of Geographical Indication Property for the Purpose of Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Geographical Indication, as a intellectual property, which has a great economic value, is a important issue and gap on many international trade negotiations. Since the signing of the 1994 TRIPS Agreement, the community of scholars and relevant government departments in China carried out a lively discussion on geographical indication, but which mainly concentrated on the legislative and institutional development. In order to Improve value management level, this paper , From the asset evaluation angle ,elaborated the evaluation purpose of the geographical indications property, analyzed the value influencing factors in all respects, and proposed a new idea that was not limited to assess the value of assets on a specified day , designed a evaluation model of geographical indication property using the excess earnings method and fuzzy forecast method.

articleTitle: New Progress of Medical Equipment Quality Management in China's Hospital
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The status of meidical equipments quality management in China's hospital is analyzed in this paper. The top five problems of China's hospital in meidical equipments quality management, such as legal, standard, system,personel and resource, needs to be resovled is proposed. The three periods in progress of medical equipment quality management in China's hospital, enlightenment period, development period and quick development period, was analyzied. In the end, the foreground of medical equipment quality management in China's hospital was forecast.

articleTitle: The Analysis on the Feasibility and Outlook of Monetary Integration in East Asia
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper will be based on some related standpoints of monetary integration theory to discuss the feasibility of implementing monetary integration in East Asia. And basic on this, this paper will also analyze the three evolution phases that East Asia implement regional currency cooperation.

articleTitle: The Construction of MICE Customer Satisfaction Index Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It's of great significance to improve customer satisfaction for MICE industry. The goal of this research is to construct MICE Customer Satisfaction Index model which is based on the European Customer Satisfaction Index model.

articleTitle: Application of One Combined Algorithm in Enterprise Capability Appraisal Model Based on Rough Set and Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As businesses are many factors involved in capacity assessment, it is difficult to judge the results, aims at the imprecise and uncertainty of evaluation, an enterprise capability appraisal model based on rough set and fuzzy theory is given in the paper. A java program by using rough set algorithm is developed to determine weight of the index, then combining fuzzy evaluation to get the comprehensive evaluation. The actual application shows that the model is a feasible assessment method and makes the evaluation more rational.

articleTitle: Research on Learning Behavior of University Innovative Research Team - Based on Knowledge-Sharing Game Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: University innovative research team, as a representative form of research organization in university, have been become the main force of knowledge creation and output in national independent innovation system. Learning behavior is an effective mode for synergetic development of university innovative research team, and knowledge sharing makes the visualization and systematize of learning achievements come true. On the basis of connotation of university innovative research team and learning behavior, this paper analyzes the matrix relationship of them, and employs the knowledge-sharing game model to explore the actualization of knowledge sharing mechanism. Finally, interaction process model of learning behavior and team performance have been given in order to guide the efficient construction of university research team.

articleTitle: A Parallel Vulnerability Detection Framework via MPI
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Open source applications have flourished recent years. Meanwhile, security vulnerabilities in such applications have grown. Since manual code auditing is error-prone, time-consuming and costly, it is necessary to find automatic solutions. To address this problem we propose an approach that combines constraint-based analysis and model checking together. Model checking technology as a constraint solver can be employed to solve the constraint-based system. CodeAuditor, the prototype implementation of our methods, is targeted at detecting vulnerabilities in C source code. With this tool, 9 previously unknown vulnerabilities in two open source applications were discovered and the observed false positive rate was at around 29%.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Decision to Evaluate Comprehensive Quality of Sponsor Representative
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With China's constant perfection and development of securities market in public offer system, some professional researchers propose an implementation of grading management over sponsor representative. It is urgent to establish a scientific system to evaluate the overall quality of sponsor representative. This paper applies the method of fuzzy decision into the evaluation on sponsor representative in terms of comprehensive quality, in a hope to provide an academic support for the implementation of grading management over sponsor representative.

articleTitle: The Monopoly and Competition of Port Logistics Service: Circle Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Regional monopoly and competition are the common characteristics in the development of port industry, and coordination between them is of great significance for optimal development of port logistics services. This essay attempts to analyze monopoly and competition by using the Circle Model, in an effort to provide evidence for public policies concerning competition on a scale basis.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influences of Demurrage on Yard Utilization in Container Terminal
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years international trade has developed rapidly, while international trade is mostly done through the container transport. Therefore, the global container transportation is also developing rapidly, but this has brought unprecedented opportunities and challenges to the container terminal logistics industry. To face the growing terminals container throughput, the problem is how to improve the operational efficiency of container terminal, and maximize the rate of its operational capacity. Because of land scarcity in container terminals, the yard utilization in many container terminals is already in the edge of warning line. In this paper first establishing the simulation model of container terminal based on eM-Plant, and analysis the influences of time demurrage of container terminal on yard utilization(denoted as YU), then analyzing the data obtained from the simulation. Getting the optimum solution, and then provide support for decision-makers.

articleTitle: The Main Characteristics of the Model of Innovation in Australian Businesses and Their Rationale
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents along with economic globalization and the impact of fierce market competition, businesses are undergoing restructuring, resources innovation and change in the way of innovation in accordance with changes of the market, businesses continuous innovation and creating new market demand. This paper discusses the characteristics are the model of innovation, shows players, path, mechanism and survival condition those should be extremely complicatedly organized to form regional characteristics to adapt to local economy the mode is a systematic, comprehensive and flexible approach to analyze the incentives of innovative activities. The research focuses on the uniqueness of the model of the innovation in Australian businesses, what readily suit well Australian businesses are and their rationale, which elements interact that influence those models, and aims to advance innovation efficiency in Australia.

articleTitle: Structural Equation Model Analysis of Impact Factors on Scientific Research Motivation - Perspective on Self-Determination Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article analyzed the intrinsic motivations and extrinsic motivations of scientific researches based on the self-determination theory (SDT). Established the structural equation model of scientific research motivation, the multilayer effects of intrinsic and extrinsic motivations on scientific research were verified through the test of examples. Finally, some valuable management suggestions were given for scientific research units.

articleTitle: Capability Coordination with Option-Contract Based on Leader-Follower Game
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Logistics Service Supply Chain (LSSC) is different from finished goods inventory supply chain, in which supplier-buyer coordination is approached only through logistics capability adjustment and optimization. A kind of coordination mechanism by options contract on logistics capability based on leader-follower game is developed to increase the parties' expected profit in this paper. Results show that the negative linear relationship exists between option price and option execute price, and the value of option price must be located in a certain scope as the core element of contract parameters under channel coordination. The effectiveness of coordination mechanism and the proposed mechanism for the allocation of surplus system expected profit is verified through a numerical study finally.

articleTitle: Logistics Network Design Problem with Information Sharing Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the information sharing effects on the logistics center location problem, which is described by a bi-level programming model. The upper level is to determine the optimal sites of logistics centers to make the total cost (fixed and variable cost) minimum, in the range of fixed investment formulated by decision makers. The lower represents customers demand assignments among different logistics centers with different information sharing levels. Chaotic optimization algorithm (COA) is applied to solve the model. A simple example is given to illustrate the applications of the model and its algorithm.

articleTitle: The Specific Application on Importance Level Analysis in the Risk-Based Audit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is an important task in the current auditing occupational field to strengthen the management of the audit risk. The principle of importance is an effective audit tool which can be used to measure and control risk in the process of audit. Different accounting information users, different companies, different environments and different judge standards make it is unrealistic to establish the common importance standards that can be accepted by all accounting information users. Based on audit practice, the paper analysis the application on importance level in the risk audit, explores specific applications of importance level in the audit planning phase, implementation phase and evaluation audit results.

articleTitle: Lean Distribution System of Earthquake Relief Resources Research
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article making models is based on the supply chain management and set in the distribution of earthquake relief supplies. During earthquake disaster relief, it is important to send earthquake relief materials to the disaster area in as short a time as possible which depend on the material dispatching method. With Solving the problem of allocate and transport relief materials, it should be considered in timeliness, economy, efficiency. On the basis of analyzing the development of domestic and foreign relief materials logistics system, the model of lean logistics distribution system whose goal is to optimize the relief materials logistics system was built by adopting heuristic algorithm.

articleTitle: Assessment of Eco-Environment in Qingdao Based on Urbanization Development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Bringing urbanization development system in assessment system of urban eco-environment, and regarding it as reference system, based on the principle of interaction between urbanization and urban eco-environment. Then to estimate comprehensive development level of eco-environment in Qingdao during 2000-2009by principle component analysis (PCA), finally to assess relative development degree under the background of urbanization development by the model of relative development state and the membership degree function in fuzzy mathematics. The results show independent development level of eco-environment in Qingdao during 2000-2009 is upward, but fluctuating and being in lagging state relative to urbanization development, which indicates although absolute development level of eco-environment in Qingdao is improved year after year, relative level is unstable in the process of faster urbanization.

articleTitle: The Application of the Service-Profit Chain in the Mobile Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of a lack of service benchmarking framework, this research aims to develop a holistic telecommunication services industry benchmarking framework based on the service-profit chain concept and the characteristics of the cellular industry. The framework is based on idea from relevant literature. The authors discovered that nine constructs including three input constructs (e.g., service provider, competitors, and customer), five intermediate constructs (e.g., customer's perceptions, customer satisfaction (CS), customer trust (CT), customer loyalty (CL), and customer retention (CR)), and one output construct (e.g., profit) should be included in the model. In addition, contrary to previous works, it was found that each component of the service package (i.e., core, supplementary, and value-added services) should be considered as an individual element instead of a single complete service package. However, the nine constructs and their mutual links need to be tested and validated in the future. The main contribution of this research is the developed telecommunication services benchmarking framework linking together sources of sustainable competitive advantages - five intermediate constructs. While most researches tended to consider the complete service package as a single element, this work segregate the single package into several relevant service components. Hence, with limited resources, the relative level of impact of each service element on CS, CL, CR and profit could assist the formulation of service improvement efforts. In the other word, knowing the order-of-importance of service components, managements could allocate resources accordingly.

articleTitle: The Mode for Constructing the Competitive Advantage of Modern Industrial Logistic Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of economic globalization, the relationship between modern industrial logistics and manufacturing industry has become closer and closer. The industrial logistic service is an important constituent of the value of the product and the primary source of product differentiation. This paper analyzed the relationship between the industrial logistic service and the production-manufacturing system; And also, elaborated a value-chain logistic strategy for modern industrial logistic enterprises to provide an integrated solution for production-manufacturing enterprises. The strategy is based on the supplier management ability, customerized project management structure and information integration ability; besides, the strategy of Sinosteel is used as a case for analysis.

articleTitle: Deformation Monitoring and Analysis and Result Analysis of in Excavation Engineering of Qingdao Subway in Hexi Station
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The deformation monitoring plan are given and the in-situ monitoring study is demonstrated on the foundation pit deformation ,especially on the retaining piles deep horizontal displacement and steel strut axial forces of variation in this paper. Through reasonable and effective monitoring deformation of development foundation to meet the construction information requirements to achieve the purposes on safety prediction ,timely feedback , effectively construction guid.

articleTitle: Analysis on Wage Collective Bargaining Strategy of Central Government-Owned Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Wage collective bargaining provides a feasible way to establish normal wage growth mechanism. Due to factor of property rights, the wage collective talk of central government-owned enterprises is different from classical wage collective negotiation. The paper suggests establishing a two-level framework for wage collective talk. Analysis based on cooperative game theory indicates industry-level tale participated by department in charge, industry labor union and monitor is the most favorable. As for enterprise-level wage talk covered by industry-level talk, the result based on Rubinstein-Stahl Alternating Offer Mode demonstrates that counter-biding abilities of agents decides employees' actual wage increment rate working at central enterprises with the given distributable profits.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence Factors on Mobile Service Value - A Case Study of Mobile Phone TV
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mobile services are characterized by multi-actors, cross-industries, integrated, dynamics, interaction, and requirement uncertainty. These features make us hard to calculate their service value. This paper construct a network relationship model of actors in mobile service, study the ecosystem formed by these actors, and ecological level. Then we take mobile phone TV, the most typical service within mobile service as an instance, analyze the influence factors on mobile phone TV service value, propose a service value calculation model, and compute service value by means of conjoint analysis.

articleTitle: Comparative Research between Shocks of the International Financial Crisis on Mainland and Hongkong Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper adopts VAR model to analyze the different shocks of this financial crisis on the mainland and Hongkong market, and the reason of these differences, by observing the responses of A-H cross-listed companies. Besides, we use event analysis to study the volatility effect of two markets by different events during different periods of this crisis. Through the empirical research, we reveal how the crisis transmits to our capital market.

articleTitle: Lundberg's Inequality of Erlang(2) Perturbed Risk Model in Markovian Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A famous problem in nonlife actuarial field is considered in this paper. We extend Erlang(2) perturbed risk model to a Markov dependent model in which the inter-claim time, the claim amount, the premium rate and the volatility of the diffusion process are all regulated by a continuous-time Markov process. By the means of the martingale approach, we obtain an upper bound of the ruin probability of our model, described as the Lundberg's inequality, and derive a representation for the corresponding adjustment coefficient.

articleTitle: Project Management and Project Integration Management in Relationship with Service Marketing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The new economy made it necessary for researchers to focus on service marketing due to products not being successful on their own. Marketing techniques have changed from traditional which was based mostly on goods only, goods and services to services only which make it even easier for service marketing to succeed since its new and have higher demand. Therefore this article explains what service marketing is, factors leading to projects success. It explains the project processes and gives reasons why projects fail. The article is based on a literature review that presents the relationship between service marketing, project management and project integration management.

articleTitle: Develop Venture Capital and Promote Technical Innovation of University Science Park
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As incubation base and radiation center of technology achievements, University Science Park is in accordance with development requirement of enhancing China's competitiveness by indigenous innovations and therefore becomes the new impetus for regional economy developing. Currently, the main reason of restricting University Science Park development is lack of capital supporting which blocking conversion of scientific research achievements. Venture capital is an efficient way to solve the problem. Based on analysis current status and obstacles for national and overseas venture capital, this article put forward solutions for expending financing channels.

articleTitle: Research on Relation between Financial Support and Grain Production: Analysis from Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper has analyzed important relationship between financial support and grain production with Henan province as an example. It investigates the significance of finance as core of modern economy and important dynamic mechanism for guiding economic resource allocation. Measures for reinforcing financial support to facilitate sustainable development of grain production in Henan province, which is requirement of grain security and social development.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis on the Stress for the Portal of Two Parallel Tunnels
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A numerical analysis on the portal of two parallel tunnels is carried out, to learn about the effect on the staggered space of two tunnels to the liner stress of tunnel's portal. Thirty numerical models have been founded for analysis base on the different of staggered space of the two parallel tunnels. The results show that: if the clear distance and the separated mileage make change, the extreme value of maximum Mises stress value of tunnel liner is alterability and the section which locate the tunnel portal with maximum Mises stress is invariable; when the clear distance and the separated mileage are changed in a range, the effect of the clear distance and the separated mileage on the extreme value of maximum Mises stress value of tunnel liner is coupling.

articleTitle: The Mechanism and Approach of Channel-Based System Reform through the Separation of Program-Making from Broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: How to promote the "quasi-channel-based system" to "channel-based system" and how to raising up the efficiency of the channels' resource-allocation are both the concerns of media managers and researchers. This article analyzed some outstanding questions existing in the process of today's channel-based system reform such as homogeneous competition between channels, unbalanced development and unbleached structure in channels' right-responsibility-benefit. And it raised how to help the mechanisms and approaches of the channel-based system's reform and innovation by separation of program-making from broadcasting to realize the mutual benefit and common evolution of the two systems' reform.

articleTitle: Safety Assessment on Railway Crossings Based on Extension AHP and Set Pairs Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Focusing on the railway level-crossings in Dalian, from view of the system analysis, the reasons about the accidents factors in railway level-crossings are analyzed and assessed. Firstly, with Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) method, the accidents factors are divided into two levels, and then the weights of each level's factors are calculated; Secondly, Using the Extension Sets (ES) method, the safety-levels of these factors are identified; Finally, according to the accident weights and safety-levels of the influencing factors, basing on the Set Pair Analysis (SPA) theory, the safety status of the railway level-crossing is mastered. The research results show that the safety weights of the railway level-crossing accounts for 30.01%, the hazard weight accounts for 29.67%, the assessing result is set pair equipollence, and so the level-crossing is in danger. With this assessment method, the safety status of the railway level-crossing is described more accurately, and it has certain guidance to the railway level-crossing safety classification.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Coordination between Defense Spending and Economic Development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper gave review on domestic and foreign research literature, methods, and conclusions about the coordination between defense spending and economic development. Balancing well the need to build a strong defense with economic development in the process of Chinese modernizing construction, the paper proposed an evaluation index system, as well as an assessment model. The paper also presented some empirical research by applying the related statistic data for the years 1997-2007, and drew a conclusion of the relationship of coordinated development.

articleTitle: Study on Allocation Efficiency of Physical Capital of Chinese Papermaking and Paper Products Industry - An Empirical Analysis on Panel Data
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An empirical analysis is made, based on the capital allocation efficiency model of Jeffrey Wurgler, on the quantitative relationship between physical capital growth and profit growth of Chinese papermaking and paper products industry. The results show that the physical capital allocation of China papermaking and paper products industry is inefficient. Therefore the main factors which constrain physical capital allocation efficiency of China papermaking and paper products industry are further analyzed from the viewpoint of capital management and financial channel. Finally, at the aspects of business model, capital utilization and regional layout, the systematic countermeasures are suggested to optimize physical capital allocation efficiency of Chinese papermaking and paper products industry.

articleTitle: A Search Algorithm for Solving the Economic Lot Scheduling Problem with Returns under the Basic Period Approach
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this study, we are interested in the economic lot scheduling problem (ELSP) that considers manufacturing of the serviceable products and remanufacturing of the returned products. In this paper, we formulate a mathematical model for the ELSP with returns using the basic period approach. In order to solve this problem, we propose a search algorithm to find the cyclic multiplier k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> of each product that can be cyclically produced for every k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> basic periods. This research also uses two heuristics to search for the optimal production sequence of all lots and the optimal time length of the basic period so as to minimize the average total cost. This research uses a numerical example to show the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: Research on the Establishment of Evaluation System of E-Commerce Enterprise Value
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays e-commerce as an increasing important business mode has exerted great impact on traditional business mode. Against this background, it is of special significance to research how to assess the value of e-commerce enterprise. This article will establish the evaluation system from four aspects which includes financial indicator, customer base indicator, company's overall ability indicator and credit indicator. Factor analysis method will be adopted to make evaluation. Standards of classifying e-commerce enterprise value will be created and a systemic research of e-commerce enterprise value will be conducted.

articleTitle: Incentive Strategy of Human Resources in Education Organization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the era of economic globalization and knowledge economy of today, education has been placed in important positions around the world. Educational organizations as the inexhaustible human society forward momentum carries to lead the dissemination of social development and cultural mission, it uses the wisdom of fire illuminate the endless course of development of mankind. Teachers, becoming the main force of human resources, culture and knowledge of modern science and technology producers and creators, is the promoter and disseminator of advanced culture, is to promote the development of advanced productive forces and an important force for social progress.

articleTitle: Groundwater Management in Shanghai, China: History, Problems and Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Groundwater management is a new challenge for most developing countries. A case study of Shanghai groundwater management history is put forward to provide experiences for other countries. The paper classified Shanghai groundwater exploitation history (since 1961) into 5 phases, considering the over exploitation in different aquifers and consequently land subsidence in different times. Measures, carried out by Shanghai Water Authority, are analyzed, including exploitation reduction and recharge. Intergraded water management is suggested for the sustained development of groundwater management in Shanghai, especially discussing currently overlapping institution mechanism among different departments, few economic management methods, vacant of basin plan and management, etc.

articleTitle: The Research of Riskguard Mechanism in Enterprise and University Cooperation Innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Because of the complexity and uncertainty of the process of collaborative innovation in enterprise and university cooperation innovation, There are various risks in cooperation. Based on the questionnaire survey and case studies ,This paper apply the risk management theory and put forward eight different risks which exist in enterprise and university cooperation innovation. Finally give the way of evaluating these risks.

articleTitle: Financial Management in Network Economy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Network economy is based on network technology. It is a new economy which there is no space and time, geographical restrictions between producers and consumers of consultation. In this new economic model, all aspects of business management are gradually realizing the network on-line management. However, the traditional financial management concept and mode will be inevitably impacted in large degree. It is necessary to consider the management innovation problems, in order to adapt to economic changes and development. This article proposed network economy under the financial management of the reconstruction of ideas, from the financial management objectives and concept, content and way of working and so on.

articleTitle: On the Regional Economic Growth Pattern Transformation in the Context of Ecological Civilization of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the context of ecological civilization, China traditional regional economic growth model should be changed into the pattern which is helpful to save resources and protect ecological environment. Paper analyzes the motivation and purpose of the change, and then proposes that the effective approaches of achieving regional economic growth pattern transformation involve the regional production element structure adjustment, economic performance model transformation and space structure optimization.

articleTitle: The Conflicts of Geographical Indications between Mainland China and Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of the conflicts of geographical indications between mainland China and Taiwan. Mainland adopts the mixed model while Taiwan mainly adopts the trademark protection model supplemented by the anti-unfair competition protection. The GIs conflicts between mainland and Taiwan have existed because of business moving, historical factor, same geographical names and lack of communications. Finally, suggestions are given as follows: cultivate the awareness of geographical indications among the public, establish the cooperative system, make use of industrial associations and provide severe punishment.

articleTitle: Public Service Provision: An Analytical Framework Based on the E-Government
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-government application can help the government serve better the public and businesses in a virtual environment, which reflects responsiveness to customer needs in the information age. This article gives an analytical framework based on the e-government in terms of the transformation of government functions, work and financial authority matching and performance management.

articleTitle: Research on Impact Mechanism of Refined Safety Management in Coal Enterprises: From Knowledge Internalization on Organizational Level
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study will analyze the refined safety management of Chinese coal enterprise by means of the high-level interviews, case analysis and investigation. And it will also use real evidence and case studies to verify the effectiveness of contents and systems of the enterprises' refined safety management. This work will help the enterprises shake off backwardness and low efficiency of safety management and performance. In addition, it will help reduce accidents, improve safety management performance, promote production, and enhance safety quality.

articleTitle: Property Adjusting of Magneto-Rheological Damper Using Neural Network Adaptive Filter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Magneto-rheological (MR) damper is one kind of damping changeable component which output damping force can be controlled by input current under certain working condition. There are many models have been developed to predict MR damper's output include LMS force method which has been developed in our previous research. But most of model with unchangeable parameter which have been selected under certain condition in lab cannot adjust itself to adaptive actual working condition even under a small disturbance, such as temperature. To develop a method which can adapt different working condition, an adaptive filter has been studied based on neural network with BP update program. Furthermore to adjust MR damper's property to expected damping function, an adaptive inverse control method has been presented with the adaptive filter in this paper. The numerical simulation results indicate that the adaptive filter can fix the error introduced by varied working condition, the control precision of characteristic of magneto-rheological damper is better than phenomenon model, and the damping characteristic of MR damper can be controlled by using the adaptive inverse control method.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Spread and Investment Effect of Tourism Industry in Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By using input-output model, this paper analysize the spread effect of tourism industry in Henan Province from the spread routes, effect power and effect power coefficient, sense degree and sense degree coefficient, and take Xinyang as an example to analysize the investment effect of tourism industry. The results show that the tourism industry in Henan province is the basis and belong to final demand industry, and has weak power to boost and promote the economy, and closely linked with food manufacturing and tobacco processing industries, accommodation and catering, transportation and warehousing industry and other sectors. However, tourism industry has significant investment effect.

articleTitle: Study on Value of Low-Carbon Economy of e-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of e-business at an alarming rate of the national economy has become an indispensable force, and its low-carbon characteristics fit the requirements of low-carbon economy. However, the value of low-carbon economy of e-commerce has not aroused the special attention. This paper analyzes the economic value of low carbon of e-commerce, and discusses the need for development of e-commerce in the environment of low-carbon economy.

articleTitle: How to Design the Motivation Mechanism for Knowledge Sharing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: knowledge sharing (KS) could add to increment for knowledge of its organization. But there are so many of barriers in the KS process, because of so many influencing factors which include individuals & knowledge characteristic, & organization, and etc. So Pareto Optimum achievement should be used for how to improve the KS performance under positive motivation. Conceptual model of the knowledge sharing is put forward based on knowledge sharing mechanism researched by analyzing the drive-force of the knowledge sharing deeply & utilizing the uncompleted information dynamic repetition game theory, which gives more theory foundation to design Optimum mechanism for KS.

articleTitle: Agricultural Risk Diversification and Loss Compensation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Agricultural risk diversification and loss compensation are main content of agricultural development. Agricultural insurance and produce futures are major approaches to spread agricultural risks and to offset the loss. A series of measures should be proposed to manage risk and compensate the loss of agricultural risk in Xinjiang, such as to perfect the risk spreading system of agriculture insurance, to set up the platform of agricultural information marketization, and to strive to develop contract produce.

articleTitle: Value-Added Service of Trade Fair Organizer: An Evidence from Concurrent Events in China International Industry Fair (CIIF)
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Research into the value-added service of trade fair organizer is scarce, and analyzing the success of brand fair CIIF from a perspective of concurrent event has seldom been undertaken. The paper examines the concurrent events of CIIF in recent five years from 2006-2010. The result suggests that concurrent event planning is the unique service element for the creation and maintenance of an excellent image of the fair and in attracting both domestic and international exhibitors and professional visitors to attend and reattend the fair. The findings will result in more targeted marketing by trade fair organizers in order to achieve the acquisition of more exhibitors and visitors and enhance the competitive ability of the exhibition enterprise.

articleTitle: Comparison on Two Analysis Methods of Strategic Network: Whole and Dyad Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Relational attribute and structure attribute are the two main attributes of firm's network. Most researchers' works are based on them. We compared the two analysis methods and found that there are different effects by using difference analysis method. The dyad analysis method can give a focus and deep view of the relations. And the whole network analysis method can provide a whole and integrated understanding of the network's function.

articleTitle: A New Hybrid Method for Short-Term Price Forecasting in Iran Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, a new hybrid method for prediction of the weighted average price (WAP) of Iran electricity market is introduced. The proposed model has a linear structure which its components are selected based on correlation analysis of WAP time series with its past values and the total required load as the most effective variable in this market as well as the critiques of Iran electricity market. The model coefficients are tuned by Genetic algorithm (GA) as an optimization algorithm based on available data from electricity market of Iran. The simulation results based on experimental data from Iran electricity market are representative of good performance of developed model in forecasting the market behavior.

articleTitle: The System Analysis of Force about Factor Impacting on City Size - The Case of Changshu City in Jiangsu Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The reasonable value of city size is required in the process of city planning with the rapidly development of urbanization. The paper divides some factors impacting on city size into three strikes of sustaining, restricting and driving, with the help of strike definition in physics. When three strikes are on balance, city development is considered among reasonable scale. Firstly, based on revised eco-footprints method, sustaining strike is applied with land area to response the sustain ability of city development. Secondly, applying the method and theory of thresh analysis, restricting strike is included energy, water resource, land resource and environmental capacity, and analyzing them restricting city development. Thirdly, driving strike mostly is analyzed by the use of semi-quantitative method. At the same time, Changshu city in Jiangsu province is system analyzed as the case using the above corresponding method and theory. It is concluded that it has only 50% land area to sustain itself and it is a typical export city. And it's restricted strikes include water resource and environmental capacity.

articleTitle: Technology Integration - An Approach to Accelerate Technology Transfer in CNPC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Technology Integration makes a significant contribution to the oil companies' business success. There are two types of technology integration being identified in oil industry: one focus on technology development which played as a novel R&D approach and the other focus on technology application which viewed as a new production pattern. The challenge to promote effective technologies transfer and maximize the commercial value of established advanced technologies within CNPC has met through the implementation a strategic plan call "Technology Tangibility". The essential to the plan is technology integration, which is not the same with the prior two types of technology integration, but a new type of technology integration identified in oil industry. "Technology Tangibility" focuses on turning new developed technology or existing effective key technologies to their application through integrating individuals technologies into an integrated technology package. By implementation of function integration, information integration and distribution integration, Technology Tangibility enables the original technologies to be standardization and formalization and presents an visible offerings and perceivable value to the end-users. Business benefit is realized through accelerated technology transfer as a result of improved communication efficiencies and lowered barriers to adopt.

articleTitle: Strategies to Improve Daqing Service Outsourcing Competency
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Daqing service outsourcing industry has developed rapidly, but the competency of the industry needs to be further improved. Based on the effective competency research tool - Diamond Model, the paper analyses Daqing service outsourcing competency from six aspects, including factors of production, demand, related industries, enterprise strategy, structure and competition, opportunity, and government. Then, it puts forward competency improving strategies of establishing industrial strategies, developing diversified international market and increasing the recruitment and training of service outsourcing talents.

articleTitle: The Influential Factor of the Responsiveness in Intangible Cultural Heritage Tourism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper puts the responsiveness in the view of the tourist of t This paper puts the responsiveness in the view of the tourist of the intangible vulture heritage and research the relation between the responsiveness and the experience of the tourists, It points out that the factor of the responsiveness is the tourists' subjective evaluation of the tourist experience of the intangible culture heritage, defines the conception of responsiveness and the category of the theory research, and constructs the model and extended models of the responsiveness theory. In the theory model of responsiveness, the paper probes two variables which influence tourists' responsiveness of the intangible culture heritage. One is the varible of the experience subjects, and the other, the experience object. Besides, by the use of the research result about the theory for reference, the paper defines the variables of experience subject and object, dimensions and index of measure, and puts forward five hypotheses.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Development Strategy of Technological Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises under Tail Financial Crisis Background
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: During the global economic development advancement, technological small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) with the characteristic of high technology content, big growth potential and flexible mechanism have become the power to improve the world economic development and an important index to weight comprehensive national power. As an important carrier of technological innovation, the technological SME are playing an influential role in technological innovation and are also the big guarantee for the national adjustment and optimization of industry construction and the transformation of economic development mode. Financial crisis's haze has passed quietly and the tail financial crisis era has arrived along with it with the symbol that the European and American entity and the financial industry are turning better, and the newly-emerging nations extensively carry out the currency contraction policy due to the bloating pressure. Speaking of Chinese technological SME, how to promote and develop under the tail financial background, has the important meaning for advancing the upgrading of industry construction and the transformation of economic development mode, promoting our country's independent innovation ability and the international competitiveness, and acceleration the sustainable development of the economy and society.

articleTitle: The Determinants of the Operational Performance for Food Ingredient Suppliers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims to analyze the factors that influence customer profit contribution for a food ingredient supplier by using a case study. A total of 644 corporate clients of this supplier are sampled from January 2007 to December 2009. By running a multiple regression model, this paper conducts an empirical analysis in order to understand the factors that influence the customer profit contribution. It is hoped that the research findings can provide a reference for the management of the supplier in question. The results show that prices, credit days, and transportation distance are negatively correlated with the customer profit contribution. All of the other factors such as the percentage of compound products, customer loyalty, and business intensity are all positively correlated with the customer profit contribution. This paper can serve as a reference to food ingredient suppliers for risk management, the planning of working capital, business strategies, revenue targets, and customer loyalty. This can also assist suppliers in the adjustment of supply chains in order to pursue sustainable growth in a highly competitive market.

articleTitle: A Model of Managerial Overconfidence, Moral Hazard and Corporate Investments
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper studies the impact of managerial overconfidence on corporate investments under the moral hazard framework. By assuming a fully competitive and information-transparent capital market as well as rational investors, the study finds that managerial overconfidence reduces moral hazard, but may result in over- or under-investments; the relationship between managerial overconfidence and inefficient investment probability is non-monotonic; managerial overconfidence is positively related to investment-cash flow sensitivity. The paper also analyses the roles of supervision and incentives in preventing inefficient investments by overconfident managers.

articleTitle: The Enterprise Innovation Performance, R&D Investment and Default Risk - Based on the Listed Company in Yangtze River Delta Region
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper , basing on the measurement of the innovations and the default risk indicators, we take default risk as the induced variable, and take R&DR, innovations, corporate size, system risk and asset-liability ratio as the dependent variable, to empirical analysis the correlation among the listed company's default risk ,innovation performance and other variables. By the empirical analysis of 241 listed companies, we find that the main factors which affect the DR consisting of Constant, firm size, Lev, R&DR, region, year, and R&DR. And there are problems of over-investment in R&D existed before the financial crisis. The regression coefficient of innovation performance is negative before the financial crisis, but it is positive after the financial crisis, which is consistent with the conclusions of many abroad literatures.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Evaluation Index System of Investment Value of City
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the propelling urbanization and the rapid development of economy, society and city, and the teeming of question s on city' s development and construction cry for external, comprehensive, scientific analysis and evaluation of the development of the urban economy, especially the evaluation of investment value as soon as possible. In order to formation of a scientific and rational the evaluation index system of Investment value of city, under the principle of systematism, relativity and importance, this paper displays an comprehensive evaluation index system that it make up by three aspects: urban comprehensive matching capacity, investment cost and investment benefit, then, combines the Delphi method with the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) method to work out the weight of each index. Finally, generates the composite index which are processed in standard way. Take Liaoning Province as an example, in this way, this paper has carried on the comprehensive rank and appraised to the city, has analyzed the advantages and disadvantages of investment value. Such sorting and analysis will help to define the direction and the strategic measures for urban development, to make scientific policy-decision for the investors to invest scientifically.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Game Analysis of Cooperative Innovation in Industrial Clusters
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Innovation capability is a critical factor of the survival and continuous development of industrial clusters. The research of innovation mechanism not only plays a guiding role for the competitive advantages and development of industrial clusters, but also has important meaning for sustainable development of regional and even social economy. Cooperative innovation is a major operation form of cluster innovation. Considering the condition of the equality of innovation initiators and cooperators, an evolutionary game model was built based on Replicator Dynamic and the evolutionary process and results of cooperative innovation were analyzed. It was concluded that the deepness of cooperative innovation can be promoted by increasing the sharing private resources paid by initiators and cooperators. Finally the suggestions were indicated for promoting the cooperative innovation of industrial clusters.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Innovation Theory in the Service Economy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development in ICT over the past century have accelerated spectacularly in the past few decades. This has opened a new way forward for innovation and productivity improvement in services via their impact on organization and coordination. Innovation in services has received a great boost recently from new ICT and accompanying market evolution. This is more than just an outward shift in the production function, but rather the evolution of economic coordination through increasing division of labor. In this paper, we propose a theory of this evolutionary process.

articleTitle: Optimal Profit Model in Coordinating Supply Chain with Stochastic Demands
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Coordination between two different business entities is an important way to gain competitive advantage. The collaboration and coordination between upstream and downstream in the supply chain is the key to gain for the whole supply chain system. This paper analyzes the relationship of the cost and the profit between supplier and buyer in supply chain, establishes general cost-profit model in a two-period supply chain, and obtains non-coordinated model without outsourcing under shortage and coordinated model with outsourcing under shortage. The paper also illustrates the feasibility of the model through a numerical example.

articleTitle: Does Corporate Social Responsibility as a Governance Mechanism in China?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, increasingly attention to Corporate Social Responsibility(CSR) incurred the suspicious of "maximized profits of Shareholders". Companies must be responsible for the stakeholders, this is a realistic question. However, undertaking social responsibility will affect the operating target, and then if this can affect corporate governance has become focus and aroused much attention, this question has been verified by quantities of studies, then, if we can take CSR as a corporate governance mechanism? Is CSR a internal or external governance mechanism? There is no conclusion, and the studies are very limited. However, this article analysis the relationship between CSR and corporate governance, and we think that integrating CSR and corporate governance is the realistic way companies can choice, only through corporate governance, CSR can become true and be practical. China has its own special characteristics on equity structure ,and the capital is imperfect, So this article has a positive sense for constructing the Chinese harmonious society, and promoting the Chinese companies undertaking CSR and completing corporate governance.

articleTitle: Research on Interaction Technological Talent Accumulation and Economic Development Level
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays, with the development of innovative knowledge-based economy, scientific and technological talent has become one of the key factors in promoting the economic development. And the major purpose of solving the problem of scientific and technological talent accumulation is to better promote the economic development as well. The economic development and scientific and technological talent accumulation have mutual influence in their interaction. In this article, we firstly define the connotation of scientific and technological talent, and then analyze the interactive relationship between scientific and technological talent accumulation and finally propose the relevant policies and measurements for forming the scientific and technological talent accumulation effect on the basis of the preceding analysis.

articleTitle: Study on Service Enhancement Competitive Strategy for Manufacturing Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service enhancement strategy is an important differential competitive strategy adopted by manufacturing enterprise, it will develop a far-reaching influence on manufacturing development, and enhance competitiveness by "service" has become an important strategic choice for our manufacturing enterprise in background of global competition and knowledge economy. This article analyzed manufacturing's competition background, and discussed obstacles in implementing, finally it proposed implementing steps and guarantees, therefore it will provide the beneficial reference for formulating service enhancement strategy of manufacturing enterprise.

articleTitle: The Optimization Research on the Mechanized Production Model of Rice-Wheat Rotation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Rice-wheat rotation is one of the principal planting patters of rice and wheat in China. Research on mechanical production model and economic benefit of rice-wheat rotation can further optimize the production model. The paper defined rice-wheat rotation region of China and divided the region into three parts including developed area in the east coastal, major grain producing area in midland, less-developed area in southwest. Study out 10 typical mechanization production models in rice- wheat rotation region by analyzing the present situation. Then compare the models at the cost, output value and proceeds. Analyze the trend of different areas on the principle of efficiency, economy and equipment practicable.

articleTitle: The Missing Theoretical Basis of Performance Management: Review and Prospect
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Research in the field of performance management is characterized by an applied focus. And there is a growing need for researchers in this field to make explicit the theoretical basis of applied performance management. Existing explorations on the theoretical basis of performance management has been reviewed. Suggestions for the future exploration are offered.

articleTitle: The Research on Index System of Concessionaire Selection in Traffic BOT Projects
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Because of the inherent complexities and strategic impacts of BOT (build-operate-transfer) projects call for careful concessionaire selection methodologies. Selection of the right concessionaire, which is critical to the success of such BOT projects, depends on the quality of identifying and defining suitable project-specific criteria and the quality of formulating an efficient tender evaluation methodology. This paper analyzes and draws experiences and lessons from this concessionaire selection practice and evaluation methods.

articleTitle: Concentration Ration and Structural Embeddedness of Equipment Manufacturing Industry in Heavy Industrial District: Case of Heilongjiang, China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial clusters are usually referred to as spatially concentrated networks of small and medium sized firms. Rich literature concerning these industrial clusters has focused on high-tech industry and labor-intensive firms. In this paper we attempt to identify concentration ration and structural embeddedness of equipment manufacturing industry in Heilongjiang province by use the existing conceptual frameworks and related theories. This paper researches the cluster's concentration ration and concentrated networks then puts forward some suggestions as to how to overcome these problems and to carry out the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Organizational Culture Construction Based on Knowledge Sharing at Libraries
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This thesis discusses the flow and influencing factors of knowledge sharing, and puts forward 3-dimensional theory of organizational culture construction based on knowledge sharing at libraries, which is composed of value dimension, system dimension, and conduct dimension.

articleTitle: The Benefit Game behind the Policy of "Home Appliances Going to the Countryside"
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzed the behavior of major relevant stakeholders¡agovernment, home appliances enterprises, rural dealers, farmers in the "Home Appliances Going to the Countryside". Established the following game models based on the game theory: the complete information dynamic game model between government and home appliances enterprises, the infinitely repeated game model between home appliances enterprises and farmers. The equilibrium results showed that the government was necessary to pre-investigate the credit of home appliance enterprises, the home appliances enterprises must provide high quality home appliances to the countryside in the long interests, otherwise would cause a lose-lose situation. In the end, the different proposals were put forward to the government and home appliances enterprises to achieve all relevant stakeholders win.

articleTitle: Perceived Developmental Performance Appraisal and Knowledge Sharing Behavior in China: Do Traditionality and Organization Ownership Matter?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We found that perceptions of developmental PA was positively related to knowledge sharing behavior .Their relationship was mediated by affective organizational commitment and moderated by individual traditionality and organizational ownership types.

articleTitle: Maximum or Minimum Option Pricing Model in Fractional Jump-Diffusion Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Assume that the stock prices satisfy the fractional jump-diffusion processes, the financial market model in fractional Jump-diffusion environment is built. By means of actuarial method and fractional jump-diffusion process theory, the explicit pricing formulae for European maximum or minimum option are obtained.

articleTitle: Evolvement of Life Cycle of Artificial Ecological Recreation Site and Analysis on Its Countermeasure - A Case Study of Chengdu
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Theory of life cycle in tourist destination put forward by Butler is a kind of theory describing evolution and change in recreation site, based on this theory, feature and law of life cycle at 2 types of representative artificial ecological recreation site in Chengdu, Huanhuaxi Brook and Sansheng Village, are analyzed, interior and exterior factors influencing change of their life cycle are analyzed, countermeasure to prolong their life cycle is put forward, which has directive signification for future development of recreation site of the same type.

articleTitle: The Applying of AHP Method in an Engineer Blast Project
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In engineering blasting practice, there are a lot of unsafe factors which have big uncertainty. Some of them can't fully quantitative analysis. So it's difficult to select a good blasting scheme selection. Using AHP method can solve the problems. This paper introduces the working principle of AHP method. And it discusses the specific application, combining a Qingdao blasting engineering case.

articleTitle: The Basics Issues on the Security Information Management Practices in Organizational Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The main purpose of this paper is to illustrate the complexities and solutions involving data and knowledge and to establish the effective practices of the information security management (ISM), and also to create an awareness to the information users of the benefits and advantages surrounding security as well as examining whether the methods are reliable on the organizations management theories and information system approach.

articleTitle: The Principal-Agent Models about Risk Seeking Players
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The principal-agent model, which is used to study the incentive problem in corporate and in western countries, is generally under the assumptions that principal being risk neutral and agent being risk aversion. By analyzing, the organization's risk attitude, which is jointly determined by decision maker's risk attitude, competition situation of the industry and external environment, is likely to be risk neutral and risk seeking in China. So, when studying the incentive problem between organizations in China, the existing assumptions should be viewed as enormously restrictive and the conclusion should be not valid everywhere. Two models, one that is the principal being risk seeking and agent being risk neutral, the other that is principal being risk seeking and agent being risk seeking ,will be structured. In order to compare with risk aversion, measure of absolute risk seeking and the gain associated to the risk are defined. The optimal incentive contract declare that the agent will share either all or no risk; boundary conditions depend on the value of parameters which are risk, measure of absolute risk seeking and the cost of effort.

articleTitle: Chinese and American Request Strategy: A Study on the Speech Act Behavior of the College Students
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Request speech act is frequently performed in daily life. The present study examines request strategies produced by Chinese and American college students in English. 30 Chinese and 30 Americans participate in the study and they all major in management. The data are collected by means of a modified written Discourse Completion Test. The findings indicate Chinese and American college students have more similarities than differences in terms of request strategy. However, Chinese are influenced by pragmatic transfer when they choose request strategies. The study has implications to develop Chinese English learners' sociopragmatic and intercultural competence, which will facilitate intercultural communication and management in the future.

articleTitle: Study on Financing System of Low-Rent Housing in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The low-rent housing system is an important complements of the housing provision system in China. But, the development speed of the low-rent housing system is limited for a variety of factors in the past decade. Compared to the huge demand of the low rent house, only a small number was benefited from this policy. And financing is the key problem of low-rent houses. However, the financing channel of low-rent housing construction in China is still narrow, it is difficult to satisfy the very big fund demand if only depend on the current mode of financing. This paper systematically analyzed the main problems of the financing system related to low-rent housing in China. After compare and classify the current innovation patterns, the paper summarized the framework of the financing system of the low-rent house and point out the direction of innovation in future. Finally, suggestions were put forward for the comprehensive use of financing patterns and the optimization of capital allocation of low-rent house projects.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Web Mail Forensics System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the continuous development of network technology, Web mail technology has become an important means of information transmission and management in government agencies, enterprises and individuals, however, the subsequent problems of protecting web mail security has become a concern to users. This paper presents a free, flexible and not dependent on the mail protocol web mail forensics system model by deep study of Email principle and method on the basis to network forensics, so as to improve the mail safety and accuracy. This paper in the end verified the validity and rationality of the model.

articleTitle: A Theoretical Framework for the Identifying, Assessment and Development of Competency of Border Officers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Border officers are a special group within the board range of army officers. They are responsible for the organization and implementation of the development of border armies. Therefore the competency of these officers will directly affect the successfulness of these developments. Through a review of relevant literatures this paper first gives an overview on the state of competency research. This paper then presents a method on how a competency model for border officers can be constructed. Future research in this area can utilize the framework in their construction of competency models.

articleTitle: On Legal Issues of the Internet-Based Digital Copyrights
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the virtual space of internet, social subjects minimize the cost of accessing information. There is a new means of communication for the works protected by the traditional copyright system and the accession to the original cultural products is also changed in a great extant. While the further developments of the information technology make the existing balance of interests changed, which triggers off the problems such as fair use, freedom of expression, protection of privacy, etc. All in all, some measures must be taken to resolve the problems in the dimension of the rule of law, the digital rights management(DRM).

articleTitle: Analysis on Technical Progress Contribution to the Development of Dairy in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, the development of China's dairy industry is an important stage. On the one hand, foreign companies speed up the penetration of Chinese dairy industry; on the other hand, domestic dairy enterprises competed fiercely. It is necessary to objectively measure the contribution of various production factors and technical progress in dairy industry to development in order to achieve a better resources allocation. The paper, using 1994-2008 data of China's dairy industry, constructs dairy growth model which references the basic idea of Solow model including technical Progress factor. The results show that the technical progress contribution rate of China's dairy industry is 51.01% on average, which surpasses the contribution rate of capital and labor these two factors. The author also further compares China's dairy industry contribution rate of technical progress before and after China entering WTO. Finally, author conducts an economic analysis on results, in the development process of dairy industry, the technical progress plays a major role; while production factors have been a transfer phenomenon in dairy industry cycle.

articleTitle: The Comprehensive Evaluation of Railway Freight Enterprises' Performance Based on the Balanced Scorecard Card and AHP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Firstly this article analyses the factors of SWOT impact for the railway freight business performance; and then we calculate the weight of each factor which is identified by four dimensions in the BSC decomposition and AHP analysis; TOPSIS is used to make the horizontal comparison of different companies with AHP the weight and get the final ranking of enterprise. Research shows that: Research result showed that this method was practical and feasible. It has important reference value of the practical method for railway freight transportation enterprise performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Study on Software Safety in Industrial System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Many cases of system hazards caused by software failures. To prevent system hazard leaded by software failure, steps insuring software safety must be done. Activities of software safety including safety analyses, safety design and safety evaluation should be deployed surrounding software safety requirements. Software safety development runs through every stage of software developing Lifecycle.
