As a subset of the integrate system, all activities of software including safety development should be go through the system. During software developing lifecycle, hazard identification, hazard analysis, testing, and hazard tracking are processed to ensure system safety.

articleTitle: Study on Telecom Operators' Competitiveness under the Network Convergence
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the changes of the operators' competitiveness structures under the background of 2/3G network convergence. First, it builds the operators' competitiveness structure model from dynamic perspective. Second, it analyzes the relationship between capability and resources of telecom operators and its impact on enterprises competitiveness in the light of resources and capacities. Finally, it compares the differences of competitiveness structure model between the 2G and 2/3G network convergence and put forward the developing direction and the strategy for operators under 2/3G network convergence.

articleTitle: The Mid-High-End Talent's Job Embeddedness, Turnover Intention, and Cooperative Behavior: Job Insecurity as a Moderator
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper take the Mid-high-end talents working in China as study subject, investigated the relationships among job embeddedness (JE), turnover intention, and Cooperative Behavior. Moreover, it focused on the role of job insecurity (JI) as a moderator among these processes. A self-administered questionnaire survey method was used to collect data from 586 the mid-high-end talents personnel working in Beijing, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Wuhan, and other areas. The hierarchical regression analysis was conducted for data analyses. The findings indicate that JE has significant positive effects on cooperative behavior and significant negative effects on turnover intention, and JI was moderating the relationship between JE and the consequence variables.

articleTitle: Hybrid Genetic Algorithm for Inventory Management Based on Postponement Strategy and Bilevel Programming Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An optimal inventory model with postponement strategy, that is a bilevel integer programming model, is considered. A hybrid genetic algorithm together with branch and bound algorithm is proposed to solve this model. The numerical simulation shows that the results obtained in this paper not only improve the inventory benefits of overall supply chain, and reasonably adjust the optimal inventory of branch points.

articleTitle: Intelligent Estimation of Uncertainty Bounds of an Active Magnetic Bearings Using ANFIS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Active magnetic bearings is known to be inherently unstable systems that have a widespread applications and an increased potential research area in today's technology. So far many controllers including H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> robust controller has been developed for the system. However, proper selection of the required weighting functions for robust and non-conservative controller synthesize is still a critical issue that needs more investigations. In this paper the selection of uncertainty weighting function for the robust controller synthesize is automated by intelligent estimation of uncertainty weighting functions using adaptive neuro fuzzy inference system (ANFIS). Then a robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller for the magnetic bearings is designed based on the intelligent estimated uncertainty. v- gap metric is utilized to validate the estimated uncertainty bounds for improved robust stability. Comparison with another neural based estimation method of uncertainty proves the validity of the applied approach.

articleTitle: Internal Control of the Reflection on Qilu Bank Fraud
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper analyzes the problems on internal control of Chinese city commercial banks based on Qilu Bank Fraud, and provides suggestions on how to improve internal control of city commercial banks.

articleTitle: Financial System Reform, Earnings Persistence and Debt Maturity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The debt maturity of specific firms has been important to measure efficiency of credit resources allocation, Xue and Zhu (2010) suggest that financial information play different role in short-term and long-term credit market. We focus on the financial system reform in the end of 2003 promoted by Chinese government, investigate the influence of earnings persistence on debt maturity by Chinese listed companies during 2002-2006, find that the firms with lower earnings quality obtain longer debt maturity after the reform, the result show that information relativity has increased significantly, but rent seeking is still important factor affecting the credit resource allocation.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Chinese Public Cultural Service System Efficiency Improvement from the Perspective of Strategic Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article introduces the current situation and progress of the construction of public cultural service system of China, and analyzes Chinese public cultural service system from the perspective of strategy network. The strategic network development path and key elements of Chinese public cultural service system are discussed. We give conclusions that through introduction of core node, developing the digital network around the core node as the information center, to achieve complementarity between the various nodes exchanging information, sharing resource, are the key elements to improve the integral efficiency of Chinese public cultural service system.

articleTitle: Research on Civil Servants' Tacit Knowledge Management Based on Topic Map
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the tacit knowledge of the civil servants is an important part of the total knowledge in government, tacit knowledge management becomes significant for government to improve their work's effectiveness. In order to realize the purpose of civil servants' tacit knowledge management, this paper proposed a management method for the tacit knowledge of civil servants based on topic map. The thought of the Codification Mode and Personalization Mode was integrated into this method, which first obtained information about civil servants' tacit knowledge through various channels, and then based on this information to construct topic map. People, who want to get some tacit knowledge from other people, can first search the topic map to find the person who possesses it, and then get it through interaction with him. Through this method we can manage civil servants' tacit knowledge effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Credit Risks Prevention-Control System of Group-Affiliated Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the improvement of market economy system, the progress of enterprise reform and the rapid development of the large-scale groups, the credit business to the Group's customer has become a centralized trend. However ,some commercial banks seem not be adept in the ability of concealment, hysteresis and chain of the group-related customers credit risks, so that it led to a spate of credit risk events. Based on the concept, features, characteristics of the group and the requirements of credit management, moreover, the introduction and analysis on the development, financial changes, External security and financial loss of Hebei A Co, Ltd, the paper proposed some problems in commercial banks such as untruthful information of the related- Enterprise, decision-making by financial information, ignoring the professional configuration, blindly believing big clients, imperfect post-loan management, unscientific assessment methods etc. To resolve the problems must rely on the staff, the systems and the technology.

articleTitle: The Study of the Influence of Brand on the Loyalty Card Targeted Promotion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The 2x10 experimental method is conducted in the paper to research the consumers' difference on owning wishes , loyalty card acquiring method preference and promotion effect of loyalty card between famous brands and non- famous brands. The result of the research is as follows: the consumers' loyalty card owning wishes of famous brands is stronger than that of non-famous brands; the preference of three loyalty card acquiring method-"buying", "buy gift" and "buying+10"-has not significant difference between famous brands and non- famous brands; when consumers only can obtain the loyalty card through "buying", there is no significant difference between the loyalty card price of famous brands and non- famous brands; when consumers only can obtain the loyalty card through "buying gift", the amount of "threshold" which consumers are willing to pay for the loyalty card of famous brand is higher than that of non-famous brands ; when consumers only can obtain the loyalty card through "buying+10", the consumers of famous brands who regard this method as acceptable is more than that of non-famous brands.; The will and behavior of information search of members of famous brand corporation is less than that of non-famous brands corporation; the repurchasing behavior of members of famous brand corporation is more than that of non-famous brand corporation; The oral spreading will of members of famous brand corporation is stronger than that of non-famous brand corporation and the members' perceived value of famous brand loyalty card after being used is higher than that of non-famous brand loyalty card.

articleTitle: Web Video Consumption Behavior Research on a New Distribution Platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Web video service is a growing market with huge potential, but lack of business model and consumption behavior research. In this paper, we first introduce a new web video distribution platform, E-surfing Digital Content Player (DCP) and describe its three core competences, based on a new business model - Information Mart. In order to better understand web video consumption behavior characteristics and the potential market of DCP, we perform a questionnaire research on the web video consumption behavior. Meanwhile, monthly content orders of DCP are analyzed to research current hot contents and custom preference to provide guides and suggestions for future business works of web video. After above statistics analysis and researches, marketing strategy advices are provided about DCP and are also valuable for other web video providers to refer.

articleTitle: An Emergency Local Group Decision-Making Model Based on Variable Precision Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aiming at the complexity of emergency decision-making, this paper proposes a local group decision-making model based on variable precision rough set.Gathering the experts' evaluations in the multi-decision tables,we measure the acceptability of the contingency plans and present a solution to get the expert weights, then classify emergency plans based on variable precision rough set to get local preferences and group classification results,which is assembled to obtain consensus ranking of contingency plans based on expert weights. Finally, a case study on the flood emergency decision-making is conducted to illustrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Knowledge Management in Venture Funds
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In modern knowledge society, venture funds are playing important roles in SMEs financing and there are many risks in venture funds' investment. Can venture funds manage the risks with knowledge management? That is the topic the paper will study. The paper first discusses the definitions of venture funds and knowledge, and then analyzes the need for knowledge management in venture funds to manage risks. Finally, the paper takes market risk management as an example to study ways to manage risks with knowledge management. With the application of knowledge management in venture funds, SMEs will acquire more funds and venture funds will acquire more rewards.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Management Information Resource Sharing Based on Grey System Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through the comprehensive analysis of the content of information resource sharing evaluation, an index system for synthetic evaluation is built up. Based on the grey system theory, the Evaluation model of management information resource sharing is constructed, which is preferable to solve the problem of sharing evaluation.

articleTitle: Development Problems and Suggestions of the Groupon
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: the emergence of the Internet and electronic commerce development expedites network behavior, thus appear a large number of professional engaged in network service specialized website, based on the influence factors of groupon development summarized analysis to find the key factors influence the development of the future, and give advice to the business model development, marketing function using and integrity self-discipline management and optimize the development environment and etc.

articleTitle: A Study of Requirement and Development Stratagem on Manufacturing Information System for Contemporary Manufacturing Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of the contemporary and advanced manufacturing technology (AMT) is the favorable subsisting and developing environment for traditional manufacturing enterprise. In this paper, the practical requirement to information technology and the key problem to manufacturing information system for the contemporary manufacturing enterprise (CME) in dynamical market environment are analyzed. The developing trend and characteristic of CME is discussed. Also, a software exploiting integrated framework with contemporary manufacturing info system is designed. It is the base that more advancing the networked integrating product development and manufacture, adapting the new product development management and organizing mode for contemporary manufacturing enterprise.

articleTitle: Research on Quantitative Model of the Bullwhip Effect Based on AR(1) Demand
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper establishes a quantitative model of bullwhip effect under the max-min inventory management system with the market demand subjecting to the AR (1) demand process in a simple two-level supply system including a single supplier and a single retailer, resulting that the bullwhip effect will be extended with the increasing of lead time and service level. The result couldprovide some significant reference value for retailers to reduce the bullwhip effect.

articleTitle: Research in the Combination of Professional Knowledge and Drawing Skills in Teaching of Building Electrical CAD
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The research is devoted to the study in the relationship between professional knowledge and drawing skills in the process of teaching engineering drawing. Hopefully the research can provide an environment in which professional drawing software can be properly applied and then the learning in the functions of drawing software can enable students to have a good mastery of not only the basic knowledge required by the professions but also the drawing skills of engineering drawing. It is regarded as a technical teaching which can make good use of some practical cases, placing emphasis on the standardization and regulation of CAD. This can help lay a solid foundation for the later study of other professional courses.

articleTitle: Valuation Unit-Linked Life Insurance with Continuous-Installment Premium
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we present a two-phase approach to value unit-linked life insurance which the premium is paid continuously instead of up-front prior to a fixed time. At or before maturity, the policyholder withdraw a constant cash flow at proportion withdrawal rate from the corresponding sub-account regardless of the performance of the capital market. Under the unual assumptions, we derive the sub-account value process and build the payment model as well the withdrawal one. By using arbitrage-free principle and the two-phase method to analyze the discounted expect payoff, we achieve the pricing partial differential equations and deduce the fair policy value.

articleTitle: Research on the Competition Lock-In Strategy Based on Uniqueness of High-Tech Products
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The characteristics distinguishing high-tech products from traditional products make the competition strategy of high-tech enterprises different from those traditional ones. In this essay, we will analysize the uniqueness of high-tech products in market competing, ie: the net effect, increasing returns, the path dependence and the winners taking all. Also in the paper the definition of the competition lock-in will be made and there are different ways for high-tech companies to take the competition lock-in strategy according to the position variety of high-tech products in the very fields.

articleTitle: On the Location of Financial Services Organizations in Shanghai City
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We find that spatial distribution of financial services organizations in Shanghai City is uneven by the calculation of financial services location quotient in different Shanghai districts and counties, which agglomerate in Pudong New Area, Huangpu, Jing'an and Luwan District. With google, baidu and other search engines in accordance with the zip code, we find that the organizations of commercial banking, securities, insurance and futures intensively agglomerate in Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone and Bund financial Agglomerative Zone, and make further discussion. Finally, we make the conclusion that the back-office organizations of financial services in Shanghai City is still in a process from agglomeration to intensively agglomeration.

articleTitle: Study on Supplier's Quality Supplying Competence Index in the Case of Multi-Quality Characteristics with Excursion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the further research result of article "Analysis and Evaluation of Quality Supplying Competence Index"( Wen Decheng, ICQ'05-Tokyo: Quality Evolution-Way to Sustainable Growth,2005.9)", this paper infers the formulas about supplier's quality supplying competence index when suppliers provide products which are Multi-quality characteristics and there exist excursion between every quality characteristic tolerance center and the distribution center. This paper also studies on the relationship between supplier's quality supplying competence index and the products' defective rate, then draw a mapping table when supplying products have two quality characteristic.

articleTitle: Stock Price Synchronicity and Limited Arbitrage
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new view of limited arbitrage is applied in the study of the reasons of stock price synchronicity in China based on the behavioral finance theory. This paper made an explorary study about the relation between limited arbitrage, stock price synchronicity and market efficiency. A conclusion different from the study about cash stock dividends in foreign countries is derived that cash dividends as a tunnel of dominant strockholders increase the holding cost of arbitragers, and affect stock price synchronicity, leading to low market efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on Technology Innovation Mechanism of Circular Economy of Scale in Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to promote the sustainable development of Chongqing, circular economy of Scale is a basic approach. The development of circular economy of Scale in Chongqing must be paid attention to, which can prevent and dissolve the corresponding risks of circular economy construction projects. In this paper we discuss the system of technology innovation mechanism and characteristics of the development of circular economy of Scale in Chongqing, and we put forward the countermeasures of technical flow of recycling economy of Scale in Chongqing.

articleTitle: System Analysis and Model Construction of Innovative Culture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Technological innovation already has been becoming the focal point that the whole world competes for each other. Innovative culture is the soul of technological innovation. This article analyzes the factors of affecting an innovative culture, puts forward the main factors of innovative culture, government, education, enterprise, financial and intermediary institutes. Moreover, finds connections and regularities among the five factors, and construct a system including the five factors, from their systematic analysis, points out each factor play a certain role in the innovative culture system. Finally, analyzes sub system of innovative culture from the five factors, and point out the channels of building an innovative culture system---material aspect, rule aspect, behavior aspect, spiritual aspect, states how to build innovative culture from the four channels specifically.

articleTitle: Research on the Competitiveness Analysis and Evaluation of International Contractor Based on the AHP Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: More and more Chinese contractors have joined in the global construction market in recent years. How to evaluate and upgrade self competitiveness is always an important issue for numerous Chinese international contractors. This paper proposes an AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process) model to analyze essential competitiveness factors which based on experts' evaluation opinions from the international construction areas, and determines some main indicators constituting the competitiveness of international contractors through model analysis. It also carries out comparisons between Chinese and foreign international contractors which are based on relevant statistic data. At the end, this paper gives some suggestions for Chinese international contractors to improve their competitiveness.

articleTitle: A Research on How to Improve the Quality of Ordinary University's P.E. Teaching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper discusses how to improve the quality of the physical education teaching in ordinary universities, and analyzes this topic from P.E. teaching reform, innovation education to modern education technology.

articleTitle: The Research on the Supplier Evaluation Model Based on Entropy Value
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By introducing the concept of 'entropy weight',the paper proposes a suplier evaluation model based on entropy value method.Using entropy value method and according to the difference of each evalution index,give value to index weight.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Consumer Purchase Intention Affecting Online Shopping Behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper takes a survey to the college students, and analyzes the impact imposed by variables of purchase intention and the inter-relationship among variables such as perceived value, perceived risk and perceived usefulness. The empirical results show that perceived value is the main factor affecting purchase intention, perceived risk has no direct impact on purchase intention, and perceived usefulness has a positive effect on perceived value.

articleTitle: The Factors to Hinder Small Retail Entities from Developing E-Commerce and Its Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For the status that the transaction volume of C2C is greater than B2C in consumer-oriented e-commerce, this paper analyzed the problems encountered by the B2C e-commerce model with no physical store and the good conditions that the traditional retail companies have in developing e-commerce. This paper hold that why the traditional retail companies do not want to develop e-commerce has some reasons: first, they do not want to be pathfinder; second, they worry that e-commerce will increase the cost of business operation; third, they believe that it's required to cultivate the consumer spending habits; finally, they think that technology is immature and so on. Traditional retail companies developing e-commerce need the support from the government. At the same time, the leaders of traditional retail company should update their ideas, strengthen the infrastructure of network and information, and pay more attention to train e-commerce talents.

articleTitle: A Study on the Growth Ability of the Agricultural Products Processing Enterprises Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Most agricultural product processing industries are labor-intensive industries. Agricultural product processing industry has very important significance to improve the added value of agricultural products and improve the overall quality and efficiency of agriculture in the international arena which is known as the never fading of the "1.5" industry. However, most companies are for the primary processing of agricultural products and did not form a unique advantage of agricultural products .The ability to expand the market is relatively poor and its development is slow and high value-added processing agricultural products is still low so is the growth of poor business. We found the evaluation index system of the growth ability for the agricultural products processing enterprises in this paper. We use the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation to measure the real enterprise. The conclusions is that technological innovation is the continuous driving force for the growth of agricultural products processing enterprises and the entrepreneurs are the important and indispensable resources during the growth of agricultural products processing enterprises.

articleTitle: The Effect of Hostile Acquisition Threats on the Equity Value and Firm Value
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the effect of hostile acquisition threats on the manager's effort, equity value, operation value and firm value, under the separation of ownership and control. We analyze the optimal ratio of the acquisition premium that the shareholder will determine. At last, we use numerical methods to compare the manager's effort and firm value under non acquisition threats and acquisition threats, and to reveal the effect of takeover efficiency on the firm value. We find that acquisition threats can enhance the manager's effort, increase the equity value and firm value, but will reduce the return of manager, and reduce the operation value when the takeover efficiency is high.

articleTitle: Webquest Based Cabling Network Engineering Experiment Platform for Research
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, research on "Webquest Based Cabling Network Engineering Experiment Platform for Research" is discussed.It studies the interaction Webquest-based teaching platform for experimental research, mainly on the theory and the related Webquest experimental teaching interactive platform cabling network engineering courses as an example of the teaching process, using the Internet to achieve interactive teaching experiment in the form of task-driven, through the scaffolding and follow the decomposition of tasks to explore some ideas down. This platform aims to resolve the limitation of traditional teaching methods, and play the learners' learning initiative and creativity to enhance teaching effect .

articleTitle: Discussion on Environmental Cost Accounting and Environmental Cost Control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article demonstrates the situation that the demand for environmental accounting is increasing and the relevance of environmental accounting information is becoming significant. Then it discusses the difficulties confronting in China now, which include the lags behind of theory research, the lack of systematical research and the lack of imposed environmental cost control. It puts forward the suggestions that we should apply environmental cost quota control to ensure sufficient environmental expenditure, apply a systematic method that combines accounting and statistical ways to calculate enterprise explicit environmental cost and enterprise implicit environmental cost respectively, and then publish the environmental cost information both in the balance sheet and off the balance sheet.

articleTitle: Strategic Analysis of Employee Turnover
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the background of economic globalization, enterprise's original employment relationship system is facing serious challenge and retaining reasonable turnover rates is becoming more important. This paper analyzes the concept of employee turnover, turnover cost as well as occupation distributing character. In addition, this paper makes analysis and discussion on each influencing factor in the model of employee turnover .Finally ,this paper discusses how to minimize the negative influence of demographic factors, controllable factors and uncontrollable factors in order to achieve win-win between enterprise and employee.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Listed Company's Corporate Governance to the Enterprise Financial Ability
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article attempts to explore the influence degree on the financial capability from the equity characteristics, the composition of the boards and the incentive mechanism of senior managers.

articleTitle: Option of the Housing Construction Model Based on the Multi-Objective Decision-Making Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The sustainable development of Chinese urbanization is closely related with the housing industry. It is a critical problem to establish a suitable construction model of the housing projects which can both be effective to protect the environment and meet the demands of the housing supply due to the urbanization. There are three main construction model of housing project including brick and concrete structure construction model, reinforced concrete structure construction model and steel structure construction model which all have their own specialties. This paper constituted a multi-objective decision-making method according to the objects of the housing supply amount, the speed of manufacture, the construction cost and the environment protection. Through the evaluation standards application and the calculation, the conclusion was drawn that the steel structure housing construction model is the best one and its countermeasures has been proposed further.

articleTitle: On New Products' Diffusion Based on Corporate Social Capital
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the factors that influence new products' diffusion and illustrates the effect of corporate social capital on new products' diffusion. Some researches have showed that corporate social capital would promote the spread and diffusion of new products; it also contributes to develop opinion leaders and formulate a diffusion network that centers the opinion leaders. This paper has practical significance in the investment of corporate social capital.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Air Logistics Amount of New Airport
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The research of air logistics amount of new airport is important foundation to formulate aviation logistics development policies and measures. The research for air Logistics amount of new airport is always difficulty. In this paper, the model of comprehensive analysis of multi-dimensional was established based on the features of services radiation regional of new airport. And on the basis, combining the features of the new airport, this paper adopts nonlinear regression of support vector machine to analyse air Logistics amount of the future of new airport. Then empirical research was done.

articleTitle: Research on Carbon Dioxide Emissions Performance of the Chinese Industry Sector
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We examined traditional and environmentally sensitive total factor productivity (TFP) in 21Chinese industries in the period of 1992-2007. The Luenberger productivity index (LPI) was used to examine the causes of productivity changes while accounting for carbon emissions. The index enables us to divide the change in productivity into efficiency and technical changes. The results showed that11 of 21 Chinese industries have a higher environmentally sensitive TFP during 1985-2000 compared to TFP when carbon emissions are not taken in account. The TFP growth that was found mainly results from technological innovation than efficiency improvement. We found that almost all energy-intensive and material-intensive industries were more efficient and showed higher LPI when bad outputs are considered than with LPI without undesirables.

articleTitle: The Study on the Growth Path of OEM Upgrades to OBM Based on CAS Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article applies complex adaptive system (CAS) theory to research the growth path of OEM upgrades to OBM, and points that growth path of OEM upgrades to OBM is a complex adaptive system, analyzes the complex adaptive system features of OEM upgrades to OBM; and then researches the interaction between agents, open, tagging, diversity, self-organization and so on aspects of the system, and further discuss the growth path of OEM upgrades to OBM.

articleTitle: Cost Coordination Mechanism of New and Remanufactured Products
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For firms remanufacturing their products, the total life-cycle costs and revenues from new and remanufactured products determine their profitability. In many firms, manufacturing and remanufacturing operations are carried out in different divisions. Each division is responsible for only part of the product's life cycle. Practices regarding transfer pricing across divisions vary significantly among companies, affecting the life-cycle profit performance of the product. In this research, we investigate the consequences of different types of transfer pricing approaches. In a two-period model, we analyze the profitability of different transfer pricing approaches. We determine that a cost coordination mechanism that allocates a portion of the initial production cost to each of the two stages of the product life-cycle is the most effective. We conclude with managerial recommendations concerning cost management.

articleTitle: The Analysis on the Relationship between the Equity Incentive and the Accounting Information Quality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study examines the relationship between the equity incentive and the accounting information quality of the Chinese listed companies. Our sample is measured between 2005 and 2009, obtained from the annual reports of Chinese listed companies. Based on the empirical research, we find that the effect of the equity incentive on the accounting information dose exist and phases. The companies with the equity incentive plan will have higher accounting information quality between 2005 and 2007. But, the equity incentive has a negative effect on the accounting information quality of the manufacturing between 2008 and 2009, and the relationship between the equity incentive and the accounting information quality of industries other than manufacturing during that period is opaque.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Cultural Difference Effects on Sino-U.S. Business and Their Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a part of communication, cultural differences affect business negotiation deeply. In a globalizing world today, with international business happened frequently, cultural differences bring influence to communication, any misunderstanding of it may directly affect the business. Therefore, it makes sense for the countries of different cultural backgrounds to understand each other. With the entry into the 21st century and China's access to the WTO, Sino-U.S. trade and economy has developed rapidly, and it is necessary for the negotiators from two countries to understand the cultural differences and make full use of the beneficial strategies.

articleTitle: Product Decision in a Flexible Production System: Pure Standard Product or Mixed Mass Customization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research examines the effectiveness of mass customization strategies in a production system with unlimited flexible production capacity. The manufacturing firm produces standard products in a flexible factory where mass customization is technologically feasible. We explore whether the manufacturing firm should adopt mass customization. We find that the mixed mass customization strategy dominates the pure standard product strategy when the setup cost for mass customization is negligible in the production system. We identify the parameters that would impact superiority of each product strategy.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Correlation of Audit Market Concentration and Audit Quality - A New Discovery Based on Chinese Securities Market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using the data of listed firms from 2002 to 2009 year in the Chinese securities market, this paper do an empirical study on the correlation of audit market concentration and audit quality. The results showed that: China's audit market concentration is still at a low level, but is gradually improving; the ratio of Non-standard audit opinion, as a proxy for audit quality was not positively correlated with the market concentration from 2002 to 2009, the development trend shows an opposite direction.

articleTitle: Using Actor Network Theory to Analyze Chinese Triple-Play Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Following the 3G licenses issued in the Mid. 2008, Chinese telecommunication market had put the integration of telecommunications networks, cable TV networks and Internet on the agenda. However, to deploy the service well, some barriers in regulatory policies and enterprise ownership have to be broken down. Given this background, this paper we draw upon actor-network theory (ANT) mainly focuses on the influences of the strategy and how to imply the triple-play services successfully.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Strategic Emerging Industry: The Earlier Stage and the Shake-Out Phenomenon
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The industrial landscape is becoming increasingly complex and dynamic, with innovative technologies stimulating the emergence of new industries. Literatures searching life cycle always describe a smooth pattern of emergence over time in which the number of firms in an industry increases, hits a peak, decreases as a result of a shakeout, and then stabilizes as the industry reaches maturity. When these findings applied to the strategic emerging industry the life cycle curve need modified according the industries' characteristics. This paper introduces an alternative pattern of evolution of strategic emerging industries in the earlier stage. Two phases are added in the process and the time axis extended into five phases. During the earlier stage, an industry experiences a sharp decrease in the number of firms - a "mini shakeout" - before increasing again, reaching a final peak and undergoing a major shakeout as described in the extant literature. We then propose a conceptual model that highlights the role of unexpected factors, the internal factors and strategic importance of the emerging industry to the firm in determining its likelihood of exit from the industry.

articleTitle: Accounting of Three New Production Factors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, with the development and renewal of the enterprise operating and management concept, the content of assets is increasing, the value of intangible assets is paid more and more attention to. This paper analyzes and discusses the recognition and measurement of three new production factors human resource, enterprise management and information that exist some disputes, and at last puts forward the specific thought and method about the recognition, measurement and calculation of the three new production factors.

articleTitle: Research on the Staff Relationship Risks in the Merger and Acquisition Process of State-Owned Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the degree development of China's market economy deep, enterprises' merger and acquisition is used widely as a main way of the reform of state-owned enterprises. However, the merger and acquisition of state-owned enterprises not only creates profit¿Cbut also brings about risks. On the basis of collecting risk-related literatures, with "Tonghua Iron and Steel Incident" occurrence, this paper analyzes characterization and causes of staff relation risks in the merger and acquisition process of state-owned enterprises. According to risks appearance, risk prevention measures are provided and the early-warned system of staff relation risks is built in the merger and acquisition process of state-owned enterprises, so as to make for achieving a win-win development of enterprises and employees.

articleTitle: Car Cost Forecasting by Support Vector Regression with Tabu Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This electronic document is a "live" template. Accurate cost forecasting is essential for the design style of car. The support vector regression is applied to forecasting the cost of car, and the tabu search algorithm which is a meta-heuristic algorithm, is used to optimize the parameters of support vector regression. The experimental results show that the proposed method can forecasting the cost accurately.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Service Model of Digital Library
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the dramatic growth of knowledge, it is especially important for digital library to acquire the knowledge need of its users. The paper described the needs of users of digital libraries and digital library knowledge service models, also proposed Agent-based personalized knowledge service model of digital library and its implementation mechanisms.

articleTitle: The Research on Influencing Factors of TMT Conflicts Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Information revolution and operations with a trend of diversification posing a new challenge to top leaders, they increasingly need to conduct efficient work as a team. Due to the difference in occupational backgrounds, educational levels, and working departments of the members in Top Management Team (TMT), it is difficult to avoid contradictions and conflicts within the team. This paper, using analytic hierarchy process (AHP), investigates factors influencing internal conflicts in TMT by building conceptual models to hierarchically analyze. This paper, based on matrix consistency check, adopts comprehensive assessment to attain combinational weights of the relative importance order of the bottom level to the top level, thus making clear different extents of various factors' influence on TMT internal conflicts, therefore laying a good foundation for making a solution to TMT internal conflicts.

articleTitle: Mechanism Design of Multi-Attribute Auction Based on Venture Capital
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The venture enterprise' value is not fully revealed as a result of asymmetric information in venture capital exiting market. To solve this problem, this paper studies the venture capital equity trading mechanism design under the assumption of the IPV model based on multi-attribute auction theory. To make our research closer to reality, this paper relaxes previous assumption and studies the venture capital equity trading in the case of affiliated values and establishes the corresponding multi-attribute auction model. The study enriches the venture capital exit research content, and provides a theoretical guidance to venture capital exit with the auction approach.

articleTitle: Finance Intensification: From Finance Intensification to Finance Shared Service
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Finance intensification is the leading way to improve the efficiency benefit of finance service. In companies of china, almost all finance service have already finished the computer accounting and developed the financial management of information technology. Such revolutions offer the support of information technology to the financial shared service. Beginning with the historical changes of finance service, the treatise analyses the connotation of intensification which is based on what the procedure of financial intensification to financial shared service and the tendency and direction of finance intensification.

articleTitle: Research on Corporate Governance and Constraint Mechanism of Over-Investment Behavior by Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Possible factors to constrain China's over-investment have been analyzed and related assumptions been proposed. The behavior of over-investment of the listed companies in China and strategies of its constraint mechanism have been analyzed carefully by constructing related models on the basis of previous experience and the actual situation and by an empirical analysis with collected data in 2006-2008 from China's listed companies of A share as the study sample. The following results have been obtained from the analysis: (1) Some listed companies in China commit over-investment and the amount of over-investment shows a positive correlation with the flow of the company's free cash; (2) Over-investment by the listed companies could have been effectively restricted if there were some big non-state shareholders, or independent directors or managers owned some shares of the company; (3) The largest share proportion by the shareholders, equity concentration, ownership restriction, separation of chairman and general manager, and Managers' executive compensation salaries did not effectively restrict companies' investment behavior. Our findings have important implications for restricting over-investment and for corporate governance.

articleTitle: Managerial Function and Coordinative Mechanism of Purchasing Contract in Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Purchase contract management is an important links of purchasing and supply chain management. This paper discusses two functions of purchasing contract, i.e. management and coordination. Managerial function is through contract to control the operations of the parties to keep the supply chain stable. Coordination function is through risk sharing and benefit allocating mechanism to improve and optimize the supply chain performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Factors of Independent Innovation Pattern Based on Patent Data Measurement
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A large number of researches at home and abroad have indicated that patent data can play the role of quantitative analysis of measurement innovation activities excellently. This article has made quantitative analysis of patent factors in independent innovation pattern from the perspectives of patent quantity and quality based on summarizing the current measurement innovation activities of patent data applied at home and abroad and has reflected the property right factors of the independent innovation pattern by applying indexes of the patent self-citing rate and non-self-citing rate. This article has built the quantitative analysis index system of enterprise independent innovation based on patent metrology that is suitable for the actual conditions in China so as to complete the research into the independent innovation pattern factors thus providing relevant theoretical analysis model and tools for the study and selection of independent innovation pattern of China's enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Market Innovation Action Path of Company Based on Customer Value
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper probes into market innovation action path based on customer value. At first, it researches the background and introduces the framework of market innovation action path. Then, it establishes strategic model of business units, and emphasizes on measuring relative customer value occupancy and sales growth rate of each unit. At last, it positions the measurement results in four quadrant of double variables matrix, and chooses corresponding market innovation model.

articleTitle: Channel Pricing Decision Based on Manufacturer Forward Integration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Manufacturer forward integration is a common method to improve brand value and compete with independent retailer for manufacturer. Through the comparing analysis between channel pricing decisions under manufacturer forward integration mode and independent retailer mode. We find the following results. The wholesale price under manufacturer forward integration mode is higher than the corresponding wholesale price under independent retailer mode. The retail price in manufacturer-owned store under manufacturer forward integration mode is higher than the corresponding retail price under independent retailer mode. The independent retailer profit under manufacturer forward integration mode is lower than the corresponding profit under independent retailer mode. The profit of manufacturer who owns store under manufacturer forward integration mode is lower than the corresponding profit under independent retailer mode.

articleTitle: Knowledge Data Mining in Population Structure and Transition of Economic Development Pattern
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Transition of economic development pattern is a comprehensive harmony development process of population, resources, economy, environment and other systems, is an overall planning with people-oriented to harmonize urban and rural development, regional and national development, social economic development and opening up. It is helpful for knowledge data mining in harmony stage and trend to find harmony or disharmony reason between the two sub-systems, population structure system and economic development system. Based on the findings, suggestions on optimizing population structure are given to harmony with transition of economic development in China.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Rationality of GEM IPOs Pricing Based on SFA, Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper employs stochastic frontier approach to do empirical study on the Rationality of GEM IPOs Pricing whether the offer price reach potential high price. According to the results, there is no significant evidence for offer price reaching its potential high. Meanwhile no evidence supports the founder has relation with the potential high offer price, the shares founder owned do not signal the ventures' quality. While venture capital has positive relation with potential high offer price, for venture capital pursuing IPO success rather than firm growth. Moreover, we also find the ventures' character for example size, proceeds from issues, and belong to new industry has positive relations with the potential offer price.

articleTitle: Climate Change and Sustainable Mountain Settlement in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China Mountain areas are subject to rapid change, socially, economically, and environmentally. Adapting mountain settlements to climate change have become the most formidable challenges of our times. Since mountain settlements nationwide go through a process of rapid change, the question is how to ensure sustainability in change; in other words, how to adapt to climate change for a promising future. The paper begins by outlining the background to the issues. It goes on to identify key issues and make recommendations.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Relationship between China's Log Imports and Disaster of Forest Pests
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We analyzed the relationship between China's Log imports and Disaster of Forest Pests empirically by cointegration theory and Granger causality test. The research shows that there is long-term and stable balance relationship between China's Log imports and Disaster of Forest Pests, in which one-way Granger causality exists and it can rebanlance by 35% if unbanlanced in short term. Accordingly, this paper concludes that it is impossible for China's Log imports policies. we try to put forward proposals to achieve sustainable development of China's forest industry by controlling Disaster of Forest Pests.

articleTitle: Industrial Innovation and Development of Industrial Agglomeration District in Henan Province, China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, international and domestic industries are transferring from the developed eastern coastal areas to the central and western regions in China. Henan Province should seize the historical opportunity of industry transfer to achieve industrial upgrading and economic growth. Based on the industrial innovation theory, the paper analyzed the effects of industrial innovation on the industrial agglomeration districts and the existing problems in the development process of industrial agglomeration districts in Henan province, and then put forward the corresponding policy recommendations.

articleTitle: Quantitative Study of the Administrative Penalty by Applying Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Over the years, government mainly adopts penalty as a tool in the administrative management, but it lacks scientific management to measure the amount of penalty. This has a negative impact on the reputation of government and management efficiency. Applying Markov chain to resolve the decision problem of the amount of penalty can provide a quantitative basis for the government penalty management. This paper provides a favorable scientific management idea for government administrative management by application research on the city parking charge which is a widespread problem in our country at the present stage.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprises' Financial Performance from the Perspective of Capital Operation: Taking Textile and Garment Enterprise for Instance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As one of the national industries, textile and garment and its capital operation have been attached great importance to. The paper selects data of listed textile and garment enterprises as samples, then researches their financial performance using factor analysis. It turns out that the capital operation neither enhances the operation capability of textile and garment enterprises nor distinctly better their financial performance, which indicate that there exists some problems in the aim and approach of capital operation that should be modified.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Linear Profiles Using Change-Point Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A control chart based on the sequential change-point detection model is proposed for monitoring the linear profiles. This chart based on generalized likelihood ratio statistics can detect a shift in either the intercept or the slope or the standard deviation by a single chart that is different from the other control charts for linear profiles. The simulated results show that our approach has good performance across the range of possible shifts. The simple diagnostic aids are also given to estimate the location of the change and determine which of the parameters has changed. We also investigate the effectiveness of these aids and give comparisons with the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Based on Support Vector Machine of Image Classification Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents a support vector machine (SVM), The color images and text to effectively classify the large image database. In order to evaluate the performance of this method, it will be this way for the artificial neural network, this method proved to be superior to other methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Risks of E-Commerce Mode
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the environment of intellectual economy, e-commerce has become an important business mode. Meanwhile, risks exist in any kind of business mode. This article analyzes the influential factors of the risks of e-commerce mode by examining the connotation of the risks of e-commerce mode. In the following, it conducts risk evaluation of e-commerce mode and give recommendations of responding to the risks of e-commerce mode.

articleTitle: The Characters of the Eco-Industrial Park in EU and US and the Inspiration for the Wuhan Metropolitan Zone
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the beginning of the 21st century, the eco-industrial park has become the important carrier for the development of circular economy in the US and the EU countries. It is also the new direction and trend for the development of the industrial park. This paper discusses the main characters of the eco-industrial park through the analysis of the eco-industrial park in the US and EU. The Wuhan metropolitan zone is now in the process of its attempt for the construction of resource-conservation and environment-protection society under the guidance of the Chinese Central Government. Based on the detailed discussion on the development status and main problems of the industrial parks in the Wuhan metropolitan zone, the author finally points out some practical suggestion for their future development.

articleTitle: A Research on Enterprise Informatization Evaluation Indexes System in Printing Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we introduced a evaluation indexes system for printing enterprises' informatization based on the relative model of China national informatization evaluation center. These indexes considered both general informatization evaluation model and the printing industry's features. Then we did some investigations on several printing enterprises to verify the indexes. By the result, we finally got a set of practical indexes to evaluate the printing enterprises' informatization situation. Using these indexes, printing enterprises can find the gap and implement their own informatization strategy.

articleTitle: Public Participation in the Consultative System for River Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the economy continues to develop, people's living standards have been improving, China's river management technology has greatly changed, in order to manage the increasingly complex problems of river management better, the Government should increase public participation in decision-making areas. This paper analyzes the current status of national public participation and deep reasons related to public participation. And make consultative and advisory system for river management, rights and measures.

articleTitle: Comparative Studies on Financial Competitiveness in Fertilizer Manufacturing Listed Companies of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, based on factor analysis, we select 9 different finance indicators such as current ratio, return on assets (ROA)and total assets growth rate,etc, in order to conduct comparative studies on financial competitiveness in fertilizer manufacturing listed companies of China, then we reach several conclusions and give some relevant advice.

articleTitle: A Personnel Assessment Model Based on Entropy-TOPSIS and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Combined entropy method with TOPSIS method, a comprehensive assessment model for personnel assessment is built. The model firstly adopts entropy method to solve the objective weights of multiple indexes in multiple attribute decision problems, which eliminates the subjective influence of artificial factors, the general difference and other defects in traditional weighting methods; and then TOPSIS is adopted as objective function to obtain the comprehensive evaluation value and prior order of evaluation objects. Application analysis demonstrates that the proposed model is correct and feasible, can reduce the adverse influence of artificial factors and can provide decision support to personnel assessment practice.

articleTitle: Chinese Psychological Capital: A Grounded Investigation in Public Sector
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper explores the applicability of the 'Western' concept of psychological capital to the People's Republic of China (PRC) context and highlights critical areas of divergence. Employing a grounded approach, Optimism, Creativity, Resiliency, Self-confidence, Forgiveness and Gratitude, Courage and Ambition (Hope) were found to be common types of psychological capital both in China and in the West. However, the dimensions Courtesy, Humility, Self-possession and Sincerity fell into the 'different' category of our analysis on psychological capital since these concepts were relevant in the West, however, they are not perceived as dimensions of psychological capital in the literature.

articleTitle: Analysis of Bulletin Board System Hot Topics Based on Multiple Keywords Combination
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Collection and analysis of information about network public opinion has currently become an effective means to get people thinking and recommendations by the government departments. In this paper, we presents a method of BBS(Bulletin Board System) hot topic analysis based on multiple keywords combination, this method, which use Chinese automatic word segmentation technology, firstly extracts keywords by counting the word frequency and then removes useless words from word frequency table and obtains the hot topic through the keywords positive connection. We described the method in details with a experiment which can prove the validity and rationality of the analytical method at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Repeating Contract Research on Nonperishable Product with Random Demand
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A two-stage supply chain consists of a manufacturer and a retailer. Manufacture acquire demand information through EDI. This make it possible for upstream enterprise to manage inventory and determine output. If supply chain member keep repeating trade relationship, the long-term supply chain performance can be improved through signing a wholesale price contract .Study contract coordination problem when supply chain sell a nonperishable product to end customers. The efficient or optimal output quantity can be achieved through introducing penalty contract.

articleTitle: Study on Characteristic of Emerging Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper has deeply studied the definition and characteristics of emerging technology, conducted the emerging technology industrilization potential evaluation by introduction of the technology foresight into the setting-up of evaluation indexing system and Delph method for evaluation. And the characteristics of emerging technology evaluated was studied from different industries and with different industrilzation potential value within one industry respectively, bying divided into two groups according to their industries and industrilization potential value within industry; the emerging technology characteristic of technology, maketing and so on was studied by paired sample T test in order to obtain the decisive factors affecting emerging technology industrilization potential. Combinng the industrilization potential ranking and the decisive characteristic of emerging technology would be usful to the decision-making in emerging technology industrilization process.

articleTitle: Study on Time Controlling for Large-Scale Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The mode of time controlling is put forward to solve the problems that the owner's management ability is too weak to control the project effectively in the progress control for large-scale construction project. The connotation and workflow of time controlling are introduced, stressed that the management system which is under the premise of quality assurance should be set up at the core of progress plan. The methods of time controlling are presented, namely, the planning, controlling and coordination for the project progress. In order to ensure the efficient management of large-scale construction project, measures are elaborated from the perspectives of organization, economy, contract, technology and information management.

articleTitle: GM (1, 1) Grey Forecasting and Analysis on Energy Production and Supply in Shandong Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As one of the important economic provinces in China, Shandong province plays an important role in energy production and energy consumption. Based on the revised time-series data of the energy production and supply in 1985-2009 in Shandong province, this study has established a grey forecasting model GM (1, 1) and made the accuracy checking for it. Smoothing test and exponential test are employed here. According to this GM (1, 1) model, a forecasting analysis on energy supply for ten years from 2010 to 2020 in Shandong province has been made. Further discussions on the energy safety in the future ten years have also been carried on with the forecasting data of GDP growth and energy demand in the corresponding period.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Consumer Motivations Participating in Virtual Brand Community
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the literature and in-depth interview, this paper proposes a model for indentifying the consumer motivations participating in virtual brand community. They are comprised searching for effective information, obtaining preferential treatment, seeking offline interaction, sharing post-purchase experience, and maintaining information quality. Moreover, their effects on consumer participation modes are also empirically investigated. The results demonstrate that three participation motivations are found to have effects on seeking participation and interactive participation, like seeking effective information, sharing post-purchase experience and maintaining information quality. The influences of obtaining preferential treatment and seeking offline interaction on the both are not found to have statistic significance. These empirical results highlight some managerial implications for inducing the consumer's participation, as well as building attractive virtual brand community.

articleTitle: The University Students Personal Knowledge Management Strategy Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of information technique, students don't know how to the knowledge of the oceans of valuable information and put them into the knowledge already have knowledge does not know how to manage and efficiently take advantage of it, in fact a waste of information and energy consumption. From the students with personal knowledge management of the analysis of the university of personal knowledge of the necessity for students, from personal knowledge demand, the gathering, a personal knowledge and information management tools of choice, college students the knowledge, knowledge innovation and application, maintain and increase personal knowledge system seven search for knowledge management strategies. Specific.

articleTitle: The International Competitiveness Analysis of Zhejiang's Furniture Industry and the Affecting Factors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Zhejiang province, with distinct competitive advantages in the domestic and global furniture market, is China's the second-largest province in terms of furniture production and export. This paper conducts a systematic evaluation of international competitiveness of Zhejiang's furniture industry by using competitiveness indices such as international market share, contribution rate of exports, trade competitiveness index, revealed comparative advantage index and others. Moreover, based on an in-depth analysis of the influencing factors, this paper puts forward measures to enhance international competitiveness of Zhejiang's furniture industry.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Economic Impact of the Mega-Event Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a complete model and method of evaluating the mega-events' economic impact on the bidding cities and relevant zones, the Shanghai Expo taken as an example. Based on the three fundamental parts of GDP, we foresee the growth of the economies through the application of the historic data by numerical approximation. Comparing with the real degree at which the Expo brings the paper presents three main indexes which measure the economic impact by the means of difference equation. Then analytic hierarchy process is applied to assess the overall economic impact of the Shanghai Expo on its related zones. A comparison matrix is provided, and the weight value of the comparative importance of the three factors is calculated, which consists of the whole GDP. A concise result of synthetic impact index of Shanghai Expo is taken by the above method. Finally, some methods of evaluating the mega-events' economic impact are discussed for future work in the paper.

articleTitle: Research on Formation Mechanism of Information Risk in Supply Chain and Its Control Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In supply chain environment, the asymmetry of information, distortion of information transmission between enterprises and the application of information technology will cause some information risk, which affecting the efficiency of enterprises in the supply chain. This article focuses on formation mechanism of information risk in supply chain and its control countermeasures. Three main reasons for the information risk are analyzed, which are commission-agency mechanism, bullwhip effect and the application of information technology (especially under the environment of "Internet of Things" and Cloud Computing). Then some control countermeasures are given to achieve effective management of information risk in supply chain.

articleTitle: Ontology Language OWL Research Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: OWL originated in the W3C, is known as a Web ontology language for descriptions. Since February 10, 2004, OWL has been officially recommended as a W3C standard. OWL has the describe logic as the logic-based theory, in the syntax and semantics are integrated to the construction thinking of describe logic. OWL reasoning tools are currently the OWL ontology knowledge base into description logic reasoning.

articleTitle: Discuss about Sustainable Development Service Concept of Tourism Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper, starting with the basic theory of sustainable development, expounded the requirements and inspiration about the theory of sustainable development in the tourism industry, To achieve the sustainable development of tourism industry, its focus is to use the idea of sustainable development to arm service concept of tourism industry, Because the service concept of sustainable development, not only can affect tourism demand, and guide green consumption, but also can create of the green benefits. And discussed seeking for sustainable development means of tourism industry from the point of service concept, Finally, under the guidance of the sustainable development service concept, author put forward his recommendations and observations about tourism industry's several key issues to be addressed.

articleTitle: Application of AHP Method in Building Construction and Cultural Combined - By Human Living Environment Construction of PengAn as the Background
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Building construction and cultural construction are important components of the human living environment construction, to highlight the cultural construction in the importance of human living environment, and the combination of building construction and cultural must be concerned. Taking the human living environment construction of PengAn as the background, this paper discusses policymakers rational decision and the feasibility of cultural elements merged into building construction.By using the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) method to establish building construction and cultural combination model ,expected to provide important reference for colleagues.

articleTitle: A Study of Online Purchase Intention: Based on the Perspective of Customer Trust
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper takes on online shopping environment into account, combs the relationship between customer trust and customer purchase intention based on existing literature, and discusses how to enhance customer purchase intention through the increase of customer trust.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Rural Finance and Rural Economy in Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Rural finance has played a crucial role in the rural economy. Heilongjiang Province as a big agricultural province, in which rural finance is not well developed. The empirical analysis suggests that the low level of rural finance in Heilongjiang province can not have a strong support on the rural economy, which shows the financial supply shortage. However, the rural economic development is the Granger causes of rural finance. It means rural economy development can boost the rural finance in Heilongjiang Province, but the contrary is not obvious, and there is not a distinct interaction mechanism. Therefore, it needs to further improve the rural financial system and promote the level of financial development so as to better services for the rural economy in Heilongjiang Province.

articleTitle: Adding More Value in Place: Strategic Human Resource Planning for Industrial Cluster and the Policies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper focuses on making the industrial clustering value-added in the view of human resource management. We are aware that the four types of core talents (entrepreneur talent, managing talent, technology talent, information talent) of enterprise are critical for strengthening enterprise core competitiveness and the knowledge spillover. By adopting the model of strategic HRP for the industry cluster's value increasing, the main effective ways that how the strategic HRP enhance industrial cluster's value through the core talents are clearly analyzed. Moreover, this paper also analyzes the major challenges that Chinese industrial cluster currently facing in the process of Strategic HRP. And the macro and micro policies were proposed for regional government and firms to take in the end.

articleTitle: Review on BOT Projects Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
