abstract: BOT financing mode has been applied widely around the world at present, and how to analyze, evaluate BOT projects performance scientifically, objectively and comprehensively has become a hot research topic. This paper reviews BOT projects performance on evaluation scope, evaluation index and evaluation method through collecting and contrasting related literatures at home and abroad, points out the deficiencies of existing research and puts forward the future research proposals.

articleTitle: A Research of the Evaluation Index of County Economy Index System Based on the Zhongyuan Economic Zone
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The construction of the Zhongyuan economic zone is to construct the regional of the economic growth pole, optimize the allocation of the resources within the region and transform the mode of the economic development. As a basic unit of the regional economy, county is an important carrier of the rise of the Zhongyuan economic zone. Based on the elaborates of the objectives and principles of t the Zhongyuan economic zone, this article analysis some difficulties about the current construction of the Zhongyuan economic zone, and then based on the current problems facing the construction of the Zhongyuan economic zone, they proposed the evaluation index system of the county economic development ,it is not only provide an objective basis on the county government's macro-economic evaluation of the management, but also point out the direction of the county economic development, and enhance the level of the county economy, and promote the rapid development of the Zhongyuan economic zone.

articleTitle: The Comparison Research of China's Aviation Network's Key Nodes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In accordance with the principle of centrality indices were selected, degree, closeness, node betweenness and flow betweenness, to progress the centrality of CAN (China's Aviation Network) and rank the degree of importance of nodes in CAN. The result shows that: in the four treatment results, the application of node betweenness index made the best; its centrality degree is 96.92%. And by comparing the centrality degree value based on different indices of the CAN network, got the major Chinese aviation network nodes are Beijing, Urumqi, Guangzhou, Shanghai and Kunming.

articleTitle: Studies on the Implementation of National Standards for Student's Physical Fitness and Health in the Collegiate Track Events
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the study of the determinants of the physical fitness for the results of the track events, it is surprising to learn that the weight coefficient of the sidestep Test index is 0.4, and there are event group differences in the selected indicators among the winners in the track events. Therefore, the suggestion: The accuracy reflected from National Standards for Student's Physical Fitness and Health can provide the scientific guidance in the event registration for the college and high-level representative teams who will participate in the track events.

articleTitle: The Study of Landscape Visual Impact Assessment in Mountain Tourism Area
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the breadth and depth of tourism resources development, the study of landscape protection and landscape planning has increasingly been focused on. This paper uses geographic information technology and virtual reality technology, takes small-scale mountain tourism area for example, proposes method of the cumulative viewshed analysis to study the landscape visual impact assessment of Qixing Lake and the surrounding natural landscape which is the only mountain lake in National Forest Park, Guangdong Nankun Mountain based on temporal database of the landscape resources distribution. In the study, it compares the difference of the lake and the surrounding visual landscape sensitivity in wet and dry season, then gets assessment of landscape visual sensitivity of the surrounding area of the lake. It overlays all the sight spots around the lake to analyze the sensitivity on this basis and then gets the result of 8 the highest water-related sensitivity spots. They are Gold Top, Riyue Island, Lanfen, Gujing Fall, Qixing Lake Station, Zhu ye xi sheng, Meilong Fall, Tomb. It calculates the distribution and area of the lake landscape from these points. Based on the cumulative viewshed analysis of these sight spots, it gets visual sensitivity evaluation of lake landscape. The result of lake and surrounding landscape visual impact assessment will provide scientific basis and evidence for water area planning and development, optimization of the lake travelling route and promoting the protection and restoration of the surrounding landscape, so as to promote the use of mountain tourism resources reasonable and sustainable.

articleTitle: The Motivation and Methods of Information Sharing in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The nature of supply chain management is to optimize the decision such as production of the enterprise, inventory, marketing and so on through information sharing in supply chain, so information sharing among node enterprises is a fundamental work in the supply chain. Firstly, this paper puts forward the view that information sharing can not only reduce risk brought by asymmetric information, but also promote whole performance of supply chain, meanwhile sharing the private information among the partners will bring certain risk and information cost. Then analyzes the major motivation of information sharing from four aspects, and indicates that node enterprise can get better by sharing itself private information with another enterprise. Finally, it brings forward the primary methods to realize effective information sharing such as information technology methods, shareholding swap incentive method, back selling incentive method, pricing incentive method, and order Incentive method and so on.

articleTitle: Development Strategy of Automotive Electronics Industry in Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper illustrates the significance and background of developing automotive electronics industry, focuses on the development status of automotive electronics industry in Chongqing, explores the development direction and path for the development of the automotive electronics industry, and makes recommendations and measures. It is necessary to develop automotive electronics industry as a new strategic pillar industry to find a breakthrough for the integration of informatization and industrialization of Chongqing.

articleTitle: Research on Spatial Distribution of Potential Fire Spots and Risk Assessment in Urban Areas - Case Study of Gulou District, Fuzhou, China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposed a fire risk assessment system and quantitative capacity evaluation method for fire risk protection based on rational analysis of current building layout, fire protection demands and supplies. As results, the classified fire risk assessment and spatial distribution are achieved. A case study of Gulou District of Fuzhou is addressed, and an innovative research methodology of fire protection planning is proposed.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Construction Industry Internationalisation Performance Based upon International Advanced Index between China and Japan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Both China and Japan have great influence on the Asia-Pacific and even the world economy. China's development is obvious to all. Chinese construction industry has made significant achievements in recent years. As one of the developed countries, Japan has been stagnating for several years. After decade years of decline, the Japanese construction industry recovered in 2008 and accelerated slightly from 2009. The International Advanced Index is introduced to measure the international performance of Japanese and Chinese construction industry. In addition, a comparative research study design is adopted to explore the difference between the Japanese and Chinese construction industries. Besides the Width Index, the other indexes in the International Advanced Index of Chinese construction industry are higher than the Japanese construction industry. The Chinese construction industry has been catching up to the Japanese construction industry in the global market. Future research on the industrial competitiveness is needed.

articleTitle: Research on Service Management Current Situation and Countermeasure of Chinese Large Retail Chains
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article uses the service management of our large retail chains as research object, uses "retail chains service management processes" as train of thought. On the basis of extensive market survey, the writer analyses service management current situation and problem of our large retail chains objectively. To strengthen service management, the writer proposes countermeasures including optimizing service management processes, service management project innovation, customer classification management, strengthening service system construction, improving the personnel quality of service management, improving the level of enterprise information technology, etc.

articleTitle: Study on the Strategy Research of the Urban Low-Carbon Development in the Post-Disaster Reconstruction - Case Study of GuangYuan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Take post-disaster reconstruction typical city Guangyuan as the research object, it introduces the background and significance of our country's development of low-carbon city, expounding the concept and model of the low-carbon city. Using the new standard system of the low-carbon city announced by Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, evaluate and analyze Guangyuan's low-carbon reconstruction effect .The results show that Guangyuan has environmental advantage for its rich clean energy resource, and 52.6% forest coverage, economic development lagging behind and clean energy technology backwardness is the main obstacle to Guangyuan's low-carbon development. Guangyuan's low-carbon development should be promoted by improving relevant regulations and system, low-carbonization the industrial structure and energy consumption structure, advocating the citizen's low-carbon consciousness, and creating the clean energy technology.

articleTitle: Effect Evaluation of the State Key Laboratory Special Funding Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to investigation and analysis of the concluding report of the State Key Laboratory special funding every year, an input and output index system was constructed for the sake of quantitative consideration, and a model of infinitesimals Archimedes was then chosen to evaluate the index system. In the process of evaluation, the raw input and output data indexes were normalized. Through comparing the results of DEA evaluation before and after the normalization, it was indicated that the relative efficiency between decision making units can be better evaluated after non-dimensional handling of the original data via the normalizing process. Moreover, from the evaluation results, it was found that more than half of the effective decision making units were in DEA state, which demonstrated that the special funding has a better effect. For some non-DEA efficient decision making units, improving measures toward the direction of DEA effective evaluating were given through the projected principle.

articleTitle: Energy Demand Prediction of China Based on the Theory of Co-Integration and Error Correction Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the theory of Co-integration and Granger-causality test, this paper makes a study on the relationship between energy Consumption and GDP, and makes a prediction of china's energy demand from 2010 to 2020.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Supervised Clustering GA and Megathermal Climate Forecast
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new multi-objective supervised clustering genetic algorithm is proposed in this paper. Training samples are supervised clustered by attribute similarity and class label. The number and center of class family can be determined automatically by using the fitness vector function. The two key elements have optimization nature and can be unaffected by subjective factors. Use the nearest neighbor rule and the class label to estimate the class families of test samples. The early warning model is implemented by C#, using the data of summery abnormal megathermal climate in Zhejiang province. The experiment results indicate that this algorithm has a unique intelligence and high accuracy.

articleTitle: The Analysis on Carbon Emission Strategy of the High Energy Consumption Enterprise Project Considering the Government Supervision
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper we introduce the evolutionary game method for the further study on the carbon emission strategy of the high energy consumption enterprise project. The issue of carbon emission of the enterprise project considering the government supervision can be seen as an equilibrium process which includes the game between the enterprise and the government. The boundary rationality of the game participator in social production system made the game process to be a process for the stable state. Based on the model of evolutionary game involving the enterprise and the government, we find that the initial state run a key role on the strategy. And the unstable state strategies have the trend to achieve or degenerate to the perfect or the terrible strategy. And several parameters can be utilized as the locus of control for the government's policy.

articleTitle: The Study of the Integrated Risk Measurement of Insurance Enterprises by Copula Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From the prospective of the international trends, integrated risk measurement is now an increasingly important risk management tool for insurance enterprises. This paper tentatively uses a copula model in order to measure the economic capital of integrated risks of insurance enterprises in China. Use an insurance enterprise to explain how to measure the economic capital of integrated risks. And the calculation process demonstrated that the economic capital using the copula model Copula lower 24.05%, 16.72% and 24.43% than it at the assumption of complete dependency, which justified the assertion that there is diversification effect between insurance business lines. Also, we found that economic capital required by the insurer was lower 48.11%, 60.59%, 56.78% and 60.79% than its actual solvency margin, which justified the assertion that the economic capital method could help to optimize capital allocation.

articleTitle: The Demand of Alternative Red Meat: Factors Affecting Consumers' Perception and Consumption Decision of Ostrich Meat in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study investigates consumer's perception toward ostrich meat product and the factors that affect consumers' decision to consume ostrich meat. The results of factor analysis show that consumers' perception toward ostrich meat has two factors: positive factor and negative factor.

articleTitle: The Negative Impact of Equity Issue on China Market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper investigated how and why abnormal stock returns associate with the announcement of equity issues by Chinese firms. We estimated abnormal return by OLS, using the market model. Then we chose some variables and established an econometric model to verify some hypothesis introduced in previous study. The empirical results indicate that there exist negative abnormal return on China stock market and the average abnormal return on announcement day is -0.017. Regression analysis show that the price pressure hypothesis and the wealth transfer hypothesis can well explain the negative abnormal return on China stock market which is also associated with the company's investment opportunities.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Inbound Tourist Market Structure in Liaoning Province Based on SSM Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Shift - share method (SSM) is an important method in the analysis of economic structure of a region or city, and also a scientific method in the assessment of tourism market .The change of the tourism market structure has a great influence on the sustainable development of the tourist destination. This article used the SSM method to analyze the tourism market ,on the base of the inbound tourist of Liaoning province ,2002 -2008 ,and draw to the conclusion that ,in the inbound tourism market of Liaoning province, the market share of America, Singapore, Hong Kong, Thailand, Indonesia, Canada is stable , the market share of Macao, France, Russia, German, England and Italy is ascended, and the market share of Japan , Korea and Taiwan is descended. According to these problems, the author put forward the measure to expand the overseas tourism market.

articleTitle: The Research on the Relationship between Network Capability and Innovation Performance: The Intermediation of Knowledge Resources Acquisition - An Empirical Study of SMEs in Xinjiang, China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of studying the logical relationship between network capability and innovation performance, introducing the knowledge resources acquisition as intermediary variable and using structural equation modeling, the paper has tested the impact of enterprise network capability on knowledge resources acquisition and innovation performance. The results show that network capability of SMEs in Xinjiang, the underdeveloped region in China, has a significant impact on knowledge resources acquisition and innovation performance; Network capability has not only a direct impact on innovation performance but also an indirect impact through knowledge resources acquisition; At the same time, network capability positively correlates with explicit knowledge acquisition and tacit knowledge acquisition, and the impact of network capability on tacit knowledge acquisition is greater than that on explicit knowledge acquisition; In the four dimensions of network capability, relationship assistance has the greatest impact on tacit knowledge acquisition, while understanding of partners has the greatest impact on explicit knowledge acquisition.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on Interest-Rate Risk to Chinese Life Insurers and Scenario Testing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Interest-rate risk is one of key factors to influence the operation of life insurance industry. This paper analyses the influence on the liability of Chinese life insurance industry, brought about by recent years' continual interest rate cut, and describes quantitatively the exposure level of the reserve fund to the interest rate risk. Furthermore, scenario analysis and stress testing was applied to the condition of asset and liability of an insurance company at the end of 2009. The result is turned out to be that the performance of present interest rate risk management in Chinese life industry is good and yet to have to further perfected.

articleTitle: The Regional Sci-Tech Policy of the EU and Its Inspirations for China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper has applied systematic ideology, inductive and deductive methods to analyze the regional science and technology policy of the EU and its inspiration for China. The regional science and technology policy of the EU is closely related to the regional policy of the EU and it has played very important role in solving the regional problems of the economic recession regions in the EU. The successful experience of the EU is very useful for the revitalization of the Chinese industrial structural readjustment regions, such as the North-eastern and Central areas of China, which are similar with the economic recession regions of the EU. With complete legal document, sound policy instrument and scientific capital management, the regional science and technology policy of China can be expected to play a more important role in solving the current regional problems of China.

articleTitle: Impacts of Public Listed Company Anti-Takeovers from Legal Perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The impacts of anti-takeover of public listed company on the target company, stockholders, managers and employees have two sides. To the target, anti-takeover can keep the target's independence, which benefit to long-term development of the target. While anti-takeover increases costs and expenses of the target, which make against current development of the target. To the shareholders of the target, anti-takeover can ensure fairness of takeover which benefit to the public shareholders. While the preventive devices are adopted, the manager may only pay attention to defensive effect, but harms some shareholders. To the social common interests, anti-takeover make for forming market system about anti-monopoly and help to frame the hostile takeover, while anti-takeover can waste social resources. Anti-takeover has good and bad influences on employees and creditors. The aim of the article is put forward some advice of legislation through analyzing impacts of anti-takeover .

articleTitle: An Analytical Network Model for Decision Support in Global Manufacturing Operations Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper discusses an analytical network model for efficient decision support in global manufacturing operations management (GMOM). Impact of business globalization on manufacturing operations management, key features of GMOM and challenges for the decision making have been identified. Based on the understanding of decision support requirements for the GMOM, an analytical network model has been developed to support multi-criteria decision making in GMOM. Research methodology comprises the theoretical study of Analytical Network Process and empirical study. Development of the decision model has been illustrated through a case of global manufacturing location decision. Further work will integrate the analytical network decision model with fuzzy set theory to enhance GMOM decision making under "wicked" situations.

articleTitle: Rural Logistics Demand Forecasting Based on the BP Neural Network Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Rural logistics development is relatively weak. Based on the logistics demand forecasting problems which appear in the rural logistics development, this paper puts forward the method of BP neural network to apply to analyze the countryside logistics demand forecasting, and then takes the countryside in Chongqing as an example.

articleTitle: Discussion about the Method of Constructing Loss Amount Model: Trying Construction Loss Amount Model with Newton's Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In non-life intensive computation of insurance, loss amount model is mainly constructed with loss detention law or the tendency analytic method. But there are some problems in both methods, such as more restrictions on the empirical data, and they can not be used to construct the loss amount model with nonlinear data. This paper attempts to solve the problem with the Newton's interpolation method, and examines the forecast effect under the conditions of nonlinear data. The results show that the estimated value obtained by Newton's interpolation method is better than by the current methods.

articleTitle: A Study on the Evolutional Path and Dynamic Mechanism of Industrial Agglomeration
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial agglomeration is a special form of industrial organization between a pure market and enterprise organization. From the ecological perspective, this article will apply eco-evolutionary theory to analyze the development path of industrial agglomeration, which includes the processes from individual, industrial stocks, agglomeration formation, and development to maturity, and the dynamic mechanism. Through the analysis framework of industrial agglomeration development path and its dynamic mechanism based on eco-evolutionary theory, this article will give an example of Zhejiang Yongkang hardware industry and analyze the dynamic mechanism of the formation of hardware industrial agglomeration.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Influencing Factors of Competitiveness of China's Undertaking Information Technology Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper mainly makes an empirical research on the influencing factors of competitiveness of China's undertaking information technology outsourcing and the relationship between them. Based on Porter's competitiveness diamond model and relative domestic and foreign researches, this paper selects seventeen indicators as influencing factors and classifies them into six groups. Then through factor analysis, the principal component factors of each group are extracted. Through granger causality test and co-integration test the influencing factors which meet the measurement requirement are obtained. Finally the relationship between competitiveness of China's undertaking IT outsourcing and several indicators is obtained by regression analysis. Research concludes that rising input of capital and labor, rising cost of labor can undermine the competitiveness of China's undertaking information technology outsourcing; government support can elevate the competitiveness; other factors have no influence on the competitiveness.

articleTitle: A New Framework to Deconstruct Customer Complaining Motivations: Based on Consumer Self-Concept and Self-Threats Perception
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the actual predicament of service recovery, this paper reviews the existing theories to analyze the insufficiency of explaining the customer complaining motivation, and tries to put individual self-concept into the study of customer complaints, aiming to establish a new perspective to explain customers' cognition of service failure and how the motivation of complaining is produced. The study constructs an integrative model of customer complaining motivations in a service failure environment, in which the service failures (types) are taken as the initial independent variables ; customer self-threats perception is seen as the core intermediate variable ; self-monitoring and value orientation are introduced as moderator variables. This study is hopeful to reveal the psychological mechanism of consumer service failure cognition and complaining motivations, which is of great significance for enterprises to adopt proper service recovery strategies to rescue customer loyalty.

articleTitle: A Study of the Organization Reengineering in the Process Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper elaborates the existing problems of the traditional organization structure and the nature of process management, and further explores how to reconstruct organization in the process management.

articleTitle: Policy Choice for China to Participate in Transnational Tobacco Smuggling Control in the Post-Convention Era
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The tobacco smuggling not only prejudices the interests of the country and the tobacco enterprises, but also shakes the effect of the tobacco control convention. While the government suffers the tax losses, the tobacco enterprises are also the main victims of the smuggling. On basis of the common foundation and interests, Chinese tobacco enterprises and governmental law enforcement authorities may make joint efforts to crack down on the tobacco smuggling.

articleTitle: Study on the Collusive Corruption in Supervision and Examination of Bank Credit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Commercial banks are typical hierarchical organizations, in which the multiple-principal-agent problem exists and induces serious internal collusive corruption. This article analyzes the collusive corruption between the credit supervisor and the credit manager in bank credit activities, through three possible situations of supervision and examination, including honest and costly supervisor alone, corrupt and costless supervisor alone, and the coexistence of both supervisors. The results of this paper indicate that it is still necessary for the internal supervisor to provide the supervision even though he could collude. Meanwhile, it is inefficient for the bank only depending on the costly external supervisor. Finally, some suggestions are also proposed.

articleTitle: Past, Present, and Future of Bidding, Auction and Bid-Posted
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, bidding, auction and bid-posted are the main patterns of land use right transfer in china. From an economic perspective, bidding, auction and bid-posted all belong to auction. This paper sorts out foreign literatures for auction study: practical auction has had a long history, modern auction theory originates in Vickrey, and the revenue equivalence argument it proposed has been the cornerstone of auction theory; while existing auction theories concern relaxing the assumptions of revenue equivalence theorem, of which the relaxation for two assumptions of fixed bidders number and independent bid is essential for effective auction design. This paper argues that future study can focus on general equilibrium models and mechanism's effectiveness of auction, relationship between auction theory and other trade theories, the relevant laws and regulations and such aspects.

articleTitle: Verification of Environmental Kuznets Curve between AG-NSP and Rural Netincome - Evidence from Zhejiang Province of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: I calculated the total pollutant emissions of livestock manure and rural life in Zhejiang province in China from 1990 to 2009,, which are important non-point source pollution source in agriculture ,by using method of emission coefficient. I explored the relationship between rural net income and rural environmental quality of Zhejiang province with the Environmental Kuznets Curve (EKC) model. The results displayed that there is no significant correlation between rural pollution and per capita net income of rural residents in Zhejiang province, which means it doesn't well agree with EKC curve. This study argued that some other factors may have a great influence on relationship of them.

articleTitle: A Study in the Adaptation of Team Leader Style
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Work team has become a popular concept in the field of management.The author studies the relation between team leader style and circumstance factors .The author concludes that the effective team leader must reaction with the circumstance factors such as the team member maturity and the task structure.

articleTitle: The Characteristics of China's Health Policy Transition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By analyzing China's health policy transition, its characteristics in five aspects were summarized: from isolated measures to systemic measures, from instrumental value to ultimate value, from efficiency orientation to fairness orientation, from unitary means to diversified means, from elite model to public participation model.

articleTitle: Visual Analysis of Hotspot and Frontier of Traditional Chinese Medicine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We choose SCIE and CNKI as the data sources of literatures about traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) and use the information visualization software CiteSpace as the tool to analyze. In order to do hotspot and frontier analysis, we first find out the highly cited papers of TCM. Then we use CiteSpace to clearly show the hotspot and frontier research of traditional Chinese medicine both in China and the international world. We compare the differences of hotspot and frontier research between China and the international world. We find that the development of international study of TCM is behind the domestic development.

articleTitle: Research on the Predicting Models of Insurance Premium during the 12th Five-Year in China's Insurance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Insurance premium is a very important index for the developing situations of insurance. Based on the temporal series data of insurance premium over the past ten years, this article probes into the predicting methods for insurance premium based on grey system theory, sets up grey information renewal GM (1 , 1) models pointing against the demerits of the traditional GM (1, 1) models, and then it makes predictions about the scale of insurance premium during 12th Five-Year Plan. Results of study can provide a reliable basis for science decisions on problems concerning about insurance.

articleTitle: Considering Equilibrium Accessibility in Conflict Resolution over Demolition Disputes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An innovative methodology named Equilibrium Accessibility Analysis based on modified Incentive Algorithm is presented for resolving two-decision maker demolition disputes. Incentive Algorithm is modified by taking into account the irreversible moves and path-dependent transitions. Thus, reachable is identified at the modeling stage, and the path generation step at analysis stage is modified. The major contribution of this research is the Equilibrium Accessibility Analysis, which considers whether the equilibriums are accessible. The systematic procedure of Equilibrium Accessibility Analysis is put forward, and five equilibrium accessibility definitions under five cases are proposed. Thus, equilibriums can be refined reasonably and effectively. A real-life demolition dispute is used to illustrate how this new methodology can be conveniently and effectively applied in practice.

articleTitle: SPOT NDVI Change and Its Correlation with Economic Factors in China-Russian Border Area of Heilongjiang River
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper researched the spatial pattern dynamic change of vegetation on China-Russian border area form 1998 to 2007 using NDVI data of 10-day synthesis. Then the analysis had been made on the relationship between vegetation coverage change and economic factors using data from local statistical yearbook. Results showed that that mostly research areas were well covered and vegetation coverage trend got better during the last ten years. At the same time, there was the positive correlation between NDVI and average wage while negative correlation between NDVI and agricultural acreage.

articleTitle: The Comprehensive Evaluation of Vocational Education Quality in Rural Human Resource Development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper constructs the evolution index system of vocational education in rural human resource development (RHRD) and then exposits the principle and steps that use the factor analysis method to evaluate the quality of vocational education in RHRD. On that basis, the paper takes Ningbo province as a example and does an empirical analysis on the quality of vocational education in RHRD of Ningbo province during 2005 and 2009. The research result shows that the factor analysis is a better objective evaluation method which is suitable to do a comprehensive evaluation on the quality of vocational education. And this empirical result has positive significance for the relevant government departments to improve the quality of vocational education and develop the rural human resources.

articleTitle: In Search of Nonprofit Organizations in China: The Problem of Creation of Income
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the increased number and expanded scale of Non-profit organization (NPO), the separate support from government will not be able to meet the need for NPO's development, commercial marketing concept also applies to NPOs. This article is going to research and exploration the creation of income of NPOs based on marketing operation of NPOs.

articleTitle: Promoting Stewardship among Employees through Systemic Human Resource Practices
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Stewardship is defined as attitudes and behaviors that place the long-term best interest of the organization ahead of one' own individual interest. Stewardship behavior is the actual behavior one acts during daily work, which has been tested by various researchers to be positive with organizational performance. So how to promote stewardship behavior of employees becomes a considerable path to increase the organizational performance. This paper reviewed previous literature of stewardship and models of promoting stewardship behavior, and proposed a model based on human resource practices.

articleTitle: Duration Estimation Method for Highway Construction Work
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: How to estimating the duration of construction work is a key factor to consider when scheduling a new highway project. Because highway construction projects are generally completed outdoors, this work is inevitably affected by kinds of random factors. There is the high level of uncertainty involved in highway construction. Current project planning based on traditional duration estimation method cannot clearly ascertain the level of uncertainty. This paper divides the random factors involved in highway construction into two groups: weather conditions and the other factors. According to the different characteristics of these two groups of the random factors, the paper proposes different methods to deal with them when estimating the work duration. The computer simulation technique is used to estimate the effect of weather conditions. The traditional PERT method is used to estimate the effect of the other random factors. Finally, a case study is conducted that confirms the method can be practically used to estimate more reliable durations of highway construction work.

articleTitle: Study on Construction Project Management and Cost Control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the competition in the construction market is fierce increasingly, profit margin of construction enterprises is getting smaller and smaller,and cost control of construction projects become more and more important.The control of construction project cost becomes one of the cores in project management. Construction project management is a systematic, comprehensive, dynamic subject, requiring construction project manager to regularize and standardize the organization, goal, quality, safety, and cost of construction project . In this paper, in order to achieve the project cost control effectively and create greater economic benefits,construction project management content,measures and cost control measures were studied.

articleTitle: Research on IDSS by Matlab Integration: Theory and Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Intelligent decision support system involves lots of calculations and analysis, and this will affect the operational efficiency of the system. This paper raised that integrate matlab into the IDSS, and let it compute data alone, which will improve the efficiency of the system and so that system designed and implemented will be easier and more convenient to be used. Finally an example is given in combination with matlab integration steps and methods, and this method is novel and practical.

articleTitle: The Spatial Allocation of Factors, Factor Mobility and Agglomeration of Information Service Industry - An Empirical Analysis from the Perspective of Provincial-Level Panel Data
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The differences of industry in space allocation are caused by factors and its mobility. Based on empirical analysis of inner-provincial panel data, our results are that fixed capital and human capital have an impact on the agglomeration of information service industry, while entrepreneur and the quality of the population have a very significant impact especially on enhancing the agglomeration level of information service industry. Factor mobility and transfer such as technology, information, capital etc in space would promote the localization of knowledge spillovers and impel agglomeration in information service industry.

articleTitle: Market Integration in Resource-Saving and Environment-Friendly Society - Using Chang-Zhu-Tan Urban Agglomeration as a Case Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As tourism market integration is very important in tourism market field, methods for determining whether the tourism market has been subdivided reasonably and when we should carry out integration are of significance. In this paper, we propose a STFI (Segmentation-Targeting-Financial analysis-Integration) concept model for evaluating the extent of tourism market segmentation, and determining whether integration is necessary. The feasibility of STFI model was tested using Chang-Zhu-Tan urban agglomeration as a case study. The result suggests that the net profit of Zhuzhou City Market is negative of the three regional markets, so we should consider that it's time to integrate Zhuzhou with Changsha Market to be Chang-Zhu Market, which can save marketing cost and produce high profit. Therefore, it can be concluded that STFI model is a promising method for measuring the rational tourism market segmentation. The result could be helpful for researchers and policy-makers in tourism market management, especially in the area developing Resource-saving and Environment-friendly Society.

articleTitle: Research on the Match between Enterprise International Operation Competitive Strategy and Cross-Culture Management Mode
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper, through a deep analysis of the different competitive strategies and the major cross-cultural management mode in international operation, holds that facing different degrees of pressure from globalization and localization reaction, only if cross-cultural management models and specific competitive strategies match each other is the strategic objective of international operation likely to be achieved. The thesis offers specific countermeasures.

articleTitle: The Timing of Merger and the Decision of Information Search Based Synergistic Value under Double Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the timing of merger and the decision of information research based synergistic value under double uncertainties. Through the introduction of the concept of merger success factors, we research merger threshold under two sources of uncertainty which contain size uncertainty and realization uncertainty. Then we estimate the information value of information research and get hold of thresholds of information research and merger, and by comparing these three thresholds we find the optimal strategy of merging firm. Finally, this paper compares the timings under no information research and information research, and reveals the relations between the probability of merger success, the correlation and the timings of merger and information research through numerical analysis.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Merger and Acquisition Performance of Chinese Private Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Merger and Acquisition has become an important method for Chinese private listed companies to expand their production capacity and acquire greater market share. Meanwhile, however, whether M&A can bring better performance has become the theoretical and practical focus in China. By adopting the assessment method of accounting ratios and with reference to the financial data from 42 sampled companies, factor analysis is made by selecting 9 financial ratios related to companies' financial solvency, liquidity, profitability and growth potential reflecting their core competence. The empirical results indicate that the M&A performance in these companies is not significant. In order to improve the said M&A performance, it is suggested by the authors that effective measures should be taken in the level of companies and governments.

articleTitle: Research in Systems Modeling and Simulation Based on Automobile Maintenance Flow
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the modern manufacturing industry stepping into the era of post-industrialization, Chinese modern manufacturing enterprises have to promote technical innovation, adjust industrial structures, perfect supply chain management, strengthen quality education, enhance management level, fulfill energy saving and waste lowering, uphold stable, sustained and coordinated and scientific development. Facing to the global finance crisis even though the economic crisis, this is to be a difficult problem how to make outlying before us. Utilizing systems modeling and simulation, the manufacturing enterprise is sure to tide over and win the first strike among international competitions. This is an important aspect of the study in modern industry engineering.

articleTitle: Investment Risk Management of Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of market economy, increasing investment of Chinese enterprises, investment risk management is more important. In this paper, with two aspects, securities investment and industrial investment, analyzed, propose some the methods of risk management. Risk management in securities investment: Analyze the investment environment and forecast various types of securities trend; Make use of portfolio for risk diversification; Use derivative instruments for hedging. Risk management in industrial investment: Analyze the investment environment to determine the scale of investment; Diversification; Make good use of financial leverage and operating leverage; Use VaR technology to control the overall enterprise risk.

articleTitle: Industry Technology Roadmapping Research Based on Consensus System Emergence Modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes an idea that industry technology roadmapping could be considered to be an open, complex giant system, from which consensus system emergence problem can be demonstrated and solved by meta-synthesis proposed by Qian xuesen 20 years ago, industry technology roadmapping process is actually a complex system modeling, technology roadmapping itself should be a hall for workshop of Meta-synthetic engineering-HWMSE, therefore it should be handled by meta-synthesis proprosed by Qian xuesen, from qualitative to quantitative methodology and finally building TRM consensus system emergence model.

articleTitle: Interactive Financial Reporting Mode Study Based on XBRL
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of the general financial reporting model, the author proposed the idea of interactive financial reporting model using the expansibility of XBRL. Based on the analysis of the financial information supply chain, the author discussed the implementation methods of interactive financial reporting model.

articleTitle: Cultural Conflict and Integration of Trans-National Corporation and Cross-Cultural Management Strategies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With a constant intensification of economically global tendency and an incessive expansion of trans-national corporation's direct foreign investment, almost all trans-national corporation are encountering a common problem: cultural conflicts incited by trans-national management. Improper management of cultural conflicts will frequently result in the failure of management in local country. This paper is intended to explore the cultural conflict and integration and corresponding cross-cultural management strategies during trans-national management. Finally the countermeasures and suggestions are elaborated to improve the healthy operation of cross-national corporations.

articleTitle: The Feasibility Analysis of Developing Supplying Guarantee Species for Sichuan Security Enterprise: Taking Asphalt Supply for Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With developing of construction guarantee institution in china, there are more and more companies of construction guarantee, varieties of engineering guarantee is also becoming rich. Further investigations indicated that company of construction guarantee in Sichuan rarely did supply of material in bank guarantee, then will supply of material in bank guarantee market be performed by company of construction guarantee in Sichuan based on the feasibility analysis This paper will take supply asphalt for example, and chose two representative enterprises as the research object for a preliminary discussion and analyzes on the problem.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Influence Factors of the Regional Energy Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: International regional cooperation has become an important way to countries to solve energy issues. In many regions the regional energy cooperation is an inevitable trend. But the complexity of regional energy cooperation, the progress of the regional energy cooperation is not smoothly. This paper by using the dynamic analysis method of evolutionary game, analysis the influence factors of the regional energy cooperation. And then does simulation by use the MATLAB, in order to test the conclusions of the evolutionary game model of regional energy cooperation. Then give some suggestions to the regional energy cooperation.

articleTitle: A Decision-Making Model of the Optimum Relationship between Enterprise's Product Profits Target and Warranty Period
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Researching the optimum relationship between the enterprises' product profits target and warranty period can help enterprises to formulate the reasonable product warranty. In the present paper, a new decision model is developed for producers to determine the optimum relationship between enterprise's product profits target and warranty period based on extreme value principle. Through the graphic and quantity analysis, the enterprises' may break the value concept of that offering the longest products warranty period is same as created the best service value for the user realize the goal of providing higher and better service for the user.

articleTitle: Construction of High-Level Talent Development System Based on Competency Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Currently high-level talent development has become one of the key constraints for China's transition to powerful country. According to China's current development plans and personnel structure, this article made an in-depth analysis of the problems in the developing of high-level talents, introducing the theory of competency model and modern ideas of HRD, Constructing the high-level talents development system from the base on competency model, forming systematic and scientific system and pattern, reinforcing the effectiveness of the high-level talent development to meet development requirements.

articleTitle: Research on B2B2C-Based Logistics Operation Patterns
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-business (EB) is one of the most extensive and successful areas enabling the information technology, where more and more enterprises and customers set up the business within this platform. In this paper, the e-business patterns of B2B2C for the small and medium enterprises are introduced. Then the paper brings forward the logistics operation patterns which are applied within this e-business pattern. Finally, the logistics operation pattern which is suitable for the small and medium enterprises is concluded based on the analysis of the cost of the different two logistics operation patterns.

articleTitle: Prediction of Mine Casualties Loss Based on GM (1, 1) Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Prediction of casualties loss is an important part of risk management in mine. Based on the different damage degree, the total personnel casualties loss was calculated. According to the grey system theory, the GM (1, 1) predicting model was established for predicting the personnel casualties loss in mine. By testing, the prediction precision grade of the model is "good", the fitting precision of the actual value and forecastable value is high, it has certain practical value, the predicted results can be used as the basis of safety control in mine.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimal Investment Timing of Visitor Attractions under the Uncertainty of Tourism Demand
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: the investment of visitor attractions (IVA) is irreversible and uncertain. Tourism demand is the main uncertain factor affected it. Based on the Real Options Theory, this paper studies the optimal investment timing of visitor attractions (VA) under the uncertainty of tourism demand, and does the numerical analysis to the parameters in the model. The conclusion is: the greater the uncertainty of tourism demand is the greater value of the project and the options are. So the investment company tends to wait rather than invest immediately.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Modular R&D within Standardization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In light of the highly complex nature of the development of technical standards in high-technology industries, this paper discusses four essentials for the design of modular R&D within standardization and analyzes its optimization based on fundamental elements of modular design. This is an attempt to improve R&D capability and R&D performance of high-technology enterprises (HTEs) in standardization, thus enlightening HTEs on managing modular R&D activities appropriately and adopting efficient steps for standards formulation.

articleTitle: Study on the Irrational Factors of LOFT Mode in Urbanization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: LOFT mode is a kind of living mode generating in the background of rapid urbanization which contains important significance in protecting historical industrial remains. Widespread applying of LOFT mode has led to blindly following. Based on the characteristics, to look into the unreasonable element of LOFT mode and to clarify the trouble we are facing, is the key factor of ensure the sustainable development of historical and industrial heritage, which will surely provide basis for future improvement.

articleTitle: Review on the Relationship between Transforming of Scientific and Technical Achievements and Contribution of Science and Technology Advance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The advance of science and technology plays an increasingly significant role on economic growth, whereas the transforming of scientific and technical achievements is the key point of combination of technology and economy. The level of perspicuity on how the transforming of scientific and technical achievements influences the distribution of the progress of science and technology is not only the premise on which if fully playing to the effect of science and technology, but also the key point that determines whether the change in economic growth mode could be transferred from extensive form to intensive form or not. This paper is to make a comment about the relationship between economic growth and the progress of science and technology as well as concerning the transforming of scientific and technical achievements more orderly and more logically. And raise some prospects related to the research of transforming of scientific and technical achievements and distribution of the progress of science and technology: Defining the calculation method of the ratio of transforming of scientific and technical achievements; Researching the relationship between transforming of scientific and technical achievements and contribution of science and technology advance.

articleTitle: Customer-Service Provider Relationships in Chinese Context: A Qualitative Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study explores the customer-service provider relationship from the customer's point of view in Chinese context. The results from qualitative study indicate that close relationships or commercial friendships exist and develop between customers and service providers, and 18 components of these interpersonal relationships are also been identified.

articleTitle: Section Carrying Capacity Management System of High-Speed Railway in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For the high-speed railway, sections where passenger flow densities are approximately same, can be divided into a passenger flow section. To different sections the corresponding passenger train number should be stipulated. So it is necessary to calculate and research on the carrying capacity of each passenger flow section. This paper takes the Jing-Hu high-speed railway as an example, and the trains on the line are supposed to be the high-speed trains. According to the stopping deduction coefficient of high-speed railway, the carrying capacity of each section and the short-line capacity caused by the skylight are calculated in this paper. Also a section carrying capacity of high-speed railway management system is developed in this paper. It can accomplish the purpose of calculating, analyzing and statement of the section carrying capacity.

articleTitle: A Research on the Early Alarm Indicator System for the Small Enterprise's Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Supply chain can also brought about risk and crisis while bringing benefits to enterprise, The crisis of the supply chain may make a big breakage and lost to enterprise. Especially for the small enterprises in our country, the little wave in its supply chain can make a small enterprise to death because of their limited power to avoid risk. So, Most of minor enterprises must have an early alarm for the supply chain. After an analysis of the inside risks and outside risks which a small enterprise facing, this paper emphasize particularly on the key indexes which are important to the small enterprise, and build an indicator system for the risk early alarm during the management of the supply chain by using method of AHP. All these may help small enterprises to improve their management level of the supply chain.

articleTitle: The Study on Non-Linear Identification Algorithm about EEG
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: about EEG, we could seem as a chaotic attractor, and the identification EEG has been changed into the identification of non-linear parameter. In the identification processing, we find that the optimized algorithm PSO is better to produce a adaptive result.

articleTitle: China's Domestic Airline Competition Analysis Based on System Dynamics and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper offers a system dynamics method to analyze competition of China's domestic airline courses between main cities which are operated by only two main airlines. The model highlights four factors that affect purchase behavior: price, safety impression, service quality, punctuality rate and define the concept of airline's total impression based on the latter three factors. Real data is collected through survey and simulation via Vensim software is conducted to give analysis to the system. We use the model and simulation to study how different airline price strategies and different airline impressions can affect purchase behavior separately.

articleTitle: Research on Partner Selection of Real Estate Development Enterprise in China Based on Supply Chain Management Thoughts
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Along with the development of the real estate market in China and the increasingly fierce competition of the real estate industry, in this situation, this paper has analyzed the necessity of supply chain management introduced into the real estate enterprise management in China and has presented the constructing mode of supply chain of real estate development under the direction of the supply chain management theory, combined with the actual situation of China's real estate enterprises. Meanwhile, supply chain partner selection principle, comprehensive evaluation index system and methods have been put forward when supply chain partners need to be selected, with the real estate development enterprise regarded as the core enterprise on the supply chain.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Society Design
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Society system is a special complex system and its main elements are human that have initiative and study capabilities. In human-driving social problems, human's decisions are the main factors that determine the environment evolving and the effect of decisions. It is necessary to study new methods to deal with these problems. The recourse for the complexity of the human-driving social problem is analyzed. Then based on these analyses, the crucial elements of society design is presented, and the concept model and its solution formulation are also developed. Therefore, a new idea and research direction are presented for solving the human-driving social problem.

articleTitle: Research on Control Method for Guiding DI Shapes Semantics in Product Design Development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Modern enterprise competition has been not only competition for product system, but has developed into competition for brand system basic difference and individualized charm. Based on concept of design identity, research on inheritance and controllability of enterprise brand image is of realistic meaning. Applying fundamental principle of semiotic theory of lateral axis, this paper has proposed to control enterprise image effectively and master relation and change law of core layer and affected layer by guiding DI shapes semantics factors, and used semiotic theory of lateral axis and design procedure as well as affective operation of operation management method to prove scientific effectiveness of guiding DI shapes semantics.

articleTitle: Business Cycle and Enterprise's Manipulation of R&D and Tech-Transfer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Business circular fluctuation, as the inherence of economic development, inevitably exerts its impact on manipulation of R&D and transfer. It is held herein that there is a sensitive interaction and co-movement between the cycle of R&D and business cycle. And business cycle is a determinant to tech-life cycle, which is a determinant to tech-transfer.

articleTitle: The Exploration for the Development Models of Engineering Entrepreneurship: Based on Comparison between the Universities in China & the U.S.
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The modle of the development for the engineering entrepreneurial capacity is a kind of modle which can help to promote the development of engineering education, including to develop the abilities of engineering expertise, innovation, Entrepreneurial spirit and social awareness.This article compares the modles of the development for engineering entrepreneurial capacity between China and the U.S., which is based on the comparison for the training objectives, curricula, organizations, forms of activities, funding sources and so on. And it is suggested that it is necessary to establish the training objectives consistenting with China''s national conditions and regional economic development, to rely on venture projects, to improve the system of the entrepreneurship curricula, to establish the business organizations, to open up the sources of funds and so on.

articleTitle: A Research on Tourism Human Resource Development Based on Competency Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The application of a competency model in China's tourism enterprises is still growing. The ability of tourism professionals is the key which can enhance the core competitiveness of enterprises. A competency-based model for human resource development (HRD) proves to be a useful tool to help tourism enterprises to gain competitive advantages. The model is composed of three aspects: professional accomplishments, professional ethics, and value orientations. The model will provide the directors, practitioners of HRD and their employees, with a unified criterion for their practical work and human resource management.

articleTitle: On Sustainable Development of the Main Logistics Market in Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The sustainable development of the main logistics market can regulate the market order and expand the market space to achieve effective allocation of resources. On the basis of analyze current situations the main logistics market in Chongqing, this paper reveals the typical problems and proposes measures to ensure their sustainable development measures.

articleTitle: Service Self-Aware and Data Adaptive-Allocation for Scientific Research Information System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Currently, it's more and more important to share information and reference resource news for scientific researchers or managers to carried out collaborative research to some extent. In this paper, a service self-aware and resource adaptive-allocation architecture is proposed and demonstrated in scientific research system which can realize the flexible and controllable requirements. Self awareness of the services provides the ability for the system to autonomously detect and improve its perception accuracy and timeliness.

articleTitle: Designs of Company's Cash Flow Indicators & Case Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an important means to analyse a company's operation conditions, cash flow indicators based on cash basis, which cannot easily be manipulated, are closely related to its financial performance. According to the constructed cash flow indicators of operating activities, investing activities and financing activities, and data gathered from Datang International Power Generation Company Limited, the article makes a general analysis of financial conditions for the purpose that exploring the considerable role the cash flow indicators play in assessing a company's financial performance.

articleTitle: Establishment of a Quality Scale (QFD) for Creative Product Design Service
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The objective of this research was the establishment of a quality scale [QFD] for creative and product design service that was not available before. The cultural and creative product design industry of Sanxia indigo dyeing was taken as the case study to develop such a Quality Function Deployment (QFD) system. In addition, digital inject textile printing technology was utilized to replicate and analyze the pure indigo blue color and totems used in the traditional indigo dyeing process. As the local cultural and creative industry are progressing rapidly in Taiwan and global markets, this research intends to develop the Old Street of the Sanxia indigo dyeing creative product design industry into a case study, with the objective of exploring the establishment of a quality control scale for a design service entity that has never had one. This research also intends to preserve and record traditional Sanxia indigo craftsmanship and totems with digital printing technology so that it can be scientifically preserved and analyzed. The Sanxia indigo shops and consumers were targeted as the objects of study. This research has probed into the actual operations of the Sanxia indigo dyeing creative product design industry. Data were generated through review and study of domestic and international literature and articles. Interview surveys and on-site observations were conducted, as well as hands-on experience in the shops, to gain a real understanding of the industry. Based on the QFD which originated in Japan in the 1960's, the "voice of the customer" was collected and analyzed for product design and production in order to actually meet or even exceed customer expectations of the products. While the QFD was mainly used for the manufacturing industry, the goal was to try to set up QFD concepts for the design service industry, the Sanxia indigo dyeing creative product design in this case. The House of Quality deployment model was used to conduct a series of matrix analyses, and through the quality deployment mechanism, the "voice of the customer" was transformed into a design scale for the development of creative products. The six foundation frameworks of the House of Quality (Hauser 1988) were explored. The frameworks are: 1. customer demand, 2. engineering analysis, 3. competition analysis, 4. relationship analysis, 5. technology assessment and 6. correlation matrix. The findings will provide industry vendors with important Sanxia indigo dyeing references for product design and quality principles to help meet consumer needs. Three conclusions from this research were obtained: (1) The importance of creative product design quality is reflected in the following four aspects: a. It is a key element of the customer purchasing intention-product feature; b. It is a rule for industry existence and success; c. It can enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty and d. It can improve the operating performance of the industry. (2) If creative industry service procedures are included in the quality scale of creative indigo dyeing product design, a complete quality scale of creative product design can be constructed. (3) Creative indigo dyeing product design quality of Sanxia indigo dyeing art should be strengthened in terms of dye liquor materials, indigo dyeing features and post processing techniques so as to ensure the quality of creative product design and enhance customer satisfaction and purchasing intentions.

articleTitle: Urban Environmental Management's Objective Choice Based on Multi-Attribute Decision Method: Economic Development or Environmental Protection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: How to make a rational choice between economic development and environmental protection must be the first problem to be answered in urban environmental management. In this article, the problem is analyzed by multi-attribute decision method. In analysis, it will probe into the determination of decision-making set and attributes set based on the detailed problems that objective choice will face to. The article also illuminate the application of multi-attribute decision method throught a real case. The research conclusion is that, using multi-attribute decision method, we can find the best objective solution which can take all parties benefits into account. The choice will decide the policy tropism about urban environmental management in the next period of time.

articleTitle: Influence of Family Relationships on Family Business Succession: A Conceptual Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Succession is a challenge to family businesses for a number of reasons, including the excessive influence of the family subsystem on the business. Recent theoretical developments suggest that the effects of family adaptability and family cohesion on the effectiveness of succession and the satisfaction with succession process are determined by the family's commitment to the business and acceptance of individual roles. This article also highlights the importance of considering mediating factors in conducting family business research.

articleTitle: Research on the Management and Service of Family Policy for the Floating Population in Urban-Rural Districts of Beijing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Those who deliberately give unscheduled birth should be punished severely, and those who are non-intentional should be given instruction, guidance and intervention. The register system of marriage and childbearing certificate should be improved; the management responsibilities in domicile and residence should be definite; the issues about the family planning institutions and personnel and funding should be planned and solved; the management of floating women at childbearing age should be classified and free them of dilemma. The management can be improved by expanding service channels.

articleTitle: A Discriminant Analysis Model for Supply Chain Transaction Cost
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an important part of supply chain costs, transaction cost has not been considered much in traditional cost accounting. In the past, transaction cost of purchasing was contained in material or fixed asset cost at recognition and initial measurement. Then, it was gradually apportioned to income statement. However, transaction cost of sales was directly charged as expense of this period. With huge development of enterprises relationships in supply chain, the method of cost accounting above is inapplicable. We put forward in the essay that transaction cost of purchasing material should be treated in the same way as transaction cost of sales, in which the cost is separated from inventory cost and directly figured as expenses. In this paper, a linear discriminant analysis classification model based on Mahalanobis distance is constructed to justify the theoretic analysis. And financial data of a representative manufacturing corporation is studied. The results validate our point of view on transaction cost of purchasing material, and furthermore, lay the foundation of constructing new cost accounting system in supply.

articleTitle: The Mechanism Financial Innovation Promotes China's Capital Market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through the analysis of the already existed financial innovation in China's capital market, this paper did a research on the mechanism financial innovation promoting China's capital market. On basis of the above, the paper proposed that the financial innovation is the driving force of China's capital market and the development of China's capital market needs the support of innovation in financial products, institutions and systems.

articleTitle: A Programme Implementation Model for Architecture/Engineering/ Construction Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Traditionally, the vast majority of practical and theoretical developments on construction project management have been related to single projects considered in isolation. In fact, it has been suggested that up to 90%, by value, of all projects occur in the multi-project context. So, there exist essential defects in research that concentrates on a single project whilst ignoring its interrelations and interactions with other projects. With the rapid development of Project management theory, Programme Management, which integrates project management and strategy management, has been widely implemented in Manufacture, IT and Communications industries, and has achieved great success. In the background, this dissertation aims to provide an entirely novel management concept, and provide project-based enterprises with a 'roadmap' to high payback areas.

articleTitle: Comparing of Compensation and Benefits of Chinese and American Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The design of compensation and benefits system is reasonable or not largely affects the fate of employees. The motivation influence of the wage levels and employee benefits, which plays an important role for increasing the enthusiasm of the staff and improving the production efficiency.
