Satisfied with the compensation and benefits is the core of human resource management, which makes a tremendous impact on the development of the enterprises.This paper carries on the comparison analysis to the staffs' compensation and benefits of Chinese and American enterprises, on base of this comparison analysis concludes and summaries the Chinese and American enterprises respective characteristic, from where to help Chinese enterprises to build a more reasonable compensation and benefits system, then further to retain employees and enhance the competitiveness of enterprises.

articleTitle: Problem Analysis and Policy Recommendation on China's Engineering Consulting Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Deeply influenced by the planning economic system, China's engineering consulting industry still lag behind the international norm, although the consulting concept has been introduced into mainland for about 20 years. The insufficient regulations and irrational enterprise system severely restrains the development of China's engineering consulting industry. After entering the WTO, China's consulting enterprises will confront more crucial competition. In order to make Chinese consulting firms survive in the competition, the industry must be reformed. This paper will first analysis the current problem exists in industry and then find out the root of weakness, finally propose recommendations on financial, legislative and institutional aspects, to promote the reformation in China's engineering consulting industry.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Development of International Service Outsourcing in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the new round of global industrial transfer marked with the shift of service industry, the huge market potential of service outsourcing industry and its role in promoting the healthy development of the economy have been recognized by many countries and regions. In recent years, China's enterprises have been expanding their scale and fields of service outsourcing industry, and the service outsourcing industry has achieved rapid development. This paper discussed the current status and problems of international service outsourcing in China, carried out analysis on the impact factors of China's service outsourcing and put forward constructive proposals.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Efficiency of the Supermarket Chain Based on the DEA Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Papers is starting from the supermarket chains' the function of the system, the use of DEA Efficiency Evaluation of the feasibility of each branch, according to the principles of efficiency evaluation supermarket chains. Identified a series of evaluation index, and establish the efficiency of the supermarket chain evaluation system, with an example using the method of virtual decision making units in DEA on the traditional model was improved, then explain the DEA method of evaluating the efficiency of the supermarket chain is reasonable

articleTitle: Ideas on Individual Information Service of Foreign Periodicals
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Individual information service is the kind of information service based on Reader's personal demands, which has been attempted in academic libraries both at home and abroad. The necessity of individual information service in foreign periodicals is expounded in this article. Some practices and experiences such as new periodicals announcement service and establishing foreign periodical column were introduced; the existing problem and the developmental tendency in individual information service of foreign periodicals were proposed.

articleTitle: Internal Control Evaluation under Risk-Based Audit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Internal control is an important symbol which measure the modern enterprise management. A good internal control system can guarantee the quality of accounting information. Through the analysis of the internal control evaluation criteria, the paper pointed out that auditing environment should be considered under modern risk-based audit. Finally, the paper not only proposed the contents of the internal control system evaluation, but also proposed the comprehensive evaluation system under risk-based audit to meet the development needs of enterprises.

articleTitle: Control and Management of Process Cost for Coal Companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper analyzed the industrial characteristics of process cost in coal companies, and give some advice for coal companies dividing the targets of cost management by means of forward pass based on the reference o f historical data, and the method o f process cost control. The result indicates that the control of production cost should focus on prediction control, venue control, and afterward analysis, so that achieve the optimization of production cost control for coal companies.

articleTitle: Research on Monitoring-Based Risk Management of Deep Excavation Engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the study on risk identification, risk estimation, risk assessment and risk control of monitoring-based deep excavation engineering, a set of feasible risk management system of deep excavation engineering is built up in this paper. The expert surveys method (including Delphi), fault tree analysis, checklist are used in identifying risk factors in deep excavation engineering. The risk estimation method of deep excavation engineering based on subjective estimation is proposed. This paper has established a monitoring-based risk assessment system on deep excavation engineering, including the standards of risk probability classification and risk loss level, the risk assessment matrix, the risk acceptance criteria and risk levels. The relationship between risk level and monitoring level is set up. The risk control method on risk tracking and risk early warning is put forward.

articleTitle: The Circulation Pattern of Online Scientific Journals
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Taking Christopher Alexander's Pattern Language as a theoretical base, the article defines the mission of online scientific journal circulation and some key issues needed to be solved at first; then via amount of empirical research on practical circulation activities, it figures out some optimal solutions for the issues, namely some sub-patterns consisting of the circulation pattern; finally it discusses and adjusts the research results.

articleTitle: Risk Evaluation of Public-Private Partnership Projects of Urban Rail Transit Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The limited availability of construction fund has become one of bottlenecks hindering the development of urban rail transit in mainland China. The introduction of Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) model delivering private sector funds to the construction of public infrastructure can effectively alleviate the financial pressure on the government. However, higher practical risks have threatened the successful implementation of PPP projects and highlight the need of risk evaluation for PPP projects. This paper aims to evaluate the risk degree in the whole life cycle of PPP projects by quantitative analysis method. An index system on PPP risk evaluation of urban rail transit was established, covering macro-environmental risks, economic risks, legal risks, construction risks, and operational risks. Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method was used to quantitatively evaluate the PPP risks. The case of XXX city was analyzed to demonstrate the use and capabilities of the method. The result shows the PPP risk evaluation method could provide effective decision-making support for risk allocation and control.

articleTitle: Development of Learners' Output Ability in Oral Class
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Language learning depends on not only the input of language materials but also the output which may provide learners with feedback information but also practice the knowledge acquired. This research paper is devoted to the study in language output and principles on how to realize the output in learning a foreign language.

articleTitle: The Decision-Making Theory of Foreign Direct Investment Based on Real Options
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the real options theory, the opportunities in the decision-making of FDI would be regarded as the real options belonging to the multinational enterprise(MNEs). Facing the market and technology uncertainty, there are options to defer investment and growth options contained in the opportunity of FDI. When the value of options to defer investment increases, MNEs have motivation to delay the investment; and the value of growth options increases, MNEs have motivation to implement the initial investment. This paper develops a two-stage model of FDI based on real options theory, discusses the effects of real options value to the FDI decision-making. When making investment decisions, both kinds of real options should be consolidated balanced, and thus the timing of FDI be measured.

articleTitle: Comparison of Service Industry Productivity of Major Cities in Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service industry productivities of eleven major cities in Hebei province are deeply analyzed in terms of related statistic data in 2008 abased on DEA method in this paper. The returns to scale and input surplus are also studied and the reasons of comparatively low efficiency for some cities are provided for improving service industry competitiveness of Hebei Province and optimizing industrial structure of the region.

articleTitle: Security Strategy of E-Commerce in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The rapid evolution of computing and communication technologies and their standardizations have made the boom in e-commerce possible. However, there are many disadvantages of current e-commerce payment system, such as payment model, payment security system, etc. The paper first analyses the present situation of Chinese online payment system, then the paper goes on to identify the perceived threats and vulnerabilities of e-commerce systems. Finally the paper proposes some measures in the construction of China's secure payment system.

articleTitle: The Theoretical Deduction of Implicit Human Capital's Transaction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Personal and organizational implicit human capital could be effectively transformed into each other and this process is the basic key aspects of knowledge-based economy. Each person the subject of the implicit human capital is the source of value creation. And the organizational implicit human capital is the amplifier of the productivity. Personal implicit human capital transform into the dominant capital is the key factor of personal or organizational success. In this paper, we will make the assumptions of the factors of implicit human capital transformation based on the Literature analysis.

articleTitle: Langue, Parole and Foreign Language Education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The distinction between langue and parole has contributed a lot to the development of the linguistics, which has not only a theoretical sense in the language research and study but also a practical meaning in the practical foreign language education. In this paper, on the basis of the distinction between langue and parole, the author makes a tentative comparison between the two terms and Chomsky's competence and performance and Halliday's linguistic potential and actual linguistic behaviors and then puts this theory into practical use - foreign language education with his own teaching practice.

articleTitle: A Game Analysis of China's Environment Protection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Environment protection is an important aspect for building a harmonious society in China, and it relates to China's sustainable development. This paper analyzes China's environmental problems according to the Game theory, and puts forwards relevant proposals.

articleTitle: Production Fragmentation on Productivity: Based on Data from China's Industries
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is no objection that international production fragmentation does have great improvements on industrial productivity. As the biggest developing country, China also benefits from the international production fragmentation. This study first provides firm proof to the improvements of China's industrial productivity brought by the international production fragmentation in form of processing trade and general trade. Then this study focuses on the different impacts on industrial productivity brought by developed countries and under developed countries. The conclusion is that production fragmentation undertaking from developed countries does have greater improvements than that from developing countries.

articleTitle: Forgive Your Failures: How the Customer-Organization Relationship Benefits for the Service Recovery?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although there is general agreement with the importance of high quality customer-organization relationships, there is no consistent evidence as to how the customer-organization relationship affects customers' attitudes and behaviors after a service failure and recovery. This paper investigates the moderation effect of the service recovery condition on the relationship between customer-organization relationships and the effect of service recovery. The empirical result shows that strong relationships may provide a sort of protection which will benefit the service providers after a service failure.

articleTitle: Study on Compensation Structure in Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Compensation system is not only the core compenent in the human resources management and development, but also the important means for talent incentive in enterprises. The compensation structure as the part of compensation system is the important content of the compensation system designing. Recognizing its importance, this paper meticulously discusses the post, performance, ability and market-oriented compensation structure. The connotation, behavior orientation, advantages and disadvantages of compensation structure are analyzed, and thereby proposing its application in business.

articleTitle: The Impact of Global Management Factors on the Cash Flows of Japanese Discrete Business Companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study focuses on the comparison of two companies; company A, which has adopted G-FMI (Global Factory Managed Inventory) and company B which has not adopted G-FMI. The aim of this study is fourfold: to identify those external and internal weighted factors which influence cash flow on these two companies, to compare and analyze the degree of influence of such weighted factors, and to prove the superiority of G-FMI through comparison analysis of the two companies, and finally, to clarify the effect of contribution of top management on discrete business companies. Analysis of the results taken from use of publicly available data has identified the weighted factors unique to each company, quantitatively measured the degree of influence of each weighted factor through use of standardized coefficients, and found that exchange rates had the greatest influence on the cashflow of company A. By using this research as a basis, it is possible to identify those weighted factors influencing any company and to do a quantitative comparison analysis on the degree of influence of those factors for any company.

articleTitle: The Study on 7Ps Marketing Strategy of Open-End Fund
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a very important popular public trust and investment tool, Open-end Fund offers a credible choice of investment to investor. With the development of Open-end Fund, the marketing level is enhanced greatly. But, with increasing competition and the existence of purchase and redemption mechanism, fund management companies are facing a lot of marketing pressures. The traditional 4Ps of marketing strategy cannot meet the needs of the development of open-end fund any more, and to establish a new combination of marketing strategy has become necessary.

articleTitle: Study on the Relationship between Emotional Intelligence and Employee Performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Relationship between emotional intelligence and performance is the main subject of emotional intelligence under organizational circumstances. The research aims to exam how employees' emotional intelligence effects their performance, The main conclusion is that employee's emotional intelligence or some aspects of emotional intelligence can positively improve his or her own performance.

articleTitle: Construct Emergency-Response Logistics System and Public Crisis Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Frequent public crisis shows that to construct system of public crisis management is essential, and a important tache is to construct a emergency-response logistics system. Emergency-response logistics has the characters of paroxysmal and uncertainly, temporary and compelling, feeble-economic and Public Interest, which request that government exert a dominant role in the constructing an emergency-response logistics system which would comprise of guarantee system, direction system, communication system and equip-deliver system.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis of Price Discovery Function in Steel Futures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By the end of 2010, China's steel futures listed on the market only two years, in 2010 the rebar futures year-round reach the deal about 45122.48 million hands, ranking the first global commodity futures volumes. Studying whether steel futures has the price discovery function, and whether steel futures plays a guiding role to the steel production management and sales, have important practical meanings. Results show that Our country steel futures and spot market, there exist certain positive correlation and between the two there is a long-term equilibrium relationship; our steel futures have a certain price discovery function, but the price discovery function not revealed.

articleTitle: Regional Disparities and Spatial Autocorrelation of Chinese Tertiary Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims to estimate the regional disparities and spatial autocorrelation of the tertiary industry development in China from a spatial econometric perspective. It delineates the trend of Chinese regional disparities and its spatial dynamics from 1998 to 2006 based on an exploratory spatial data analysis. The findings are as follows: (1) there exists an interregional inequality and weak correlations between provincial services industry development; (2) the spatial divergence between regional tertiary industries is significant and is going to increase in the short run. Then it examines the factors that contribute to the regional divergences of the tertiary industry development and puts forward several policy suggestions to narrow the regional gaps in the development of Chinese tertiary industry accordingly.

articleTitle: Chinese Commercial Banks' Loan Innovation: Network Perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Chinese commercial banks' loan innovation has been greatly upgraded along with Chinese market economy setting up. In this article, we have answered how they can innovate their loan model from the perspective of network. There are debtors' networks in different commercial banks. The more intense those networks are the better that those commercial banks can have their evaluation knowledge. The better that those commercial banks manage their evaluation knowledge; the better their innovation performances are.

articleTitle: Government Leaders' Media Communication and Public Image Building in Emergency
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Sparse literature exists on the topic that government leaders' media communication principle, and in guidance of which leaders build their public image in emergency. Especially how different communicating skills used can help to mode leader's public image containing different characters. So in this study the theories of public relations, image and communication were used to discuss the principles of leader's media communication in emergency, the aim of and the strategy for building moral image and talent image of the leaders in emergency, And the aims of building leaders' visual image and the different communicating skills which contributing to shape an approachable leader who can share risks with their people, an efficient expert who is sharp at crisis management, a determined and calm mental rescuer.

articleTitle: On the Implementation of "Merry P.E." in the Curriculum Reform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Merry P.E " bud in Japan in 1960s-70s. Since the 1980s, along with the beginning of the reform of Physical Education, the thought of Merry P.E spread quickly and widely all through China. Merry P.E is put forward to solve the problem of students' sports-weariness and to develop sports ideas and lifetime sports. As an educational thought, its basic core is: how to strive to make physical education through a variety of measures to achieve a relatively perfect situation of "happy to teach and happy to learn", and how to establish a scientific and comprehensive education thought of Merry P.E. In physical education classes, the dominant position of the students should be respected and they should be enabled to experience all the fun when mastering skills and doing physical training. By experiencing the fun of sports, the students gradually form the ambition and habit of lifelong sports.

articleTitle: Applying the Stochastic Interest Rates to Solve the Jump-Diffusion Contingent Claims Pricing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, by modifying price behavior of risk asset and considering randomization of interest rates, broaden the two basic assumptions of Black-Scholes option pricing model. By martingale method, pricing formulas of European call option and put option, and parity are deduced, and finally the pricing formula of European option is also given based on the risk asset paying continuous dividends.

articleTitle: Design Evaluation System for Design Management Based on Group Decision
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to improve the quality and efficiency of design, the paper introduced the theory of group decision into design evaluation stage of design management. Individual evaluation methods and group decision methods are researched according to design management. Design evaluation prototype system for design management based on group decision is constructed.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis on the Economy Growth of the New Silk Road Transportation Economic Zone in China - A Panel Data Model on the Basis of Six Factors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This thesis used empirical analysis methods of establishing panel-data model, Took the 17 most important cities along the East and West traffic artery Long Hai and Lan Xin railways on the New Silk Road in china as modeling samples, analyzed the different role of six factors to promote this Transportation Economic Zone's economic growth, which included human capital, transport capacity, the level of urbanization, industrial gathering, the regional gap, and the market scale variables. According to the empirical analysis of the spatial transportation infrastructure spillover effect, it showed that the spatial spillover effect of transportation infrastructure was positive.

articleTitle: Technological Leapfrogging Based on Enterprise Mergers & Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the global background of technical advantage being corporate core competence, the most important motivation for M & A is acquiring relevant technology for technological leapfrogging to improve technical efficiency and technological competitive advantages. This paper takes technological competence as an example to demonstrate the path choosing of implementing technological leapfrogging. The paper proposes technological leapfrogging based on enterprises M & A strategy. M&A strategy is an effective method of achieving technological leapfrogging through M&A strategy and fostering core competence based on technological competence. This paper also discusses the issue of the decision model of corporate technological leapfrogging strategy pattern, opportunity research of technological leapfrogging in M&A, technological diffuseness effect based on technological leapfrogging M & A and technological competence development in implementing technological leapfrogging via M & A.

articleTitle: E-Readiness Model of the Chinese Logistics Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study explores the factors that affect e-logistics adoption in Chinese logistics industry. It proposes IEPER, a three dimension research model, based on internal environment e-readiness (IER), external environment e-readiness (EER) and pathway e-readiness (PER).

articleTitle: Analyze on the Forecasting Demand of Front-Line Worker in Logistics' Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the fast development of logistics, the logistics in our country is still in seedtime. How to boost competition becomes the problem each company must face to. This paper introduces the application of the call center into the logistics. Call center, as a bridge linking all companies and customers, can realize the integration of the customer resources and information flow and ultimately strengthen the company's competition. The importance of personnel forecast was pointed out in this paper. Comparative analyses through instances between several methods of personnel forecast were expounded by the author.

articleTitle: Theoretical Research on Highway Regionalization in Western China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper put forward the idea and the theory of highway regionalization. The evaluation indexes system was es-tablished, and principal component analysis was used to lower dimensions and it can eliminate the correlation and information overlaps lying in multi-indexes. Cluster analysis was used to classify these regions into several categories according to the new indexes obtained from PCA.The results can be use to predicate the reasonable scale of highway network in the West. The results show that this method can simplify the original complicated problem and lead to an objective, reliable, convinc-ing conclusion and make the prediction of the reasonable scale of highway network in the West is pertinence and maneuver-ability.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Industrial Upgrade Path of Sporting Goods Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: However accompany with the oneself development and the variety of the exterior environment, the sporting goods industry is in difficulty. According to these difficulties, this paper combines the current situation of sporting goods industry and its position in the global chain, will discuss the possibility of complete industrial upgrading of the China Sporting Goods Industry from the structure promotion of global value chain and the construction of domestic value chain.

articleTitle: Study on Trust Model of SMEs R&D Alliance Based on Reputation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: R&D Alliance is an effective way for SMEs(small and medium enterprises) independent innovation. In order to realize cooperation across the organization and border-crossing, SMEs R&D Alliance must consider how to reduce cost, improve cooperative effect cooperation, and meanwhile guarantee the flexibility of SMEs. The essence of SMEs R&D Alliances cooperation and cooperation is closely linked with trust. Trust is the basis for the cooperation. In order to maintain the stable cooperation relationship and good operation, SMEs R&D Alliance requires establishing incentive mechanism for the members' cooperation. The reputation of organizational members' cooperation is undoubtedly an effective incentive. By using the KMPW reputation model of complete information dynamic game, we can analyze the trust problems of SMEs R&D Alliance under the condition with information asymmetry. Moreover, the KMPW reputation model can also disclose and transmit the trust information about the enterprises effectively.

articleTitle: Control Mechanisms and Market Knowledge Acquisition: An Empirical Study in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research develops a framework for investigating the individual and joint effect of contract and trust on market knowledge acquisition from marketing channel. The data from manufacturer-distributor relationships in China are used to test our hypotheses. The results suggest that, contract is inversed U-shaped impact on knowledge acquisition, while trust can increase knowledge acquisition. And the joint execution of contract and trust will enhance market knowledge acquisition. These findings provide valuable theoretical thinking for manufacturer's execution of selected control mechanisms to promote its knowledge acquisition from its downstream distributors.

articleTitle: Effects of Behavioral Parameters on Volatility of Asset Prices in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The fluctuations of capital market mainly originate from the volatility of asset price. How to understand and describe the volatility of asset price is meaningful for both the finance theory and the finance application. The attribute of investor's subjective behavior makes marked effect on asset price. This paper sets the equilibrium price of stock in capital market as a function of subjective discount factor, relative-risk-aversion coefficient, and habitual parameter, and researches the effects of the investor's behavioral parameter's fluctuations on volatility of asset price with the method of numerical simulation. The simulation outcome reveals that a little fluctuations of investor's behavioral parameter result in big fluctuations of stock price in China.

articleTitle: Study on Degree of Tourism Industrial Cluster in City
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces the concept of cluster of tourism industry and degree of tourism industrial cluster, and puts forward a model of agglomeration degree and cooperation degree of firms. We prove this model by analyzing empirically on Qinhuangdao's tourism industry. Then some conclusions are drawn in the end.

articleTitle: Data Mining Application in the Innovative Activities of the Science and Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As to the innovation in the science and technology, the informatization is an important topic of theoretical research. Moreover, it is also considered the essence of the modernization in the science and technology. With the development of the information age, the amount of information growing exponentially, data mining is produced in this case. The new technology is, not only a product of the information age, but also a new way to overcome the data mountain in the road of progress. In this article, the role of data mining played in the innovation of science and technology was discussed, respectively. We take a brief review about its influence and application on the innovative activities in the science and technology. Furthermore, a prediction on the development of data mining had been discreetly presented at the end of each part. In this paper, the general applications of the technology were profiled, which may be helpful for the domestic researchers in the science and technology.

articleTitle: An Extension of Dividend Catering Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper extends the dividend catering theory raised by Baker and Wurgler (2004) and predicts that expected dividend per share is negatively related to those factors below: the information ratio about dividend cost, the percentage of stock ownership, as well as the premiums of tax, risk, investment. Besides, in another extension of basic model, we incorporate overconfident psychology bias to arbitrageurs, and explain how psychology bias effect dividend payout propensity.

articleTitle: Research of the Regeneration Mechanism of Urban Residence Based on Field Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Confronted with global energy crisis and environmental deterioration, residence regeneration has attracted more and more attention for dealing with the ageing urban residences. On the reference of electromagnetic field theory in physics, the mathematical formula of field force of residence is established. We demonstrate that " field force" F is proportional to "residential Value" V (t) and "housing demand level" D (t) , but inversely proportional to the square of the distance from the human activity center to residence, and is restrained by the social, cultural, economic and other conditions through the case of the Qingshan district in Wuhan.

articleTitle: A Study on the Modeling Process and Method of Competence Model in Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is critical to identify competence model structure and discuss modeling process and method, because it decides that the competence model is applied successfully in human resources management and the development practice or not. Synthesizing domestic and foreign research about competence model, from the behavioral science angle to establish model, basic research has been mature, but the model validity is still limited by the factors, such as time, enterprise size, cost and so on. In fact, the massive basic study and case accumulation can provide reference for the companies, therefore this article based on this mind has proposed another modeling ways. It is a very important step to study the suitable modeling method according to the different modeling mentality and different data nature for the enterprises.

articleTitle: Self-Enforcing Mechanism for Relational Contract in R&D Based on GNBS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: economical contract is not very well in R&D, and relational contract is complementary for it. Self-enforcing is key point of relational contract. Repeated game is used in self-enforcing mechanism, while special invest happened before the repeated game. So self-enforcing mechanism based on repeated game could not take effect in R&D. Introduce GNBS and fixed price, build up game frame on foundation of relational contract, analysis the difference of decision in one time trade and in relational contract, put forward the condition in which the partner would choose the best investment. According to this, self-enforcing mechanism for relational contract in R&D is built up.

articleTitle: Quality Management of Old Cement Concrete Pavement Fragmentation Firmness Technology: Based on Ha-da Expressway Maintenance Project
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using the Impact Compactor to deal with the old pavement existent diseases, the old cement concrete fragmentation firmness technology can postpone largely, even avoid the reflective cracking of asphalt overlay. Based on the practical maintenance in Ha-da expressway, in this paper, discussion is made about action principle and construction focus in the old cement concrete fragmentation firmness technology. And its quality management on the maintenance project is investigated uppermost.

articleTitle: Education: The Engine of Investments in Human Capital in China's Rural Areas
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China is a populous country with rich labor resources. It will gain sustainable momentum in future competition if the human resources can be transformed into human capital, especially investments in human capital in the vast rural areas. Through investment in education, the advantages of resource can be converted into competition. This article, through economic methods, analyzes investment in education from four aspects: the analysis on cost and benefit, Matthew Effect, life-cycle theory and education signal. It is believed if investment is increased in education in rural areas, the investments in human capital will be more promising, the economic development will be coordinated, the income gap between urban and rural will be narrowed and the quality of our people will be improved.

articleTitle: Research on Sino-EU Trade Frictions and the Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the continuous development of Sino-EU trade, trade friction are increasing, the EU is becoming the area imposing most trade sanctions to China, the increasing trade friction becomes an important issue that affects China's foreign trade. The causes for more trade frictions from different angles are figured out, according to the present situation of Sino-EU trade friction, this paper try to analyze the reasons leading to Sino-EU trade frictions and on this basis put forward countermeasures and suggestions dealing with Sino-EU trade frictions.

articleTitle: The Interaction Effect of User Participation on IT Service Providing Process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The economy model has change from manufacturing oriented to service oriented. Traditional concept which the value of a product is according to the price in transaction is different to modern concept that the price of service which customer is willing to pay depend on how customer is satisfy to the service during the consume progress. Furthermore, the modern production process starts to put emphasis on co-creation with consumers. This article investigate the IT service providers to examining the effects of service dominate logic in the value creation process. Our result shows that provider value co-creating process and experience design process have positive effect on perceived customer relationship.

articleTitle: A Measurement Tool to Improve Individual e-Business Capability in an e-Business Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A measurement tool for an individual e-Business capability is important to manage and improve their work ability in an e-Business environment. This study presents a tool to measure an individual e-Business capability with the measurement items, process, and method based on the previous literature. The developed tool construct were verified by factor and reliability analysis with the application of SPSS software. This tool has four measurement factors and fourteen items. The utilization of the developed tool was confirmed by applying it to a case study.

articleTitle: The Application of Factor Analysis and Logistic Model in Monitoring the National Physical Fitness about Gansu Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this study, we make a quantitative research on adult physical fitness level by using multivariate statistical analysis methods and econometric models. Based on the data of national physical fitness from Gansu province, we firstly apply factor analysis to study the distribution status of adult physical level of Gansu province. Then, we analyze the influencing factors of eligible rate on the adult physical fitness about Gansu Province by Logistic model. The results show that adult physical fitness of cities in Gansu decreases in the following order: Wuwei, Lanzhou, Tianshui, Jiuquan, Linxia, Qingyang. We also discover that gender had little effect on the eligible rate of adult physical fitness in Gansu, while age had greater impact on the eligible rate of adult physical fitness.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation of Urbanization Level of Harbin from Farmers' Angle - Taking Shangzhi Bin County and Shuangcheng as Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It analyzed the influenced factors of farmers participating in the urbanization in Harbin by Logistic model, and the results were that the education level, weather the farmers owning the land and knowing about the urbanization influenced the urbanization process a lot.

articleTitle: The Research on Relationship of Local Fiscal Expenditure for S&T and Economic Growth - Based on Cointegration and VAR Model Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The local fiscal expenditure for science and technology(S&T) and the economic growth are two interactional facors in an economic system. Basing on the sample of Fujian Province in China, we estimate the long-term and short-term elasticity of the local fiscal expenditure on the economic growth, and then study the interaction between these two factors. We find that the lag effect and the long-term interactive effects exist between them, the local fiscal expenditure for S&T play a more important role on economic growth of Fujian province in long-term than short-term.

articleTitle: The Simulation Research on the Evolving Trade Network of the Cluster of the Information Industry in Xi'an
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the comprehensive evolving model of trade network, this paper introduces the parameters of evolving mechanism for the industrial cluster network, which are got from the investigation of information industrial cluster in Xi'an, then simulates the real evolving model of trade network and discusses the evolving results of the network characteristics. The four conclusions are as follows: (1) in the real evolving network, the in-strength and out-strength, in-degree and out-degree distribution follow the power-law distribution all the way. The ratio of the long-term relationships to the short-term ones decreased at first and then increased. The network has a small average shortest-path, which presents the small-world feature. The proportion of the triangle structure decreases, but the network has an appropriate clustering, and the probability that the short-term relationships form the triangle structure is higher than the long-term relationships do, and the network has the hierarchy, and is not reciprocal. (2) The mechanism of the link establishment protects the power-law feature of the network, the small world feature and the appropriate clustering, and enhances the reciprocal feature. (3) The enhancement in the mechanism of the link deletion weakens the power-law feature, and affects the connectivity. (4) The enhancement in the quit mechanism of eliminating the inferior node just weakens the power-law feature without causing destructive effect, and improves the connectivity of the network.

articleTitle: A Content-Based Information Retrieval Model Using Non-Negative Matrix Factorization Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: During the last decade, the demand for content-based retrieval among the mass information continues increasing. Unfortunately, the traditional key words matching method has been useless. Therefore, how to retrieve the expected results in semantic level has become a tough challenge for information retrieval. Theoretically, many methods have been proposed to solve it, among which latent semantic analysis (LSA) model is the most famous one. However, while conventional LSA methods, for example singular value decomposition (SVD), do make advances in this issue, they consume large memory and generate elements with negative value in some dimensions, which is meaningless. With such consideration, in this paper, we propose a content-based retrieval model using non-negative matrix factorization method, which generates a latent semantic space representation with non-negative parts as a low rank approximation to term-document matrix. Experimental results show that our approach gets a good performance in content-based retrieval.

articleTitle: Trade Revenue Model on the Base of Comparative Advantage under Incomplete Specialization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: if the difference of productive factors volume between two countries is large engough, incomplete specialization will occur in trade. Then the gains from trade will be obtained by country with less productive factors, while country with more productive factors will not benefit from trade. The effects of increment in productive efficiency and productive fators volume under incomplete specialization are different from those under complete specialization.

articleTitle: Examine the Proposition That the Japanese System of HRM Is Moving Closer to the Anglo-American Model in the Postwar Period
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The report characterizes the Japanese HRM model, and analyses the reasons for the key transformations occurring in the model with comparison with the Anglo-American model to investigate whether or not the Japanese HRM model is moving towards the Anglo-American model in the postwar period.

articleTitle: Research of the Development Tendency of Tourism Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays, tourism is no longer luxury consumption for the ordinary people. After ten years of rapid development, the tourism in China has become a pillar industry of the national economy. Along with the development of the Internet, the online tourism is growing stronger. Many online Tourism practitioners grope for the new approach continuously, and make every effort to realize the Internet enclosure movement. Based on the research of online tourism, this paper explores its possible future development trends.

articleTitle: Does Management Turnover Improve the Performance of the Distressed Firms?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The theory of the market for corporate control argues that management turnover can improve the firms' performance. Given the institutional background of concentrated ownership structure and weak investor protection in China, we conjecture that the top executives mainly cater to the controlling shareholder lacking of independence. Consequently, top management turnover plays a passive role in corporate governance in China. Using a sample of the special treatment companies, the empirical results show that the likelihood of management turnover is negatively associated with the firms' performance prior to the special treatment, while management turnover cannot improve the firms' performance and cannot alleviate the tunneling by the controlling shareholder after the special treatment.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Index System of High-Tech Enterprise Independent Innovation Capability by Using Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With theory of technology innovation, enterprise development strategy and applying statistics applied, this paper summarizes and abstracts factors of high-tech enterprise independent innovation capability. It analyzes and modifies the factors using research and factor analysis, then makes the evaluation index system of high-tech enterprise independent innovation capability.

articleTitle: The Theoretical Framework of the Selection on Parent-Subsidiary Control Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The control of parent company has been the indispensable and most effective tool for the healthily development of the enterprise. Parent- subsidiary has developed rapidly, but the issue of control always exists, and its effectiveness can't satisfy expectation. Combining with these influencing factors: external environment uncertainty, parent strategy and subsidiary's strategy role, this paper reviews the literature about control mechanism, builds a theoretical framework about the selection of parent-subsidiary control mechanism, and extends the relationship between the control mechanism and performance based on this framework.

articleTitle: Removal of Natural Organic Matter by Integrated Vertical-Flow Constructed Wetland
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nature organic matter (NOM) in natural surface water sources not only affects the odor, color and taste of water, but also acts as a precursor of disinfection by-products (DBPs). To controll the formation of DBPs , several treatment processes or their combinations have been studied for removing NOM from water. In this study, the removal efficiency of NOM in source water using a pilot scale integrated vertical-flow constructed wetland was presented. The results show that the constructed wetland system can remove NOM effectively. When the concentration of CODMn, UVA254, UVA410, TOC and SUVA in influent are 3.67~5.44mg/L, 0.106~0.213cm-1, 0.028~0.084cm-1, 3.50~5.12mg/L and 2.31~5.24 L/mg•m, the average removal rates are 49.9%, 63.4%, 80.8%, 45.1% and 36.6%, respectively. The main organic matter in effluent is unhumic substrate. The pretreatment by constructed wetland is helpful to control the production of DBPs and may be helpful to reduce the Ames mutagenicity.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on the Transfer Motivation of Rural Surplus Labor Force Based on the Reconstruction of Todaro Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper mainly discussed the transfer motivation of rural surplus labor forces based on the reconstruction of Todaro Model. The article firstly seperate transferred labor forces into two classes: "development form labor" and "life form labor" according to the income gap between in urban and rural areas, as well as other reasons, and then induced the characteristics of each class through the empirical analysis. Further, this paper judged the realization of development objects by both classes through empirical analysis on a series of development factors' variables. This paper also brought forward relative policy suggestions in the last part.

articleTitle: The Optimization Model and Its Algorithms for Multiple Transportation Modes Selection for Single-Task in the Fourth Party Logistics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of multiple transport mode selection, the paper presents the route optimization model for single-task from one origination to several destinations in the fourth party logistics, and gives the solution of Genetic Algorithms. In the algorithms, a length-variant encoding scheme of round number is adopted to represent the selected route, and idea that keeps the best individual is used. The results of experiments show that Genetic Algorithms can solve the route optimization problem based on the selection of multiple transport modes in the fourth party logistics conveniently and effectively.

articleTitle: On the Present Situation and Developing Countermeasures of Track-and-Field Teaching in High Colleges
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper illustrates and analysizes the present situation of the track-and-field teaching in high colleges of our country. This study is carried our in the manner of synthesis; The result shows: We face the great challenge of dilemma in the track-and-field teaching in high high colleges. How to deal with this situation? This paper looks forward to the prospects for the tract-and-field teaching in high colleges. meanwhile puts forward the developing measures about the future track-and-field in high colleges.

articleTitle: Comparing Study of Route Planning Algorithms Based on Hierarchical Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Hierarchical strategy is widely used in route planning algorithms to improve the computing efficiency. Hierarchical and Partitioned A-star (HPA) algorithm and Highway Hierarchies (HHs) algorithm are two famous algorithms that use the strategy. When use route planning service, both computing efficiency and planning rationality are concerned. Some improvement was taken to make the HAP algorithm more suitable for the real road network. Then a large scale random test is taken on the road network of Guangdong Province, compare to the HHs algorithm and the planar a* algorithm, the experimental results show that the amended HPA (AHPA) algorithm is more efficient and the planning result is more reasonable.

articleTitle: Is Appreciative Inquiry Thinking Training Also Effective in Virtual Environment?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this study was to probe how Appreciative Inquiry (AI) thinking training affects individual's performance in virtual environment. Sixty eight students of a university in Taiwan participated in the study. Thirty four of them received six hours of training courses. The remaining subjects serve as the control. All subjects were administrated the Emotion index before and after the AI thinking training. We adopted ideas number, and project rating of individual performance in virtual team. Exclude the disturbance of positive and negative emotion, the ideas number and project rating in AI thinking training are higher than in the other. It also showed that AI thinking training is effective to the training of creativity in the virtual environment.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Scope Economies in Chongqing Logistics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: there is dramatically expanding in Chongqing logistics industry recent years. This article estimates the quadratic cost function with scope economies theories, and calculates "global scope economies" and "Product-specific economies of scope" to analyze the internal efficiency. The empirical findings show that from the 80% mean output level to 400% mean output level, GSE value first increases and then decreases, and there is max when it reaches 230% mean level. when the scale of chongqing logistics industry expands to 2.3 times, the velocity of increasing on scope economies reaches Maximum; if it continues to expand, the scope economies will still increase, but the velocity of increasing will be down.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis of Contribution Made by Credit on Upgrading of the Industrial Structure - Taking Tianjin for Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Taking banking institutions' short-term loans in Tianjin for example, the contribution of upgrading the industrial structure made by credit is described quantitatively in this paper through empirical analysis. It is found that the promotion of the first and the second industry development is greater and the tertiary industry development is the most prominent. Therefore, credit plays a great role in promoting the upgrading of industrial structure.

articleTitle: Exploring the Dynamic Changes of E-Business Market in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-business innovating applications have posed novel, technical, organizational and commercial challenges. As e-business market is growing very fast in China, the e-business enterprises are facing the problems of coping with dynamic environment changes and building up strong competitive advantages. It is essential to find out the current situation of the e-business market. By conducting the survey on the market leaders, this paper aims at using SWOT model to analyze the current environment of E-business market in China. By analyzing the results of the in-depth interviews, the main strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats were found out for determining the strategies.

articleTitle: Review and Prospect of Research on Organizational Citizenship Behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With global economy being integrated, organization is confronting ever-increasing competition, which requires employees in organization work in a spontaneous, active, proactive manner. Therefore it is a new direction in studying organizational management to understand motivating factors of organizational citizenship behavior (OCB) and exploring measures to motivate exhibition of OCB by employees effectively. From two perspectives of social psychology and organizational behavior, the main literatures on the study of OCB are reviewed. Furthermore, significant motivating variables which influence OCB are recognized and classified, which include individual and situational variables. At last, the limitations in existing studies are analyzed and the further research trends are suggested.

articleTitle: Empirical Analyses on Factors Influencing French Direct Investment in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on econometric models, this paper uses the related statistical data of 1990-2008 to analyze empirically factors influencing French direct investment in China by Eviews6.0 software. The result shows that the huge market potentialities and rapid growth of Chinese economy are the main driving force of French direct investment in China; The economic development level of France is an important factor of French direct investment in China ; The exchange rate between Chinese Yuan and euro has close relationship with the French investment in China. However, the impact of wage's difference, interest rate's difference, the previous accumulated stock of French direct investment in China, financial policies and other factors are not significant on French direct investment in China.

articleTitle: Comparison Research of Model Cities' Undertaking Ability in Service Outsourcing in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the adjustment of global industrial structure, the international service outsourcing industry has been developing quite rapidly in the international transfer of services. China should make full use of undertaking international service outsourcing to develop domestic economy, to enhance the competitiveness of enterprises related to services and to optimize and upgrade the industrial structure. In this paper, methods of qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis of entropy are used to make a research of model cities' undertaking abilities in service outsourcing in China and put forward countermeasures and suggestions feasible.

articleTitle: Customer-Led Online Open Innovation of Consumer Goods: A Multiple-Case Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Traditionally, studies of open innovation (OI) focused on high-tech industry. Though consumer goods industry is increasingly adopting online open innovation (OOI), managers are unclear about the trends of OOI. This study proposes a new classification of OOI in consumer goods industry: firm-led OOI and customer-led OOI, and identify the evolution trends of customer-led OOI. The finding is based on a longitudinal study of 138 cases. The results highlight the important areas that managers should pay particular attention to.

articleTitle: Research on the Role of Institutional Investors in Risk Management of Listed Chinese Companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The expropriation of minority shareholders by controlling shareholders is the central agency problem in listed Chinese companies, which will harm performance and sustainable development of listed companies. There has been an explosive development of institutional investors recent years but the governance role of institutional shareholders is controversial. This study investigated the role of institutional shareholders in risk management of listed Chinese companies by studying the governance role of institutional shareholders. By constructing a model, this study researched on the risk of listed companies and find that controlling shareholders will expropriate minority shareholders. Then this paper studied on the role of institutional investors in mitigating agency problem and improving performance and find that institutional investors can mitigate agency problem and improve performance. Our finding suggests that institutional investors can play a beneficial role in risk management and eventually sustainable development of listed companies.

articleTitle: Study on Characteristics and Management Methods of Youths' Network Self-Organization Behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper firstly clarifies the contents and characteristics of the network self-organization, and then from the perspectives of self-management and social management, it studies the two management methods of network self-organization through conducting practical research on the network self-organization in Beijing, analyzing its development status as well as focusing on its characteristics and current problems.

articleTitle: Static Traffic Grooming Mechanism Based on Quantum Immune Algorithm and Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Traffic Grooming in optical networks is one if the most important and hot problems in the area of optical network. In the static traffic grooming problem, we introduce the concept of QoS (Quality of Service); in order to minimize the network cost utilization rate and to maximize the QoS degree of the users at the same time, we apply the intelligent computing algorithm -QIA( the quantum-based Immune Algorithm) to the framework to solve the problem.

articleTitle: The Impacts of Industrial Cluster's Network and Knowledge Integration Capability on Firms' Innovation Performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial cluster's network and knowledge integration capability are important factors for firms' innovation performance .This paper studies the relationships between them with empirical research method.The result shows that both network structure and network relationship of industrial cluster have significant positive effect on innovation performance;Both internal knowledge integration and external knowledge integration have significant positive effect on innovation performance;Both network structure and network relationship have a positive correlation with knowledge integration capability.Knowledge integration capability has positive correlation with innovation performance.Network structure and network relationship have influence on innovation performance by the mediating role of knowledge integration capability.

articleTitle: Study on Strengthening Practice Teaching Base in Universities - Based on the Experience in Foreign Universities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, China's colleges and universities have some problems in the concept of education, the cooperative teaching and the teaching staff organization etc, during the process of constructing the practice teaching base. Practice teaching in the foreign universities stresses ability development, school-enterprise in-depth cooperation in building a good practice teaching base to provide students with practical conditions. Learning the successful experience from abroad, it is recommended that practice in the university education should be through the whole process of personnel training, and we should build a base for effective operation and management model, strengthen the faculty and the facilities in the base, and establish a normative system.

articleTitle: Research on VMI Coordination Management Model Based on Third-Party Logistics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) is a new method of inventory management .The defect of VMI is that responsibilities and interests of the supplier is not unified .This paper remedies defects of VMI by means of building VMI coordination management model based on TPL. This model can improve the cooperation enthusiasm of vendor and retailer to promote the effective implementation of VMI.

articleTitle: China's Gold Industry, based on DEA Efficiency Analysis of Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper uses data envelopment analysis (DEA) to analyze the efficiency of the gold industry, based on China's gold listed companies. And it has reached the conclusion that there exist significant differences in the efficiency of China's gold industry; scale efficiency and productivity has a significant positive correlation, while pure technical efficiency and scale efficiency shows a slight degree of negative correlation; most of the gold business is in a stage of increasing scale efficiency, and only a small amount of enterprises are at or near effective scale; scale efficiency is the main factor of the production and operation efficiency of China's gold industry,; this thesis puts forward suggestions and solutions based on the conclusion.

articleTitle: Study on Management of Asymmetric Information in Equipment Procurement
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Information is the foundation and platform of procurement mechanism to run smoothly. Many problems in equipment procurement is caused by asymmetric information. The paper describes the condition of information management in equipment procurement. Based on the rules and characteristics of information management, it makes analysis of information asymmetry in equipment procurement. The paper proposes such ways to solve the problem of asymmetric information as strengthening competitive negotiation, establishing information periodic report system and using e-commerce, electronic data interchange system or paying more attention to civilian programs. Solving the problem of asymmetric information may lay the scientific foundation for equipment procurement.

articleTitle: Measuring Rural Tourism Value for Money: The Experience Economy of Leisure Agriculture in Central Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the rural tourism and agricultural development, the experience economy activities of leisure agriculture have played an important role. This study applies the concept of experience economy to analyze those factors affecting the evaluation of "value for money". The empirical results show that the higher receptions of escapism and esthetics have significant perceptions. This implies that the operators of leisure agriculture might have to pay attention to the tourists' evaluation of "value for money", besides improving the tourists' satisfaction.

articleTitle: Disclosure of Accounting Information of Corporate Social Responsibility Based on Stakeholder Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Corporate social responsibility is the entity of business stakeholders in the economic responsibility, moral responsibility, legal responsibility and ecological responsibility, and corporate social responsibility disclosure of accounting information is the responsibility of corporate stakeholders' true reflection. In the framework of the traditional accounting system, this paper collect social responsibility information directly from four levels respectively:corporate interest groups, economic responsibility, public interest groups, vulnerable and moral responsibility, government's legal responsibility and ecological responsibility to the environment and disclosure through social responsibility reports.

articleTitle: Building Four Subjects Model of National Innovation System and Analysis on Evolution and Features of Chinese
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the former model in NIS and the important status of technological agencies, we divide the development process of national innovation systems into three stages which are named as Early stage, Three Subjects Mode, four Subjects Mode and then divide Four Stage Model into three periods which are Government-oriented, Universities push - enterprises pull oriented, Self-development oriented. Finally, based on the above classification, we analyze the characteristics and lessons of NIS' evolvement of China and give some suggestions since the reform. We arrived at several conclusions of tendency of the development and evolution in the futureas such as market operates, government instructs, scientific intermediary sustains, risk fund sustains and so on.

articleTitle: Study on Theater Service Model under the Condition of Technological Advance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Beginning with the conception of service encounter and using theories of interface management, this paper analyzes the features of service encounters in retail banking, hospitality industry and retail trade industry under the condition of technological advance, puts forward the concept of Forward Service Encounter and Backward Service Encounter, and then build the extended theater service model under the condition of technological advance.

articleTitle: Pricing Decision after Online Channel Introduction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Online channel can provide a chance for manufacturer to increase sales and reduce cost. Based on the consideration of the acceptance difference of online channel for consumers, we discuss the dual pricing problem after online channel introduction for the channel structure of single manufacturer and retailer. Some results are derived: Online channel will help retailer reduce retail price and increase sales. When the acceptance degree of online channel is high enough, online channel can increase profit for the manufacturer. The best pricing strategy for the manufacturer is to set a reasonable wholesale price and direct price in order to ensure no sale online. When the proportion of consumers with high acceptance degree on online channel is big, online channel can benefit the manufacturer and retailer at the same time if the acceptance degree of online channel is high enough.

articleTitle: Clients Behavior Analysis of Securities Company Based on the Web-Log Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) is a developing direction for China Security Company in the future. Relative to abroad developed countries Securities Company, our China securities Company still is in a low level for the clients behavior observation. In this paper, author introduces the data mining technology into Security Company customer behaviors information management processes. Meanwhile, through construct the clients behavior model and data mining processing to refine some high value customers behavior character information, thus, to offer accurate data supports for the company Policy-makers. Also, a real case is analyzed in this article, having a very strong reference meaning in fact.

articleTitle: Constructing Boolean Functions with Maximum Algebraic Immunity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Because of the recent algebraic attacks, a high algebraic immunity is now an absolutely necessary property for Boolean functions used in stream ciphers. For a n-variable Boolean function f, the algebraic immunity AI(f) is no more than n/2. If AI(f) equals n/2, the immune of f resisting algebraic attack is optimal. In this paper, focusing on algebraic normal form and the construction requirements of Boolean function, the conditions that Boolean function f does not exists annihator with deg(f)≤m are analysed. The sufficient conditions that Boolean function f reaches the maximum algebraic immunity are obtained¡DTherefore a new class of Boolean functions with optimal algebraic immunity are constructed, and the balanceness and count of the constructed functions are discussed.

articleTitle: Research of Data Mining Technology in Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The characteristics of e-commerce are described. The function and technology of data mining are analyzed. The processes of data mining in electronic commerce are discussed. A new improved algorithm is proposed through analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of Fp-growth association rules mining. It is proved that the improved algorithm has higher efficiency and lesser memory cost than Fp-growth algorithm by the experimental results.

articleTitle: The Impact of the High Speed Train in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: High speed train (HST) has become the dominant mode of transport on many countries, which is a technological break-through in passenger transport which has allowed to increase railways share in modal split in medium range distances, competing with road and air transport. The largest high-speed train in China was launched in November 2009, with high success according to occupancy rates and public opinion of its quality, safety and impact on regional development. This paper estimates that the HST is best designed to substitute conventional railway services on routes where much higher capacity is required and to reduce travel time, further improving the railway service, also against other modes, therefore leading to mode substitution. It is found that the environmental impacts are not clear. And the high investment in HST infrastructure could not be justified based on its economic development benefits since these are not certain.

articleTitle: Research about E-Commerce Customer Value Classification Based on Affiliations Cloud Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A flexible division method of customer value based on affiliation cloud clustering algorithm is proposed in order to solve the defects of the "hard division" about e-commerce customer value.The method puts cloud model into the qualify evaluation of the e-commerce customer value. Effectly divides the e-commerce customer value by affiliation cloud clustering algorithm and a uncertainty expression of knowledge is achieved.Experimental results show that this algorithm can describe the character of uncertainty and randomness of customer value classification.It also has perfect effect on classification.

articleTitle: Business Innovation of Third-Party Payment in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In China, the prosperous development of e-commerce, travel reservations and other industries drives the rapid growth of online payment. The business scale of China's third-party payment reached 1.0105 trillion RMB in 2010. But in order to survive, many enterprises of third-party payment adopt the strategy of low-cost, which leads to a long-term status of loss. In the market of third-party payment with similar services and single business model, innovation will undoubtedly convert into the key competitive power for success. Nowadays the strategy of centralized marketing target and the strategy of differentiation are more suitable for the third-party payment enterprises in China.

articleTitle: Research on Customer Relation Management in e-Commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer relation management(CRM) is an important management concept and technique, this paper introduces the reasons for the rise of CRM and analyzes its role on enterprise management. Through implementing database marketing and data mining strategies, based on information technology, customer relationship management may facilitate companies build long-term customer relationship, maintain customer loyalty, achieve competitive advantage and sustainable development.

articleTitle: A Business Process Reengineering System Based on AI and J2EE
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Business process reengineering (BPR) is a hotspot both in academic field and in modern enterprises.
