articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Working Pressure on Turnover Intention of New Employees
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through a questionnaire survey on new employees, this paper empirically studies the impact of the working pressure new staffs are bearing on their turnover intention. On the basis of data analysis, it discovers that the working pressure new staffs are bearing includes pressure from woke itself, organizational management pressure, role ambiguity and conflict pressure, interpersonal relationship and communication pressure, career development pressure, and personal qualities pressure. Among them, except personal qualities pressure, all other 5 types of pressure have positive influence on the turnover intention, and pressure from work itself has the greatest impact, personal qualities pressure has no obvious impact on the turnover intention. It also presents corresponding suggestions in line with research conclusions.

articleTitle: Design of Equipment Health Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is an important means of mastering equipment health rule and innovating equipment management mode to build up equipment health management information system. It resolves the core theory of equipment from several points. And it brings forward the equipment health management information system structure design and function design. It definitudes the system structure of Monitoring equipment, equipment health management dealing center, dynamic data store and management layer and two basic functions of core operation and basic management.

articleTitle: Constructing Automatic Evaluation System for E-Government
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the analysis of existing methods and means of e-government evaluation, we propose an automated,quantitative evaluation model for e-government.The purpose is to avoid the inherent disadvantages of artificial uncertain factors and time-consuming. By analyzing each stage of the model,combined with existing Web data access technology, database technology and neural network technology,we intend to establish a set of automated e-government website evaluation system.

articleTitle: Study on the Resource Base of Timber Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the perspective of industrial competitiveness, this paper systematically studied the resource base of Chinese timber industry. The concept and the categories of resources were firstly defined, followed by the meaning of resource base. The contribution of resources was then theoretically analyzed so that its theoretical basis has been expanded in view of competitiveness sustainability and marginal revenue to indicate that the development mode led by intangible resources is the decisive factor for timber industry to establish a lasting competitive advantage. Third, an empirical analysis was made on the contribution of resources systematically. By means of econometric models, this paper calculated the contribution rate of production factors of wood processing industry, furniture manufacturing industry and papermaking and paper products industry separately, revealing that tangible resource plays a leading role in the development of Chinese timber industry. Finally, according to the empirical results, the idea was put forward that the resource base of Chinese timber industry should be converted, that is, to mainly achieve the transition of the tangible resource-led development mode to the intangible resource-led development mode.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Technology Innovation Efficiency of Regional High-Tech Industry Based on DEA-Malmquist Index Approach
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By combining the Data Envelopment Analysis method with the Malmquist productivity index, this paper carries out a dynamic evaluation of technology innovation efficiency of Henan's High-Tech industries from 2004 to 2008. The results show that technical innovation efficiency of these industries is not effective. The reasons are analyzed by inspecting technology efficiency change and technological change, and some recommendations are given.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Dangerous Point Pre-Control Management System for Thermal Power Construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Dangerous point pre-control management is a branch of safe management. The accident in thermal power construction of china, death accident especially, have predominantly especially phenomenon, because thermal power construction quantities is great, the operation of upper air is many, construction contract is intricate, unsafe factor is man-made, and so on. For weightily improving safe management in the thermal power construction, accident must be kept within limits radically. After the paper analyzing the characteristic of thermal power construction carefully, the system function is showed, and the design goal of the system is confirmed, new system in the aspect of management information is developed. The system mostly makes use of the module of dangerous point management, the module of individual information management, the module of teaching and examination, and the module of safety trend, in order to realize the function of dangerous point query, management and analyses, the function of individual information query and management, the function of inline teaching and inline examination, and the function of safety consultation, mutual intercourse in safety. The system running and indicate that it reaches design request developing and applying expectantly, and enhances the safety of thermal power construction.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Management Innovation in Colleges Using Institutional Economics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Facing various impacts of knowledge economics, network technology, college industrialization, logistic socialization and financial management system reform of higher education, it is urgent to change the existing management system, concept, contents and operating mode, so as to promote the sustainable development of higher education in our country.

articleTitle: Marketing Positioning of Service Products
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on service marketing theory, this paper combines the market analysis, competition analysis with company's internal analysis, through the image positioning and product positioning, marketing principles and other practical activities, and taking the market segmentation attractiveness as the breakthrough, this paper put forward the critical and decision-making views about the status and role of positioning in marketing strategies, and proved them through practices.

articleTitle: Employability Development of Graduates in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This is trying to provide a notion on educational reform requirements in China in the light of current employability needs. After an introduction of the problem statement, this paper deals with an analysis of labour market demands for graduates, and comes up with an outline on the priority of employability enhancement. The paper continues with a thorough conceptualisation of the concept of employability and current notions on career development, and concludes with proposals for reforming the education curriculum. The paper is meant to evoke discussion and to stimulate curriculum reform efforts. This paper focuses upon current labour market demands and offers insights for educational institutions engaged in optimizing curricula.
